reviews.comment: He obviously knows what he's talking about, but did a poor job at creating an engaging lecture. Weekly quizzes based on problem sets that were extremely disconnected from lecture material, exacerbated by a lack of worked-through examples in lecture, resulting in a less than 50% average across them all. Midterm and final were much less difficult.

(This is for UC Irvine's Physics 113a class) - He is one of the better professors in the physics department. Lectures were okay with some in class activities. Quizzes were unbalanced, 5 questions for 15 minutes. Expect averages of 50% for each quiz. Exams were a hit or miss. He does give a curve but it is not significant. Chill professor also.
Tough grader

Absolutely delighted to have had Dr Abazajian for a prof. Fair exams, thorough lectures, excellent exercises and very charismatic man. Maybe a downside of reading the lecture slides verbatim at times, but he definitely goes out of his way to make sure you learn and succeed.

I have had many physics professors at UC Irvine. Some are extremely smart, some are passionate, and some are good at teaching. However, I have never met a prof with all three qualities until I had ABAZAJIAN. He is not only smart and passionate with physics, but care for his student and willing to give you second chance which saved me after poor mid

Quantum mechanics is a really difficult thing to teach, but I think Prof. Abazajian did a great job teaching a hard class. He tends to speed through lectures, but he is always open to ask questions to after class. He is also a really charming guy, he definitely stands out among the other physics professors I have had.
Professor Jones has no respect for her students. The material is not that hard, but she is unecessarily rude.

The material was not difficult she makes it difficult due to the amount of work she assigns. Her exams are super long and specific. Make sure you know everything! She provides everything you need but expects her students to only care about her class, as if we don't have other classes. Aslo shes blunt and gives rude comments.

Dr. Jones' online lectures were very useful for learning the content, and if you watched all of them and reached out for help when you need it then you could get an A pretty easily. She gave multiple extensions and opportunities for extra credit, and was very understanding of complications with assignments, both major and minor.

Coursework is 'mostly' straightforward, however she can be very rude. Took this class at 8am, so enthusiasm wasn't at the highest amongst the students first thing in the morning, so she was very cranky and often compared us to the other class. Can be helpful, but sometimes students don't want to ask.

Dr. Jones was a professor who made you work for it but gave a lot of leniencies. Her grading policies were very flexible. She is specific about what she wants, so make sure you read ALL of the directions! For online: lectures 3x/week, zoom recitations 2x/week. Recitations are intimidating, but make sure you know the topic well before presenting.
She is very rude and hard to talk to, but the class content is not very difficult. I would not suggest her.

Definitely not my favorite. Can be really rude and grades so hard. Other times she can be nice. I don't know she goes back and forth depending on her mood. Tests were pretty hard and difficult to study for. Not your best choice for 120 but also not your worst.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you have any other options for this class or 120, take them instead.
Just do not take her

Has strict standards and is pretty inflexible. She's obviously very passionate about what she teaches and tries to encourage students, but her up-tightness can be off-putting. Be consistent at putting your best effort and study hard for tests. Don't just memorize, but understand concepts as they can be applied to calculation problems.

Dr. Jones appears cheerful but is consistently rude to students. She knows her material and has great notes yet they are purposely left incomplete so if you skip class you are screwed. Assignments are graded strictly. Format her way or expect serious deductions. Tests: long, hard, confusing problem statements.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She knows her material and wants you to understand, but she makes things more complicated than they need to be, which makes things confusing. Her directions are not very specific and she is often looking for something very specific from you. She is wound really tight, which makes her come off as rude, and she is often subtly very condescending.

Dr. Jones has her flaws but she wasn't horrible. She was rude and unhelpful when I asked her a question about one of the pre-labs, but the TAs are awesome so it didn't really bother me. She did accuse one of my group mates for plagiarism when that wasn't the case, but she took it back after explanation. Not the perfect professor but definitely good

First of all - whomever wrote the one underneath was being a smartass. Dr. Jones is a very brilliant and understanding woman. Although she is tough, it is because the material is important and may sometimes be hard to learn or understand, but if you go to her, she knows that you want to be successful and she does everything in her power to help.

Shes the best professor Ive ever had. She got a boyfriend and is super nice now, she might even get married and have kids so her exams will get a lot easier! Def take her if you can because she will hype you up like no other. Go to office hours, she secretly gives extra credit to those who show up with home baked goods ;) Def take her for GPA boost

She's very controlling and picky. Always wants things her way which can be very frustrating sometimes. She seems really enthusiastic when she's teaching but scary on the inside. Kind of hard to go to her for office hours since you don't know what to expect from her. She can be intimidating.

Dr. Jones makes the most of every opportunity to roast her students. Her lectures consist of bragging about how she got a 4.0 in her chemical engineering undergrad, accusing every student at some point of cheating, and derogatory insults. She puts stuff on her exams that she has not taught before. The textbook will be your lifeline.

People complain Dr. Jones is strict. She's not. She is just plain vicious. She sent threatening emails to the entire class to report us for "cheating" because we had the same raw data as the other two people in our lab group. If our lab group of three did the experiment together, how is it possible for us to NOT have the same raw data?
This is a tough class. Expectations for the lab are high and you only have two hours to get it done. All the guest speakers, which she schedules every week, are really interesting to me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I actually really liked Dr. Jones. She talks really fast, and everything she says is important for the tests, but she's engaging and she has a lot of resources. Never ever miss a class. Study up for the tests and you'll be fine. There isn't too much work outside of class and you don't need to read the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Angela Jones has got to be one of the worst lecturers at Maryland. She often torments her students and perpetually insults them. Her exams cover almost nothing she does in class and she is so anal about the honor code. I do not recommend taking her for BIOE120 and BIOE121, but honestly you do not have a choice cause this class is a gateway course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very hard class.  Did not think I would get an A until the curve at the very end of the year.  Tends to be in either a really good mood or bad mood and it was hard to tell which you were gonna get.  Huge range on tests from F's to 98's.  Huge curve on the final of over 16 points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: NOT A FUN CLASS! The information is not really intro level biology material. A lot of math and the class is really boring because she is bad at lecturing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: If you do not have previous college level biology and college level chemistry experience this class will be very difficult and you will probably not do very well. She lets you use a formula sheet one sheet front only but this won't help too much because her exams are very specific and she tries to confuse you. Also she is very rude to her students.

She's a great professor that likes to lecture. You don't have to use the textbook because 90% of everything on the tests come from her lectures, but the book does help if lecture is too fast. Also, if she fails like a lot of people don't understand something she'll post resources on Canvas to help you learn more. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is very helpful and always answers questions clearly. She is very picky about how things are done, but that allows for the class to have structure. Not only that, she tell you exactly what you need to do to be successful in the class. She is very nice and I have also gone to her for help for internships and college planning.

Take this class if you want to be BIOE, but prepare to work for it.  If you meet with her outside of class she will try very hard to make you understand. However her exams are incredibly long as they take concepts you're probably barely familiar with and make you take them to the next level. Also she takes plaigarism more seriously than anyone.

Dr. Jones is passionate about what she teaches. She is pragmatic and a good lecturer. She is EXTREMELY helpful and is big on participation. Her tests are fairly straight forward. A few things that are frustrating: she tends to over-explain homework problems and often I don't know what she is asking and she does not follow the book - which is sad :(

If you have not taken calc 1 or chem 135 or any college bio course, you will struggle and even drop or fail. Jones is not there to explain why or how, she just tells you things and bam, you must know from there on.

Shes condescending and not very nice. I thought shed be nice because she seems enthusiastic, I was very wrong. She is not very helpful because she often cant rephrase herself. She also is really not trusting of students and makes us sign the honor pledge all the time and makes us scan our homework into elms which is annoying.

She can't convey her thoughts to the class. She forgets to say a lot of information and is very confusing. Also, if she is in a bad mood, the class sucks. She gets very strict and short tempered easily. Don't take her class.  I thought she'd be great because she's "american", but she can't reword things when you don't understand what she says.

He assigned only 6 homeworks across the whole semester and one quiz. The reset of our grade was exams. He keeps saying we need to understand the concepts not memorize the formulas, but then the exams require us to use 30+ different formulas. Avoid him if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very messy lectures. Isn't prepared. Look at old tests to pass. Would never take him again.
He is a great teacher and his exams are similar to assigned homework.

He makes you buy unnecessary materials doesn't specify which materials you need for that class. Spent over 500$ just for that class only took this class because it was mandatory for my major. All your grading is by your TA, not the professor You can't be late or absent; if you are, you can be kicked out of the class or grade deducted by 10% or more
would eat a spoon of dirt each day in order to never have this professor again
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor doesn't care for students who are financially struggling. DON'T BUY ALL YOUR MATERIALS BEFORE CLASS. You will save a lot of money that I couldn't. He also promotes his textbook, but there is no reason to buy it like he says you need to, you can get a copy from the library or online. Overall, it's pretty boring, he just goes on and on.

Professor Abrams was awesome! His lectures were engaging and the projects were challenging but fun. he gives really good feedback and I felt like I learned a lot in his class. There were a LOT of materials to buy, but that's not the professor's fault. Plus, we would be using those materials for classes in the future, not just ARCH200.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: cost of materials was insane

He's...okay? He cares about architecture and wants his students to grow and learn. He gives a harsh but helpful critique. Expects his students to casually spend 100$ A WEEK on supplies. He wants you to use specific materials yet makes no effort to make acquiring them easier. Make friends and buy materials in bulk so you can split the cost.

He's a really nice guy.  Not always the most clear, but he wants people to do well.  I think studio might be the hardest thing I've ever done, but that's not a reflection of the type of teacher he is.  I had him for 242 and the workload wasn't too bad.  He's pretty understanding if you need to miss a class for sickness or some other reason.

I  guess he's fine. I wouldn't say that he's the best teacher out there though. He picks favorites, and doesn't really understand the true culture of studio. I think this might be his first experience in teaching. and well he has a lot to learn when it comes to being the best.

Dr. Lloyd is a great and understanding professor that I would recommend to anyone. The amount of work is average and justifiable. Work is engaging and not redundant. Attendance is necessary. The final is a group project, but honestly, he's really good abt keeping ppl engaged and coming to class, and would address any issues if they arise.

Professor Lloyd is an incredible professor. He genuinely cares about his students' success and pushes us to grow as professionals. I ended up learning way more than I expected and gained a lot of useful perspective. The class did start off pretty fast with a heavier workload, but it definitely leveled out mid-semester.

If you have not taken Professor Adam Lloyd during your time at UMD, you are seriously missing out. He grades fairly, gives good feedback, and will always make it clear his criticisms are purely constructive. He genuinely makes an effort to befriend his students, and I seriously doubt anyone who has had him as a professor has had a bad time.

I hate writing (it was a requirement) but Dr. Lloyd made this class easy. This class was based on a big group project, steps to this project were completed along the semester. He gives lots of good feedback to make sure you are on track and final grade ends up being good if you consider the feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's truly great.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took her class in my frshman year and she is the perfect person to teach you basics in stat. She really helped me gain love for the subject so much so that I became AMP for her class the following year. I saw how much material she provides her students, she is very kind and very helpful. She is a really hardworking professor, do take her class!

Syllabus was clear and followed to a T which was helpful when I missed some lectures. Prof. Khurana published notes which were helpful for understanding proofs and reviewing. She spent time to ensure we understood the material. The hw and exams were very fair, no curveballs. Overall, Professor Khurana made the material understandable and enjoyable.

Dr. Khurana is an amazing professor! She makes sure to set every student up for success with the resources she provides. In lecture, she goes through and updates her raw notes with examples and more details, then provides these notes on canvas. Her exams are straightforward and similar to practices. Highly recommend!

Professor Khurana is excellent. For each topic, she delivers well-structured notes that are easy to understand. I found her to be very helpful in her lectures and explanations. She provides an abundance of practice problems in the form of worksheets, quizzes, and old exams. Her desire is for every one of her students to thrive. I loved her class.

Dr. Khurana is a wonderful professor. She provides solid notes for every topic that are easy to follow. I found her lectures and explanations to be very helpful. I frequently saw her in office hours, and often times asked questions outside the scope of the class, and she was always able to help me. She truly wants each of her students to succeed.

One of, if not the most caring and nicest professors at UMD. I had the pleasure of taking her this spring, and her exams were incredibly fair and generously graded. If you make the effort to attend lectures and engage with the material, she'll recognize it and genuinely want to see you succeed. Amazing and caring professor 10/10 would take again.

The course is organized well and Professor Khurana provides enough practice material through the homeworks and sample exams to prepare for finals and midterms. Workload is reasonable, with bi-weekly assignments. Professor Khurana is always willing to help during and outside of office hours.

Dr. Khurana is one of the kindest and most dedicated professors I've had at UMD. Her engaging teaching style, abundance of resources available to students, and welcoming environment ensure students feel confident in the material and supported. She cares about her students' success, making her an amazing professor. I couldn't recommend her enough!

Dr. Khurana is one of the kindest and most dedicated professors I've had at UMD. Her engaging teaching style, abundance of resources available to students, and welcoming environment ensure students feel confident in the material and supported. She cares about her students success, making her an amazing professor. I couldn't recommend her enough!

I had Ms. Archana for STAT100 this past fall. She was an amazing teacher, both in and out of the classroom. Her understanding nature and dedication to helping students to the best of her abilities were truly commendable. Ms. Archana will always be there to help you if you ask for it. Just try and you will have an A in this class.

Archana is nice, caring, and accommodating to students. There are bi-weekly homework assignments along with some short classwork and take-home quizzes (HW+CW+quizzes=30%). There are two midterms, each worth 20%. The final exam is worth 30%. Overall, the course content itself was not too difficult, provided that you know some basic linear algebra.

STAT401 with Dr. Khurana is one of the most organized and fair courses I have taken. She wishes her students to do well, tries her best to resolve problems, and accommodates students. The lectures are intuitive and well-planned, with the exams similar to lecture examples and practice exams. If you come to lectures you will do well in her class.

Dr. Khurana is one of the best professors here. She cares about her student's success and gives plenty of opportunities during the lectures to get extra credit. She's so sweet and takes her time to ensure that everyone understands the lesson. If you have the chance to take this class with her, definitely do it!!

I had Prof Khurana in Spring 2023. STAT100 was difficult for me. I met with Prof Khurana often and she was super sweet and helpful. The content in the class was hard but the assignments were doable. However the exams destroyed me and I ended up failing the class with a D (oh well). I have a problem with the content, not the professor she is sweet.

Professor Khurana doesn't have a great teaching style, I only understood concepts more through the AMP sessions. She does problems in class that seem easy but the ones on exams are so much harder and leave you very confused. Overall, she has a pretty lenient grading policy but just make sure to put a lot of effort into studying for exams.

Professor Khurana really cares about the success of her students. She has an accent and can be slightly hard to understand, but she posts all notes online and goes out of her way to post like 5 sample exams weeks before each big exam. She is not preaching at her students in lecture, rather, welcoming their questions and feedback.
She's so nice and makes the class so easy. She also offers so much support outside of class. Definitely take her class!!
Very accommodating to students and ensures that everyone understands material before she advances in the lecture.

Khurana is definitely one of the best math professors at UMD. She tries to make sure we all understand a topic before moving on and constantly asks for feedback. Some people complain about the class but if you actually pay attention in lecture, take good notes, and utilize the extra resources outside of lecture you will do great.

Professor Khurana was such an amazing professor! She gave us plenty of time for the homework and was always checking in to see if the workload was manageable. The content is calculus, so on the harder side for math, but she always went over the problems throughly especially if she seemed the class wasn't fully grasping the concept.
Prof. Khurana is very sweet and will usually grant extensions. She would ask for feedback in her class and actually implement it. Super kind, def recommend!

The best professor I have ever had. The nicest person ever and takes her time to go over material. Constantly asking if the workload is too much, if we need extra time and always looking to make sure we understand. Teaches the content and then takes up many example problems which is very helpful and explains why she is doing what she does.

She is such a sweet lady and if you are taking this class to only fufill your math requirement like I was, it is a breeze. Come to class though, or else you'll have to do outside work in order to perform well on her exam and quizzes though. By far one of the sweetest lectures I've had :)

First math professor that i've ever had that actually had me understand the material. She went into detail and very slowly to make sure we understood. The homework really helps you so make sure you do it. She is very accommodating often pushing back homework or quizzes if there was a situation that called to do so. Her tests were very fair too!

I took AP Calculus in high school so this class didn't seem too hard. I sometimes think she makes the content harder than it is. Her voice is a little annoying when lecturing. Make sure to do the homework as they do help you learn. Exams are exactly like the practice exams so make sure to attend the review sessions. Final is cumulative.

Professor made the class easy and her lectures were super beneficial. I never took calculus before and could keep up with her. She goes through new concepts slow and exams are almost identical to the practice exams. Also, do the review problems she sends because sometimes she'll put a review problem in the exam word for word.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Khurana is decent. She is a lenient grader, willing to give partial credit for various things. But, there is no time in lecture to actually digest the examples you are writing down before you move to the next problem.

Math was not always my strongest subject, and I did not do well in Calculus in high school, but the way she teaches the course is very clear and thorough. There is a homework assignment after every class, but they are very simple and easy to complete. Definitely one of the best math teachers I have ever had.

Professor Khurana was new to teaching BioStat I think, but she taught the material well. I had never taken statistics before her class and she made everything easy to understand and was very patient. She takes time to make sure everyone understands, and will move deadlines for projects or hw's if needed for the class. Very chill class, recommend.

Best professor I ever had as a math major. She gave a lot of detail to make sure lectures and homework were straight forward. Never any surprises. She always asked if we understand and would slow down if asked. Very kind and considerate!

She is by far the best professor Ive had. She is very reasonable with the work she assigns and is always asking for student feedback. The only thing shes not flexible with is late work, but plenty of time is given. She writes very clear, easy to follow notes. She is a very caring professor and wants everyone to do well and really understand.

STAT410 is no joke and she teaches it extremely well. She loves when students come into her office hours to ask her questions and will make accommodations if you are unable to make them. She is such a nice person and truly tries to make sure everyone is ready for the exams (which are insane). I would suggest taking her for any class she teaches!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shes so sweet and really cares about her students. She is always available and helpful during office hours. All you have to do is attend the lectures, pay attention, and when she assigns extra practice problems, do them! They mirror the quizzes and the exams. One of the best professors Ive ever had!

TA's definitely make the class. My TA was definitely less caring than the others but Archana definitely made up for it. She is very caring and understands that we have way more work than just her class (unlike most math teachers). She goes out of her way to make sure we understand something before being tested on it. Has even extended HW to help.

As a Music Major, I had no reason to take a class like this. The rumors of Calculus can be true, but only if you make them true. I dedicated a lot of time to this class. Take notes, don't skip class or discussion (fight for those test points), and do the homework. Her tests are doable too! They follow a format that you can easily study off of. :)

She is a nice and understanding professor. I went to her office hours often for help and she always answered any questions I had. She is also super responsive to emails! Wish she allowed for corrections to raise grades but she gives solutions + feedback. Stat is hard regardless of who you have but Archana makes it a bit better.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Khurana was a really amazing teacher. Her lectures aren't the most entertaining, but she's very precise and will make sure you know exactly what you need to know. She's very understanding and helpful if you need extra help. The Minitab assignments are a bit tedious, but that's really the only complaint I have.

Super nice lady. Doesn't exactly come across as the most intelligent lecturer, but you will still learn what you need to. She is very caring and will move home works and quizzes around as per requests. Easy tests.

She is a great instructor!! Take her class, you won't regret. Teaching is clear, she is knowledgeable, and she really cares about how well you learn and always ready to help you out. We became good friends after taking here class. haha. It was a great experience.

TAKE HER CLASS!! Seriously, she is so caring wants to help her students out. The material itself is difficult because stat is just a hard subject, but she clearly really wants her students to pass. Lectures are not the most exciting, but if you put effort in you can definitely get an A.

I think her lectures could be better. She goes over basic/easy material too much, and more difficult concepts too fast. However, she is available outside of class not only through her office hours but emails as well. I asked her a lot of questions on homework through ELMS and she always responded promptly!

I took stat100 with Prof. Khurana for my gen ed math requirement and it was so easy. She speaks with an accent but after a while you barely notice it, and she is so nice and always wants to give extra credit/drop low grades. Exams are exactly like classroom activities, so make sure to go to discussion and get to lecture on time.

Such a caring professor. She gets criticized a lot for her heavy accent, yet she is ALWAYS available to answer any questions or help anyone struggling. Gives lots of homework but provides step-by-step instructions for basically all of it. The class is a bit of a challenge but in terms of quality professors, Archana is your girl.

I took her class because of all the good reviews... BIGGEST MISTAKE EVER. If you intend to take her for STAT1OO please select the other professor for the sake of your GPA. If you don't have any experience with Stat, choose the other professor. She speaks to fast in lecture, and her accent takes some getting use to. Rushes through handouts & slides
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She was so amazing this semester. Constantly available outside of class for any help. She makes some mistakes during lectures but she's human and she's so sweet about it. She made the class a lot easier for me this semester. She does so many examples in class and explains everything so well. Her exams aren't that bad also. You should def take her
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: She truly wants students to do well in the course & understand material. Goes relatively slow when teaching new material to ensure that all understand. Exams are exactly like practice tests &HW is manageable. Discussion WS counted as extra cred, but quizzes once a week in discussion(some are group quiz). She does have a thick accent though.

She's super patient and won't hesitate to explain things as many times as you need. Really cares about students and genuinely tries to help you succeed. Miracles happen in office hours, make sure you go the moment you aren't sure about something. Go to lecture, extra lectures/review, and office hours, and you'll be okay!

Very straight forward in expectations of what type of problems you should be able to do. Lectures are a little frustrating as she tries to convey a lot of information to a lot of people and gets easily hung up, but holds plenty of office hours and does a great job helping you work through any problems or questions you have. Also curves ocasionally.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you're taking Math141 (or probably any other math course, really) TAKE HER!!!! It's extremely important to her that her students do well and feel that they really understand the material and she SHOWS IT!! Highly recommend attending her office hours the second you don't understand something, they're actually magical. Exams aren't too bad either.

TAKE ARCHANA! She is THE BEST professor for Math141 at UMD! She is soo caring about every student. She curved our exam score which helped the entire class a lot. She gave us bonus points, dropped our lowest quiz, group work and web assign scores, half weighted our lowest exam score, possibly doing everything she can do to raise everyone's grade.

She is very accessible outside of class, uploads around 2-3 sample exams for every exam, and held two extra review sessions to prep for the final. Lectures are straightforward, and she tells you when a question is 'very important'/will show up on the next exam/final. She also curved Exam 4, when avg was 61%. She'll extend WebAssign if ppl ask.

If you have to take MATH141, take Archana. She is a great professor who really cares about her student's success. If your grade is below average she will reach out to go over your test individually. Her tests are very similar to the practice problems she gives. Don't miss a lecture!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She can be a bit hard to understand at times, but is probably the easiest professor to take a pretty hard class in. She uploads practice tests before exams and if you take those enough until you get them all right, you will probably do pretty well on whatever exam you are about to take. Her lectures are usually just doing examples from the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Khurana is really awesome! She makes what is supposed to be an insanely hard weed-out class, into a relatively doable math class. She really explains the material and gives you every opportunity to succeed. She extends office hours during exam weeks, makes exams much easier than the other classes, and gives you so many course materials.

I absolutely LOVE this professor. She is so caring and passionate. She is one of the few professors that I actually learned from at UMD. I was someone who switched majors and did not take math for over a year, but she made the transition so smooth. She always gives you the time U need. You will learn from this class, just put in the time :).

Prof Archana is an amazing professor!! I had her first for stat400 and when I learned she was also teaching stat401 the next semester, I was quick to register for her class. She explains concepts really thoroughly and has really straightforward exams. I would completely recommend her!!! Prob with Justin she's one of the best profs at UMD

Prof. Khurana is amazing! I really like the way how she explains new concepts& how she compares them with related previously-learned concepts. One best thing about her teaching is she helps us organize lecture notes well and sums up materials which will be most likely on exams!She also gives review sessions before each exam, which is really helpful

Professor Khurana is definitely the most caring math teacher I've ever had. She really wants students to succeed and is so helpful during office hours. She will explain anything many times until you understand it. Most of the tests were fine if you study, which says a lot considering  I am not a "math person."  She is the best! Take her!

I entered UMD as freshman hearing terrible things about MATH141 (Calc II), but taking the class with Archana was a great decision. She is very approachable outside of class (eg: show her a problem/concept during office hours and she'll re-explain the entire thing) and made what is considered a weed-out course feel like a  regular class.

Dr. Khurana is definitely among one of the best Math professors that I've had. She will explain something 100 times if she has to for you to understand it. The fact that she genuinely cares is easily recognizable. Her tests are not easy, but they are not too difficult either.

Absolutely awful... just kidding! Although she may seem at first like an unapproachable professor, she is quite approachable and tends to help students out any way she can - whether it requires extending a homework assignment or helping in office hours. She genuinely wants you to succeed but it is up to you to put in the effort. Tests are medium.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: In order to succeed in her class, you have to stay up to date on notes and homework. She is really helpful and genuinely cares that her students succeed. It helps to go in to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Ignore all the other ratings on Dr. B, her classes are very difficult but she is a really good lecturer and she makes herself very accessible to students. Getting an A with her may require extra effort but it's not impossible. Lock in and learn her material, it's very worth it!
I dont think its possible to get an A on any assignment. And if you do it is probably on a hw assignment which isnt worth much and its still rare she typically gives 4/5 or 3/5 on hw.

Dr.B is nice & tries to get to know you but her class is challenging and sometimes hard because she is a tough grader and her quizzes are hard because theres so much covered in the lecture that youre busy taking notes and not retaining any info. The quizzes have trick questions and although she says she gives completion points for hw shes picky

Dr. B is a nice woman, and she actually reads what you write which is rare in college. But the SEMESTER LONG GROUP PROJECT was the worst thing Ive ever done in college. Her class had a decent bit of work and nobody ever got 100% on anything. Yet we all finished with A+ so thats good. But getting there was torture. Honestly, take another class.

Dr. B is very nice and tries to get to know all her students on a personal level. Theres a semester long project that was such a pain and honestly pointless. All we ever do is write papers. She can be hard at grading sometimes but actually takes the time to thoroughly read our work and provide us with lots of comments. Lectures are boring

Overall a pretty frustrating teacher. She rarely, if ever, provides a rubric and yet grades harshly. The subject is sometimes engaging, but the class is bogged down by so many group projects and papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. B is awesome. Taking Hlth 300 with her is amazing. She is really helpful and her tests are like her homework so if you focus on the homework you will do fine.

Professor Brown is a really kind, funny lady. She doesn't use presentations so attendance is recommended. She had us sign our names on little slips of paper for attendance. All you need to do is show up though. All the test questions are in her lectures, and exams are open note. She learns everyone's names and makes lectures fun and engaging. Queen

Dr. Brown is a gem. She's a very traditional lecturer- comes into class with her notes handwritten on paper and expects everyone to keep up with what she's saying, so come to class with typing fingers ready. She is so sweet, and very much cares about the topic and her students. I'd love to take her again!

Dr. Brown is such a caring and great teacher., and her lectures were very easy. I don't know if it is b/c it was an online course, but she gave out no homework, and our only grades were based on 3 exams and attendance to the class. This could be good or not good depending on how you do on the exams. She also talks a lot about her personal life.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is the best! Tests are super easy and right from the notes. Beware she does not have PowerPoints and you must take notes as she is talking. However, she makes sure to emphasize the important information that you will need for the test. Truly interesting class and the sweetest lady.

Such a nice person!! She truly cares about you and wants you to succeed. Show up and take notes on EVERYTHING she says (even the stories she tells!) and you will do great on the exams. 83% is the usual average for her exams, so still make sure to study! Interesting class and going to her lectures were fun :)

Best professor ever. One of the only lectures I've actually looked forward to. She does pass around an attendance sheet and doesn't have any powerpoints so you do have to show up but the lecture is very interesting and you can tell she genuinely wants the best for her students. Exams are very fair, I would highly recommend to anyone who needs 350
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is one of the most caring professors (and people) you will ever meet. You learn some interesting concepts throughout her class, and she always provides a story for each concept, keeping you engaged in class. Her class is not difficult at all if you attend class and pay attention and take a few notes. Two mandatory tests (one optional).

She is by far my favorite and easiest professor I have had thus far. Her exams are super easy as long as you show up to class and take notes. She does not post any notes, but the lectures are easy to sit through and go by fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is a great professor. She really wants everyone to do well, and teaches things you will use the rest of your life. Also, if you have KNES major issues I recommend going to her because she is always willing to help and can pull a lot of strings for you.

Dr. Brown is the BEST prof in KNES took her sport pysch class back in 05-06. class was at 8am but WELL WORTH it. exams are super ez she likes to talk about her daughters and random things which is sometimes amusing but pay attention cuz some of those random stories pop up on her exams. exams are all Multiple Choice. have to hand write all notes
Dr. Brown is a great professor in a department of difficult professors. I'm not sure if I would have made it through without her (graduate school).
Dr. Brown is a great professor in a dept. with a lot of very difficult professors. She was a great mentor to me and I don't know if I would have made it through without here (graduate degree).
lots of fun and very very hot back in the day
Dr. Auchard was truly a joy to be taught by. He was very motivational and inspirational and taking his class was truly formative in my life and my career. I would give him my highest recommendation.
Dr. Auchard is my favorite professor at Maryland.  I have learned so much from him.  Do not miss the chance to take a course from this brilliant man.

Professor Auchard is the best teacher I have at UMD thus far.  He is funny, thoughtful and entertaining- He kept the lecture interesting and insightful, and I left every class itching for the next one. I didn't read the books and I did fine, but I know people got a lot more out the class by reading the books, and most of them are short.

I rarely walked out of this class without having my mind blown. Auchard is amusing and a ridiculously talented person and teacher. It's a lot of reading but its worth it for how much you learn. Even if you don't read the books its worth it for the lectures. Don't take this as an excuse not to read, just saying, take the class.

I loved this guy. He is a little silly and doesn't want you yawning in class but he was very insightful and I am definitely taking another class with him. I think he's my favorite English teacher at this school

I had such high hopes for this class, I really did. I even liked Auchard because his classes were so interesting. However, what I can not tolerate is his condescending and harsh tone with grading. I am a very good student, however there was absolutely no pleasing this man. And the comments he made to me on papers were absolutely uncalled for.

Dr. Auchard is honestly and truly the best professor I've ever had. His lectures are engaging, his stories are great, he has a great sense of humor, and if you ask for it he's more than willing to help you.
My favorite English Professor so far. Attendance is mandatory, but his lectures were so interesting that I wanted to go.I thought his grades were really fair too.

Auchard is tough, but he's a good professor. You need to read and go to class to get by. He is very strict with attendance. He grades hard. But you'll learn a lot from him.  His lectures are really interesting. There isn't a whole lot of discussion and he doesn't grade on participation, though.

Attend lecture and you will be golden. I didn't read a single book, because I could just pay attention in lecture and auchard would go over everything that was important. He related everything to sex, which was kinda creepy, but overall was interesting.
Easiest class ever at Maryland:  That's all you have to know.
Interesting and thought provoking

Auchard is an amazing man, plain and simple. He is not only extremely intellectual but interesting as well. He makes you think about what you're reading in ways you never thought possible. I would take this class and re-read everything again simply because I would want him as my professor.
Fabulous prof! Fascinating insights into the books. Wants our input a bit but mostly just lectures and you want him to never stop.
Amazing teacher, must read in order to be successful. Papers and exams are all do-able,just be sure to take extremely careful notes during lecture. Discussions are kinda worthless.

Professor Auchard was a great professor. He can related anything to sex, which kept things interesting. Class is mandatory, sparknotes are good tools to help you understand but you need to read the book for the tests.

Professor Auchard is great at what he does. His lectures make you want to go to class. Not only are they relevant to the novels we read, it's just plain awesome to hear what he has to say. Take this class if you ever have the chance, it will be one of your best at Maryland.
one poster whined that you couldn't pass his tests by reading spark notes. boo hoo. it's a lit course, you have to do reading, moron.  auchard is the man. take his class you wont' regret it.

Prof. Auchard does amazing things with the exact language of the novels and the themes of the books. He has made me a much better reader and has made me much more aware of some major issues in modern society.  This is my favorite course.

He has been by far my favorite teacher in college! He is so intelligent and so interesting! I honestly didn't mind going to his class and didn't feel like I was sitting in a boring lecture. He really made me think!

He was very good. I like him a lot because he was very good techer. Reading in his calass was always fun. He helped me alot with my spelling and gramar improvement. I much smarter now cause of him. Hes a great techer.

He is the most amazing professor at this school. It's not that he's smart, but he's sooo amazingly wise about everything. And he tells great stories. You never even have to read the books (just sparknotes for the quizzes in discussion) BUT YOU HAVE TO GO TO CLASS. the tests are about what we went over in lecture. the paper is the only hard part

Auchard is a fantastic teacher.  He is very clear in his expectations and goes out of his way to help his students improve and perform well.  He's full of energy and engaging.  He has a wide-range of knowledge, and makes class very enjoyable.  He's definitely one of my favorite profs in the department.

Professor Auchard was wonderful!  He was funny, charming, well-prepared, and enthusiastic about his material.  I dreaded the course material beforehand, but he made me want to read and the material and consider it in a different way.  He was fair and always willing to help you out in any way.  A great guy and one of my favorite professors!
I love this class its actually interesting, if you pay attention and take good notes youll get an a or a b for sure

Look- If you want an A (well at least a B), just go to class and write down all the points he makes about certain sections of the books.  I didn't read ANYTHING and I got a B because he just askes you to repeat what he says in class for the test- then, VOILA!  Easy A.  The paper's kinda rough, but only one.  If you take good notes, take the class.
Very interesting class. He's good at what he does. Attend every class, listen and take notes and an A or B will come very easy. Probably get a B without even studying.

He is terrible. The class has one of the highest drop rates in Maryland. A very good chance you can fail because he does not go over what you need to study for the test. His notes are random. Not on powerpoint, its like he is just having a conversation. And the test do not measure general knowledge. They give you exact irrelvant quotes.

I have no idea what everyone is talking about. 241 is a breeze. If you read the books (and they are all easy reads) you will do fine. I got an A on all of the tests and quizzes and I didnt study a second for any of them. If you can read youl do fine. he is interesting and he moves from topic to topic quickly but also gives lots of nice detail.

The class is not easy at all. I think people post how easy it is so his class get  full.  The class has one of the highest drop rates at UMD.  The quotes are so specfic that you can not read sparknotes . They ask you to read a book a week. The class is awful . Plus a  quiz every lecture. And the TA grades the exams. They are usually on a agenda.
actually enjoyed attending classes, very entertaining and little work. very understanding and nice guy
Oustanding professor and human being. One of the strongest influences on my academic career and outlook on life in general.
No Comments
Great guy, amazing teacher.
Good teacher! Interesting class. Def take if you need a engl credit or like reading novels.
He will truly amaze you with his insight and humor. He seems like the stereotypical quirky english teacher, but can talk about ANYTHING if you approach him. Very fair and simple grading system.
Great Teacherrrrrrr!!!
All around good time.  He's a good professor and a really interesting guy.  Read the books/sparknotes, go to lecture, and you will get an A in this class.
One of the besy professors I've had, very passionate about teaching
amazing teacher, really cares about the material
No Comments
This was the easiest class I have taken at Maryland.  The only thing is if you don't like to go to class, particularly discussion, don't take this class.
The best class I have taken at College Park.  He is funny and keeps you interested.  I like the way he relates present day ideas to those of the past.
Patient, thoughtful, and possessed of a remarkable memory; Professor Auchard was a GREAT adviser.
Amazing. He actually makes reading and lit interesting. And he knows his Sex and the City.
HE WAS HOT HOT HOT. IF YOU LIKE HOTTIES, TAKE THIS CLASS!! YOU WILL BE DROOLING YALL!!
Probably the kindest person on the face of the earth, and absolutely gangbusters as a prof.  Also, he tells a lot of stories, and he has the worlds most soothing voice.

Professor Auchard is funny. This year's class was basically one huge discussion. We spent most of our time listening to his stories. Only two tests and a paper. However, Fall 2004 there will be sections and he might give reading quizzes.
Great teacher in every way.  No explanation necessary, just take his class!

I found his lectures very clear and easy to follow, even when the material was challenging. The course covers a lot of content, which is expected, but it was presented well. I appreciated the fair exam structure with two midterms, a final, and an optional third exam.

Excellent lecturer; he really focuses on developing intuition for the material, which is most important for an upper-level math class. There's only a couple exercises from Fitzpatrick every week, and exams mostly pull from HW questions and practice problems.
Very fair Professor. Great Lecturer, dilutes difficult concepts into intuitive explanations. Make sure to understand practice problems relevant for each exam.
Very fast writer but good professor. 3 exams and a final with the lowest dropped. Exams are fair and explanations are clear.

Dr. Berhanu is a great professor and very generous with grading, dropping the lowest of three midterm grades. The course followed its textbook (available online) closely and sufficient practice problems and in-class review was given for each exam. Attendance was recorded but did not contribute to grades (although it should be treated as mandatory).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Highly recommend this professor. Very good at explaining the topics and making sure students understand the definitions. Exams are very fair, too.

Professor Berhanu is great. I could clearly see his passion for the subject, and it shines through when he teaches. Sometimes he doesn't explain all the moves he makes, which can be confusing if you get lost in proofs easily like me, but otherwise he is very informative and engaging professor that I would gladly take again.

Prof. Berhanu knows how to teach mathematics well. His teaching style is very direct, but it works well because he's good at explaining things. He very clearly has a passion for the subject, which makes the lectures more engaging. He prepares you well for the exams, and gives good feedback on them afterwards.

Professor Berhanu is an excellent math professor. His love of the subject is apparent in his lectures and gets passed on to his students. He explains difficult concepts in a way that makes them easy to understand. Exams are very fair, and directly related to what is taught/practiced in class.

Easily the worst professor I've had during my time in college. The class was moved to be asynchronous just before the start of the semester, which I totally get, but it's like there was no attempt to accommodate. Recorded lectures run 3x longer than the allotted class time, feedback is super unclear, and the required trips don't work in this format
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Boring material. You will not learn anything related to art history (not her fault, just the course itself). This actually did feel like a waste of time because I will not use any of this material outside of this class. Prof is OK - she can be passive aggressive. Just do your work on time and show up and you'll be on her good side.

If you enjoy learning history by listening, Honig is a great storyteller. Don't skip - the class isn't hard as long as you pay attention in lectures. Be very organized with your notes and pay attention to details. The essay prompts are a little bit convoluted but they are not indecipherable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: First time Ive had a professor who makes me want to drop out of college. Her prompts are an essay themselves. I have no idea where to even start on papers. She speaks/writes vaguely. Her wording isnt the clearest and very confusing at times. It doesnt help that shes a harsh grader. Save yourself and find a better prof. Good luck!

AVOID at all costs. What she wants is never clear and no matter what you do, your work is never good enough. To top it off she is a harsh grader and what you read never ends up being discussed in class. She belittles you and picks at every statement you make. Worst teacher ever.

Exams were very difficult, professor stated he didnt care about students, he would often say to learn just use the book instead of actually explaining it to us during lecture. He made exams worth 85 percent of your total grade, 45 percent coming from the final alone.

His handwriting is messy, his lectures are unintelligible, nothing's recorded (so you can't visit it later), and the only homework assigned is 20-40 questions for each section of the textbook. Nothing is checked/graded, there's no practice during the discussions. Just quizzes and two exams, which were harder than the given material. Avoid this guy.

Avoid this professor if you can. His lectures consist of proofs and never really cover important topics. I learned more through youtube videos and TA for the course. On top of that, the final was worth 45% of the grade, dropping my 98% down to an 80%. The test had topics that were never covered by the professor and were harder than past exams.

Take Brosnan's class if you are very good at learning information on your own, have taken the class before, or can learn from online materials. Going to lectures is not enough to do the homework and certainly not the tests. Know that he rarely knows what information is on tests or homework and he doesn't go to his own office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Brosnan is really fun guy. For non-math majors, his lectures are hard. They are full of proofs and few examples. I watched Justin's lectures on YouTube and had less of a headache. We only had 2 exams which were the easiest out of all of the 241 professors this semester. If you do the homework, you will do fine on his exams and TA quizzes.

Brosnan is an outstanding guy, he cares about how his classes are doing and is very approachable in case you need help. Unfortunately, sometimes his lectures get off track and he gives a lot of proofs that you don't really need to succeed. His midterms are pretty easy though. Study before the final and you'll do great.

Horrible lectures but there were no surprises on the test. All exams were straightforward but hard. Would not recommend, but if you are someone who can learn math easily by themselves, not a bad option.

Basically makes 141 doable. It's a very hard class with tons of material to cover, but Brosnan is a solid lecturer and makes the midterms relatively easy. The final is another story and it's worth 40% (!) of the final grade. But generally he is nice guy (drops a midterm some quizzes and HW, and still curves at end) and will help you through Calc 2.

He cannot teach calc 2 at UMD to save his life. Lectures are not helpful and he is very bad at articulating information. I wouldn't wish a semester with him onto my worse enemy. Test were difficult and the curve was not that great at the end. If you have to take him just try to go to GSS and teach yourself and you'll survive.
A really nice person but can't communicate concepts well to students in his lectures
Cannot teach for his life. Goes over how to get theorems but not how to use them. Unable to answer questions and communicate coherently in general. Would not take again.

Brosnan is a really great professor and a really great guy. His lectures can be really entertaining despite the dryness of the material, and very often he'll mention things from other areas of mathematics to spice up the stuff we're covering. On top of this he's really approachable and answers questions well.

He seems like a really genuine guy. His lectures  can get a bit dense, with a lot of proofs you don't need, but make sure to memorize the really important theorems, because you'll need to regurgitate them on his tests. That being said, compared to most 140 teachers, he's a  very easy grader. The averages on all of the tests was in the high 80's.

Dr. Brosnan is a solid professor. He goes into detail on topics, and explains the proofs and theories behind how they work, which can often frustrate students who are only trying to get an easy grade (and not necessarily fully understand the material). He grades fairly and makes jokes occasionally. He's definitely a brilliant guy.

His lectures were hard to follow at times, and he focuses a lot on proving the math that he's teaching, but his tests were easy and the class was curved!  This class was rarely the cause of any stress.  Funny guy, too.

He's a respected professor. He's good at teaching but only just good I think Steven Chadwick is a much better choice. But the advantage with Brosnan is his exams are pretty easy and on top of that he always curves his grades at the end of the semester. That is a very big plus point
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He's really great! He really challenges people's ideas in ways that make you think deeper about your opinions. Attendance definitely matters, but he's a great teacher!

West Virginia University - History of Economic Thought (Graduate level)
Dr. Kogelmann is engaging and personable. Gives great feedback and lectures that are interesting, relatable, and informative. He is far more interested in what you LEARN than what you already know.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: (West Virginia University) Dr. Kogelmann is my favorite professor that I have ever had (I am a senior graduating in the spring). He is very personable and engages with his students in a variety of ways. He shows care for his students and makes them be actively involved by trying to get their opinions. Please take his classes its the best!

Brian is awesome, just a really good teacher and brings a more casual feel to a philosophy classroom as compared to older instructors. Lots of reading, 2 question quizzes for each one, and two papers that you can ask for feedback on as many times as you want until the due date. This professor wants you to do well & is genuinely amazing
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is probably my favorite professor I have ever taken. His lectures are super informal and engaging and explain the readings super clearly. I respect his manner of grading, 2 papers and 2 question quizzes on the reading (easy) before class. There is always class discussion based on our thought process. I wish he taught more classes!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was the most engaging lecturer I've had in college. Awesome Class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: It was a lower level class so it wasn't very demanding. He gives quizzes at the beginning of every class about the reading for the day. It is just one question that you can usually just guess without actually doing the reading. Overall he is just a cool guy that knows a lot about environmental philosophy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: LOVELY LOVELT POPS

Proffesor Aruoba 402 course was difficult. There were problem sets given, but you could collaborate with others, which is good. The tests were challenging, but the curve he provides at the end is quite good. Although challenging, this course is interesting.

Prof. Aruoba is not an easy Professor. The problem sets took some effort and discussion sections were mandatory (attendance was checked). He covered more material than the other prof. teaching that term. Exams were tough and graded harshly in my opinion.  Class was heavily curved. My grade was based on my exam scores being well above the averages.
Terrible
terrible... awful...

Class was taught mainly from power point slides, which explained concepts better than the book did. Was very helpful in class, but the tests were very difficult and did not reflect what was stressed during lecture. Got a 77 on the 1st midterm, 52 on the 2nd, 37 on the final..and got a C in the class, which shows how much he curves.

Bad teacher and bad class. Do not take this professor. Not only is the course material difficult, he is a poor teacher, whose exams are EXTREMELY difficult. Save yourself from wanting to shoot yourself!!!
Difficult material but good teacher. Slow lectures. Discussion attendance required. Just takes time- hours of studying but pays off.
He is very smart but a bad teacher. His tests are unfair and he is very unhelpful. Also has no ability to answer questions clearly.
Very thoughtful, kind, and upfront about expectations. Love to have a prof who is actually approachable and makes you feel able to ask q's
She is great. Accommodating and fair grader
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: if you've never used digital technology or are not a health comm person this class can seem overwhelming at first. there are a lot of assignments. professor b was really responsive to any questions though and was able to clearly explain anything I was having trouble with
Great teacher
Professor B is awesome!! Its clear she cares so much about students doing well. Material was actually interesting and useful. Would def take her again
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You really need to read the book and watch the videos he provides. NEEEED to participate in lectures for credit. The final was definitely a bit hard, but was expected. Overall good professor. learned a lot thats for sure!
Professor Humberto tries to scare students with participation, but the lowest grade that he will give you is an 85. He genuinely wants students to learn and emphasizes important topics in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: participate participate participate! he includes it in his grading and will love you as a student if you do. he has random pop quizzes in his lectures like every other class, and whoever answers first gets extra credit. 10% extra credit for the exam if you give a presentation (rlly helpful). handful of quizzes (pay attention in lecture, skim book)
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He acts really hard on participation, but if you show up and talk a few times you'll do fine. All quiz and test questions are on Quizlet, wish I knew that at first, probably would've gotten a higher grade. Only graded on a few things, so if you fail a quiz you're not looking great. Does give extra credit for a presentation - definitely do it.

TAKE NOTES AND READ THE BOOK. He gives quizzes on every chapter on the next class after he finishes the lecture, and an exam every 4 chapters. He says that they quizzes and exams will be easy, but THEY ARE NOT. The questions are confusing, and you must know the EXACT answer or you will get it wrong. There are a lot of "It could be this or that" ans
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr.Capp came off as unbearable this semester (Spring 2026). He is very harsh in his comments about you graded assignments, makes jokes about failing the class constantly, and grades things very slowly which is unhelpful because the assignments build off of each other. The course is designed around his opinions rather than the content so good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Capp is one of the most knowledgable and engaging professors I ever had. His lectures are full of humor and he explains topics in a way that really deepens your knowledge of BCHM and the scientific process in general. As a class, his tests are long, but fair difficulty wise, and has sporadic participation Qs called TopHats to be aware of.

Dr. Capp is very nice and respectful towards his students. However, I can honestly say this was by far the most difficult class I took at UMD. There is a lot of information, but Dr. Capp tried his best to make it as understandable as possible. The exams are very hard and they constitute 80% of your grade, so do not blow off any of them.

Probably one of the best professors I've taken. He really cares about his students and is willing to help if you ask him. As a grader, he's very tough, but in a good way. Gives constructive criticism in order to improve your professional writing.

Dr. Capp is hands down one of my favorite professors at UMD. I was so afraid going into biochem, especially since 463 is considered one of the hardest classes for the bio major here. But this man made the content easy to understand with really funny and memorable analogies, and he is so approachable during office hours.

Dr. Capp was fantastic! I retook Orgo 1 with him Summer 2020. I wish he could teach all my Orgo/Chem lectures! His humor was greatly appreciated while learning a subject that can be rather tedious. He makes great analogies to help you commit things to memory and is a fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I never thought I would enjoy orgo so much until I met Capp, he actually made me interested in the subject and is straight forward with what is needed for the exams. The only thing is for the exams, he puts a lot of info packed into the exam which will make you feel like you're being rushed for the exam. But it was a fair exam overall

Capp is honestly a pretty great guy. He tries to teach us concepts in a way that we can understand easily. He's also really funny and is always open to explain something if you don't understand. His tests and quizzes are really hard though. just to give an idea they're 10X harder than practice problems gone over in class and not enough time

Capp is a great professor and extremely hilarious. He explains concepts really well and takes his time during office hours/discussion to explain problems so you can understand. way too much effort for a low level gen ed

took her for mgmt 4010 at tulane. beware. beware!!! I do not wish that upon my worst enemy.

Professor Conover is fantastic. She's always going around class to each student to check up on them and offer help. The projects are fun and she really helped me improve my art. She also gives a lot of free materials! Would 100% recommend.
literally amazing, also the art advisor so she can help you if you randomly have questions

Words can't describe how amazing Professor Conover is, and how dedicated she is toward each and every single one of her students. She helped us succeed and gets along well with us. Taking her class also helped balance the stress from other major courses.

Prof Conover is one of the best art profs at UMD, and that's saying a lot given how great the whole dept is. She is so considerate and laid back, but that doesn't mean you can slack off! She truly wants you to succeed and will be your friend and converse about life with you. I highly recommend her as a professor and as a mentor.
I had Professor Conover for ARTT210 and signed up for ARTT320 because I loved her so much! She is very sweet and helpful. She gives good feedback and tries to keep you as stress free as possible.
She is a fun and helpful teacher. She is also the sweetest. She makes the class more stress free. One of my favorite professors!

Very amazing and knowledgable professor, as well as a native Spanish speaker. Assigns nightly but short homework and two writing assignments throughout the class. Mandatory attendance, no tech policy, but there's good reasoning behind it.

She is a professor who genuinely cares about your success and wellbeing. She is understanding if things come up, and is super helpful if I have questions and confusions. The class is entirely in Spanish but she is clear about all instructions and speaks slow enough to understand.

Chila is a great teacher. Everything is very well laid out in the assignments and she clearly loves her classes. The content isn't too bad and she gives full study guides, printed out, for use. The readings are pretty simple as well. There's a few movies but they usually are in English or have subtitles.

You could tell that Professor Hidalgo really wants you to succeed in her class. She is very willing to work with students to improve and is very encouraging. While she does grade on participation you never feel judged for how good your skills are. I would love to take another class with her.
She's very sweet and understanding. Absolutely loved taking her class. She makes participation very easy and speaks at an understandable pace.

Sweetest woman ever. Classes are easy enough. Make sure you do the hw b/c she calls on everyone to read their answers. The only downside was that here quizzes/exams were super hard. I don't really know why- I'm good at Spanish and always do well on tests- but I struggled all year for a good grade on them. Don't let that stop you from taking her!
I loved her so much. She was so kind and genuine. She made us all laugh in class. I would 100% recommend her.

She is such a caring professor! She truly wants her students to learn the language since she understands the struggle of learning another language. Attendance is basically mandatory, and so is homework, but very honestly it's great practice. She also has a great sense of humor, which makes a class with potential to be boring, much more bearable.

Chila is the nicest professor I have had at UMD. She's very caring, gives good feedback on homework, and is always willing to help students. She's Colombian, so her accent takes a bit to get used to. Like all Spanish classes at UMD, there are attendance policies she has to enforce, but she is understanding of outside circumstances.

Definitely very caring and understands that learning a second language is difficult. She assigned a few activities for homework each class and told us exactly what the content and format of quizzes and exams would be. The class was easier than my high school spanish classes.
Professor Hidalgo was great! She was very caring and liked to engage us. She was personal and kept class interesting. There was a lot of homework but if you did the work, the class was pretty easy.

AMAZING! Best professorr! She reminds me of a teacher you'd have in high school. It's so hard to find a professor who can actually connect and build relationships with students. She gives homework every class, which is easy, then goes over it in the beginning of every class. Participation really matters! She does great reviews before test as well

Senora Hidalgo is a great professor. I really learned a lot from her class and it was pretty easy. No taking notes, only daily homework that took less than an hour. Honestly show up to every class, do the homework, study a little for the exams, and participate and youll get an A.
The Best

literally most boing lecturer ever. she expects you to remember so so much specific content, you get cheat sheets but they dont help. material is poorly organized or clarified to what is crucial information or how it flows together.  the material itself is a lot and rather boring, she tries to make it fun but just such a boring class

Carleton is a great lecturer and you can tell she's very sweet. The syllabus says she doesn't curve the class but she did in my class (Fall 2024 semester). I had an 95 that got curved to an A+. Clearly enjoys both the teaching aspect and content of her job. She knows the material really well and genuinely hopes that you're interested. I find that her lecturing is really clear as are her expectations for the course. She is also flexible with grading--I've had her for two courses and she's provided opportunity for extra credit in both.

Dr. Karen is a good professor who really cares that students do well. The course covers a lot of dense material and the tests were somewhat tough, but nothing unmanageable. Dr. Karens teaching style is unique to say the least. I found that the lectures were very unorganized and hard to follow. Dr. Karen has a list of people who would question their grade during the semester who will receive points to boost their final grade. Exams are fair and reflect lecture content. This class was asynchronous except for the GAE. Dr. Carleton is very passionate and knowledgeable, and going to office hours will help.

Dr. Karen is a gem. Your grade is mainly from the exams but they are graded fairly and not too bad if you watch all the lectures and attend the GAEs. The homeworks and concept checks were basically free points to boost your grade bc there were unlimited attempts. She really knows what she's talking about and makes BSCI 207 more enjoyable.

One of my favorite professors! While the material can be a little dense, she does a great job at making it understandable and is clearly passionate about what she teaches. She's super caring, friendly, and encouraging outside of class. TAs were great too. Exams are a little tricky but manageable. Take her class! You won't regret it

Dr. Carleton was very supportive of students in her class. She really made an effort to engage us in a course that covered a wide variety of topics, and I genuinely looked forward to attending class. She was always willing to discuss topics outside of class and showed a genuine interest in all her students.

Solid professor. You can tell she loves biology. HW every 1.5-2 weeks. Study the slides for exams. reviews.comment: My only problem was that Dr. Karen wrote the most oddly worded questions. I would understand the concepts but miss questions because they were written with word grammar and word choices. She's really understanding and nice so get to know her!

only participation is with a few small group assignments, but theyre for completion. Professor Carleton is really nice and really caring. The class of BSCI207 itself is really terrible and annoying, but she tried her best to help her students. She gives a lot of assignments, but they work and help you learn. She makes learning in an online environment effective without overwhelming you. I really enjoy her class and you can tell she is a kind and caring person. I have taken her twice and she makes my day better!

Dr. Schull is the nicest professor ever, she cares about her students a lot her class is a stress relieving class, she makes sure her class isn't going to affect your mental health, her assignments are super easy, the material is interesting, and book club is mandatory but not hard at all.

The 3-week summer class was very easy as long as you kept up with the work. A paper was due 5 days into the class and another due 6 days later. I had class MWF. Two classes were on campus at UMD and one class was online. I didn't buy the book and have an A. The exams were very easy. She is a great speaker not boring at all.

The way Dr. Schull creates her syllabus plan is very helpful. I learned so much from her Violence in Families and Children in Families classes. I took Violence in Families & Children in Families with Dr. Schull & she is SPLENDID. I was extremely engaged all semester in both classes. GREAT TEACHER

this was an easy class. pretty much fill in the blank on the slideshows which can be downloaded from blackboard. attendance is somewhat mandatory because she has activities given out randomly. i didnt really use the book mainly just for the weekly responses.
she is very strict and not cool at all. she has weird rules about being in class on time but she is always late to class herself. she does not curve

I thought she was very nice, she requires a lot of work and mandatory weekly postings which I found to be quite annoying, but she is willing to curve and you'd have to be very stupid to not get an A or B
Great prof! Easy class, just show up and listen and you should be able to get an A. Test are not hard as long as you've paid attention. Never used the textbook, don't bother with it.
just go to class .. listen to what she has to say. she speaks kinda fast but u can get her notes on webct so make sure u got the print outs so u can jot notes down

Dr. Karol is a fantastic professor - I cannot sympathize at all with these negative reviews. You will learn more from him than any other professor in the GVPT department - and his classes are not at all difficult.
