Even though i dropped the class immediately after syllabus day, I heard horror stories from this class from those who took it. Glad I made the right decision. The fact that he knows his field doesn't guarantee his ability to teach it.
Walk away from this class.

Im a history major so I'm a bit biased. I took this class for HIST319P and HIST419P and received a 98% in both classes. He is a very kind professor but there is a lot of reading so be prepared for that. But, he will help you in any aspect that you need just ask.

Took his course for my senior seminar and learned A LOT. I found it to touch on other topics that I was covering in other European history classes so it helped me immensely.  

He's incredibly nice and a great lecturer.

He is a nice guy who is very accommodating of people with potential issues, and with that being said, I think the lectures are very informational and interesting overall. I had Moctezuma during Summer 2023. He is a very nice person, and he shows that he cares about his students. Only complaint I have was that the labs were poorly worded.

This wasn't too bad of a course to fulfill a gen-ed. There's a quiz after each lecture reviewing the slides and an external reading/movie on the topic. There's a 3-page paper due at the end of the semester requiring you go to the US Botanical Gardens and 3 exams. A fairly easy class over all for people that don't do well in bio like me.

Prof. Moctezuma is great and makes the class interesting. Grade relies on good test scores but online quizzes definitely help boost. Also, make sure to attend lab because its a lot of points and they are all easy and never last as long as they are supposed to. SO FUN! Took this cause it was "the easy lab gen-ed" but genuinely had a great time. He's super kind, fun, and knowledgeable. Labs are mandatory but easy to get 100s in. There's an online post-class quiz after every lecture (easy), and a pre-lab quiz before every lab (easy). 3 exams (easy), just study for a few days before. I highly recommend it!

Professor Moctezuma is one of the nicest professors I've ever had. He's very passionate about what he teaches, and he shows that he cares about his students. My biggest complaint is that the labs are poorly worded and are thus very confusing. Another thing is exams are purely memorization based; I didn't do horrible on them, but also not amazing.

Took BSCI135 as a gen-ed science lab and would recommend it. Interesting class and labs are so easy. Exams are basically memorization of his lecture slides, but not bad. Professor Moctezuma is one of the best professors Ive had so far, he is extremely knowledgeable and you can see how passionate he is. Going to lecture is key to getting high test test scores but theyre very interesting and he keeps it fun. 100% would recommend this class for non-science majors who dont like math and high workload

Hes a good guy but the exams are a lot of the weight of the grade, more than most gen eds. Theres extra credit opportunities . Great professor!

*Took this class online because of Covid. Prof. Moctezuma was a really nice and caring professor. Very responsive to emails and his lectures were very enjoyable and I didn't zone out very much. Would definitely take another class from him again.

So a lot of you guys say that hes a bad professor but hes not I know for sure that he gives all the right answers and all the right exclamations one of the things that are really the best about him is that he takes No time for people that havent finished writing down the notes yet but overall hes a wonderful teacher hes very funny and sweet.

Take this class... if you hate yourself. Moctezuma was a heck of a nice guy but an unbearable professor. He compiles 400-500 lecture slides together for the tests and theyre super hard. Really nice guy but his class is not good. He reads straight from the slides and then expects you to memorize every powerpoint (usually 45 slides) and tests you on that.

I really liked Prof. Moctezuma, but I honestly wasn't a fan of the course. He is very funny and full of cheesy jokes, and the lab was really easy. Professor Moctezuma is super nicer and really cares about his students. However, the test were incredibly hard and he was not able to help us. More specifically, there were no curves in the class and your test grade is final.

I really wanted to like this class because he is seems like a sweet guy, but his expectations for non science students are through the roof. reviews.comment: I came in not really caring about the subject, taking it only to fill a requirement. I highly recommend you take the class, if only for him

Way too much information for a course intended for non-science students. Your grade is only based on 4 100 point tests which require ridiculous amounts of memorization. Save yourself the trouble and take geography for your lab instead of this.

impossible tests, I don't know why everyone says its so easy because its not. grades only based on 4 exams. tests are so specific

Moctezuma is a great dude. Material isn't necessarily easy, but you can get As on exams if you study reasonably hard. LOTS OF EXTRA CREDIT boosted me by two whole letter grades. Probably best way to fulfill lab natural science credit

I nearly spend no time on my requirement course like math 140, but I often get A or A+ in the exam and my professor's paper is the most difficult one. However, this course is just a opitional course. Took this class for a Gen Ed and loved it! Professor Moctezuma is awesome

Pretty chill professor. All we do in class in powerpoints

understands that not everyone wants to me there, but makes the class as fun as possible. he's goofy, and gives extra credit for attendance/quizzes. you'll need to study for each test, but there are no cumulative midterms or finals. overall, if you need your CORE lab science, this is a great class to use.

Moctezuma is the perfect professor for this class. He understands that 98% of his students are only taking him for core so he opens up his semester with "I know you guys are only here cuz you have to be, so I'm going to make this semester fun for you guys and maybe youll learn something too"
Moctezuma is a beast

Dr. Ebrahimian evidently cares about the success of his students, and is always willing to answer questions. Ebrahimian is the goat. He has really good lectures and made calc 2 super easy to understand. He also has amazing fashion sense. As long as you go to his lectures you will be fine in this class.
The best math professor. Everything was explained really well. The quizzes and exams are fair, and the homework can make you learn a lot.

MATH410 is an extremely difficult class but Ebrahimian did his very best to make it as understandable as possible. He genuinely cares about your ability to succeed in the class and does his best to listen to students' requests. If prof. Ebrahimian is an option for MATH241, please take it under him. Calc III became a very fun class with him, I felt I was studying the material more for the joy of learning rather than to get a good grade in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had, and I've had some amazing professors at the university. He teaches you exactly what he assesses you on in the quizzes and exams. reviews.comment: Very accommodating professor with very realistic standards and expectations. If you do what is asked of you, and study an average amount, you could earn an A. This man is very good at explaining what he is doing and answering your questions. He makes the high level course feel like a breeze and makes exams and quizzes very doable. Definitely would recommend signing up with him if you have the chance.
was pretty good professor but the HW were hard but not really his fault as the math department assigns them so do practice problems from the book and watch alot of partick jmt

Great all around lecturer. His tests from my experience were harder than other professors but prepares you for the final. Gives a ton of good practice exams and prep before exams.

He is a very good teacher and listens to what his students needs. When I took the class he changed some of his grading policies by dropping more quizzes for example which helped a lot of people. He is also generally a good teacher especially that he tried to explain everything very clearly.

Straight-forward, easy tests with many practice sample exams. I had a great TA so lectures felt unmandatory; however, the one time that Professor E was absent, the whole classed missed him very much. He is a funny guy that loves math more than any person you will ever meet.

reviews.comment: Ebby is a fantastic professor. Calc 3 can be hard, but his lectures make everything very clear. He was always in a good mood and liked to make jokes. His exams are fair and there was a quiz every week in discussion. I wish I could have him for every math course I have to take.

Dr. Ebrahimian is such a good professor. He explains concepts so clearly and succinctly. Ebrahimian is the best math professor I have had. He explains everything very well and offers a lot of opportunities to get help through office hours. He grades really reasonably and frequently adds humor throughout his lectures

reviews.comment: Calc 3 is super fast paced but, the concepts are not very difficult. Usually he'll introduce one topic do one example and then move onto another topic and do the same thing. As a freshman taking calc3 i think i got very lucky by having him my first semester. what a god

Pretty good professor. He explains the content really well. Makes sure to demonstrate tougher problems during lecture. Exams correlate with difficulty of of practice problems. If you don't do the homework you'll have a hard time. A good TA really helps. Adamant about no curve. Averages on first exams are 80+.

Calc 3 is not an easy class, but Dr. E explains difficult topics very clearly. He assigns homework but it is never checked. Do the homework and use the solutions manual. He was amazing. He made me fall in love with math. No his class is not easy, but Calculus 3 by nature is not "easy." Professor Fenlon is very enthusiastic about her subject matter and her enthusiasm is infectious, making what might have been a dull class for me actually interesting! She is very eager to help students and answer questions, and she genuinely cares that her students succeed.

Professor Fenlon is very understanding and caring. The way she teaches content is very engaging, and she gives students a limit of 3 extensions per semester. In addition to that, if you visit her office hours she's very helpful and will provide valuable feedback.

Professor Fenlon is very understanding, she gives extensions on every assignment if you need it and provides great feedback, and encourages you to resubmit your assignments again. Overall she teaches well and it's a great class to take with her.

Professor Fenlon is an amazing professor! She teaches digital curation really well and makes it interesting for people who are taking the course as both a required credit or an elective credit. She's a great professor, very caring and provides amazing feedback. Her hands-on activities were interesting and stimulating. 100% recommend her.

Dr. Fenlon was a pretty good professor. She tried to make class engaging by doing a lot of in class activities. There's a lot of group stuff. Test and quizzes are all online and open note. Material is not that difficult. I barely went to class and still ended with an A

Honestly? The only issue I had was he was extremely fast in lectures. While the textbook is NOT mandatory, I'd recommend reading it to follow up on the lecture. He moves fast.

He is really understanding and helpful if you need it. His lectures are engaging and he posts them after, which is very helpful. The exams are hard, but the review materials he has really help with studying for them. He also has lots of assignments that can boost your grade.

If you are thinking of a class to take for a GenEd for the lab credit RUN!!! This class will take up most of your time and the test are kinda tricky if your not majoring in bio/any other natural science. I thought this would be a manageable class based on these reviews and now I'm struggling to get a C-/ Dont do what I did/ good teacher tho.
Great professor and very kind. I liked that he records his lectures so you can go back to watch them multiple times. His tests can be hard to study for since they cover a lot of material.
he's just always so jolly
One of the best professors at UMD! He is amazing.

I would def recommend Dr Fletcher. The lectures are fast paced but the slides and recordings are always posted after class. Overall the class was easy, there was a textbook but I didn't really use it. He had three exams and dropped the lowest exam score. He also rounds which is a gods blessing. I was on the verge of an A- and had an 89.2% but he still rounded up to an A- even when he said he only rounds .5% and above up. Definitely take him if you could.

For exams, it is all about memorizing word for word exactly what was said on the PowerPoint. His exams were a bit hard but they were fair. He records every lecture and is super nice and welcoming to any questions you have. Has 3 exams and drops 1 and there is a final at the end. The best option you got is this guy 100%.

THIS MAN IS A GODSEND. Take him to any class you can get. He is approachable and just being in his class is enough to motivate you out of a rut. Struggling with the class? He'll work with you to find a solution. He remains to be one of the best professors at UMD. He is amazing.

I didn't think it would be possible to say this, but the 5/5 rate my professor score doesn't come close to explaining how good of a professor Fletcher is. I cannot stress this enough: TAKE HIM ABOVE ALL OTHER OPTIONS! This man is very clear about everything. His exams can be challenging but if you pay attention you're set. He is the best professor.

This class is very fast, so you have to work hard to keep up, but he tries to help you understand the content despite the fast pace. He's fair on grading tests, although I found them to be really difficult (the first one averaged a C), all other assignments are very easy. Attendance is only mandatory on discussion days, lectures are recorded.
Love him. A literal angel. We need more STEM professors like him at UMD.
Great lecturer and awesome office hours. The work load is typical but manageable. Tests were fair and study guides did well at covering the topics we needed to know. All in all a great class!
One of the best professors Ive ever had. He cares about his students, listens to feedback, and lets us use a cheat sheet for exams. Would take him again!

Dr. Fletcher was such a good professor and was very understanding. Lowest scores are dropped and you are allowed to have a cheat sheet (full front and back) on the exams. A lot of material but all lectures are recorded and very manageable. Loved this class and the professor.

I LOVE THIS MAN. he made a hard class bearable, please take him if you ever have the chance for any class. for every single test we got a full printer sheet of paper as a cheat sheet and he gives extra credit on every exam. He always seems very enthusiastic about the material and really knows what he's talking about and can explain it well.

Love this man. Cannot stress this enough, take him for any class that he teaches. He offers so many small assignments to boost your grade and is the nicest human being alive. HW graded on completion and gives cheat sheets on tests. Lowest exam grade is dropped. Lecture heavy but he tries to make all the information manageable.

I really enjoyed BSCI170 with Dr. Fletcher! The content was difficult at times, but his lectures were easy to follow and super engaging. He really cares about his students and is very accessible during office hours. I would highly recommend him for any BSCI course!

I loved Dr. Fletcher's course. I am not a science person but this class went well. He is very caring and passionate about biology. Def go to GSS and office hours as it can help a lot

Phenomenal professor and person. Cannot recommend him highly enough. Lots of material, but he makes learning interesting and breaks down the information in an accessible way. Genuinely loved his class and would 1000000% take any course with him again.

Fletcher is an amazing professor. His lectures never exceed 25 mins, are broken down perfectly and he gives you enough time to watch them before you meet for class. Best bsci170 professor you will find at umd. The class is difficult and there's no getting around that but Dr. Fletcher is enthusiastic to help and the class is run very smoothly.

Dr. Fletcher is probably one of the best professors I have ever had. I wish his class was live every day, because I would love to go. If you want a good professor for any BSCI class, take Dr. Fletcher

He cares so much about all his students and genuinely gets excited to teach and wants to see us succeed. He is so inspiring and has amazing energy. He also encourages you to come to office hours even if it's just to silently do work and have him there if you have questions or if you want to just meet his dog. Amazing person and amazing teacher.

Professor Fletcher was by far my favorite professor this semester. He cares about all of his students and wants us to succeed. His teaching style was super helpful for the way I learn. I would definitely take a class with him again!

Dr. Fletcher is great! 10/10 would recommend. This was his first time teaching at UMD, but the class was run very smoothly (even with the online format). Lectures were asynchronous, but we also had synchronous meetings on Zoom to complete group activities ( 1x/week). He is very caring & provides his students with everything they need to succeed!

Organic Chemistry 2 is already such a difficult course and somehow this professor manages to teach it in the worst way. I have gone through 3 separate tutors so I can understand the content. He purposely does not teach things in class, does not post accurate practice resources and is such a harsh grader. Please take anyone else for this course.

Everyone complaining about Professor Fribush is probably upset that they didn't get the grade they wanted. I do not think that the negative reviews are fair. The material is hard no matter what teacher you take. Professor Fribush's tests are very fair and you know exactly what to expect. He covers everything and is very responsive to questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Fribush does care. The course itself is extremely difficult no matter who you take. I will say for the amount of time and effort I put into this class I should have gotten an A. The curve helped a bit, but the class is so small it is like impossible to get an A. Take the day time orgo to improve your chances of a better grade.

Lectures on Mon nights from 1830-2130 are excruciating and often with only a 5 minute brake throughout.  Tests are impossibly, demoralizingly hard despite long hours of study on my part.  You must read each chapter cover to cover and often reread and self quiz.  He provides a ton of helpful materials, but the average on our exams were 70, 58, 54.

Fribush was my favorite professor in the SIE program. He is a very clear lecturer - I actually preferred him to the text. And he's very intelligent. My advice is: Copy your notes. Do relevant homework problems. Read before class. Ask thoughtful  questions. It's not a difficult class, but you have to consistently study. 2-3 A's per class of 15-20.

The course was definitely challenging, but I think almost everyone came out ok in the end. I did think he sometimes packed alot of info into his slides, but it was nice not to have to rely solely on my own notes when studying. A benefit: I am studying for the MCAT and haven't needed to review orgo very much because I studied so hard for his class!

Dr. Fribush is nearly the worst teacher I have ever had. Orgo is a difficult subject anyhow, and the fact that he seems to enjoy watching everyone do badly doesn't help. He gives abstract lengthy answers to questions. The tests are on minute details found in the lecture or book, and graded with a fine tooth comb! Avoid him! Take orgo during the day

Howard Fribush is a bitter man. He wants you to fail. He enjoys it when you fail. He will not admit when he's made a mistake. If you ask a question he does not know the answer to he will become hostile towards you. He has a Hitler mustache, and I don't think it's a coincidence because he runs his class like a fascist. Avoid him at all costs.

Dr. Howard Fribush's Lecture on Monday evenings are brutal.  He lectures for 3 hours straight, offers one mini-break, which lasts only 5-10 minutes. The lecture is only suppose to last from 6:30-9:20 and he will go over his time limit; sometimes close to 10 pm.    I don't recommend him to anyone who cannot imbibe information at breakneck pace.

He is good overall, however, he is determined to achieve a bell curve for his grades.  Since the evening classes are composed generally of more motivated students, this means that you might get a B or a C where you might have gotten an A in the day class.  Exams and grading are very nitpicky.

Awesome professor, if you have the opportunity I would 100% recommend taking him. If you can try even a little bit you will probably at least get a B+ in this class. The tests are entirely lecture based and, besides a few small assignments,  make up your grade. He's super flexible and understanding if you need to miss something or make it up too

Frauwirth is a really good professor! For the most part: He makes it very clear what is going to be on the exam. His averages were around 80's for the midterms which is pretty good for an upper-level. Be wary that some minute details might be asked on an exam though.
great class
Lectures have many information and can be very long, but were organized very well. Lectures are recorded and exams are fair, but there is a lot of information and details that has to be known.

Great professor! No crazy homework, TopHat questions in class. HOWEVER, THE TA MAKES YOUR EXAM GRADE. There was a significant issue my semester with one TA (mine) grading extremely tough for her sections compared to the other sections. Frauwirth did nothing to change this. This made the exams way harder than needed to be. Otherwise a decent class

literally my fav professor ive had so far as a jnr neurophys major. lecture heavy. go to lecture! everything is in the lecture you need to know. hes def the best prof at umd. so understanding and really just wants you to understand the material, not make you fail. if i could give him a 20/10 i would. he is very considerate and his work is minimal.
Lab is time consuming but make sure to attend since it affects your grade. In person lectures are boring and monotoned but watch recordings at 2X speed to study

Dr. Frauwirth's class was pretty manageable! His exams were very detailed, but everything came from the powerpoint slides. Overall, he's a pretty good professor (though lectures can get boring at times), just make sure to keep up with the material on a regular basis and you should be fine.

Difficult class..A LOT of memorization. He's a good lecturer and records. Midterms were fair since they contained info from his slides. Lab portion was easy if you had good TA (shoutout Adit).He reuses exam questions from previous semesters so try to find people that have taken him before. Had a B average on midterms and final and ended with an A.

I enjoyed the content of this course and Dr. Frauwirth is a great professor. There is a TON of material that is covered every lecture, so being present and paying attention is KEY. There are probably at least 50 lecture slides of material every class. Office hours are very helpful and the lab TA's are great! I would recommend Dr. Frauwirth!

There are 4 exams, the final is cumulative and VERY difficult. Each lecture is cram packed with a LOT of content, making it hard to know what to study. The readings are long and brutal to get through. The lab was easy. Free participation points for clickers is nice. Lectures can be boring at times, but Dr Frauwirth is sometimes funny.
It's a very tough class and the professor doesn't make it easier. You really need to study really hard to get a decent grade. Exams are heavy and can be very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is nice but strict, doesn't give chances to make up exams even if you have an excuse. He isn't understanding at all. I wouldn't recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He was honestly the worse professor I ever had. The WORST! I took immunology during the summer and I wouldn't recommend anyone to take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very straightforward exams, 1 quiz weekly that is based off of textbook readings. Exams test only on what's covered in his lectures. Both exams and quizzes can ask very specific questions sometimes, but are still really fair overall.

Lectures were easy to follow, the exams were pretty detailed but overall fair. The class was asynchronous, we had 3 exams and a final, as well as lecture quizzes every week. We also had clicker questions graded on completion. As for lab, it wasn't bad, somewhat confusing but fair amount of work (2 lab reports, one group project, & a few quizzes).

He is the best professor I have had at UMD. This class is challenging, but if you keep up with the lectures you will be fine. He is good at explaining things and posts video recording of the lecture so you can go back and add more to your notes. I highly recommend him! UMD needs more professors like him.
great professor, I recommend you take him

Best bio professor he records his class so u can just get everything from there all his exam is from his lectures from his recordings the reading he gives out are useful for quizzes but you don't need them for exam
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The processes in a cell are very complicated and he does a very good job of making the easier to understand. He is a very nice and cares a lot about his students. You may see reviews on how he comes late to class and how he messed up on the final. But you could tell this semester he was going through a lot of personal things & being a new dad.

He was always late to class due to his newborn, and he printed out the 3rd exam instead of the final exam, passed that out, realized what he did, came back 30 min later with the final, passed that out, realized it was the final exam key, then decided to give us all 100s on the final- still a great teacher, would take again

Great lecturer. Extremely clear. Very funny and genuine guys. Wants you to do well. Don't expect a curve, though. The averages on the exams are usually very high. You'll need to put in a lot of work into this class. Very enjoyable though.

One of the best teachers I ever had! Very easy to follow along during lecture and explains everything slowly and makes sure everyone understands. Tests are extremely fair as long as you memorize / understand each slide you will get a 100%. Avgs are always in the 90s for his exams. Just study his slides n you wont even need the book.

Great professor, I really enjoyed the class and learned a ton. He is always giving extra credit and chances for easy points. He expects a lot of his students so get ready to study. He really taught me most of what I know in biology. His weekly online quizzes are terrible because of the amount of reading that is supposed to be done.

Frauwirth is a nice and caring dude. He realizes the class material is hard so he does everything he can to make sure that you do well. There are plenty of chances to boost your grade through clicker questions and Online quizzes. The lab is very easy but alot of tedious work.

Tough class, need to work really hard for a decent grade. Pop quizzes probably hurt more than they help. Test are worded confusingly and are extremely difficult. Expect to study ALOT. Barely passed. Failed my midterm and final but going to office hours was definitely helpful.

Talks way too fast, gives random useless facts, and gets distracted easily. Will explain fairly simple concepts in a way that makes no sense. Did offer weekly review sessions. Gave pop quizzes almost every class, which were not easy points. DO NOT take this class if you want to learn biology or get a good grade

This is the worst class I've taken at Maryland. I'm in the middle of the course and am praying for a C-, which I have never had to do in any class before now. Coming into this semester my GPA was 3.76, and now it will significantly decrease because of this class that is required for PSYCHOLOGY majors.

Memorization is key for his class.  His tests are multiple choice, but they are confusing the way they are worded.  Overall, I thought the class was boring and he has pop quizzes almost every lecture.  Lab was easy, but lab report took too much time for the amount of points it is worth. Take Shields if you are more of a concept person.

I had Dr. F for my honors seminar. I thought he was awesome. He is really passionate about what he teaches, helpful and provokes really interesting discussion. The course load was fairly easy and he is a fair grader. I would recommend the class.

Appeared nervous and spoke very fast during lectures - almost impossible to take notes.  Would have been just as useful to skip lecture and read the textbook instead since he uses almost every image from the textbook in his lectures anyway.  Also had an afinity for asking very random exam questions.  Really nice guy but not a great lecturer.

I don't know if it's just me, but I think a lot of people are underselling how hard this class is. Brings his dog to class which is cool. That being said, lectures were often not very engaging. Moreover, the exam format makes the margin for error so slim. One small mistake and your exam grade can go from a low A to low C.

I love Dr. Finkle, and I absolutely recommend him to anyone taking upper level micro! He's such a sweetie and his lectures are easy to understand. Also, he does all his tests during class time which I personally love because they don't disrupt your schedule.

If you come to class and take notes, you will get an A.
Organized class and clear expectations. The lectures could be a bit more engaging, but they get the job done.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Finkle is the kindest economics professor I've encountered at UMD. He truly cares about student progress and made it possible for students to succeed through reasonable workloads, posting lectures, and making resources available to the class. The class itself is difficult, but I cannot recommend (or thank) Dr. Finkle enough! Keep being amazing.

Hard class but he teaches well. The exams are not exactly like the study guide and have little oddities that you will only know how to solve if you studied hard and really understood the concepts. Overall great class and I learned a lot from it.

*Must Take* 
Professor Finkle is a funny and great teacher. Grade BreakDown: Three Exam-14.286% each, Optional Final-21.429%, Homework-14.286%, Quizzes-10.714%, and Worksheets-10.714%. You will definitely have to study for the exams and the exams are very similar to the practice exams. You have dedicated worksheet days to work in class on them.
Brings his dog to class, super nice. It is overall a challenging class that taught me a lot.

Amazing professor, hands down one of the best I've had. Econ is hard but he makes everything clear. Lectures are interesting and easy to follow, and he records and posts them. Exams are exactly what he teaches and review materials are great. Plus, he brings his dog to class. If you're taking 306, take him.

Professor Finkle does an excellent job of making sure things are clear and easily accessible for his students. He offers class via zoom if you cant make it in person, and he posts the zoom recordings so you can watch them whenever, which is super helpful for exams. Exam prep materials are elite and basically ensure that you get an A if you study

Finkle is a great prof. He explains class content clearly and in interesting ways. There's a lot of homework, but it's very helpful for the class. His exams are also very fair. They're just like the study guide and practice problems he gives out. He's a nice guy who gives out extra credit chances. Pay attention and do the work and you'll do well.

Even though I ended with a C- that was more of a reflection me than of Professor Finkle. He is a great professor and does a great job at lecturing. The class itself is a hard class so there is only so much he can do to help. But, if he teaches anymore economic courses I would definitely take him again.

Economics is a HARD subject. With that in mind, Professor Finkle was probably the best professor I could have gotten to teach it. His exams are very similar to what he covers in class. Attendance and reading the textbook is optional, but it will be very hard to do well without doing both. Grading is also fair and offers curves if necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. Tests what he teaches in lecture . If you study the worksheets and the sample problems for the exams you'll do well. HW and Quiz assignments suck and are way harder than the exams and worksheets but you have multiple attempts. His lectures are very clear. He also records them and has a Zoom during live lecture. very approachable
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was in a class of around 400 people online but Aaron Finkle was still able to set up 1 on 1 office times with students. His course is very tough but his lectures are both relevant and easy to understand. He is a great professor though hard. It was nice that all his grading was clear and all HW, Quiz, and lectures were relevant to each other.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor and always willing to help his students out. He knows a lot about the topics and is very understanding. This is the second time I have a class with him and both have been great.

Amazing Professor. His lectures were so clear and easy to follow. if you miss class he posts the notes online which are also very easy to follow along to. The tests were basic numerical examples he went over in class lectures and notes. If you put in effort you will do well because Pr. Finkle puts out all the resources for you to succeed.

He just wasnt the best teacher. All of his tests gave more questions then you had time for. Even his final had over 60 questions. It was a lot to manage plus hes always changing things, making it difficult to understand. Just wasnt the best teacher to take for 306. Ill just take it in the summer if I didnt do well this time around. No EC.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: i love this man. he's very good at teaching the concepts and the exams are very similar to the in class worksheets. you don't need to go to class since he uploads the notes online but it helps to go to better understand the material

I probably would've failed this class if I took it with the other professor so he was a blessing for that. The tests were pretty difficult but definitely doable. Lectures were quite boring but if you pay attention you will do really well on exams. Extra credit saved my life, do your homework.

Finkle goes over the basic examples in class then asks you different things on the tests. He's a great guy, but not too forgiving on partial credits. Had a sign error on a multi-part problem and I lost 15% on that exam. He said he curves, but not quite generously. He did give some extra credit and is open to students' concerns.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: His lecture notes cover basic examples in the textbook, often time being the exact same problem with different numbers. As long as you read the textbook, attendance isn't essential to doing well. Midterms (3) consist of 20 multiple choice questions straight from the test bank and 1-2 short answers. Homework is an easy 100% since you have 2 tries.

Dr. Finkle is an awesome/hilarious professor. He's a very caring professor and understands that the material is hard. If the average is low enough, he generously curves. Grades depend on online homework, 3 exams, and the final. Attendance is not mandatory but he explains the material very clear so it's better to go to class than learn it yourself.

I didnt go to a single class other than the exams and got a B+. Everyone is on here saying you have to go to class and they all ended up with a C, study his lecture notes and the textbook and you will be fine. One of the better upper level econs in my opinion.

He's a straight forward professor which is rare. Its a hard class where calculus is applied. He helps you prepare for the exams. There are 3 tests, a homework grade and a final. If you go to class he'll emphasize what you need to know for the exams. They are 2/3 MC and 1/3 solving problems.

Take Professor Finkle! He used LaunchPad this semester for our problem sets which was extremely helpful, he adjusted the weight of the exams and launchpad to help us, and overall hes very understanding take him.

Professor Finkle is a fantastic Economics teacher. His clear explanations of the concepts, graphs and equations make a difficult topic seemingly simple. My only complaints are as follows: he rushes through the notes in class so often I found myself missing some stuff (but he posts notes online) , also,half the class dropped after the 2nd test....
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Finkle is very clear with his lectures and best of all is that he scans in all his notes online. He is extremely helpful during office hours, and is willing to answer any questions you may have. One of the better professors at UMD, who can actually relate to the younger generation. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I was in ECON 306 during his first semester of teaching here at UMD. I took the same class before with another professor, who doesn't have good ratings on here and I couldn't understand anything. And then I retook with this new professor, This guy actually teaches very good. The way he teaches makes sense. I'd say UMD made a good choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He comes into class two minutes after it starts and just starts talking without explaining what the lecture is about. He just does examples but doesn't explain what they are about and doesn't clarify how they would be used. My notes look like gibberish because they are just random examples that don't correspond with anything.

In lectures, he does problems without really explaining why he's doing what he's doing. I went to all lectures, rewatched them and took notes on them again and still failed the exam. I sent him about 5 emails, he didn't respond to any. You have to do things the way he "taught them" on the exam or you'll be marked wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I don't even know what to say. I know this is his first time teaching this course but it's SOOO disorganized. The webassigns, discussion worksheets and what he teaches in class DOES NOT MATCH. Most of the class is baffled and we are all praying

A lot harder than you think this class is with Fernandes. He used to be easy but his final exam averages are very low even with a curve. His lecturing is ok, and TAs cover homework problems in discussion, but don't fall for people saying this is a free A.
Final exam's average was a 60% even after a curve
Absolutely horrible

Solid statistics class, feel like I learnt a lot. The entire class collaborated together (with his permission) to compile a solution manual to his final exam test-bank. While the solutions were already available in his provided notes, it was still pretty cool!
Was a lot of work. Good class!

Most exam problems were similar to those from a test bank that he provided (which was quite extensive), all the problems were solved during lectures and discussion sessions. 

I am not sure if it just me thinking this: some of my peers just don't seem to want to work, or don't know how to work/study for a college level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Respected

reviews.comment: His class is not so organized and he expects you to take exams without a formula sheet, in a class where formulas are key! His exams are very similar to sample exams but for some reason, he did not post all answers to his final and exam 2 sample exams, he made it a scavenger hunt to find answers! Made the experience difficult.

The course is well structured, clear guidelines and lots of resources for students to succeed. 

Records and live streams all lectures (allowed for a lot of flexibility for my schedule) and lectures notes are live streamed and available instantly. 

It did feel like a 400 level class, had to work hard but I learnt a lot!

Not a very good professor this semester at least. He was incredibly hard to reach outside of class and poorly communicated about due dates, sometimes surprising you with an 11:59 am due date instead of an 11:59 pm due date. He definitely has positives, he records his lectures and post his notes although he is a bit inconsistent with posting notes.

I liked how he would post lecture notes online, the problem is it is hard to follow the notes. Being said, it as also difficult to follow in lecture, he goes very fast and misses important areas that connect the concepts together. That alone is making me struggle in his class.

STAT 400 is a 3 credit class, yet the workload feels like it a 7 credit class. Between the weekly homework's and quizzes and the R projects, I spend at least 15 hours weekly outside of class time. Its ridiculous, and something needs to change.  And when the homework has nothing to do with the lectures, it hurts you on the quizzes.

The course needs to be reevaluated. The hw has no correlation to anything. You end up practicing something that's no applicable. And when you take the quizzes/exams you don't know what to do. In lectures he does not spend enough time defining what he is writing. For example, set complement, union,etc.Chill dude, but the course needs to be rethought

Nice guy. But scared how there are no bad reviews. We had review material due the third day of classes. The review material was CALC III, CALC II was the prerequisite. Hw's are impossible to solve without seeking help. Lecture was very confusing, could not apply it to the hw, which then lead me to not understand material. Then I did bad on quiz.

What I liked about Professor Fernandes was that he gives bonus points and exams are very similar to the study guides. However, this course requires you to spend a large amount of time doing group R-Projects. There are also challenging online weekly quizzes. His self-written homework contains proofs and theory that has no relevance to the exams.

The WebAssigns and the weekly worksheet are definitely a pain on the butt, but he is a pretty nice and fair guy. Usually, the exam questions are similar to the homework questions. Just need to actually study hard in this course (Cal 2 is hard in general).

Prof. Fernandes consistently showed up late to class. His lectures focus too much on theory and history of mathematical concepts rather than concrete examples. The TA you sign up for is CRUCIAL; my TA is the only reason I succeeded. Be prepared to teach yourself concepts outside of class. Invest in a full solutions manual to the textbook.

absolute great man. Students stopped attending class bc he posts notes + lectures online (& many admit to not catching up on them) which is prob why ppl got lower grades and started to complain. But if you go to class, do the bare minimum for HW, youll be more than fine. He dropped our lowest exam and wants everyone to do well in calc 2.

this prof is a great teacher of concepts but can never make it to the application in the lecture. be prepared to do a lot of self teaching and to go to every discussion, office hour, and gss session that is held. go to class, pay attention, ask questions. prof fernandes cares deeply ab his students but will give lots of hw and class is test heavy
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Fernandes is a good professor all around. He definitely cares about his students, but his class is understandably hard. His lectures are long and sometimes get very confusing. The homework and exams are challenging, but he won't surprise you with an unfair question. He's not the best professor, but he is definitely above average.
By far one the best professors at UMD. Very generous when giving extra credits. Exams are fair and directly from his lecture notes. Will definitely take him again!

He is no doubt the best Professor at UMD. I would recommend him a million times! He is so flexible and goes out of his way to help his students. His exams are 100% fair and he gives a lot of opportunity for bonus points. He handles online classes really well.

He's very lenient on grading and applied a generous curve at the end of the semester. However, the class itself is just very hard. He's always open to answer questions but his exams are difficult. He also has weekly quizzes which are generally tricky. The class isn't terrible but it is very difficult, be prepared to work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Definitely deserves a 5 because, such a caring and accommodating prof overall. He asks for feedback from students and changes his teaching accordingly. Hes so understanding during the pandemic. Gave a huge curve & bonus points. Drops your lowest exam, 2 quizzes, & 2 worksheets. Gives 12h to take exams too! No other prof will be this generous!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I agree with other students that he is very accommodating and does in fact care about his students and their success, however, I'm sure I'm not the only student that agrees his teaching style and notes can at times be extremely confusing. At times it feels like what we are tested on and what we are learning are completely different.

He cares a lot about his students and wants them to apply stat to their own life. Most of the work was hws from the textbook and Rprojects which are both very manageable. R was hard at first, but he changed them to focus more on analysis instead of code. Very understanding w/ COVID, adapted to students concerns about due dates and class structure
really cares about his students
Great professor. He's really nice although the homework is sometimes annoyingly long would take a class of his again.
He;s a really sweet teacher and I'm so glad I chose him for STAT400. He is a really understanding guy. I hope I can take him again for a future class.

Professor Fernandes is one of the best professors in the Math department. I have not had a professor who was more concerned with his student's success. He made the linear algebra easy to understand, with his very clear and precise notes. Overall, Professor Fernandes is by far the best option for taking MATH461.
I took his classes for two semester (MATH401 and STAT401). He is a really good teacher who actually wants you to know the material. He sometimes postpones the deadline. Funny dude too.

Professor Fernandes is great. He is very organized and very easy to talk to. If you thrive in an environment that is organized, that makes expectations clear, and most importantly a place where you feel like you are respected then this is your professor.

Professor Fernandes was a great professor and goes into great detail at explaining concepts step by step in a way thats easy to understand and that will be used during exams. He makes sure to help out students as best he can when the student is having any issues. I am saddened by not being able to have a full in person class due to COVID-19.
Very accommodating in these corona times. He did everything in his power to ensure his students were comfortable and excelled in this in-person to online transition

You could just read the textbook if you wanted to but i went to lecture. The lectures were pretty straightforward and he posted the notes afterwards. The exams and quizzes were super easy. Lowest quiz was dropped. The online homework was graded for accuracy but you got 10-15 tries to get it right. I would recommend to anyone choosing a math prof.

the worst instructor I've ever had at. He's a math grad student teaching this course and its obvious he's never taken stat in his life. Constantly teaching incorrect info w/ students correcting him every lecture. teaches by having his back to the class and stares at the board the entire time. If you have respect for yourself dont take his class!!
He doesn't provide great feedback. The type of rubric he uses makes it difficult to tailor your writing to what he expects. A lot of work turned out to be very tedious.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: This was my most dreadful course. There was so much busy work and the actual major assignments were weighed ridiculously. He grades these assignments poorly and without a lot of reasoning. Worst professional writing course, don't take it with him.

He's great and verrrrry understanding. Honestly if you need a credit to boost your GPA take him. In all my schooling, I've never met a professor this understanding. I've had so many late assignments and not once did he grade them as late. He's super awesome. A the moment I have an A thanks to his understanding.

Dr. Fitzgerald was amazing! I took him for Spring '22 and he was exceptional! Provided great feedback, and it was online so all material was provided. You have to pace yourself and be on top of this class too. No exams, just writing and vibes! Make sure to download the required text via iBook (for Apple users)

Taken over a winter semester; Three core assignments, with various low point tasks split throughout the semester. Very light grader, if you submit something (anything) for an assignment, you get a passing grade. He had plenty of students and a fair amount of grading, but still provided feedback on projects within 2 days of submitting it. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's knowledgable but not the most exciting lecturer. There aren't many assignments, and readings are short, but there are difficult quizzes each class.
