I had no prior experience with most the topics learned in this class, but I still managed to get an A+. Mike is super supportive and always willing to help you out or give feedback.
Mike is one of the best Professors I've ever had. What makes him an enjoyable professor is how he tries his best to make the class low stress and is very accommodating of what you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing teacher. Very well spoken and a great mentor during the online catastrophe.

Prof Mikes lectures are fun and he jokes around to make sure class isnt boring. He thoroughly walks through examples and answers any questions you have. He also has a ton of extra credit, and he bakes for you if the test average is high! The grading might seem hard, but the department grades the tests as a whole so it wont change by professor.

Mike was an amazing teacher! The coursework wasnt that difficult and he made class fun and engaging. He cooks treats for the class to motivate us for exams and he is always cracking jokes and making us laugh in class. He makes up a bunch of tricks and tips to help students remember formulas and he truly cares about his students. Nothing bad to say

Mike genuinely cares about his students, and is eager to help both in and out of class. His lectures are interesting and his personality makes it enjoyable to attend class. He quickly adapted the course for the online semester, and made sure we still had fun. Overall, a great professor who makes great lemon bars.

Mike's a gem. Had him on/offline during corona & he whipped up the new course in a week (mostly singlehandedly). Turned out loads better than the OSV. Lectures are more like TED talks, doesn't give busywork, cares deeply about students & pushes them to succeed + build friendships (they do). Very energetic, corny at times, lemon bars are a must.

Hes an outstanding professor, he cares a lot about students and will do everything in his power to make the class fun and exciting. I highly recommend taking Mike for your classes. He will also make you baked goods

Great guy who actually cares about his student. He made the class enjoyable so I did not mind sitting in a lab for 2 hours straight because it went by so fast. I would definitely recommend him for any class he teaches.

I definitely recommend taking Mike for ENES100. He makes lectures super fun and engaging and is really good at teaching new material to students. He makes an honest effort to ensure you get to know your group before starting the OSV project so you already have close bonds within your team. This was such a fun class thanks to Mike!!
Mike is a genuinely awesome teacher. He took the time to help whenever i asked questions or sent emails, he makes lectures a treat to attend, and he offers endless extra credit.

Mike is one of the best professors I have had since being at UMD. His lectures are engaging and he always goes out of his way to make information easier to understand (like relating height in terms of football field lengths). Definitely take him if you get the chance, you won't regret it!

Hola chicos! Mike is a super down to earth dude and will always be there for you. He always has positive attitude and makes every aspect of studying abroad fun and engaging. All of the activities and excursions are well planned with the academics portion so you really get to experience the country! I HIGHLY recommend this class and Mike!

Mike is a very entertaining lecturer and fun to be around. He is always available and cares about the success of his students. Grading and course load are both positives. I also had him for ENES102, he does worked examples in lecture so I recommend attending.

Mike is a great guy who cares about you as a student. If you ask him for help he will help you with anything. This class structured around the country. You will learn about the country and its renewable resources while experiencing all aspects of its culture.

Mike is the best professor you will have in college. He is so caring and has a way of making anything interesting and fun. He truly wants you to learn and will do anything to help you. This class was amazing and I really recommend the class and Mike!
Great guy. Cares a lot about the students and gives interesting lectures.

Mike is the most inspiring professor I've ever had the honor of taking a class with. My friends recommended that I take him for ENES 100, and his infectious enthusiasm drove us all to work hard and excel. His grading is clear, fair, and surprisingly lenient, and you WILL have an amazing time in class.

Mike was fantastic. He made a 9am class enjoyable and he baked cookies when we did well on exams. He's always available in JMP for help out of class and clearly cares about his students. I wish he gave more tough examples in class and stayed focused on material rather than joking all the time. Also, 4 exams are 80% of the grade which can be tough.
Overall he's alright. Doesn't practice enough difficult problems during lecture that are on the test. Always trying to entertain distracts from course concepts.

Mike is seriously an amazing professor. His lectures are always highly entertaining and he genuinely care about his students. ENES100 is really abut the how your team works as a group and the effort that everyone puts in, and Mike will do absolutely everything he can to try and help. Probably one of the best classes I have ever taken
This was my hardest class but Mike is THE BEST professor. He cares a lot about your grades and is always willing to help. Plus he is a really good baker and easy to talk to about anything.
You get +5 points if you are a Philly fan.

Genuinely one of the most fun classes you'll have at this school. Mike's enthusiastic as heck and has a great attitude. Almost all of your grade in this class is participation and he puts a lot of weight behind the peer reviews at the end of the group project, so if you skip class or don't participate you're gonna feel it in your final grade.

Mike was the best professor! I had him for ENES102 and he made a 9 AM class worth it. He truly cares about his students and he was very kind to me when I was personally struggling. While the class itself can be difficult, Mike explains the topics simply and eloquently. He made his classroom a safe place and ENES102 something to look forward to.

Professor Galczynski made statistic topics more interesting by using jokes and relating problems to real-life situations. He was readily available to answer any questions I had. Plenty of exam prep was provided in order to obtain a high grade. He bakes, and motivated students to do better on exams by rewarding a high average grade with baked treats

Mike is a great professor who cares about all of his students and makes every lecture worth going to with the information provided, his jokes, and his stories. Makes the course material very easy to understand and is always happy to help.

Although this Mechanics course is a little challenging, Mike does a great job making his lectures engaging with younger college students which helps tremendously when comprehending the subject matter. Mike is always available for office hours and review sessions.

Highly recommend taking Mike for ENES100. He puts a lot of effort into his lectures and ensuring everyone is grasping what is going on. Very approachable outside of class, which you will need to do for ENES100. The project is massive compared to the amount of class time available so expect to put in a lot of time in open lab hours to be successful.

Mike is an amazing professor that is very enthusiastic about teaching. He goes out of his way to make the class fun, and would give us a lot of extra time to complete certain assignments, as well as cut down on excessively long ones usually assigned by other ENES100 professors. He gives great life advice, and genuinely cares about his students.

Mike keeps his lectures entertaining and to the point. The tests are heavily graded however there are many extra credit opportunities that are practice problems for tests which you should be doing anyway if you'd like to pass the class. Definitely would take again.

Mike is a great professor. Doing well in ENES102 depends a lot on how much you practice, and Mike gives a lot of encouragement for doing so through extra credit and some required assignments. Hes very approachable and wants you to do well, so hell help you and give you advice and information not given in class if you go to him.

Ive been at UMD for 5 semesters and Mike is by far the best professor Ive had. I highly recommend attending his lectures since he explains concepts in an intuitive manner. I believe he takes criticism to his teaching, if any, to heart so his class will only improve in quality as years go by. Plus he bakes cookies for his classes.

Mike overall an amazing professor. In class he is humorous, well-versed, easy to understand and always willing to clarify. If you go to class, go to his office hours and apply yourself in homeworks you'll do great. One of the great things he does in class is use real world examples simple exames and exposes you to exam questions help you understand

Mike is super funny and also very caring about his students! In class, he provides plenty of extra credit opportunities. He also bakes for his classes sometimes! Totally recommend taking a class with him.
Awesome guy and really cares about his students

Your experience in ENES100 depends a lot on the professor you get. Mike made the lectures so fun and interactive that I actually looked forward to going to class. His stories are the best. Highkey one of the coolest profs on campus. Oh yeah he also bakes cookies for the class.

Mike's a great guy, but as a teacher he's just okay. His class is interesting because he gets off topic a bunch and is funny, but didn't convey the material as well as he could have. I didn't feel as prepared for the exams as I could have been.

Had a great semester in ENES100. It's obvious Mike loves teaching and wants everyone to do well. He'll walk around during lab time, asking students about their day and building cool parts for teams' OSVs like a kid with legos. And his wisdom talks will inspire you to finesse your way through life like he has. Give some and you'll get a lot out.

Mike was a great professor in our study abroad course. His lectures were energetic and lively. He was always available when we needed assistance on assignments. The best class I've taken so far in college! Amazing opportunity to go abroad and have such fantastic professors that tried to make stress levels as low as possible. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Genuinely a great guy and good professor, hope to have him again someday.

ENME407 is a really fun class/trip that is worth it if you have the $ to go to Iceland. The class consists of lectures over a few days and a lot of field trips. You are always doing something. Anytime there was a break we would rally and go out. It is for sure the most fun way to earn 3 credits and knock out a tech elective. Do it.

Mike was such an inspiration during the study abroad trip to Iceland this summer. I was having doubts about my major but this class helped me regain the confidence and passion I had for engineering. I would recommend Mike for any class he leads at UMD, and especially his study abroad sessions.

This course is easily the best course I have taken at UMD , and Mike does an excellent job teaching it. Especially with this being a study abroad course, Mike found the perfect balance between teaching the material & making sure everyone felt comfortable in the new environment. This course is loads of fun and I would highly recommend it!

Mike is one of the best professors you can have for ENES100. He is very charismatic and approachable and really puts an emphasis on teamwork and problem-solving when building the OSV, which are both super important in engineering. He really cares about his students and brings in snacks so definitely take his class if you have the chance!

I took a study abroad course in which Mike was one of the instructors. He begins to feel like more of a friend than a "professor" in the conventional sense because of the personal connections he forms with everyone. He was a blast to be around, and very knowledgeable and professional when it came to completing course work.

Mike made our study abroad trip one to remember by providing us with incredible in and out of class experiences! Our field trips were just as informational as they were incredibly fun. I took this class as a non-engineering student and Mike really made sure I was able to keep up with everyone else and not fall behind. He is a very caring professor!

ENME407 was a spectacular study abroad experience! Mike is a fantastic instructor and a very genuine guy. He demonstrated his dedication for teaching through his amazing lectures; as well as his passion for traveling through unforgettable field trips. I definitely recommend Mike for any study abroad experience at UMD!

Mike motivates you to put in the effort to succeed at the project & to learn, not for the grade. This, along with his humor & enthusiasm, made working on the project with my team & this class much more enjoyable. Mike deeply cares for his students & their education (get ready for unexpected life lessons). Hes approachable if you ever have trouble

Had Mike for 102 and definitely recommend. He cares about your success and is always looking for ways to improve, which I appreciated. Plus he is just a fun person in general, so going to class or approaching him for extra help is easier. Lectures and class was straightforward and he gives the old exams to practice with, which make the test easy.

Mike is an amazing teacher, so sign up for his section if you can! He brings in baked goods and candy which keeps up spirits during the difficult times of building your OSV. His class creates a great atmosphere for developing engineers as groups are forced to problem solve and work together. Mike genuinely wants each of his groups to succeed.

Everyone take Mike! He makes this class extremely fun and interesting. He bakes delicious goods for the class and does whatever he can to ensure every student has a good experience. He is not a difficult grader, which helps you focus more on having fun and doing the project rather than stressing about the class grade. He is the best professor!!

Mike is one of the best professors I have had at Maryland. He truly cares about the student's success and is very passionate about teaching the Introduction to Engineering and Design course. He uses enthusiasm and real-world applications to keep students engaged during his lectures.

Mike was a really great guy who made class interesting and fun to come too. As a Bioengineering major I was not very interested in mechanics, but Mike made coming to class entertaining and beneficial. His lectures were super helpful and prepared you well for exams. Would definitely recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: ENES 100 is a hard class and I really hated it at certain points, but Mike made it fun. You will learn a lot about yourself and he really does care about you. He also bakes and brings you his treats.

Mike is one of the best professors Ive had so far at UMD. He answered all emails promptly, told a lot of jokes throughout the class to keep the material interesting and the class engaged, and was very helpful in answering questions if you did not understand any of the course material. Would definitely take again!

Mike is a great guy who cares a lot about his students. He brought in candy and baked goods for the class on several occasions, and he generally worked hard to make sure everyone was having a good time in class. The ENES100 classes in general are all fairly disorganized, but Mike made the best of the situation and tried to keep everybody happy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Mike is truly a great professor. If you are lucky enough to have him for ENES100 make the most out of this experience. His lectures are fun and engaging which makes the two hour class go by quickly. Mike is also a major help with the hands on portion of this since he is always there for you or your team when you need help.
Mike was someone you could go to for help and was extremely reliable. If ENES 100 was a low grade, then Mike was the curve that saves your GPA.

Had mike for enes 102 also, literally the best teacher a student could hope for. His lectures are fun and engaging. Hes an easy grader, but he is also always willing to give teams advice and help so they can succeed and get the most from the class.

Mike was an absolutely amazing professor! He takes an already amazing course and makes it even more enjoyable through his great teaching and funny, caring, approachable, and even inspirational personality. If you are taking this course, make the most out of your experience by learning new skills and an amazing experience will come naturally.

Mike is one of those teachers that really, truly cares about all his students. He taught us not only the course material, but also how to be a better engineer in general. I learned so much from his class, more than any other class I took before him, and despite the challenging nature of the course, he was there to support us every step of the way.

I honestly think if I had my choice at any prof for 102, I would pick Mike. He was so forgiving, helpful and approachable which is crucial in this class. He understands the pain kids go through, especially their first years. His class was also entertaining, there aren't many profs that can get me excited for a 9am. Put in your own effort though too

Out of the blue during class, he picked me out of the class and gave a sized 19 basketball shoe that had a couple autographs from umd players. Few others could make such a dull class into one I looked forward to each day.

Lectures are engaging and teaches the content well. However, example problems in class are always much, much easier than what is on the exam, so you have to do difficult problems on your own to further teach yourself. No quizzes, 2.5 hrs of HW a week, and 4 exams of moderate difficulty. Decent curve and extra credit so an A is easily obtainable.

Mike is a great professor. You can tell that he ligitamitley care about his students. His lectures are funny and interesting! He will help however he needs to make sure that you do well in the class (as long as you put the effort in on your end). Also his cookies are delicious.

Mike was the best professor Ive had so far and made me excited to be a part of the UMD engineering school. He was very engaging and always willing to help students improve their knowledge and grades. Very inspiring and a great person overall.

Mike finds fun ways to demonstrate simple concepts, and is a very personal teacher. Classes move at a smooth pace, and the practice in class is always relevant to the online homework. The exams he gives are fair, and if you study hard, take decent notes, and do the online homework, you will have a blast in his class.

Mike as the worst professor I have had so far in my college experience. He is rude, indirect, and not a good lecturer. Going to another professors lectures is the only way to pass the class. Absolute worst decision to ever take a class with him. He cannot teach and randomly shared personal stories. I am here for a degree not to hear about your life

This Professor was very organized and a great lecturer . He makes the information clear and helps students get the right equations. He is fair and gives extra credit for homework assignments. I would take this professor again in a heartbeat.

Mike does a great job making lecture interesting with funny jokes and personal anecdotes. His method of teaching is very direct and he is also very accessible outside of class. Besides being an amazing teacher, he is a very cool person, great baker (bakes for students!), and fun to be around. I wish I could have Mike teach all of my courses!!!

Professor Galczynski is a fantastic teacher who makes the class fun and engaging with his lectures. He has a great sense of humor and is able to help with any questions you have about the material. Mike provides many opportunities for extra credit and uses Canvas far more efficiently and reliably than the other professors teaching ENES102.

Michael Galczynski is one of the best professors I have ever had. He creates the perfect balance of humor and effective lecture to keep you actively engaged in class while continuing to properly communicate the material. Not only is he well spoken and humorous, but he is a fantastic lecturer. There was not a single lecture I didn't learn from.

Mike is a professor who is ready to help at various times and is looking out for students best interests. Office hours really help to better understand the curriculum and the lectures help too. Mike knows how to explain the material in a way that each individual student understands the material. Very encouraging and considerate.

Mike is a really great teacher. He keeps the lecture entertaining so theyre not super dense and you stay engaged and hes really good at answering questions on any doubts on the concepts. Hes also a 10/10 baker and will bring baked good to class! I would definitely recommend taking a class taught by him if you get the chance!

Mike was great, very funny, very personable, and very understanding. He even let one guy retake an exam because they screwed up the date. Definitely would recommend. I hated ENES just because it wasn't my cup of tea but mike made it bareable

Professor Galczynski was a great Professor for ENES102H. He is by far the best teacher for this course. He is hilarious and makes the lectures enjoyable. He even brought our class cookies multiple times. Finally, he is the Professor who you would enjoy seeing outside of class. I even ran into Mike at the UMD golf course. Overall, a great Professor.
Lectures are great and engaging. Clearly cares about his students.

Great professor. Mechanics isn't an easy course but the way he teaches it really engages the whole class. I loved his corny jokes and comments and his morning 5 minute spiels. If you have to take ENES102, take it with Mike!!

Mike is an excellent teacher and person! He makes his lectures very fun and interesting while still managing to teach us all the material needed. Mike has been one of my favorite professors and I would definitely take him again!

I absolutely loved having Mike as my professor for ENES102H! He truly cares about his students, is really accessible outside of class if you reach out to him, and fills his lectures with funny jokes and inspiring tidbits. Would 10/10 recommend him and hope to have him again as my professor!

Mike is by far the best professor I had. The class itself is somewhat difficult, but Mike makes it very do-able. He's hilarious and easy to relate to, and the lectures are straight forward and engaging. He also gives you all the information and practice materials you need to do well on the exams. There are lots of extra credit opportunities too.

MIKE <3 he's by far my favorite professor from my first semester and will be hard to beat. He makes his lectures interesting with funny stories and good examples to help understand the concepts in the course. He's also really good at baking and will bring in treats, which is a good incentive to study. 13/10 would recommend.
Mike is a great professor and is able to pack a large amount of learning into a small window. He's also a great guy to travel with and this trip will definitely be a life long memory.

He has a way of teaching that makes the content seem a lot easier than it initially comes off. He's really funny and HE BRINGS PASTRIES to class every once in a while. Always available to help outside of class, very approachable and understanding. 100% recommend taking his class. (gives extra credit for pretty much every assignment too)
He's pretty good, sometimes skips over things in class but he's a lot of fun, and has entertaining lectures. He also really cares about his students
Going to Iceland with Mike has left me with some amazing memories. He made the course fun and respected us as students. The course was fun, interesting, and memorable. I wish I could do it all again.
Mike is one of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures are informative and funny.

I went abroad with this professor for a spring break term in Athens, Greece. He truly helped the students learn in a non-traditional way but remained giving very thoughtful and practical feedback on our work. I definitely recommend this professor, as he is fun, inspirational, approachable and relatable!

Taking ENCE489G with Mike was great! He was able to teach us so much in such little time! His lectures are not boring and he is so knowledgable about lots of subjects. I would highly recommend taking a study abroad class with him or even a class at UMD!

Professor Mike is amazing. He was a student once at UMD, so he relates so much to his students to help them understand that everyone struggles with course material and work. With Mike's encouragement to be self-engaged, asking questions, & provide feedback, encouraged me to work very hard in this class to Earn a very good passing grade.

Studying abroad in Iceland with Mike was a very memorable experience. He taught us so much in such a short amount of time without making me feel like it was crammed or rushed. He is always there to help if you need it and puts a smile on your face with his jokes and bubbly personality.
Mike's an awesome teacher and very enthusiastic and passionate about what he does. Highly recommend him as a teacher and hope I can take him again in the future because he makes class a lot of fun!

Mike was a great professor who made the daily lectures interesting and always kept us engaged. His humor was one of my favorite parts of the class. He was very ready and willing to help us with any questions or concerns we had with our Rube Goldberg projects. Although the course focused on Civil, Mike gave us a good overview of other branches.
Mike is the best! he is so funny and personable, definitely the best ENES100 prof. He is accessible outside of class and is always willing to help!
Mike's funny, understanding, and really really wants you to succeed. He gives good advice and adds a personal touch to the class that makes you want to succeed as well. 10/10 would recommend.

Mike was a great teacher and I truly learned a lot from his lectures, which were interesting and really caught my attention. I enjoyed being in his class because he was entertaining and not monotone. He seemed like he actually cared about all his students. It was a great experience
Mike is an amazing professor. He cares about the success of his student. He also makes the class very fun and engaging. I would definitely recommend to take his class!!
Awesome professor, good at making concepts clear and always willing to answer questions

I took Mike for ENES 100 and 102 and also ENME 407 and had an amazing experience in each one of those classes. His lectures are super engaging and clear and he takes the time to create a relationship with the students.

I was in Mikes ENES100 class which had a lot of groupwork. He would often bring candy or even bake lemon bars for the class. He tells entertaining stories or makes corny physics puns, or even runs around the class wearing a black tarp pretending to be a sith lord. He is always accessible when you need help and gives extra credit/curve for effort.

Mike made my study abroad experience more memorable than I could have imagined! He is incredibly engaging during lectures and takes the time to understand the needs of his students. He ensured that each excursion complemented what we learned in lecture. I would definitely take a class with him again.

I had Mike for two classes, one being ENES100 and the other being ENME407 (study abroad), and in both he was able to show his dedication to the success students achieved in the course. Never did I feel overwhelmed by his expectations and my experiences in both courses were fantastic.
Mike is super energetic and is really invested in his students and their success. For a class that can be easily overwhelming, he offers great insight and creates an excellent classroom environment.

One of my largest critiques of most college professors is that they are primarily focused on their research and subject area, and their teaching is an annoying side-task that prevents them from focusing on what they truly care about. This is clearly not the case with Mike; he has both a genuine passion and gift for teaching. Definitely recommend.

Took him for ENCE489G (Sustainability in Greece). Great guy and great teacher. He really cares about the success of his students and makes sure they are having fun while learning. He is a smart guy, knows his stuff, and knows how to convey that info in a learn-able way. Mike is a friend and a mentor (a frientor). Take his class.
He was very helpful in and out of class. His lectures were interesting and very easy to understand.

If you're looking to take ENES 100, definitely take Mike! He's an amazing professor who really cares for his students. He makes the class interesting and is always there to help. The class can definitely be a lot of work, but if you come and do your part you will be successful. Mike was awesome and I would definitely take him again if I could!

Definitely take Mike's class if you can! He really cares about his students and works hard to help them be successful. He also finds ways to encourage teamwork that make the class really fun and engaging. Learned a lot and had a great experience taking his class.

Mike is a very friendly guy and puts forth a lot of effort in his lectures and getting to know his students. For the first 1/2 of the semester, ENES100 is a breeze. Very little homework. But, the course can become pretty time consuming in the 2nd half when you begin constructing your OSV. tl;dr: I would highly recommend taking Mike for ENES100.
Mike is such a great lecturer! He always makes class interesting. He genuinely cares about his students and is very helpful outside of class.

Mike was an overall amazing professor during my time in his course. He prepared interesting lectures specific to several topics within the study area. Additionally, Mike was always willing to help us with difficulties. He recognized that not all of us had been taught the same material across the board. Mike was able to help us in and out of class.

Studying abroad with Mike was a great experience. The class had the perfect balance between learning the course material and applying the concepts learned in class on field trips around Iceland. Mike was very knowledgeable about the course material and the country, and his lectures were informative and entertaining.

Mike is great. He cares a lot about teaching, gets to know you on a personal level and is glad to help whenever needed. Even when all we wanted was walk around in Greece and experience the new culture,he continuously engages us in and out of lecture so that we are actually able to learn from the class. 10/10 great guy and fantastic travel bud.

Professor Galczynski is an amazing professor. He cares deeply about his students and the subject. He is easy to talk to in and outside of class and has a good sense of humor too. I would definitely recommend taking a class taught by him!
Excellent, exciting and engaging professor! Take him for any class and you will have a good time!
Mike is a very approachable proof and seemed pretty genuine in all our interactions.

What an amazing teacher! Mike's engaging personality made his lectures a joy to participate in. He is so inspiring and easy to relate to. Mike often used personal anecdotes to allow me to further understand the topic being taught. On top of it all, his fun personality and attentive nature made everyday in his class a wonderful experience.

3 words to describe Mike is not nearly enough. Mike is everything you could ask for in a teacher. He is attentive, inspiring, and all around a great human being. Mike is a role model to me and I HIGHLY recommend you get to know the guy if given the chance.

Mike is an amazing teacher. He finds a way to make the material fun to learn. He really cares, and puts a lot of effort in to making the experience as best as possible. During lecture he is hilarious. The class/trip planned for this course was unforgettable, and I would absolutely go back. I highly recommend taking this class and Mike as a teacher.

Mike put in a lot of effort planning this course so we made the most of our time in Iceland. He was also very personable, so it made the trip fun for everyone. I strongly recommend this course and this professor.
Mike was a great professor. He always made his lectures engaging with his corny dad jokes, candy, and baked goods. He genuinely cares about his students and is willing to work with you.

Mike is one of the best professors Ive had, and it shows in his lecture style. Hes informative and interesting to listen too, which makes lecture that much better. Hes an amazing teacher for a great class.

If you have a base understanding of engineering physics, you should have no problem understanding the material. Mike made it easy to clarify any confusion and/or correct any non-material related issues (e.g. grade errors)
He really knows the material and is good at explaining it. He also encouraged thinking outside the box and participation in class.
Had a great time with Mike. Would love to learn from him in the future.

He's like a bro. Very likable and his classes are always funny and interesting. He loves to bake and will sometimes bring in desserts for the class. If you have the opportunity to take his classes, jump on it.

Mike was an amazing teacher in ENES102. What other comments forget to mention is that he once took the same 102 class when he was still a student at UMD. So he understands what students go through. He'll explain everything in the most simple way possible. Visible effort from you means extra support from him.

More than anything, Mike really cares about the atmosphere of the class. He made sure we all knew him on a personal level as well as gave us plenty of opportunities to get to know the rest of the students. He cares that each student is doing well, so if you put in any effort, you'll do great in this class!
Class was interesting and Mike was relatable which is nice in engineering since this field can be intimidating.

You can tell that Mike really cares about if his students grasp the concepts that are being taught. He was very good at preparing us with problems that were similar to test and homework questions. He was always available for extra help outside of the classroom and overall, a very cool teacher. He makes this class both interesting and fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Took his ENES100 class my first semester of college. I think he will end up being my favorite professor. He genuinely cared about my learning and me as a person. ENES100 is one of those classes where you're kind of left on your own to figure it out, but Mike did an awesome job guiding us.

Really enjoyed the class. Felt Mike actually cared about me as a person. Would be available outside of class for extra help. Took the time to explain stuff. Felt he could've done a bit more teaching, but overall I still learned the major concepts. Class was enjoyable and he often brought in treats and taught us valuable life lessons.
Mike is a great teacher for 102! He's really passionate about what he teaches and always had examples to demonstrate the material. He's also so funny and definitely kept the class engaged.
Really easy to talk to in and outside of class and always willing to help

Professor Galczynski easily made ENES100 the highlight of my first semester at UMD. Never before have I had a Professor that was as charismatic about the course content. I was blown away by the hours that he put in for the students outside of class too. The week prior to the competition he stayed until 11 PM to help each team. Take Mike for ENES!!!
Keeps the class engaging and fun
Great professor, keeps class engaging and is very helpful in and out of class. Anecdotes keep class interesting but dont waste time and 100% would take again

ENES100 was my favorite class I took this past semester. Mike was an awesome teacher. He is super helpful to his students and you can tell that he really cares about their success. 10/10 would recommend

Mike was a good professor. I could tell he was really enthusiastic about the material, and he was never afraid to show it during lecture. This guy clearly loves what he's doing! That being said, he really cares about his students, and wants you to succeed; whether providing extra office hours or help, he's very easy to talk to. Solid choice for 102

Our ENES section and our team did an incredible job all thanks to Mike. He did an amazing job giving us advice and keeping us motivated throughout the semester even when times got tough. And he made a very demanding project seem manageable. He's a fantastic teacher and I would definitely take his class again.

Our ENES100 class finished tied for 2nd (should have been 1st) out of 8 sections. This success was due to Mike. His lectures were very helpful in teaching us the basic math and science behind building an OSV (Over Sand Vehicle). However, he promoted creativity and teamwork as the most important aspects of the class. That's why I enjoyed his class.
Mike cared a lot about us all getting A's, but didn't care whether we actually learned the content. He wasted tons of class time and we didn't learn as much as the other sections of ENES100.

Mike is the best! He is super passionate about teaching and he really cares about his students. His lectures are very interesting and his jokes are hilarious! Mike is a 5 star legend. Thanks so much for the hot glue award!

Professor Galczynskis course in civil engineering was the best part of my summer. He was funny and engaging while teaching us exactly what we needed to know. How much he was able to pack into each day was extremely impressive. He pours himself into teaching, and it's clear that he loves what he does. Consider yourself lucky if you get him.

This summer course in engineering was engaging and enriching. He started each class with a team building exercise. The subject matter of the day was then presented in an interactive way which made us think about how this knowledge could be used in real life. His insightful feedback helped us explore the possibilities for our final project.

Great experience! Mike is a really involved teacher, and it's obvious he is interested in what he teaches. I found he was attentive regarding any questions, and was ready to help out if necessary. His lectures were interesting, and I appreciated the amount of work he put in to making the class enjoyable.

Mike is such an inspiring and interesting teacher who understands how to captivate his students. Mike possesses the ability to relate the lecture to stories that he experienced, which actually helps create an insightful look at the lecture. Mike is such amazing guy who is willing to do whatever it takes to help the student learn from the experience

On the first day, from the moment Mike introduced himself to us, I could sense that he was a confident, well-prepared, and very likable guy. I learned so much in the ensuing three weeks; I never once felt the urge to drift away from his lectures. The countless stories that Mike told were absolutely hilarious but also insightful at the same time.

Here's a teacher who is what you would call an ideal professor. He knows his material extremely well and is able to make any lecture interesting. He has endless funny stories that always add to the situation. He does his very best to make sure everyone understands the material. Anyone who has him as a teacher is super lucky, because he is amazing!!

One of the greatest lecturers Ive ever had. Being always filled with enthusiasm, he truly knows how to make his class something to look forward to. An expert in making his students engage with the subject, Mikes always helpful with any doubts and concerns. Having him as a teachers been an incredible experience, for he surpassed all expectations.

I came into the civil engineering not completely sure what to expect, but I left a transformed person, filled with valuable knowledge, experience, and memories that will stay with me forever. As a teacher, Mike made class entertaining with his endless enthusiasm and made me eager to learn every day. A great teacher, but an even better human being.
Mike is a really awesome teacher and I recommend him to anyone. He is very helpful and tells many funny stories. Overall, he is super cool.

I had big expectations for this course. Never have I participated in a class so geared toward my passionate pursuits in engineering nor have I been so excited to learn. Mike made the course surpass all of those expectations with his enthusiasm for teaching, comprehensive and engaging lessons and invaluable advice not just in education, but in life.

If you're looking for an awesome ENES100 professor, take Mike. You can tell that he cares a lot about his students and gives many opportunities to succeed. He may be a tough grader on major assignments, but with lots of EC, group participation, and a small curve, you can trust that you will get the grade you deserve. He also bakes you goodies!

Come for the lemon bars, stay for the life changing advice. Mike doesn't teach you how to build an OSV, he teaches you to succeed in life.  Not only the best ENES100 professor, but the easiest as well with multiple extra credit assignments. The kind of teacher you would come back to visit and stay in touch with. Build your schedule around his class

Mike is an amazing professor! He puts so much effort into his lectures to make them fun and engaging - lots of discussions, extra credit, funny stories and jokes - it really helps grasp the concepts and it makes the time fly. It is easy to see that he cares a lot about this class and his students. And he bakes for his students which is awesome!
Highly recommend Mike. Participation and how you interact with your team is what matters most to him. He really wants to see his students succeed. Nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Mike is absolutely amazing. He is funny and makes engineering a little easier for everyone. He is always willing to help out in any way possible and give advice. His lectures are always entertaining and will brighten up anyone's morning for two straight hours. The OSV project is designed to be hard but Mike makes it easier by being there.

Mike was an amazing professor, pretty easy class, but it was definitely hard at times. If you choose to take him you will not regret it, because you will learn so much! Mike really introduced the Engineering process and showed us how to properly use it throughout the semester. He was very motivational and inspiring, something everyone def needs.

Mike was a great instructor for this course. He did an excellent job creating an environment in which it was easy to learn the material. He is very responsive through email and always makes extra time for students if they need it. I won't say that it was an easy A, but Mike went out of his way to provide everyone the opportunity to receive one.

He has a great personality and can woo anyone with his baking skills. Teaching skills? Eh, but who cares, I mean he bakes for his students! Luckily, the class isn't particularly difficult and so everyone gets an A and is content with the GPA boost despite not really learning much. The class is all about experiential learning, not anything from him.

Mike is an enthusiastic, brilliant instructor. He actually wants to show up to teach students. He has excellent speaking skills and consistently engages students. Mike understands and relates to the college experience of undergraduate students.

Mike was probably the most approachable teacher that I have had. He has been more than able to answer the numerous questions I've had in this class. He provides amazing guidance and support in the lab.

Although the class is a lot of work, Mike tries to make it as easy to complete as possible and explains the concepts well. He wants all of his students to succeed which shows in the way he teaches and his availability for you to get extra help if needed. Take him for ENES100 you won't regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Mike is a great professor and is very helpful. He is easy to talk to and makes the 2 hour lectures in the beginning of the semester go by quickly. He is funny and always makes sure the class is interested and involved. The OSV project was a great experience and Mike guided us well. Overall, this class was by far my favorite  class of the semester.

Mike was a great professor. He was always able to meet outside of class for questions and was very helpful as well as entertaining during lectures. He made lecture fairly entertaining and would even give us candy and baked goods. Easy to talk to and will teach you many life lessons. Take this class!

Mike made a class that is almost 2 hours bearable by making engineering topics somewhat entertaining (which is hard to do). He always had fun with teaching and really likes what he does. And he likes to bake so he gave us cookies that had oreos in them. Great guy.

Best Professor ever! He's really funny in class, very intelligent, and knows so much about the material. He is always happy to help and inspires you to do the best. Not to mention his amazing lemon bars and cookies!!

Mike is a great professor that cares about his students and their education. He constantly looks for new and memorable ways to convey new and complex information in a way that we, as students, can understand and appreciate. His lectures are relevant, innovative, and entertaining. 10/10 would recommend.

If someone were to ask me to describe a great teacher, I would just point to Michael Galczynski. Mike is an inspiration that made me and my friends always look forward to the class. He makes sure his students learn, not only in engineering but also translating those lessons to life.  However, -1 on rating, he never revealed his lemon bar recipe.
Mike is one of the best professors I've had. You can tell that he really cares about every student. Great at what he does and always ready to help.

There are no words to describe the greatness that is the experience of ENES 100 with Michael Galczynski.  What Bell was to the telephone he is to introductory engineering. What Einstein was to relativity, he is to Over Sand Vehicles.  His powerpoints so riveting you physically are unable to remove your eyes from the screen.  42/10 would recommend.

Easily the best ENES100 professor. Really cares about his students and is a great baker. Grades very difficult compared to other ENES100 professors, but he's always willing to stay late to help you out.
Fantastic person - makes sure that his students know that they should value work and learning above straight grades

Mike is a pretty good professor. He tends to run a little long in lectures and ends up skipping important information. However, he is entertaining and and overall great professor. He's a very harsh grader, but the class is curved in the end so it ultimately doesn't matter. Also, don't buy the book. You won't use it.

Professor Galczynski was my favorite professor so far at the University of Maryland.  He provides extensive feedback on all assignments and is always willing to help his students succeed.  He is extremely engaging and makes it easy to pay attention in class and understand the material.

Professor Galczynski is tough when grading assignments such as presentations but he also lends help when preparing for those presentations so that you know what he is looking for and are able to succeed. Also his advise is always delivered respectfully and is always very helpful. He is very invested in all his students.

Mike is a great professor! He knows the material well and is passionate about what he teaches, but also likes to have fun and genuinely cares for his students. Although the class was rather challenging, I consistently looked forward to it and learned a lot. As long as you apply yourself and take his class seriously, and your grades will fine. :)

Mike is a great professor, he cares about students and wants them to do well grade-wise and also cares that you actually learn in his class. He's good about being hands off and allowing for experiential learning, he'll support your group but he's not going to be doing the project for you. He's nice, funny, and makes good cookies. Take Mike.

I took ENES100 with Professor Galczynski during the fall of 2016. While I cannot say it was my favorite class due to the heavy reliance on group members in determining your grade, I can say Professor Galczynski was one of my favorite professors. He's extremely easy to talk to and truly cares about his students. Take his class!

Mike was an awesome professor!!! I learned more about engineering here than I did in my physics or calc classes. He's a super nice guy and very funny which made going to class actually enjoyable. I 100% would recommend him to other students.

Great teacher who really reciprocates respect to you when respect is shown toward his class and him. I always looked forward to Mikes class; hes really funny and makes the difficult class interesting and worthwhile and is a good person to talk to outside of class

Mike was by far my favorite professor this semester. I really enjoyed coming to class because he made it so fun. He was super helpful with our OSV project giving us the guidance & advice we needed to succeed. We could always count on him for motivation & inspirational speeches. He brings food occasionally too. Definitely take his class if you can!

Amazing teacher and class. You could probably get away with skipping a couple classes but your grade is heavily dependent upon your final project and within that project 400 pts come from your peer reviews, so if you never come you won't score well. Mike is hilarious and very helpful. His lectures were entertaining and informational. def recommend

Mike is an amazing professor. Easily the most entertaining and inspirational lectures I've attended, while still having great information. Gives plenty of opportunities for XC (including wearing costumes on Halloween). Very helpful, understanding, charming, funny, and attractive. Makes ENES100 fun. Take him, if you get the chance!

Mike is a good teacher! He is respectful and willing to help you. His class is challenging (not an easy A) and your grade is mainly dependent on the group project. However, if you come in for office hours and have him preview your work ahead of time then you should be able to get a good grade in his class!
Mike has been a pleasure to learn from! He's always ready to help, and has even altered his schedule to give my team extra lab time. I would recommend him, definitely!
Mike is simply amazing! He made going to class each week enjoyable. He made the building process very fun and I am so glad I had Mike as a professor!
Mike was incredible. Enough said. Take him if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you have the chance - take him. End of story.
Great teacher
Mike is the best guy! If you become friends with him theres no way youll do bad in the class.
Mike is the best instructor I have had. Nothing else needs to be said.
Mike is the best teacher I have had in my life

I came in to SPCS engineering not knowing what to expect, but after attending just a couple of Mike's classes, I realized that he was an amazing teacher as well as a great person in general. He really cares about his students and also has a lot of experience with engineering. It is a shame that the course only lasted three weeks!

Mike is awesome! He cares so much about his students and loves to teach. He is a hilarious lecturer and very helpful throughout the semester. He even brings in sweets to share with his students! Even after you take his class, he is still available to help you out, whether it be engineering related or career advice. TAKE HIS CLASS!

Mike is awesome! He cares so much about his students and loves to teach. He is a hilarious lecturer and very helpful throughout the semester. He even brings in sweets to share with his students! Even after you take his class, he is still available to help you out, whether it be engineering related or helping you choose a career path. TAKE HIM!!!!!!

I had Mike for a summer introductory class in Civil Engineering and I quickly learned that I was in good hands. Mike respects his students' academic interests by allowing us to give input to what we'll learn. He is also capable of connecting with his students by humbly lowering himself to match our level.

I had Mike as my professor for Civil Engineering at SPCS. He was incredibly good at keeping his class full of interesting topics and lectures. He assigned a Rube Goldberg project that was both challenging and fun. I can honestly say that Mike was one of the best teachers I have ever had even though I only was able to learn from him for three weeks.
Awesome teacher and great class!

I had Mike as an instructor at Stanford Precollegiate studies, and it isn't a stretch to say his course changed my life. He exposed me to a wide variety of engineering fields,  and is all around a great guy. Super jealous for anyone at Maryland because you have the chance to have this man for a teacher! He's a hell'ova engineer!

Mike is by far the coolest Professor I've had at UMD. He is a great mentor and someone I have learned a lot from. I took ENCE 489 with him, which was a short-term study abroad program in Prague and I couldn't have asked for a better Professor to travel with. He presents his lectures in a fun, and interactive way making sure everyone is paying attention. He knows his way around Prague and knows the historical details so doing after class activities with him was always fun and educational at the same time. He is a young professor with a lot of experience that you can learn from, so I highly recommend to take him.

Mr. Galczynski truly cares about his students and strives to help them grasp concepts and succeed in life. He tends to cater to visual and hands-on learning which makes class more interesting. He has a lot of wisdom and insightful experiences to share. He's also really funny and may or may not give you candy and lemon bars.

Mike is a greate professor. The first half of the course is heavily lectures but Mike made it bearable with his funny and inspirational stories. In the lab Mike was always around to help lend a hand and give suggestions. He was also really nice about holding extra lab hours to help us get ready for the osv competition. Wish he taught more classes

The class was good and he speaks to the students like they are real people or his equals. Often times I feel like teacher miss this aspect when teaching. I greatly enjoyed the course and it was easy to talk to him.  I think he should run for president. I leaned how to build an OSV(oversand vehicle) which was a lot fun.

Mike is by far the best instructor I've had in college. He makes material easy to understand using relatable and humorous analogies, he is very patient and willing to help, and his lectures are the perfect mixture of relevant jokes or backstories and important information. He also makes you want to work hard for yourself. Overall, great guy.

Mike is an amazing proffessor. He cares a ton about his students and is really good at explaning concepts in a way that makes sense to students. Hes also amazing about feedback. If you feel he could be doing something more, just tell him and he will probably take you up on your suggestion
He is a great teacher but a better person! Really cares about his students

Mike is a great professor. He's young, easy to relate to, and offers good life advice. He provides sufficient guidance for the OSV project and really supports his students in their endeavors. He's a very genuine guy who loves teaching students about engineering. ENES100 itself is a difficult class but Mike makes it a whole lot easier.

I was dreading ENES100 but ended up loving it because I had Mike. He's funny, he knows what he's talking about, and he actually cares about his students as people. He even brings baked goods to class sometimes! I've never met anyone who doesn't like him.

Mike was probably one of the best, if not the best, instructors and resources I had at Cal. I had him as a GSI for Physics 8A, which quickly became one of the only discussions I really looked forward to attending because of his enthusiasm, devotion, and ability to present the material in a way that was both informative and engaging. Take him!

Mike has honestly been one of, if not, the most inspirational professor I have ever had as an engineer. He is young, funny, and really understands where the students come from. I consider him a good friend as well as an amazing professor. This class takes a lot of work, but he is there for you ever step of the way. Plus he bakes lemon bars!

Mike's  a really fun professor, and I genuinely looked forward to  the portion of the semester when our 2 hour class was lectures only, not the OSV group project. I still  go to Mike for advice  in school and other things in general, and he's there for me. He's a professor that's also a friend. 10/10 recommend to everyone for ENES100!

Mike has been my favorite professor so far. He took a class that a lot of people tend to hate (ENES100) and made it fun. He made the lectures as interesting as possible and he was super helpful during the big project. He's easy to talk to and really wants everyone to succeed. If you show up and do your work this is an easy A.

Mike is the man. Period. Not only a great professor to take engineering classes with, but an awesome guy to talk to in general. Even though he's a young guy, he has a lot of wisdom and general life experience that he is more than willing to impart on his students given that they listen. Also an excellent baker.

Awesome and young.  super relatable and easy to approach.  He truly wants each and every student to not only succeed grade wise in the class, but to grow as a person too.  this class in general isn't the most fun in my opinion- but you have to take it as an engineering major so be sure to take Mike.  he made it enjoyable to come to class!

Mike is a genuinely good professor who cares about his students and goes out of his way for them. His lectures are entertaining and he has a good sense of humor. Would recommend taking his class and also befriending him because he'll be there for you when the course is over, too.
Be a good student and he'll be a good professor. He always has great, inspirational stories to tell. His baked goods are a bonus.

Mike gives his students a welcoming and informative introduction to the engineering college. While many (but not all) of the older, established professors are harsh and fail to connect to their students, Mike befriends his students.  While the ENES100 course is a test of the group's ability, Mike gave me the direction to be successful.

I had Mike as a Physics 8A Fall 2013  graduate student instructor. He was always prepared, had creative examples for explaining concepts, made going to section something to look forward to, and was really approachable especially for individual help. He's an instructor you remember after leaving college and can say cared about his students.

Mike Galczynski, is by far one of my favorite teacher at UMD of all time. The entire semester that I took his class, I was actually excited to be there.  He's witty and has great slides to keep the class engaged. He truly cares about each team, and how they are doing; he will go out of his way to make sure, everything is fine. Best Teacher! nufsaid

Mike Galczynski was one of my instructors for  ENES472, a study abroad course on global business and leadership. He is hands down one of the most engaging instructors I have ever has. He made the material interesting and interactive to the point where you could almost forget you were in class. If you have a chance to take a class with Mike, do it.

Mike was probably the best professor I had this semester. He was extremely approachable, and explained all of the course material in a way that was both interesting and easy to understand. He's also really understanding of personal circumstances, and just a generally nice guy to be around. 5/5, wish he taught all my classes.

Mike was my professor for ENES100. He did an excellent job of guiding us through the difficult tasks at hand. He was exciting and eager to teach every day. I was never afraid to ask for help. He is one the most supportive and caring teachers I have had.

Mike was my instructor for ENES472 (international business culture  in engineering). The course information was occasionally dull/repetitive, but Mike did an excellent job of engaging the class. His lectures were entertaining and insightful. Mike is always eager to help whenever possible, and it is clear that he really cares about his students.

Mike's a genuinely funny guy, so his lectures were quite enjoyable. He also made himself available to students for extra help, which is good because the project was tough. I think his level of dedication to his students is unusual. He even helped me in an academic/career advising capacity even though he had no obligation to do that. Great guy!
Actually wants to help you and for you to succeed-plus he is super down to earth and easy to talk to. I'd definitely recommend taking Mike
Awesome professor. Very helpful with all stages of your project. First few weeks have long lectures but Mike makes the lectures very interesting
Simple to follow lectures. Tailored instruction to needs of students. Understands the rigor of a college student's life.
Mike is super helpful and always available to be there for you. He teaches for the students. He explains things in ways that are memorable, relatable,  and applicable.

He was my graduate student instructor for Physics 8A at UC Berkeley. He motivated me to show up to our section, to study my butt off, and to actually learn the material. Aside from his motivation, his lectures are clear, easy to follow, and were critical to me learning the material. You could only be so lucky to have him as a teacher for physics.
This guy made ENES100 bearable. He's absolutely fantastic and the only professor worth taking that damn course with. Really helpful and nice. And gives us food!!
This guy is a hero. The only good enes100 teacher in the entire department.

Mike is AWESOME. He's super nice and funny and really into the class and competition. First year he's taught so a little rough around the edges in terms of teaching style but got better as semester went on. Always there to help- even offered to stay at school overnight to help with our projects. Definitely would take him again. TONS of extra credit

The harder you work under Mike's instruction--the more it will pay off! Mike encourages questions, curiosity, and welcomes misunderstandings and challenges as he truly views himself as a tool instrumental in our education. Go to class, study his notes, ask questions, engage in office hours, and you will be given all you need to pass this class!

Mike was probably the most helpful, instructive, relatable, compassionate and communicative teachers while I was in school. Every minute in his lecture/discussion/lab is well spent--and it is equally rewarding for your understanding of the subject and confidence in yourself to have Mike G. on your team. He encourages grit and rewards sincere effort

Michael Galczynski was the instructor for my Physics 8a lab at UC Berkeley. He was very clear and thorough when explaining concepts. It was obvious that he cared about all the students in his lab. He went beyond what was expected of lab instructors, such as bringing in extra material for demonstrations (slinkys and guitars).

Mike was my GSI for Physics at UC Berkeley and he literally saved my grade. I don't think I would have passed were it not for him. He was engaging and enthusiastic, even at an 8am session, and he was clear and made sure you understood. Cheers Mike!

One of Mike's strongest attributes is that he's highly approachable. He makes it easy to ask for help, and gives excellent, thorough explanations. He's the kind of prof that is obviously passionate about teaching and the subject, and I'm so glad I got to learn from him. Would definitely take a class with him again!
Such an inspirational teacher! I had such a blast taking his course on civil engineering and would highly recommend that you take any of his courses!
Great professor, he makes the whole class interested in whats going on. You have fun while learning really well. Lectures are helpful and simply amazing.

Mike's lectures were  engaging and inspirational. He was very helpful and even visited our class in the dorms at night to help us finish a final project. He frequently gave the class great advice about school, education, and life. His dedication to teaching was also evident in his clear, concise explanations of concepts. Mike was a great lecturer!

He was always eager to help his students in anyway possible! Before tests he always gave us really great practice problems that were similar to the test. You could tell that he took seriously helping his students to succeed unlike a lot of people who just teach because they have to.

Mike was one of the best lecturers I've ever listened to. He explained concepts such as resistance in circuits and torque better than any other teacher or professor that I've listened to. He used clear analogies that made it really easy to understand. Also, he's a really good baker, and if you're nice to him, he'll give you candy.

An absolutely great prof who really makes you believe that you can succeed, not just in his class, but in life. He's very approachable and gives great, engaging lectures and made us excited to go to class everyday. I would highly recommend!

Mike Galczynski is by far one of the greatest teachers I have ever come across. He always goes the extra mile each day in and out of the classroom. His teaching style makes harder material easier to understand. Almost everything that comes out of Mike's mouth can be written down as inspirational quotes, which helps students push themselves daily.

Prof. Mike has a talent for teaching physics. As a GSI for Physics 8A, he went above and beyond to ensure that his lectures were presented in a comprehensible manner to all of his students. His demonstrations are perhaps the best aspect; he designs them in such a way that the concepts they illustrate are impossible to forget. Thank you, Mike!

Mike was one of the best graduate student instructors I had at UC Berkeley. He was fun to talk with, and when I finished assignments early, he would come up with challenging and interesting problems to do for fun. He explained concepts very well and took the time to make sure every student had a good understanding of the material.

Professor Mike is amazing!!! He cares about his students so much and prioritizes teaching over everything else! He made me look forward to going to physics class at 8 am because his class was so much fun and he brought food and coffee. He's adorkable :) Taylor Swift, I hope you are reading this.

Mike was one of the best professors I've ever had by far. He was always there to clarify any problems for me and his lectures were truly showed that he cares about his students as well as his interest in the course.
Awesome professor, and person. Really came through for me when I needed it, and wrote me an awesome rec!

Mike is without a doubt one of the greatest  teachers I've had the pleasure to learn from. His enthusiasm for the subject matter and the manner of his teaching, through both engaging lectures and a hilarious personality, are second to none. The extent to which Mike was willing to sacrifice his free time to help his students was very inspirational.

Mike was one of the best teachers I've had the privilege of working with. He was clearly very knowledgeable, and his engaging personality and sense of humor created a dynamic classroom environment with lectures that never failed to both entertain and inform. He also took time to arrange wonderful field trips, and was quite approachable.
Had many tutoring sessions with Mike before exams, really helped me prepare for them and explained concepts in creative ways. Really knows his stuff and wants to help students succeed.

Mike was well-known at UC Berkeley for being the best Physics 8A graduate student instructor. He gave clear and engaging lectures, created helpful problems with hilarious drawings, and baked us amazing lemon bars. I dislike physics and do not excel at it, but Mike made a difficult class much more bearable. Take physics with him if you can!
He's a awesome teacher and goes the extra mile to emsure students understand the material! There was never a lecture that wasn't engaging, would highly recommend taking a class with him!

I had Mike as a civil engineering teacher at a summer program at Stanford. I don't think civil is the most popular type of engineering, but everyone wanted to be in it there because Mike is so awesome. I learned a lot from the lectures and he assigned legitimately interesting and fun group projects.

I had Mike for a summer program at Stanford, and he was really great. He's helpful, engaging and really interacts with his students. He made engineering concepts doable and interesting for high school students, and I would honestly recommend taking a class taught by him.

As an instructor for a summer program at Stanford (SPCS in Engineering), Mike helped us understand fundamental principles of engineering and encouraged us to think creatively in designing our projects. Mike is one of the best teachers and mentors I have ever had: he made the course exciting and applicable and inspired us to innovate!

Mike is one of the best instructors I've had at  UC Berkeley. He's very engaging with the students and is really passionate about his teaching. Definitely helpful during office hours and makes each learning experience enjoyable.  I would highly recommend taking his class, you won't regret it!

Mike is the best teacher I have ever had.  I am extremely sad that he left UC Berkeley, but I hope you all really enjoy his class!  You can tell he loves to teach and he really cares about his students.
WOW! this guy is an absolutely incredible Professor at the University of Maryland and absolutely MOGS all other professors here! Truly the G.O.A.T.
yea he cool

Take him for COMM107. He's understanding, funny, and an extremely gracious grader. I would take him for COMM107 in every lifetime I have. He also makes the class itself interesting, yeah it's a class people take because it's easy but he makes the class fun and teaches the course well. Easy A and a breather, plus the presentations are fun + easy.
Such a nice and funny guy! Easy grader too. Only issue is that his elms page is unorganized. I would 100% recommend taking your oral communication gened with him.
He's so nice and accommodating! Also would date him if he would ask me out (hint hint!)
Don't miss a change to take his class! While the class I took was one I thought I would hate (public speaking) Mr. Leach made the class entertaining and easily my favorite class of the semester.

Class is 50 minutes long, but you learn a lot. Very easy to learn in that class, and the topics shown in class are word-for-word what is on the exams. Exams and quizzes are multiple choice, and just some writing questions at the end of exams. We discussed interesting topics since obviously, class is about conspiracy theories and more.

Prof Lucas is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. He uses so many personal examples during lecture that make it so easy to understand the retain the information we learn. He's also super nice & funny so his lectures are never boring. He records all his lectures and he's super accommodating to students who need! Very highly recommend.

Professor Lucas was the one professor I had that made me want to attend lectures. Though he used a textbook he wrote (which I typically am not a fan of), I found it intriguing and even got my copy after the class ended. Tests make up most of your grade, but there are random extra credit opportunities if you attend class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Lucas was the one professor I had that made me want to attend lectures. Though he used a textbook he wrote (which I typically am not a fan of), I found it intriguing and even got my copy after the class ended. Go to the lecture! Talk to him during office hours. Tests make up most of the grade but are easy if you study/go to the lecture.

Prof Lucas records all the lectures which makes reviewing easier, but he offers a couple extra credit opps in class. He tells stories to connect to the subject matter and often puts these on exams, but the exams are all multiple choice which is nice. Also the final is technically optional because he drops your lowest exam grade (also nice)!

Can't recommend enough. Lectures were in person and recorded, no attendance or participation, he knows the material extremely well and lectures are easy to follow, extra credit offered some days for coming to class, great professor!

One of the best classes I've taken. The content is very practical and can be applied in real life. He spends a large portion of every class telling stories which are typically entertaining. You have to read a good bit, but the reading quizzes are straightforward. The exams/papers were simple.
I took Lucas for SOCY 230 and he is such a great teacher.  The only hard thing is his chapter quizzes, which you have to read the book for.  I would take him again!
he is a great professor, really nice and helpful. exams are very hard though, walked out feeling super confident but got low grades. very interesting class

Great teacher. you can tell he puts ALOT of effort to make the class interesting and it pays off. he has great stories that connect with the material. *BUT you must do the book readings b/c of the pop quizzes(very easy, only 4 m.c. questions) Overall, great class!

This teacher is incredible. Take him for success. He's fresh out of college, super smart and yes, girls, very easy on the eyes. Plus, he's got a great sense of humor about life and an serious passion for his research...awesome all-around.
Jeff is the MAN!  He is so interested in the material and makes it really easy to understand.  If you take a sociology class, make it this one.

He encourages you to read the textbook for assignment and exam purposes, but during class he tells us how the real world operates. He encourages us to follow the right path, gives us advice, and allow is willing to help us network with some connections he has. He is an amazing professor, keeps the class engaging and really cares about his students.

I really enjoyed Jesse's class. His current role as COO of Cloudforce brings valuable real-world insights and examples that make the material more relatable. I highly recommend this class to anyone looking for practical perspectives on management.

They do not care about their position. Just a corporate man's side-gig. Gives all his work to the TA. Engaging lectures, but completely irrelevant to course. Large amount of busywork through quizzes that have no study value. Says he'll curve the entire semester, and then doesn't curve despite C- averages on tests. Tests are difficult to study for.
Easily the best class I have taken while at Smith. Very engaging and unique lecture style that you are most definitely going to love. Participation is the norm and it is very easy to pass the class.

I highly recommend taking a class with Jesse Kellner! He brings his real world experience into class, giving you meaningful stories and ways to apply what we learn to our future. Jesse is entertaining and engaging! I took a 3 hour class with him, and I never felt bored. Participate, and do your work, and you will get a good grade!

Awesome professor, you will really enjoy his class, applies real world examples to concepts instead of reading through slides. Please take him, you won't regret it! As long as you participate and put in effort you will get a good grade regardless of doing well on the exam. Three hours of class felt like one hour.

Jesse isn't a traditional professor. He has a full-time job as a senior manager at an IT consulting company so he has a ton of tangible experience. I had this class once a week for 3 hours straight and he somehow made it enjoyable. I would recommend anyone taking him, he makes a class with silly subject matter an actual learning experience.

Prof. Jesse is a great professor he makes a 2:40 min class very fun and engaging. He seems very interested in what he's teaching but the class is a very competitive class meaning that there are more B grades than A grades. I recommend you take him. If you are interested in learning more about management.

One of my favorite professors at UMD. Her exams are very manageable as long as you go to the lecture and take good notes. She's extremely fair and tests exactly what she teaches; no random curveballs. If you put in the effort and stay engaged, you'll do well. You can tell she is so passionate about the work she teaches. Highly recommend.

super fun lectures and she really loves what she does, what's better than a teacher that WANTS to teach? literally nothing. Her exams are based on her study guides and she never strays from it so it makes studying really easy. Would love to have her as a professor for all of my other classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr Madoo was one of the best professors I had in a while her lectures were very interesting and she was very caring about her students. The class consist of 3 exams which aren't bad also she provides a study guide. The other grades are discussion grades which are pretty easy as long as you show up plus she drops the lowest one. Overall great class!

Dr. Madoo is awesome! She's really friendly, and I've always looked forward to going to her lectures. She shares a lot of interesting experiences on her job and courseload outside of lecture is very minimal. Her midterms are no longer online but they're very straightforward (50 multiple choice).

attendance only mandatory for the discussions, relatively easy to catch up from textbook if you miss a lecture but i really recommend going to lecture, she was super sweet and personable with a lot of interesting stories and also very communicative through email.
