They give you online hw (~ $30-80 dollars) and every week you get 144 questions and more if you get them wrong . It takes me a WHOLE DAY ( 7am to 7pm) to finish. Don't go to lectures  she doesn't teach use YT and have gpt 4 explain the slides. I could've saved 240 hours (Literally 12*16weeks =192 + (1 hour to dissect each lecture *3) *16=48 )
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I would say avoid this prof at all cost (especially if you're that great at chem). The class itself is pretty difficult and the class average in the class is extremely low. The only reason why I would recommend her is because of the gracious curve at the end of the semester which for me was roughly 30%. The TA, Sam, is amazing tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
The saving grace for this class (Radiochem) is that the topic is her specialty so she was comfortable sharing her life's work. There were a few homeworks that she would take weeks to grade. However, ALL exams (including the final) were take home and not timed. She even bumped students grades after all was entered. 

Can't use a pc to save her life.

THE WORST PROFESSOR."Teaches" high level physics rather than general chem. Teaches is in quotes bc she really just does practice problems and expects you to understand. Then if you ask her a question, she is super rude and condescending and will laugh at you. Save your time, pick a diff professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE W/ MIGNEREY. IF YOU ACTUALLY WANT TO LEARN AND UNDERSTAND TAKE SOMEONE ELSE. MIGNEREY is very rude and highly unapproachable. During lectures, if you ask a question she gets an attitude and responds with im not gonna ask you that. Exams are mostly mathematics.

She is terrible at explaining the actual concept she's teaching. During her lectures, all she does is example problems. That is how she teaches and you will be expected to understand every step she is doing. One good thing about her is that she pushes due dates back for homework if you email her ahead of time. Get ready for stress if you take her.

Professor Mignerey accused me of being a liar when I asked her about inconsistent grading on her test, when a classmate received credit for the same work that I did, when I had not. She is rarely available, pretty rude, and practice assignments do not correlate with the tests provided. Rely on Organic Chemistry Tutor on YouTube for learning this.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Mignerey is very smart but she often skips steps, goes too fast, and covers too much content, making lectures very confusing. We had 4 midterms, a final, daily pop quizzes, and an absurd amount of homework (hours every day). Her tests are difficult and each one averaged a C or D. She does offer a generous curve at the end though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you test with ADS, I recommend you don't take her class. She grades ADS tests last so I got mine back days after the rest of lecture and was unable to view my final since it was not ready at the same time as non-ADS tests. Overall not an awful lecturer, but incredibly rude and uncaring. I had to study for 10 hours each exam to get an A-.

Honestly, Professor Mignerey is mean. Countless people would ask questions in class and she would laugh at them or give an extremely condescending response. The class has so few grades so it makes it very difficult to get an A and the final seemed way harder than any of the problems we did before. Don't take her
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Mignerey is a terrible teacher. She has a tendency to simply put things on the board without any proper explanation as to the steps or the logic behind the problem. Additionally, she is very rude. She has no respect for students, your answer could be correct, but off by a decimal, and the complete answer will be marked wrong.

People give her a bad rep because chemistry as a topic is hard to learn quickly. She may not be the best at explaining things, but she shouldn't need to if people are ahead on the reading. If you read ahead and do the homework well or at least try, you'll be fine. I can't emphasize this more, STUDY FROM THE CHEM101, the exams are made from it.
Worst professor Ive ever has. She forgets that shes supposed to teach us, as we do not have a PH.D in chemistry. Extremely unfair, would not recommend.
The class is hard to keep up with. She doesnt go through all steps to solving problems. The class feels extremely rushed with very few grades and an outrageous amount of exams. Would not recommend.
Dont recommend, save yourself and pick a different professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Mignerey is tough. It is very hard to follow what she is saying when she teaches. She writes her work on the board, but it is all over the place and she skips explanations as if we are just supposed to know what she is doing. If you ask her a question, she gets annoyed you don't understand. There are also quizzes every single lecture day.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Awful professor that talks at you instead of teaching you. She'll go over problems in lecture but she stands so close to the board that you cannot follow her work until she steps aside. She'll ask if you have questions but literally laughs in your face when you ask. The only good thing is that her practice exams are very similar to the real exams.

I hate her. Worst teacher ever. Cannot do a single thing right when it comes to technology and all her grades are put in at the last minute. All homework is worthless; try reading the TopHat and maybe something will click but she is literally the worst lecturer I've ever seen. She gets her own practice problems wrong. Take literally any other prof.

never take any of her classes. she looks down upon students and will not explain any of the topics covered in class. exams are on material we hardly go over, and she never cares about her students and how she makes them struggle. way too much homework is assigned (abt 100 questions a week). worst prof ive had and the ta's arent helpful either.

Doesnt know how to explain or answer questions. Only shows calculations examples the whole class, with no topic or concept talk/explanation. you're lucky if you get any partial credit if you get an answer incorrect. TAs associated with the class arent a help either.

She was extremely unorganized. She wasted time each class simply trying to use her technology. She never answered any questions directly. Would not recommend if you're genuinely trying to learn the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: do not take chem with her. she explains nothing in lectures and goes so fast. she expects you to know everything without being taught the material. DO NOT take this class if you don't understand calculus. It is ALL calculus work. Probably the hardest class I've ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: 30 minutes of every hour long lecture is devoted to technical difficulties. You'd think after a year of using zoom she'd have figured it out by now; nope. She is not good at explaining things clearly, and if you ask a question she will laugh at you and act like you're an idiot and not even answer the question.

Mignerey really did not adjust well to online school. Her lectures were all over the place, and each lecture we spent 20 minutes dealing with some technical difficulty. However, her exams are really straightforward, 90% similar to the homeworks. The final was also really similar to the midterms. The last midterm is harder than the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The TopHat (textbook) readings are worthless. Dont bother reading just do the in-text problems and move on. Dr. M is terrible with technology and a bit sassy with students, but shes very pure. I personally liked her style because it gave me freedom to learn on my own, but the class was harder than it shouldve been. Dont take if bad at chemistry
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Personally she seemed better than the other teachers because she seems more organized and the lectures were helpful, ESPECIALLY chem101. However, exam 3 was unfair and she reacted in a very petty manner, unlike the other professor who gave back points. A LOT OF HW QUESTIONS.

Dr. Mignerey was nice & went over examples that were going to be on the test during class. I was in the asynchronous section, so I taught myself most of the concepts on Tophat, but this was my own choice. The practice through homework & practice exams was helpful. We actually used the materials we bought so we didn't waste our money

She can be very accommodating to the needs of specific students and the class as a whole, but can get upset about things at times. There is a ton of homework and the material is very challenging. A lot of lecture time is lost due to technical difficulties and exams are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mignerey is a sweet lady, but her teaching is not. She isn't good at lecturing especially over zoom. The HW on TopHat + Chem101 are long & tedious. Quizzes/ graded questions during lecture. Tests are hard, people usually avg

reviews.comment: Too old to still be teaching with online classes. Our average for our last exam was a 56, half of the material on the exam was never discussed in class. The other professor gave points back to students because he realized the test was unfair and Mignerey refused simply because she was feeling petty. So not worth it. Literally take any other teacher

If I was forced to choose between taking Mignerey's class again or taking a bullet to the brain, I would take a bullet. Awful lecturer, doesn't put grades in until the very end of the semester, technologically challenged, should be fired.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While Dr. mignerey seems sweet, her teaching is not ideal. The exams are extremely difficult, and I only did pretty well on them because my HS ap chem teacher was great and I have tons of specific notes from that. My background HS knowledge carried me through this course. Its also annoying how much money we have to pay for required online hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Many people don't like her, but I had a good experience with her. If you don't have background chem knowledge, her teaching style probably won't be helpful. If you have taken AP chem, you most likely will be fine. You have to work hard, but you can do well. DO EXTRA PRACTICE PROBELMS.

Easily the most pathetic professor in the UMD Chemistry Department. Although she is no doubt a smart person, her inability to teach basic chemistry was extremely frustrating. She's a wonderful person, is humorous, and has a passion for chemistry. She's just not the greatest professor/teacher. Mignerey seems to be getting quite a bit of hate on here, but she really wasn't that bad. reviews.comment: Alice has the best intentions, sure, but she makes it obvious that she does not know what she is doing. The class is difficult on its own, but with a professor who is unable to balance chemical equations, doesn't understand orgo, and wastes lecture time with balloon molecules, the class becomes impossible. Huge curve so that some people can pass.

Lectures are long with Prof. Mignerey. When I had her fall 2015, she would spend half the class talking about chalk or figuring out how to move the chalkboards. She would always ask TAs for affirmation, like shes unsure of what she's saying. She posts the lecture ppts online, which is helpful. Theres a good curve, I got an A from a high C.

Mignerey is terrible. I worked immensely hard and it was my lowest grade. She fails to explain  and makes connections in problems; students can't follow. Alice mignerey is the worst chemistry teacher i have ever had. her lectures are not clear whatsoever and she make a lot of mathematical errors. i never understood when she teaches and she gives quiz question at the end of every lecture so missing her class actually could affect your grade. exams were very difficult but big curve at the end.

She's a very nice woman, but she made multiple mistakes on exams (not balancing equations right, etc.) and made mistakes in class that were very confusing. If you want to learn the concepts, you need to learn from the book because she only teaches the math in class.
Very nice woman. She was a little confusing at times, but she wants us all to pass.

She is a terrible teacher who is not clear whatsoever about what she is teaching. 1010 would not recommend taking this course with her. She does use balloons though for one lecture, so there was that.

This class was hard and it took a lot of outside work and practice. Her tests are very hard, but doable.  Lectures are confusing, ask a lot of questions if you don't understand. She is the worst teacher that could possibly be teaching gen chem. She makes math errors in calculations and explains nothing during the lecture. Attend discussion and teach yourself from the book if you want to do well/learn because she will teach you NOTHING. Professor Mignerey is a pretty good teacher considering how hard the course is. She reads a lot from her slides and does some problems on the board which help. If you take this class, make sure you go to class and stay on top of the material or else you have no shot. Know the practice exams too.

she is a very interesting person. i went to her to get help because i had no idea what as happening and she tried to help, but couldnt understand why i didnt understand. i never go to lecture because she sends out her slides the day before anyways. she has sample problems everyday, but they are only one point, so not really necessary. dont take her

I dropped her class half way through because I was SO frustrated with her teaching. This class has been terrible for me! The online work took hours to complete, but weren't worth many points. The practice tests weren't always accurate depictions of the actual test. I am doing poorly, and have to drop the course! Do not ignore these reviews. Some people don't mind her, but she didn't work for me. Be cautious when choosing this prof

this prof is beyond useless.  the only way to get a good grade in her class is to read the text, memorize all the problems assigned and not assigned.  she can't lecture and often gives erroneous info in lecture you have to figure out at home yourself.  she is rude and insulting when you ask for help. She should be fired!

Dr. Mignerey's exams are very difficult which is compounded by the fact that her lectures don't make sense unless you understand the material fully before its covered in class. This woman one of the worsts profs I've ever had. If someone else is teaching chem271 take them and do yourself a favor. Her tests are poorly worded and the average is about 54. I have mixed feeling about the class. I thought she was a good professor but she often came in unclear. she is quite possibly the worst lecturer ever. she mumbles a lot and does the examples from the text, so you have nothing to compare to. her tests get easier, but her lectures are almost unbearable. beware.

frustratingly confusing, not capable of explaining anything. i am now in organic chemistry, and the first two weeks me and my friends that had mignerey were all behind because she taught us so little compared to the other professors. i would stay away

shes a little loppy.. but a good prof. she doesnt teach as much as the other profs, which makes you feel like you aren't learning what you need to. ive tried asking her questions after class and she just doesnt understand what im asking and gives unclear answers. read, go to class and discussion, study and you will be fine.

*Highly Recommend* Fully Online Class! Professor Shah is understanding and quickly replies to emails. One exam and one group project. Worked on a case study for the majority of the class which was easy but time-consuming.

Professor shah is a really good teacher. He is available most of the time if I had any questions. Definitely take his class if you want to learn and get an A. He's a very slow grader i didn't know the grade I had in the class until the very end.

Professor Shah is hands down the most understanding Professor I have met! Always accessible outside of class, grading criteria is clear and a very respected individual! Easy A, just do the discussions and follow the instructions in class. Make sure you submit everything on time and email him for literally any question, he's chill

Professor Ashery is a master in his field. He has ample experience in Digital Marketing and is a professor who has real working experience. reviews.comment: A true gem, he truly brings the best out of you. He is funny yet, very professional and ensures that each one of his students understands. I would highly recommend him, take him you learn a lot & will enjoy his lectures.

not a bad guy or lecturer but he never grades anything ever for so long. i literally don't know my grade and the sem ends this week. also you'll have to take 4 in-person, closed-note, closed-laptop, on-paper coding exams, do with that info what u will!

reviews.comment: While Bills is a good person, I WISH someone told me not to take him. He has 4 on-paper python exams (no cheat sheet, closed laptop, etc). He is very lenient for late work if you email him before the due date, but he also gives attendance quizzes that close 5 min into class, so you don't get credit if you're more than like 3 minutes late.

Professor Bills' class is challenging and rewarding. I highly recommend taking him over anyone else because you will walk out of his class knowing how to code in Python at a level required in the workplace. After taking his class, I landed an internship and easily completed assigned projects. The work is fundamental to the learning experience

Great professor, lots of group work, extends due dates when asked, takes time to get to know students. LOTS of work and 3 major HW assignments are difficult. I wouldn't rate Aric a full 5 stars. Lectures don't really cover concepts, you watch videos on your own time, and come to class to complete practice assignments based on the concepts the videos covered. Aric is overall a great and caring professor he makes sure to explain assignments before they are given and is very active in the discord. One more thing I have to say is he takes a while to put grades on elms.
He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to achieve success. He knows OOP can be a difficult concept to grasp, but his teaching style makes it much easier.

This might be quite literally the best or one of the best professors you'll ever have in your academic career. He is so unbelievably nice and understanding. You work a lot of the time in groups of 2 for little assignments here and there until the final project which is a larger group. Provides lots of Office Hour times and is very willing to help.

There are too many assignments including group projects, exercises, homework, in class paper tests (4 exams). He could be more easy on grading the assignments. It could be helpful if he gave extra credit opportunity for this class because this class already one of the hardest.

I came into this class very scared. I was not confident at all about my coding skills and almost quit info sci all together the first week of 326. Aric helped get me through this class and he really cares about his students. One of the best professors i have had in my college career.

reviews.comment: I don't even leave reviews for professors, but I'm going to for Aric. Hands down the best professor that I have taken at UMD. He promotes group coding and teaches us skills (like Git) not because he has to, but because he knows it will be useful for us in the future. Aric is the GOAT

I loved Aric. He was such a nice guy and was considerate with deadlines. He listened to his students and granted extensions when needed. The group work is very important in this class and to do good in the end I suggest getting a good group from the get-go.

Aric was one of the most understanding and caring professors I have ever had- going out of his way to allow me to attend independent 1on1 office hours into the night as late as 11pm. That said, he is extremely fair and critical towards keeping a level classroom, so expect a challenging curriculum and ample hours for getting work done.

Aric is a great professor and makes the course material very easy to digest. He creates all his own material and the projects are very easy to complete if you pay attention. There is ample help, and he is very accessible via Discord.
Great professor, always responds quick whenever you have questions.
the best professor i've ever had!! the semester just begun but he has already been so helpful. he is available to help and wants to help his students succeed!

Professor Bills was a great professor to have for 326. He's willing to meet and help with any problems you may have and ensures that everyone has a clear understanding of the material. reviews.comment: Great teacher, truly cares about his students success.

Aric is very knowledgeable in his field, and is able to clearly communicate directions and new concepts. INST326 has a lot of ground to cover, but his effective style of teaching makes everything easily understandable and retainable. He is one of the best professors in the iSchool. You will not regret taking a course of his.

Aric Bills is one of my favorite professors in the iSchool. The class gives videos beginning of the week, and you have to watch them by your lecture time to know what's going on. A huge thing I have to say is that you have to expect to get stuck, but pushing through on your own or with little help will really ensure that you learn the material well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

He's an amazing lecturer and truly cares about his students. As long as you keep up with the lectures, start projects early, and get help if you have questions, you'll have a great experience in this class. I've learned a lot from Aric and really enjoy Python after his class!

reviews.comment: There are a lot of in class exercises for this class, two exams, a final project, a couple of writing assignments, six homeworks, and an optional (extra credit) final exam. There are clicker questions for this class so make sure you show up to class. As long as you put in the time and effort, you will get a LOT out of this class. Take his class!

Aric is a great professor! He is extremely helpful in office hours and lectures. His instructions for assignments are very clear but they are still challenging enough to be rewarding. He is responsive to emails and wants his students to succeed.

He's an amazing professor who will help you if you want to put the work in, he properly explains topics that hard to understand and explains it better in detail if you have trouble understanding it. I highly recommend taking his classes at UMD.
Professor Aragon is a very kind and understanding professor. As long as you show up and do the work you'll be fine.

This class was a bit boring, but it wasn't hard at all. I'm very nervous about public speaking but she grades based on effort. Super caring and friendly person and an amazing professor. She grades very easily and just really wants you to improve as a communicator. Coursework was very light, but you may have to grind for a couple of hours the day before presentations. She knows it's a Gen-ed so she tries to make it go as smooth as possible. Highly recommend.

Professor Aragón is fine. Her class is very boring and you might want to sleep. The lectures in class went over the reading exactly, and the easy quizzes are based on that, so if you go to lectures or read you will get an A. Professor Aragón is very nice and does care about her students, will always help you with questions.

She was super understanding and flexible especially with the pandemic. She doesnt grade too harshly if you put in effort into your presentations which are just recorded and sent to her. Professor A is the most considerate instructor ever. We had 4 major presentations and some weekly assignments. Our class was online so our presentations were recorded on our own time. She is very responsive to emails and respects everyone's time. Very nice and intelligent.

A great proffesor. She has been incredibly considerate during the pandemic and is always there to help. You will get an A if you do the work its not hard. Only con is that lectures are very boring, although we don't have many.

She was very considerate of our well being during the pandemic. Does not grade you based on a set of standards, but rather how much you improve throughout the semester. The chapters in the books can get a little lengthy, but that's the only complaint I have. If you don't know which prof to choose for COMM, definitely choose her.

If you dread public speaking, take this class with Professor Aragon. She is very understanding and genuinely wants her students to do well. Treated every student with respect and gave extensions when requested.

Really great professor! The workload can be overwhelming with studio, but absolutely doable. Definitely budget your time wisely. One of my favorite professors I've had, very accessible and very helpful. I was struggling and he took extra time to assist me. Highly recommend
Best professor I've had at Brown so far. Her monuments class was engaging and it's so apparent she really cares about her students. Would ABSOLUTELY recommend taking a class with her.

Attend class, pay attention, and take notes. Discussion is mandatory. Class values good writing skills!

Very unfocused, and tends to cancel class ALL THE time. We once didn't have class for a week because she scheduled conferences after she planned on teaching. She's very knowledgable and she obviously spends time putting together cohesive lectures. Take notes and pay attention or you won't pass the midterm and final. Only one major paper, but small 1-2 paragraph writings weekly. Creates and uploads study guides with slides of important works.
She gets very annoyed if you talk in lecture.  She gets distracted a lot and leaves the room.  Very complainey
Ater is fantastic! She definitely knows what she's talking about and clearly cares about her students. She is also great at making the class interactive!
She has high expectations but has a great teaching style. I am able to pay attention for the entire lecture. The course content is very interesting and she knows a lot about the subject.

This class is the WORST! NEVER take ths teacher. Expects you to come early/ stay late for a completely useless class. Thinks she is the center of the world. BORING lectures and she runs off on tangents then yells at the class for falling behinde. Ugh if only I had known. . .
amazing teacher who gives more work then expected but is super fair and understanding

Hagar is simply incredible. I had her as a TA for COMM401 and she is one of the most caring, kindest and sweetest TA's I have ever had in my college career. She is helpful, easily accessible, and is willing to work with you to help understand concepts. I would recommend her as a TA/professor to anyone. You will be better just by knowing her!

Amazing professor and person. SO accommodating and just such a nice person. Her presense is just so positive and happy that she really does light up a room. Take this class with her. Learned SOO much and happy to have made such a wonderful connection

One of the nicest professors I have ever had. She cares about all of her students, and is very respectful to everyone. Not to mention, as long as you show up to class and do what she asks of you, it is a VERY easy A. If you need to take COMM107, take it with her!
She really cares about you being the best speaker you can be and she acknowledges that not everyone is excellent at public speaking and works with you to improve.

Hagar is the sweetest, most understanding professor I've ever had. She cares about all of her students and asks questions about you every day to take attendance. She gives really good feedback on speech outlines to help you do well on the actual speech. If you need to take this class, make sure you take it with her and you won't have any problems.

Honestly, my favorite professor that I have had so far. She is understanding, informative, and gives you clear criteria to follow. As long as you put effort into the class, you'll be fine. Recommend her to anyone!

As a class I feel like I didn't learn much, but it was an easy A. All quizzes were online and tests were take home. Hagar likes to focus on social justice issues in class so be prepared for a lot of current events discussion.

Hagar is amazing! She's super down to earth and easy to talk to. She will without a doubt help you with anything you need. She's really understanding and all of her tests were take-home and extremely easy. She can be a little tough when grading your speech's, but as long as you practice you'll do fine!
Can't understand him and grades exams harshly

BEST CLASS EVER! So this class is not easy by any means, but the readings are ridiculous and he actually wants you to think. You won't sit and regurgitate material from a textbook. You will have to challenge your assumptions and basically everything you understand about the world. You will either love the class or absolutely hate it.
Very much theory oriented; difficult readings in the second half of the semester; a lot of lectures; extremely helpful when u ask for it; good prof and knows the stuff he teaches very well
Not an easy class at all. Assigns some very hard readings --see him one-on-one when the reading is confusing. Has very good mastery over what he's teaching. Very helpful. And got a nice smile ;)
Very interesting material he assigns for the class. He has a very good command of course material. Highly recommended!
Not sure what the fuss is all about. Good prof, exciting class. Hard to get a good grade though...

He's really not all that bad!  All you have to do is go to class and just repeat everything he mentions in class on the exams. If you go to class and just take notes on what he says you'll be fine. I hardly ever read for class and still got a A. The class presentation is a huge precent of your grade so just do well on that and you'll be fine!

The class was pretty hard. He doesn't lecture and is VERY participation based. Participation is worth the same amount as exams. We also have to make presentations and teach the class. A student presents every single day. HE hardly ever teaches us anything, leaves it all up to the students to figure everything out. His exams are impossible.
Worst Professor EVER! Does not teach, leaves it up to the students to teach themselves. Exams are impossible, the average grade on the midterm was a D. Does not lecture at all and explains nothing.

I wasn't a big fan of her as a professor. I struggled with her methods of teaching. She is very passionate about math, and it can come off as off-putting. She lets you bring all of your notes to exams, which is great. Again, Carolina is such a sweet person, but her teaching style was not condusive to me.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Caronlina is very sweet, she does show her respect and love for her students. There are daily classkick assignments which can be pretty heavy in work. She expects participation and CLEAR explanations! Otherwise, no bueno. She is very particular in grading especially your explanations and work. No homework just classkick in class.

Carolina is a very nice, sweet professor. She does work hard in trying to make the material understandable to all students, she shows commitment and determination. But, she is a very hard grader because she is particular in your answers/responses. Word of advice: be specific as possible.

Prof Karpman is knowledgable and helpful. 106 is very easy. The class was in person but all our work was submitted online. Quizzes and exams were open note and she gives you ample time to complete them. Learning a new language can be intimidating, but Karpman makes it easy and not stressful at all. Overall she's very nice and has clear expectations

Dr. Karpman is effective and efficient in the classroom. My skill in Hebrew increased dramatically, both speaking and writing. Every week, there were a few assignments, there are 4 one-page papers, a midterm, and a final exam. If you're looking for an interesting foreign language class, I couldn't recommend Dr. Karpman enough!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Karpman makes it extremely easy to do well in her class. Her ELMS pages are very organized. She was very understanding and only required students to attend 10 zoom classes all semester. I really loved this class!

Avital is an amazing teacher. She really cares about her students and is always willing to help. Online weekly quiz which is usually pretty easy. Some writing assignments, she gives good feedback and doesnt grade to heavy. You are able to retake all quizzes to improve your grade

Incredibly smart and dedicated to Models-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) - Mark Austin literally wrote the book for the three courses that form the true core of UMD's Systems Engineering program.  You must work to keep up, he will help you if you really want it.  Very generous. Great principal investigator looking to build you and your career.
Insanely boring and dismissive of students, but any easy A.
He's not the best professor in the world but he's a nice guy and an easy A.  Seriously...I did almost nothing for this class and got an A.
No Comments

Horrible professor,talks to himself facing the board;isn't really concerned whether or not the class is learning anything and does nothing to make the material interesting (actually makes it more dull).You have no option but to take it with him so brace yourself.

Ugh, what a bad prof. Extremely boring class with too much programming. Some useful applications however very few and far in between. Exams are difficult if you don’t know what your doing and the assignments are just plain useless (from my point of view) in this field. Be prepared for one of the longest semesters of your college life.

She is very professional and has a sweet personality. She gives very detailed critic and it helped me so much in the learning process. I think its good that she pushes her student because she cares. You can see her passion through her sparkly eyes!
If you can avoid her, do not look for trouble for yourself. You may learn something, but it is not worth a whole semester long. She smiles all the time, but who knows what is behind that.
For ARTT350, ARTT352 she has high expectations but they push you to improve. She's willing to give further clarification and point things out if you approach her with your project in hand.

One of the worst teachers i have ever taken. Yeah, she knows her stuff, but she is such a people pleaser, she does NOT tell you straight up what to do. She is a little wish-washy when it comes to what she demands from you, which is annoying and frustrating.
She is dedicated, but extremely over critical and demanding. cant make up her mind about how you should improve your work which is incredibly frustrating and STRESSFUL!!!
Really knows her stuff and has high standards. Hard class, but well worth it!

This woman knows absolutely nothing about criminal justice. She is a rude, snobby person. Not educational at all. She reads directly from the slides and had nothing to add to the textbook. One of the worst classes I have ever taken.
TA is useless. Grades are never put up even though she has a TA. Really strict at times. Can be funny and nice at times
Shes hot and interesting. Class is chill. I enjoy waking up for this class
Best English course I've ever taken.

Mr. Auerbach is an excellent professor who always comes with the desire to talk about the books to the class. If you're a movie buff, he is the guy for you because he makes references to movies all the time.
An excellent, well structured and thoughtful professor
Loves himself. Not very interested in students. Just tell him what he already said.

I would take another course with Professor Auerbach without reservation. Hands down one of the best professors I've had. I learned so much in such a small amount of time, and I'm actually still curious about some of the subject matter. Passion for the material is mandatory however.
This was a great introduction to the English major. We read 'New York Trilogy,' by Paul Auster and 'Pudd'nhead Wilson,' by Mark Twain. His discussions are great and he really knows his stuff.

Auerbach was a pretty nice guy and extremely interesed in the subject matter. But he can be a little much sometimes. His exams are kind of difficult, beware the text identification. But I think the guy's a pretty good prof.
He was a good prof. I liked the class a lot and his teaching helped later on with my other English courses.

This was a great class, especially if you put work into it and have a good TA. Auerbach was respectful to the students and clear in his teaching. He was laid back, but passionate about the books. Ultimately, your grade will depend on your TA and whether or not you read, though! But Auerbach is clear and you should get a lot from the lectures.
I took 301 when it was a lecture so I think Auerbach did the best he could under the circumstances.  The class still kind of sucked, though.

Unlike some teachers, he doesn't let you take a ride just because it is an English class. However, this is a good thing in the end, albeit painful. You will be more learned after you finish this class. What more can you ask for?
English 301 is supposed to be hard, but this professor's very unclear way of lecturing and presenting material gave me the feeling that I was on my own against how hard the papers were graded.

Aya is amazing! She is kind, compassionate, & genuinely cares about her students. She knows what she's talking about and is good at teaching it. She is a tough but fair grader. Always responds quickly. Very clear guidelines and gives great feedback. She makes presenting the least stressful she possibly can. I would 100% take another class from her.

The reason I gave her a 4/5 and not a 5/5 is because she is a bit of a tough grader, she does not post all the slides and materials that she lectures in class, and has a specific way she wants the speech outlines to look. Otherwise, she is very nice, super understanding, invested in her students ideas, and response to emails quick.

TAKE HER!!! by far the best instructor i've ever had. she's very kind and makes a class about presenting as interesting as possible. speeches weren't crazy difficult and she gave us lots of feedback before speech day. i know a class on presenting can be scary to many but she literally does brief breathing exercises before speeches to help nerves :)

Ayush is a very interesting professor. He's very liberal and this comes across but he grades a lot based on effort and participation. He also cares about his students a lot and will definitely help you if you reach out to him. In the beginning part of the class he lectures a lot though on basics so be prepared for that.
Nice guy
nice

Great professor. Taught BCHM461/BCHM462 for first time in summer since 2011. Had for BCHM462. A lot of material but the review sessions and office hours are very helpful. He replied to emails. Exams are fair and project boosts many grades. He doesn't really curve but shifts 1-2 (this semester 2) exams. So, few A's, many B/Cs. Teaches very well.

Ayers has somehow found a way to pack an obscene amount of information into lecture yet remain crystal clear and not overly dry for the entire hour and thirty minutes. Anything you don't quite get during lecture is almost guaranteed to clear up later in your notes or in the pre-exam review sessions. Ayers is your first choice for Biochem I.

Prof. Ayers was very concerned about student success.  Although biochemistry is not my strongest suit, he was patient and dealt with any questions I had.  His notes were clear and concise.  You have to put the study time in; this course was very challenging.  He's also a great singer.
Great professor and a genuinely nice guy. Be prepared to be challenged, but you will learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The amount of work in the class is unbelievable.  For what he teaches in class he expects way too much.
No Comments

This guy is a slave driver!  Be prepared for HELL.  Content (optimization) very challenging, lots of homework, lots to learn.  Do not take this course if you are a working professional (taking grad classes part time).

Great teacher !!!!!! Really knows his information and remains very interactive with to make sure his students are engaged. Intresting curriculum which keeps class fun. Anyone would be wrong not to take Mr Azevedo's class if they have the chance, I took it and it changed my carreer path because he inspired me to become a teacher just like him.

A jerk.  Avoid.  He is arrogant and frankly, can't figure out why.  His knowledge is textbook, memorized facts and jargon.  Anyone can do that.  Not a scholar - a disseminator or technical information. I could have learned everything by myself using the textbook.

HE is awesome and is willing to help u if u truly need it...especially if he knows you truly care about what he is teaching.  He has a lot of knowledge and is wonderful.  He helped me through a lot and know I have a lot of knowledge I can pass down and wor

HE is awesome and is willing to help u if u truly need it...especially if he knows you truly care about what he is teaching.  He has a lot of knowledge and is wonderful.  He helped me through a lot and know I have a lot of knowledge I can pass down and wor
He is obviously very knowledgeable and passionate about the subject matter and is excited to help students learn. I would defiantly take him again.
excellent prof
Insists that everyone call him doctor. Its easy to figure out the rest. Take someone else.
Dr. A is very knowledgeable, supportive, and friendly and fair.  This is a teacher who can relate to students! I've learned so much and plan to take more classes with Dr. Azevedo.
Full of himself

I was not a fan of her because she would bully me all the time and was nosey! I loss my confidence after I went through a traumatic incident and her making fun of me when giving me feedback made me feel so small. Then when I made immense improvement she would ask extremely invasive questions. As an instructor, she was great and wasn't a hard grader
She is tough but really great, she offers a lot of support outside of class and you can tell she works hard on getting class materials ready.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Too many assignment and projects. I won't recommend her class for someone who loves acting and performing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Worst lecturer at UMD, unprepared lectures, lazy grading, and unreasonable grading. Try your best to avoid his courses at all costs!

Taking 330 with Cliff is the right choice. Projects are challenging but not overly so, and his lectures are good, albeit a bit boring. But, he is funny and accessible and gets a lot of points for that.

Cliff is an alright choice for 250. He's not amazing at explaining new concepts but not terrible either. Tests were pretty easy, though, especially when compared to the homeworks. Not a bad choice by any means.

I took this during the summer and the content was really interesting. He was not prepared for the shortened semester due to the summer session therefore a lot of topics felt rushed. He did own up to his mistake and gave the class a hefty curve due to his lack of organization. I did not need the curve but it did boost a lot of people grades.

At the beginning of the semester, he gave good lectures when talking about the beginning content however, near the end when much of the content was about proofs and giving examples, his explanations and lectures began to get confusing. His homeworks were pretty challenging, although they prepared me well for his quizzes and exams.

L Professor

Confusing, illegible, and takes MONTHS to grade homework. Then the graded homework has many errors and inconsistencies. At all costs, DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Cliff was a generally ineffective lecturer, but, perhaps more importantly, he failed to get me to care about the class. His lectures were highly confusing and I did not feel that I understood the material. Leading up to the final, I genuinely thought I could fail the class. I think I would have performed much better with a different teacher.
So nice and a very good lecturer. Took him his first semester teaching not expecting him to be very good, but he was excellent. I would definitely recommend.

Dr. B is energetic and believes in what she does. She has the biggest heart for students and wants you to succeed. She might push you a bit because she wants to see you giving your best effort, and you will be very proud to have her as your prof.
I really like her voice, she makes listening to her lectures very easy because she puts a lot of character in her explanations.

Dr. Barnhart is such a gem. She cares so much about her students and has been so understanding about the pandemic. She also makes sure everyone feels comfortable sharing and is very easy going. 11/10 would recommend

Dr. Barnhart is a very sweet professor and loves what she does. Class did feel very very long and often put me to sleep. She talks slow sometimes which made me go nuts on occasion, though that might not bother others. She grades speeches leniently. Will single you out to ask random questions during class lol. Glad I had her but would not take again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Barnhart is an incredibly kind and understanding person who genuinely is passionate about communications and wants everyone to succeed. She's a wonderful change of pace from my other professors and has handled online classes in a very impressive way. She's an easy grader but her class is slightly more work than other comm/inag professors.
Best INAG110 professor hands down. Have never had such a caring professor that cheers for her students' success. Amazing.

Most amazing professor I've ever had, hands down. Truly cares about every student. I hate public speaking, and she made this class so welcoming and friendly. She designs the class so everyone basically becomes friends. Very fair with grading and gives plenty of opportunities to get a high grade. She handled the switch to online classes very well.
Really cares about her students. Amazing professor.

Dr. Barnhart is amazing. She knows that many people generally don't like public speaking so she tries her best to help everyone. She's very encouraging and warm and if you struggle with public speaking, I encourage you to take her class.

This woman is my obsession! Participation is 20% of your grade but as long as you're there you get full credit- I hold my phone in front of her face&I get 10/10 every week. She grades speeches p easily just make sure u practice before giving it. She ends class super early a lot of the time. exams are open note get the book online&search everything
She is the best professor! She's so nice, her class is so fun, and there are open-textbook exams. TAKE HER, you will be so glad. Such a kind, warm-hearted, genuine, intelligent woman.
As someone who hates public speaking with a passion, she made the experience positive! She is a easy grader which helps take the stress of speaking poorly. Definitely take!

Dr. Barnhart is so dedicated to and passionate about teaching speech class to university students. If you have ever been intimidated by the thought of having to give a speech, take her class. Warm-hearted is the best way to describe her. Outside of class, she is devoted to improving life for disabled individuals. I was blessed to be in her class.

I absolutely loved Dr. Barnhart! She is super caring and very maternal (in a good way). She definitely cares about every single student. I hated public speaking and was terrible at it, but I've gotten so much better and learned a lot from her. She is an awesome grader and is always willing to help with speeches. Take INAG110 with Barnhart!

Joellen is actually a Saint. Genuinely the nicest person i have ever met, and I'm lucky to have been one of her students. As a teacher she is phenomenal and super supporting. Luckily she grades easily but I would have taken her even if she would fail me. I'm going to miss her going forward.

Barnhart is super sweet and makes a point to tell you she wants to be there every class. Her class is mostly focused on speeches, and she's always avaliable for office hours several times a week to help you. She's had a pretty amazing life. If you need a comm credit, take this class. Its not too difficult, and exams are open book.

This professor is amazing. She genuiely loves what she does and she cares about her students. She is always smiling and radiates happiness. I learned a lot in her class and I recommended taking an INAG class over a COMM class because even though there are more speeches, there are less essays. Dr. Barnhart teared up on the last day of class! Aww

Dr. Barnhart is so much fun during class; she goes out of her way to make a class that could be terrifying into a class that I looked forward to going to. All of the exams are open book and the speeches are graded really fairly. I would recommend her to anyone-especially if you're dreading that OC gen-ed credit.
It is always suspicious to see on RMP that there are several positive comments about a professor after initial negative comments. Think a little, put two and two together, and conclude why!

His INST314 has lots of qualitative and conceptual stuff. Some R programming, but manageable. The projects are easy but require time. Quizzes line up with lectures. good amount of extra credit up for grabs. TAs were also helpful.

INST414 is pretty packed, but he does a solid job breaking down the tricky parts like python and math.  Super chill with grading. Lectures can drag a bit, but the content is a mix of technical machine learning, programming, and even some philosophy. Good pick if you want a quick intro to data science

Be ready for his class. Take the class serious from day one. He is very knowledgeable in mathematics and has a lot of control about statistical analysis, models, data collection methods, conceptual statistics. Yes! you'll be learning with R-programing language
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If possible I would avoid taking this class with him- at least online. He is bad at explaining the concepts and does not communicate with students in a timely manner.

This class doesnt fit the description! I BEG YOU,PLEASE PICK ANOTHER ISERIES! This class is very hard to get an A. Even though I did it took a lot of effort. The online lectures are long and they dont really help with the quizzes. You also have to check ELMS a couple times a week because random assignments pop up. Trust me!

This class description was not accurate on Testudo. For a level 100 course, this was NOT. Some assignments were identical to a level 400 class I was taking which makes no sense. The lectures were hours long with no closed captions to make it easy to take notes. Though I did well, it was very difficult. Not what I paid for or was expecting at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I do not recommend this class at all. The lectures are around an hour long and he talks so slow and goes on so many tangents that they're difficult to get through. The quizzes are ambiguous and he didn't start adding assignments until the add/drop period which is a major red flag. Do not take this class!

The professor was not accommodating to students' needs or schedules because all of the videos did not have closed captions or transcripts that would've made it easier for students to take notes from the videos and make them accessible for disabled students without having to request another ADS accommodation. The videos were also way too long.

INST 414 is a content-rich class and requires a serious approach to studying the material contained in lengthy lectures and to finishing coding assignments. Prof. Fotouhi seems very dedicated to making this learning journey as easy as possible by providing very comprehensive and detailed instructions.

Amazing professor, and he made the class super easy. He seems to grade lightly, but the criteria for assignments is super super vague. His lectures (during a summer semester) were LONG; often 4hrs of content per week, but this is probably lighter during a normal semester. I would 100% take him again, he knows how to teach.

This is a very easy class to pass and if you're just looking to fulfill your 462 graduation credit than I would say take it. HOWEVER, if you're looking to learn anything of value I would say take a different professor. They don't respond to emails for weeks and the only "study" material is lecture recordings.
DO NOT TAKE. he does not know how to teach. had to watch videos and then do quizzes and did not make sense.
Very nice, understanding professor. Gives good feedback and helps wherever she can. The curriculum itself is awful but its not up to her.

Attendance is mandatory, she gives activity points every single class and you must sign in so there is no way to get around it if you don't go to class. The assignments and exams themselves aren't difficult if you genuinely take notes and pay attention. There is a lot of content for the exams, but if you go to class/participate it won't be too bad.

Attendance is required because she records it and there are in-class activities every day for points. We had a couple of group projects/papers but there was no homework. The textbook was not required but it helped a little. She is nice but does not like if people are looking like they are doing something else on their laptops.

Took her for comm307. She's really good&knows what she's talking about. There's a fair amount of work in this class but she gives u time 2 prepare. She doesn't let you use ur electronics to write notes, but it did help me focus better in class& helped me study less on exams. She also replies to emails very fast and detailed. I would take her agn

She is very nice and prefers that you handwrite notes but the presentations are also available online. She gives clear instructions and answers any questions you have. I really enjoyed COMM449F. If you are specializing in digital media communication you have to take this class, it's so informative.

Dr. Bae does not understand or have the slightest compassion for her students. She can honestly care less about you and how you do in her course. Lectures are horrible. Her classes are just awful. And she does nothing to make anything better. Unfortunately, her classes are required, so good luck but do not take an elective with her. Godspeed

Soyoung is a nice person, but she makes the class harder than it has to be. The averages on all the tests were in the 70s and going to class is mandatory if you want to pass. The information isn't difficult but every class is the same lecture-style over and over. And she doesn't let anyone take notes on their computer. Id avoid her if possible.

Honestly shes not as bad as people make her seem. However though if you usually skip class, don take good notes and dont study, avoid taking her. The exams and group projects could a lot towards your final grade, so make sure youre in a good group cause youll be keeping the same one all semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: I respect Baes work ethic and course policies. She tends to take off points for minor things on presentations or papers. If you skip class, miss assignments, and dont review notes often.. you should worry about your grade. Her classes are lecture heavy with little assignments that actually count toward your letter grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Bae for both 400 and 402 and I have learned the most from her. People that typically fail or write rude things about her seem like the students that do not want to put in work. Her classes require hard work, if you don't put in the effort, you won't pass. Only con is group projects weigh very heavy so make sure you're in a good group
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: This course is very complex. You will except group projects with a hefty midterm and final exam throughout the semester. Professor Bae is a hard grader and is not an understanding professor. She will not work with you to help you and comes off rude. Do not take professor Baes courses unless you need the credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ive taken Professor Bae for 402, 400, and 370. Shes an extremely tough grader and attendance is grades. Her lectures are long, but theyre also very informative and will help you on the exams. The group projects are mandatory and she grades them harshly. Its easy to fail her class if you dont do well on the exams or group projects: BEWARE.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She takes points off for the pettiest things like talking or being late to class. You have to go to class because there are in-class assignments (5pts). Entire semester you work on parts of a research paper w/ a group. She does try to explain concepts well and gives examples but AVOID taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Bae looks for any excuse to take points off on the paper or the presentations you do and it's frustrating because she takes off for petty things. Bae is overly structured too. She's not willing to accommodate for you. She even said that you have to talk to her (at the beginning of the semester) if you have schedule conflicts with finals overlapping
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great professor who is easy to contact and holds office hours that are very useful. Grades your presentations based on set criteria, but is a tough grader compared to other professors. Genuinely cares about students doing well in her class. Sometimes gives .1 off of reflections (Ex. 39.9/40 but has no comments).

She was mainly the one who gave the lecture while the TA was the one who taught you and learned your name. Your success really will depend on your TA but Bae was a fine lecturer. Just show up and pay attention and you should be fine.

She's very nice & wants her students to do well. Don't expect to pass if you don't attend class regularly. She purposefully puts material on lecture slides during class that isnt available ever again unless you were there to take notes. just follow EXACT directions and you'll be fine. No rounding grades even if you're .1% away.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is the best professor I have ever had. She sincerely wants every one of her student to become better than they expect to be. Do not waste time writing her lectures word by word. Listen and write down her helpful examples. Then just refer back to the lectures she post online. She is always willing to help. COMM370, not COMM379

She is the best professor I have ever had. People may think she is strict, but she sincerely wants every one of her student to become better than they expect to be. Do not waste time writing her lectures word by word. Listen and write down her helpful examples. Then just refer back to the lectures she post online. She is always willing to help.

Miss any given class, automatic loss of points. There is a graded in-class activity every class. Midterm and final projects are group projects, and she takes group member evaluations seriously. Great teacher, but insanely difficult class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I don't really learn much even while sitting in her lectures. Her lectures are dull and boring.

Pros: Her class was not too difficult. If you show up to class, study for the exams, and do assignments, you should get a good grade. Very straight forward. Cons: She requires everyone to take notes by hand unless stated otherwise. She also takes attendance so be prepared to go. Finally, she is very strict on assignment guidelines so follow them.

Dr. Barrie was the best professor I have had at UMD. We are talking about topics that could cause you to feel uncomfortable but she always finds a way to make everyone discuss, learn, and laugh. Very caring. This class is so good when everyone is participating! Two major papers and a group project! Very easy to pass if you attend class!
My favorite professor. Take her class.

I LOVED Dr. Barrie. Very kind and cares about students. No busywork was one of the best parts of this class; discussion was engaging and I learned a lot. Readings each week but not very long or dense.

Brown makes the class harder than it needs to be. It's hard to follow her during lecture and expect a lot of dead moments because nobody knows what she's talking about half the time.. She grades and posts assignments last minute, exams are very overwhelming for the 75 mins allowed, and you must participate and complete weekly self-assessments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She doesn't grade your work. The first 3 weeks of assignments will be graded. She assigns a lot of work. Your final or mid-term exam will be graded but most likely never both. But will always grade participation. It is extremely rare to get an A but also very rare to fail.
Doesn't grade lol.

Just don't take her. I promise you I've had her 4 times against my will and it's not worth the stress. I have NEVER received a midterm grade from her class. She doesn't grade on time and doesn't provide feedback on assignments. She creates all these over the top exams and projects and waits until after the final grade deadlines to submit them.

This Prof. is not cut out for virtual learning. It's clear she does not understand how to organize her elms page. Multiple times me or my group missed assignments because we didn't know they existed, which is NOT okay. She never explains what things are due when, never returns written exam grades or feedback - she's inept. Do NOT take her course.
Grades extremely hard for an elective I really regret taking this class.

I loved her!!! The class good be a lot of work but she knew all her students and cared about their work! Some projects and museum tripe felt like a lot of work but if you start early you are given a reasonable amount of time! Don't procrastinate!

Not hard but it was tedious at times with how in depth the papers were. Made the class go to the NMWA museum twice which students had to pay for and they were not reimbursed. Also made students complete a wearable art project and wear it around on campus and off campus for a total of four hours. Lectures are boring but participation is a biggie.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: took this class as an easy Gened. The class was all discussion/blog based; it involved communicating with others about the course materials. Terribly boring, learned a little bit, but I'm only happy cuz i got the A. If you put in a fair amount of effort, you should be guaranteed the A. she doesn't respond to emails tho. have fun and get 3 geneds
She is amazing and I'm honored to have taken a class with her. I learned a lot. It was a lot of work but it was worth it.

She's a really good professor and you learn so much by the end of the class. However, make sure you go to each class because she doesn't post all of her lecture notes online and your assignments/quizzes are based on the lectures. Other than that, it's not that hard to get an A in the class

This woman is Brilliant. She makes you think of black history and presents a lot of events and views in ways you would probably never think of. I will say she is EXTREMELY slow on grading things and you will be waiting for your grades forever, however, if you do the work...which really isn't har...you should be perfectly fine.

I really like Professor Bayly's class structure. Each week is consistently organized and easy to follow. She also responds quickly to emails in a caring manner. I would definitely take more classes with this professor!

Overall class experience was average and what is expected from a professional writing course. However, the professor grades almost entirely on opinion. They use 'I think' in almost every critique of your writing, rather than directly relating it to the rubric. Although I earned an 'A', I am disappointed it was based on someone's opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Definitely one of the better professors. Her instructions are very clear and if you complete all the assignments + use a tiny bit of effort it should be an easy A. You must show up to class but she gives 2 “mental health days” that came in clutch. The bigger essays she splits it into pieces and gives you plenty of time to complete each piece.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She calls a section of the assignment "boosters" indicating that it is extra credit but it isn't. I didn't know this and it killed my grade. I scheduled office hours with her twice and she never showed up on both. She canceled class last minute multiple times but marks you as absent if you are just a few mins late. She give me ptsd, don't take her!

The best way to describe Catherine Bayly is extra. She should be teaching high school. Her class is uninteresting, filled with useless workshops and checkpoints, and unrelated to professional writing. I do not feel like I learned anything in her class. Furthermore, she is unclear in many of her assignments and penalizes abscensess unecissarily

The best professor I have had at UMD. Her assignment instructions are super clear, just follow them and you're guaranteed an A. She is so encouraging when reviewing your work. She inspired me to become a better writer. She also gives out treats if you participate and is very understanding if you come late to class.

You are better off taking ENGL101 with another professor. There are too many assignments and CB grades fairly hard. She is stringent with her grading, however, she is a nice person and really accessible outside of class. My opinion: You are doing a lot of work for the same credit as ENGL101, take the non-scholars class if you have the option, or do
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Shes a caring teacher, she gives good feedback and is open to suggestions. There are about 3 papers which are doable and pretty straight forward. She has workshops that help with each stage in the writing process. Just be prepared and ready to engage then you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a great English professor who takes her time to give critical revisions on all of your papers. Truly improved my writing and cares about all of her students.

CB is an amazing professor! Really cares about her students and wants you to achieve. Her class is challenging but fun. You put the work in, you'll get an A. Overall, you're writing will improve tremendously with her help.
I genuinely liked her and her teaching style, but she is a tough grader; however, the criteria is clear and reasonable. Overall, I do recommend taking her course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Bayly cares a ton about her students! The class is definitely a good bit of work (and she's a "thorough" grader), but she'll make that work engaging and fun. And this class definitely offers opportunities to become a better writer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: No joy was found in this class, partly due to the dullness of English 101, however having Bayly was one of the low points of my freshman year at UMD.

She wants you to do well, but grades strictly. The online portion of the course was a hassle (for me at least). Lectures are on the drier side. To put it bluntly, she's definitely the kind of professor you'd want to have if you enjoy/are good at writing. If not, it will be a long semester.

Awesome teacher. Makes a morning class fun and obviously cares about her students as individuals. Can be a tough grader and some hw assignments are annoying, and the papers are a lot of work but she makes it fun! Definitely enjoyed the class despite the work. The blended class is very helpful and ample time for assignments is given with clear guide
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: attendance definitely matters for this class since she gives you only an X amount of days you can miss before it impacts your grade. and although some of the material is annoying, she's extremely helpful and genuinely cares about her students! make sure to actively participate too.

It was my favorite class. Granted I love English, but she made everything fun. She's spunky and adorable and everyday she'd start class with a different song. One time she brought us cookies. Another she brought her adorable kids. And she'll teach you so much. But you'll enjoy it so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: too hard

Ms. Bayly is one of the better professors for ENGL101. She has two 50 minute lectures and an online component in her class. You can miss class up to 5 times a semester. She is extremely helpful and will go out of her way to help you. You don't have to try hard to do well! The class is relatively easy but it can be a little annoying at times.
Fantastic Professor and excellent mentor. She will no doubt improve your writing abilities.
Baron is the goat
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor, very lecture-heavy. Tech beware, nothing is allowed in her class: everything must be handwritten in class. She also took a long time to grade things, but her feedback was good on what was graded.

Very nice person and is very very knowledgeable about her material. However, there were a total of 5 grades for the whole semester. She also took FOREVER to grade assignments. I had no idea of my grade until the end of November! She gives fair extensions and isn't a particularly hard grader. Lectures are long and boring didn't use the books once.

Dr. Baron is a very nice lady and a great professor. The only complaint I have about her is that she is very anti-technology, so all notes have to be handwritten. She also doesn't put any words on her lecture slides, so you have to listen very carefully to get all of the information. She is very passionate about the subject and grades fairly.

Baron is a really nice lady and is extremely knowledgeable. However, her lecture slides are so confusing and it's quite hard to take useful notes since she flies through everything. She also says "um" after every other word. She also takes forever to put in grades, and is kinda questionable with her grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Baron, is a knowledgeable and understanding professor. However, the first assignment for this class was on september 5th. Today is december 15th and she has not graded a single assignment (except for the reading quizzes which are multiple choice and canvas grades automatically). I have no idea what I actually have in the class right now.

It's the basic lecture heavy history class with two big essays and two exams. If you don't like lectures, do not take this class. The grading is fair and it's not too hard to get an A. The readings are really unnecessary since she goes over everything you need to know in class.

Zero homework, amazing class. She is a phenomenal lecturer, and you get the full 'history is a story' experience. There will be a big paper at the end of the year but she's extremely smart and will help you find sources. One of the best teachers I ever had. P.S. only thing to worry about is don't use your phone in class

The class is very lecture heavy and the lecture notes matter. She flys through the lectures, but will answer any questions about anything you missed at the end of class. Show up and take notes and you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Baron is funny, sarcastic and very smart. The lectures can be interesting, but honestly they can get so boring... I enjoyed the class but struggled to stay focused at times. There's 2 major papers and she's pretty lenient with grading. Also, make sure you show up to class.

Class is very lecture heavy. You can miss a couple of classes, but everything is based on the lectures. Be careful with grammar on essays and exams, apparently she was a copy editor or something, so make sure you read over your assignments more than once. She knows what she is talking about and throws a lot of info at you at once. Says "uh" A LOT.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Baron, was very understanding of the hectic schedule that students often face and always gave extensions on papers when asked. Attendance is important, but she guides the students through the material very well, leaving few questions.

Sabrina Baron is definitely one of the nicest professors at UMD. She always makes sure that everyone in the class is on the same page and is willing to let students have extensions if needed. Her lectures were clear and concise, unlike her grading, however. While her assignments weren't difficult, she never posted anything on ELMS.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Professor Baron's class. It's clear that she is very knowledgable about the subject, and her lectures reflect that. She's not the most organised (which got slightly annoying), but she's very funny. She assigns a lot of reading, which weren't necessary to do to pass the class, but were very interesting and helpful.

I really like Dr. Baron. She's very reasonable with deadlines and clear with requirements, and gave me an extension when I needed one. This class was really enjoyable - she's funny, and her lectures were enjoyable. She really made the class think, and I'm glad I took it.
By far the most approachable teacher. Always grants extensions on papers when asked, and gives take-home finals.  Interesting Lectures too, but be ready to take a ton of notes.

I forget the class number that I took with her, it was British history though. I am not a history person at all, but Prof Baron was so engaging and interesting she almost made me want to change majors. Loved her class. Learned so much. She is so helpful.

I absolutely love Prof. Baron! She knows her history extremely well and also makes class fun. I took her class this year and the day I could register for classes I just had to take another class she was teaching. She is amazing and knows how to make you get the knowledge in your head. Also very approachable and always available. Take her class!

SHE'S SO NICE! she gave me an extension on our major essay for the semester and was totally understanding about how overwhelming freshmen year could be.  She's really sweet when comes to help outside of class and her lectures are really interesting.  I loved her class!!
the class isnt too hard. I like the fact that it is a bit unstructured. you are not always so focused on the grade and so you actually learn something. She is very understanding and reachable.
She's a pretty interesting professor.  The class isn't too hard either.  I would recommend it!

no lecture guides, no order to lecture. she is a staunch man hater. i was offended by her stereotypes of men. she frequently flaunts her personal political views, even on subjects not relevant to the class. her attitude is awful. She cannot go 3 words without saying "uhhhh" or "ummmm" or "you know".... she is the worst public speaker EVER.
good professor, interactive with the students and always available esp. via email...

Professor Bernal's teaching style may initially feel awkward, but her passion for the subject drives an engaging and meaningful classroom experience. Attendance  is mandatory and she takes the time to learn each student's name and face. I am glad I took the course, as it introduced me to stories I had never heard or read about before!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: For a creative writing class, there was no free ability to create whatever we wanted. She changes everything we write to be what she wants to read and not what we originally intended. She takes long awkward pauses and stares at students. She continually mentions how she wants our works to be more raunchy. The most uncomfortable class I've ever had.
Professor Bernal likes what she does and it shows in her work. She made the poetry we discussed in class come to life.

If you enjoy having a professor who suffocates your right to speak freely, only listens to herself talk, and allows bullying in her class, this is the class for you!! She's the type of professor who "doesn't believe in grades" so she does not tell you what you have in the class until the semester is over, even if you ask. Seriously awful professor.
