reviews.comment: The readings can be long/dense, but connect to the themes. Posts are open-ended. I wrote about my own experiences/reflections/beliefs--write like you're writing an op-ed.

Do not take if you value your time. 2 discussion posts a week with absurdly long questions requiring an analysis of 30 page PDFs and 2 hour long films, multiple exams (with cumulative final), and a final essay. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Dorsey was a great professor. His lectures were interesting and lively, and all of the assignments and exams directly reflected the material that he gives you during lecture. I really enjoyed his class and his grading is fair as well

Professor Dorsey was one of the best professors I ever had. He really cares about his students, and during lecture, he liked to joke around with us. His exams are not too hard, and the final is actually a group project, which definitely helped my grade. He is a very laid back and chill person, which is why he didn't want us to stress too much.
Hands down, best professor ever. His lectures were fun and intreactive, no hard hw. Exams were straight forward as long as you took notes and payed attention in class.

Such a FUN class, AMAZING professor - definitely I will take him again!
PROS: VERY Interesting "case studies", lectures and book. 
CONS: the course is only one semester long (wish to be longer).
I will love to take him again, and I am constantly looking for when his classes will fit my schedule. 
Definitely recommended.
This is the best professor ever. He is absolutely amazing and I cannot recommend him enough.

I absolutely love this professor and have taken him for multiple classes. I highly recommend taking one of his classes, he is not a tough grader, there were only 2 exams that were online and then one group presentation but he is very lenient about it. There are 5 quizzes in class but are very easy and do not require much studying!

He is the best professor I've had here.  Every class starts with an icebreaker question which usually lightens the mood.  He is super funny and so caring.  Dorsey does whatever he can to help make everyone as successful as possible.  I would definitely look into taking one of his courses.  Plus he hardly assigns homework which is amazing!
He was a great professor and genuinely cares about his students

He is a great professor. He shares stories with the class to help you understand the topic better but also tells them in a funny way so you always leave his class with a big smile on your face. Always made my day. Attendance is not mandatory but make sure to go to class in order to ace your exams. Make sure to participate during class!

Professor Dorsey is the best professor I have had at this school. He really cares about his students and his class was the only one I was genuinely so excited to go to. He says textbooks are required but I didnt read and still got an A+ as quizzes are open note and exams are lecture heavy. I will definitely be taking more classes with him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Second time taking him and it was a blast! He is fun, caring, and really relatable with students since he is so young. Good balance between friend and professor which is really respected imo. Lectures are exactly what are on the exams and he makes them fun and engaging with stories. He is extremely accommodating as well, dont miss out on him!

Professor Dorsey is the best! I promise you hes super easy to get along with and hes a very understanding professor. He can be stern sometimes but he is literally just being a teacher. Just make sure you come to class to take notes or rely on a friend to get the notes for you. But his classes are so fun you wont want to skip! Hes the best!

Professor Dorsey puts on a really nice front during the semester to get kids to write nicely about him in their course evaluations, but when it comes to being genuinely understanding, he throws all of his "kindness" back in your face. I disclosed personal struggles that hindered my success and he refused to transfer my ec points.

I loved Professor Dorsey! He was so accomodating to students and was so relatable. You do have to go to class because it's mandatory and the tests are all lecture-based. I am 100% taking another class with him in the future.
not understanding when it comes to student concerns, class was fine but wouldn't take again

Kyle Dorsey is the best professor Ive had. Hes so engaging and hes super accommodating to his students. He has the best sense of humor too so hes always cracking jokes. 10/10 would recommend taking his class.
PROFESSOR DORSEY IS THE BEST.

My favorite professor. He makes class so engaging and interesting. The only thing is you need to go to class because the test and quizzes are literally lecture based but the lectures are so fun and he makes the content really interesting. Definitely take his class. He is an excellent professor and hilarious.

Loved professor Dorsey! Definitely recommend to take him. He is very considerate and you can tell he genuinely cares about all his students. Just show up to class and take notes. You should be fine. Most or all of his quizzes are open note

I looooove Prof. Dorsey. Only after one semester, I want to keep taking more of his classes! He always made his lectures interesting and informative. It is so important to come to lectures as the exams and quizzes were very lecture heavy. He often would allow us to ask what we should expect on exams and quizzes! Highly recommended!

I would be dead asleep in my class right before his and as soon as I got to his class I was wide awake. His lectures were very interesting and he adds personal stories to make it more fun. He was very knowledge about the topics and I learned a lot

An amazing professor who is truly passionate about his job. He knows the material really well and gives great examples to help you remember different things. He wants you to succeed so as long as you put in the necessary work, you will be good. A lot of reading but it is worth it and is on interesting material. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS CLASS!

Professor Dorsey is one of the best professors Ive had at UMD. Hes very organized and makes lectures very interesting. His tests are made up of information that is primarily in his lecture slides. He doesnt post the slides on ELMS, so you definitely should show up to class and review your notes. But youll literally WANT to show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hands down my favorite professor. He genuinely cares about his students mental health and success. His exams arent that hard as long as you study, and quizzes are open note. 11/10 would recommend taking any of his classes

Dorsey is so great. I've never had a professor make a 300 person lecture hall so engaged. He's hilarious and a great story teller. His class is weighted pretty heavily on exams so don't think it's an easy A, but 100% take him if you can.

Professor Dorsey was so kind and really cared about his students. He is one of the few teachers I have had who works hard to see everything from his students perspective. He wants you to learn the content, but also doesnt want the class to be the reason youre stressed. As long as you listen to his (super interesting) lectures, youll get an A

Professor Dorsey is one of the best professors you will ever have at UMD. He is kind, passionate about what he does, and genuinely cares about his students and their well-being. If you have the opportunity to take one of his courses, DO IT. You won't regret it. He's the best!

I loved this professor, he relates to students and his lectures are just easy to follow. I took the slavery and human trafficking class and I learned a lot. He made us read a book that I found interesting about human trafficking and you write an essay. The quizzes and assignments are pretty easy as well.

Professor Dorsey is my absolute favorite CCJS professor at UMD ( next to Robert Stewart ) Attendance is optional, but lectures are never posted online so you should just go anyway. He gives out exam hints/questions and is very understanding. 5 open note quizzes, 3 super easy exams, 1 paper!

Prof. Dorsey is hilarious!! He is dedicated to teaching content to his students but, is very flexible and laid back! There is a required textbook and readings. Make sure to focus and take notes during lecture as both his quizzes and exams are heavily influenced by lecture and less so on the textbook. I hope to take class with Prof. Dorsey again!

THIS MAN IS A KING! Absolutely recommend him 10/10!! He is so funny and tells hilarious stories during lecture. Textbook is required but honestly you only really need to know the terms b/c quizzes and exams are mostly lecture based.

I took CCJS100 over the winter semester and really enjoyed it. It was very reading heavy (we read a 500 page textbook in three weeks), but overall it was manageable. Each chapter goes along with a recorded lecture, which are engaging and content-heavy. The exams were easy if you read the book and watched the lecture.
Basically, all you have to do is post discussion board responses and watch the lecture. Professor Dorsey is very laid back but also teaches the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class has recorded lectures from Prof Dorsey and then discussions with a TA. It's sad we don't get to meet him because his lectures are really entertaining, he explains concepts well and with many stories. There's a few quizzes and exams which are all pretty easy, and one straightforward essay. Overall a good and easy class.

This class was pretty easy as long as you did the chapter notes and watched lectures. However, at the end of the semester Professor Dorsey refused to respond to any students emails about how they did on the last exam which seemed pretty unfair
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Dorsey is one of the best professors I've ever had! His lectures are funny, interesting, and very informative. He's very clear about his grading criteria and wants to ensure that you will do well. Right from the beginning, he makes it clear that he's there to make sure you succeed.

Such a nice and caring professor! He really wants you to succeed in his class and takes extra measures to do so. He loves to help his students and offers a fairly reasonable workload. His class layout was super organized and easy to navigate. Take notes on lectures, read the book and its an easy A. He is always willing to work with his students!

I really loved this class! Even online Professor Dorsey was such a funny teacher who cared about his students! He's super dramatic and tells stories which made me feel like I know him! Each week there's just a 1 hour lecture and a mandatory discussion. As long as you take notes on the lecture and read the book, there's no way you won't get an A!

Prof. Dorsey is a very nice and caring professor. Class is fairly easy, and there aren't too many homework assignments. Exams are fair and graded immediately. He can ramble on a bit during lectures, which makes them lengthy sometimes, but overall a great class and an easy A!

He is such an amazing professor. His lectures are never boring, and he's super funny and tells a lot of stories, which makes the material more interesting. He is extremely considerate and understanding when it comes to extensions or make ups.

Professor Dorsey seems like an awesome guy but in times of online classes, it just doesn't work. His lectures are drawn out to a disrespectful length and are very boring, with at least a twenty second pause and "um" between every talking point. He speaks in lecture like he's gossiping. I cannot pay attention, but, again, he seems like a great guy.

Prof Dorsey is awesome. He is funny and the class is really interesting. Make sure you participate and he will like you. Pay attention during class. He is easily accessible and really cares about his students. He does not mess around with cheating so don't even try. Quizzes and Exams are very fair

This class started out in person and ended up fully online class due to COVID. Prof. Dorsey did an AMAZING job transitioning lectures, projects, tests/quizzes, feedback, help if needed, etc. He genuinely cares about his students! I'm taking a class in Fall specifically because he's teaching! If you can, make sure you take at least one class of his!

Professor Dorseys lectures were the highlight of my week. He makes class fun and really difficult material easy to understand. If you pay attention in class and do the reading you can definitely expect an A. Discussion quizzes and exams arent too difficult if youre keeping up in class. I would definitely recommend taking his class!

Professor Dorsey is an ICON. He is not only an amazing professor, but he is a character. Lectures are interesting and entertaining. If you miss, you're not only missing content but you're missing a good time. He is super understanding and wants to see that you're making an effort. Definitely take a class with him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Dorsey is one of the best professors at the University of Maryland. He is funny, relatable, and knowledgeable. He understands if you have a problem or concern and will try his best to help you out. Take his classes!
Really relatable guy. His lectures and the textbook readings give you all the information you need, you just got to memorize it on your own.
Just worst. How did he became a professor?

Professor Dorcey made lectures engaging. While there were a lot of words on the slides, he gives you plenty of time to write everything down. He makes a lot of jokes and tells stories to help solidify the material being learned.

Dorsey gives interesting, funny lectures but doesn't always seem to know what he's talking about 100% of the time. Exams are easy and multiple-choice, and there's only 1 5-page paper, and he basically outlines how to get an A on it. The only tricky part can be the disc. quizzes made by the TAs. He gave multiple extra credit opportunities.

Dorsey was a really kind and funny professor. He would often use funny examples from his personal life when describing class content which kept it interesting. He reads directly from the slides and doesn't post them as well, but you can just get the same info from the book. Discussion section was useless but you have to go for the weekly quizzes.

You might learn more from the book than from his lectures. He reads straight from the slides and the slides are not shared to you. Sometimes the slides have too much to write and he talks while you're writing. This professor is a solid "Ok".
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Dorsey is an OK professor. His lectures are heavy and you gotta write fast. Textbook was used in the beginning of the semester but majority of it was already covered in class. There are 3 exams, a 5 page paper, and some extra credit chances. Good Luck, y'all!

Professor Dorsey's class was ok. He is a funny lecturer, but just reads off the slides. He doesn't post the slides, so you need to go to class even though there isn't participation. There is one short paper and the information is not super difficult. He offers extra credit. This class is definitely an easy B, but you'd have to work to get an A.

Encourages students to read from the textbook, even though his lectures cover all the material. Often reads off the slides. The class is not the easy A you would expect, but the exams are not difficult if you spend enough time studying. Dorsey himself is a hilarious professor, but also pretty intimidating to approach at times. Overall great class
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I always had the feeling that he didn't always know what he was talking about. Kind of like when a kid gives a presentation on something they just researched that morning...a bit cringey. His slides have way too much info on them and he hardly ever elaborates on anything, just reads straight from the slide. His tests are eh, not terrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Kyle Dorsey is one of my favorite professors at UMD. He was always available for concerns or questions via email or before or after class. He is a fair grader and prepares you well for quizzes (which will be pop quizzes) and all three exams. I genuinely learned so much in his class and I enjoyed every lecture. I took this class as a gen ed elective

This was my favorite college course thus far. Kyle is hilarious and keeps lectures structured, short, and interesting. Class never lasted the full length, no HW, exams were easy and curved, quizzes were open-note and notice was given ahead of time. Attendance is taken but has no impact on grade, but beware, Kyle is very strict about make-ups
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He literally doesn't know what he talks abt in class. Makes u pay for a book he write half way through. Overall not a good prof

not inst126 but the lack of professionalism as a professor, dropped students on the last day of schedule adjustment without clarifying that they would be dropped due to a mistake of his and the syllabus on testudo.

Prof. Heidenblad was pretty good. I took the class asynchronously and still learned a lot. The lectures were recorded with quizzes added in and the homework and labs werent bad. The exams were pretty easy and he explains concepts clearly. Hes also approachable and answers questions during his office hours. I would definitely recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very nice professor and pretty hilarious too. The only people complaining about him are holding a grudge. Every time I have asked him something, he has been respectful and gives useful answers. Class not bad at all imo. Pretty sad that people are complaining tbh.

Donal started the semester complaining about students complaining that he is inaccessible. Donal does not respond to emails over weekends or during evenings. Labwork is started Friday in discussion and due Sunday. Do you see how this is a problem? Disrespectful when spoken to, regardless of reason. Randomly changes deadlines. I have a 100% thus far
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. His lectures were well thought-out and very easily understandable. I could tell he truly enjoyed what he was teaching and her tried to pass that onto his students. The assignments were extremely interesting as they were generally open-ended, so I was very interested in my topic. I thoroughly enjoyed this class only because of the
Disorganized and comes late to class. Rarely any hands-on lab time in class (which I think is super important for something like web development) as he fumbles with Linux.

Donal is solid professor in-person. He is accessible and is very approachable. I took this course online however, and he was extremely unorganized. His lectures for the labs were almost useless to watch. I learned nothing. He grades assignments very lightly, which is a plus. I would not recommend taking an online course with him.

I've had him for 3 classes. If you aren't self-motivated or passionate about the material you won't learn much, but his classes are easy to pass. He's not extremely organized, and many assignments will end up getting canceled. His online classes in particular can get very disorganized, but this is to your benefit if you just want less work.

Donal is a great professor. He presents the information in a way that is very clear and easy to understand. He is also very accessible outside of class and willing to work with you to sort out any issues. His grading is not overly strict and the exams are an appropriate amount of difficulty for the material presented.

Donal is a great guy. He made a class that would've been very hard into a fun, easy experience. The assignments were difficult but he's very accessible outside of class and will patiently walk you through ways you can complete the assignment. He's a nice, approachable, and understanding professor. Take him!
Take him if you want an A for this course. He is the nicest professor I ever had. He is really respectful for students who have any kind of issues.
Nicest and most helpful professor I've ever had. Doesn't make you feel dumb when you are struggling with understanding python.
He is a really kind professor. Other than that he spends time giving you feedback, which helps me a lot.
he is very helpful and made learning python enjoyable
Great Professor!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Also teaches INST327 (Database Design). Donal is a great instructor who emphasizes your learning and understanding of data science techniques over grades. Make use of office hours early if you have trouble with projects, he will give you feedback until you can get them done.

Very bad professors! This was an introductory class where the exam averages were around 65%. This wouldn't have been an issue because he promised that exams would be curved and that a mean score would equate to an 85 yet he never did! Furthermore he professes to have ec in his classes but never adds the credit to your grade.

If you want an easy science with lab, then I would avoid this class. His tests were very difficult and had obscure questions. He promised everyone in the class all semester a curve on all exams and final grades and he failed to follow through on that. He was also very disorganized in how he organized the outline of the course.

Blamed students for poor test scores (the average on his exams was almost 40% every time). He clearly dislikes students, he came in with spreadsheets blaming everyone else for failures rather than his own lack of teaching ability. He promised students all semester that final grades would be curved, and then failed to commit to that.

If you love astronomy and go to his lectures, this course will be an easy A and so rewarding. 

His demos are awesome, he's great at breaking down complex information, cares about us a lot, made changes based on our feedback, & tons of extra credit and curves. 
 
If you don't care and just want an easy no-effort gen ed, this course is not for you.

This class was miserable. He blamed students for his poor communication around exams and seems to hate the youth as a whole. He provides good demos and lots of extra credit, but it is incredibly difficult to sit through lectures due to passive-aggressive comments. It makes the learning experience miserable and I dreaded going to class.

He makes the exams really hard with information that is not taught in class or in the book. The online book sucks so sorry but I recommend getting the physical book. Going to lecture doesnt help so if you dont mind missing the extra credit just go to discussion because the tas make more sense. He isnt good at explaining how things work.

absolutely awful!!! not only is his class impossible to pass but the average test scores for our exams never exceeded a 68%... absolutely ridiculous for an introductory level course. not only is he a horrible teacher but he also sucks as a person . way too anal about cheating
Great class, but hard. Learned a lot though!
Best astronomy professor I've had. Fun, excited, clear and awesome.

Dr. Hamilton cares about teaching almost as much as astronomy. His tests are challenging but he isn't harsh with grading. The point of the class is to learn and be able to solve interesting problems. I honestly believe that even getting a solid B means you learned a lot and did a good job applying that knowledge. Take if you're serious about Astro!

Professor Hamilton is very passionate about astronomy and probably one of my favorite professors. He spends a lot of time going over textbook material and his exams are challenging. He really focuses on understanding how and why things are the way they are in astronomy. Very helpful during  office hours and really cares about his students.

He was a pleasure to be taught by. He knew the material with ease and taught it gracefully. The class was small and took half of the time discussing the textbook. The other half of class was spent learning useful math. A good background in astronomy helped a lot but he built on what we already knew and made it very interesting.

Definitely a challenging course but Prof Hamilton gave more than enough chances for extra credit. Lectures were very interesting and he did a good job of explaining some very difficult concepts. Stay away if you aren?t science oriented or aren?t responsible enough to attend the lectures. Otherwise, well worth it!

Professor Hamilton loves astronomy and you can really tell that through this lectures. The class is extremely hard though and he makes you turn in homework that we have not covered in class yet. He assumed that we knew how to do the math when some of us didnt

The course was extremely hard. It did feel like a 400 level course, when it was only an elective. It also didn't help that he fired my TA mid-semester, and seemed to not care that our section was not getting the proper material and our new TA had a stick up her butt! I would NOT recommend this course if you are not an Asrtonomy major. COURSE SUCKS

This guy is terrible. I don't know what the other raters are on, but this made the 100 level class like a 400 level! He's anal about potential cheating, and pats you down after exams! I took this as an elective and it killed my GPA. AVOID!

Hamilton loves Astronomy, and you can certainly tell through his lectures. Has almost a fetish for exploding helium balloons, and his crazy demonstrations in class ACTUALLY relate to the material being learned, which helps me remember certain concepts for the tests. Tests, by the way, are no walk in the park, but he gives bonus points in lecture!

Hamilton is the epitome of an astronomy professor.  An accomplished researcher who is supremely knowledgeable in his field, he makes the most complicated concepts in astrophysics intuitively understandable.  Then he goes through the math, showing why and how ti works.  Take his classes and your view of the universe will never be the same.

The professor is a strict grader and doesn't give feedback to help improve future assignments. Grades are not given back quickly. To see your quiz scores, you have to schedule office hours every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Best teacher and class Ive ever taken. She is incredibly attentive and will make sure you understand the content. The readings are long but very worthwhile, Ive learned so much in this class. Discussions are great, easy to structure workload, she posts everything on modules from the get go, youll never be caught off guard with what to expect
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Literally the best professor Ive ever had. Ive learned so much from her and her class Im so grateful to have taken it. The readings are heavy but if you actually care about the subject it is so worth doing. The work and discussions are really engaging and she is amazing at going over it in class, making sure you understand & answering questions

The first half of the class was hard, the second half was an acceptable amount of work. She can be really nice and helpful but she can also be a bit rude and aggressive, it may be the lawyer in her. The problem is a classroom is not the courtroom and students are more sensitive than she may think. Besides that, class was interesting and fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved this course and learned alot from it.  Professor Drechsel is a very clear lecturer, made the subject matter understandable.  He also makes the course expectations very clear.  He now gives out mock exams.  I found that doing the study questions that come with the e-book and attending lectures prepares you well for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible. His class average on the final was 60 and he didn't curve. He then made a 95% an A rather than a 93% he went out of his way to make it more difficult. He needs to be more transparent about that and outline it in his syllabus. He's a pretty bad person trying to make it so hard to get an A. He says he curves but he doesn't actually.

Great lectures--always managed to explain topics in a simple, straightforward way.  Only downside is that the test questions are much more difficult than the homework questions and there is not much of a curve.  Still an overall good experience with this professor.

The exams were extremely harder than the homework assignments. He did not honor the "generous curve" that he promised us, which I eventually got over. However, I had a .6 and he did not round it up to the next letter grade which I thought was very unfair of him. I do NOT recommend him to others.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He has lecture twice a week and attendance is optional. However, to do well in this class, you need to read the textbook AND attend lectures. There is one exam and a non-cumulative final. The questions on the exams are similar to the instructor created questions on the homework. Overall, he is an understanding and reasonable professor.

There are only 2 exam for this class, and the exams are made by the professor. Exams differ significantly from the learning catalysts and assignments we do in class. Despite the fact that he set cutoffs at the end of the course, it still seems unreasonable to deny students who are barely 0.1 percent away to the next grade (not rounded up).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took Professor Ginsberg for KNES 120. Extremely easygoing professor and helps you get a good grade in his class by providing helpful feedback. I would highly recommend taking his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Took KNES131V for the summer semester. Had to record lots of jogs throughout the week and make improvements. The assignments were all easy and you just had to write them up. There were online quizzes where the answers are within his PowerPoint PDFs and were relatively easy. Easy A and enjoyable class. Few assignments overall besides exercising.

Took KNES161N for the winter semester. Had to do 12 lab workouts in 21 days which honestly was exercising most days of the week for 3 weeks. The assignments were easy, you just had to write them up. There were 3 online quizzes, and answers in his PowerPoint. Easy A and enjoyable class. Few assignments overall besides exercising.

Fun class and low stress. Lectures were actually really useful - it may seem weird to be lectured in a walking class, but you learn about the science behind walking. Quizzes and exams were super low stress. Just make sure that you don't skip any data uploads. Great way to take a break from studying for other classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Ginsberg is a great teacher! He always replies to emails within great time whenever you need help, and he always makes it clear that he IS here to help. He is a very understanding teacher, and makes things easily understandable. Overall, if he is a choice to pick from, pick him.

1-credit walking class. Super easy. Walk 2x a week (starts at 25mins a week then goes up 5mins each week, max 45mins). Weekly quizzes - VERY basic. The lecture content is actually interesting stuff too. Very low-maintenance class. Easy A. I've never taken a 1-credit course so it feels SO good to have such an easy class.

Nothing to it except your Walking assignments are SO important to your grade. Do not skip them! TIP: take advantage of the weekends! Midterm and Final are very basic MC quizzes from weekly lectures and slides. TBH: The class is a little more work than maybe a 1 credit class should be (or at least regarding time) but well worth a good exercise break

Great course taught in a way that makes it more than just about running. The most thorough and easy-to-navigate ELMS page I have ever seen was in this course by the professor. Easy A, enjoy the running!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice person!! He understands that this is a 1 credit class that everyone needs to take, so he goes easy on us in a reasonable way. Hybrid course, with weekly online quizzes that are easy to answer if you watch the lectures posted on ELMS. Participate in class so it's more fun!

Drew is known to be a great Activity Class professor at UMD. He mostly teaches basketball and has more knowledge about the classes he teaches than most other activity class professors. While he expects you to participate, he's very understanding and relatable. He's one of the few professors you'll call a friend. His exams can be tough to study for.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Drew is a really nice guy, and he does a good job making the lectures interesting. Two easy exams, all multiple choice, and Drew will yell out hints and extra credit in the middle of the exam. Attendance not useful as powerpoints are posted online, but random graded assignments given every 3-4 classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Drew is one of my favorite professors. He's super nice and makes this introductory class helpful and fun. Two major tests- content isn't super difficult if you go to lecture and study a bit.

Drew is great. He is so caring and really understands what it is like to be a student. He wants to see all of his student succeed so he will often be very accommodating. The class itself is really easy and if you show up, there isnt much work to do outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Mr. Barker isn't a bad guy, but if you can take another professor, do it. The class is easy, but prepare to be bored - he doesn't allow any electronics and drones on about useless information for so long. The presentations were probably more fun than regular comm, but the class was so boring and the grading was so heavily up to his interpretation.

Professor Barker was a great and funny guy. I think this class is way better than taking comm classes for the fsoc credit. You don't need a theatre background and it's easy to do good in the class as long as you put effort into your work. The class was great and I actually improved a lot as a speaker/presenter because of him.
Fun professor, loved the class

drew is great! I did theatre in high school and so this class was very easy, but you don't need any theatre background at all. its mostly speeches and stuff and its a lot less pressure than taking comm. he's super nice and wants you to pass. just do the work and show up to class and hell like you.
great class to take with him. he makes the material so easy to understand. just do your work and you should have an A. i highly recommend taking PSYC 100 with him.
He is a really caring professor allows for late work and makes the class so easy to understand would totally take the class again.
Professor was very clear with his expectations and tried to cater lesson to make them engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All around, a fantastic experience for an online, fast paced class. This is what I dream of when I think about taking an online course. The tests weren't bad, the material was interesting, and I was a little big nostalgic when the class was over. Highly recommend Professor Parham and encourage all who want to try psychology to do it through him.

Professor Parham is a kind, low-stress, and highly supportive professor with flexible access to his lectures, clear exam prep, manageable essays, and a generous grading policy. Take his class if you can.
Take this class. You learn A LOT and it's not hard to get a good grade, he tells you exactly what you need to do. one of the best classes at UMD.
Best professor I've taken. Really cares about students and makes learning managable.
Dirk was an amazing prof. He cared about his students despite it being an online class. I knew he would always be available and his grading was always very clear. I would definitely recommend him!

Prof. Parham is amazing! While I only had him for online winter semester, I could tell he cares a lot about his students, and his lectures are so interesting. I feel like I learned so much even just in three weeks! I would highly recommend him, he is such a chill, nice, and interesting guy.

Professor Parham was one of the best professors I have ever had! He truly wants his students to learn and succeed and I learned a lot from his class. I love how he took the time to meet with me and review assignments and how he would inquire on how we are doing. If you are privileged to get the chance to take a class with Professor Parham do it!

If you want a sign to take Psych with Parham this is it. Honestly one of the most genuine professors I have ever had and I truly mean it. Workload is not even crazy IF you time manage assignments and plan ahead of time. DONTTT wait till last minute for the essays because those can take time. Overall great class.
100% would take again

Professor Parham's lectures are so interesting that they're actually fun. He's extremely forgiving about accepting late work. His exams are always open note, and he holds review sessions to make sure you know exactly what to expect. His essays are time consuming but straightforward. Just make sure you get your research requirement done early.

Professor Parham is by far my favorite professor that I have taken at UMD so far. He really cares about his students and is so obviously excited to teach everyone about psychology. His class is so manageable and also really interesting. Also the class was on zoom and all online which is also a plus. Definitely recommend!!!!

I took this class as a freshman and enjoyed Professor Parham so much that I volunteered to be a TA for him this winter. He is the most kind, caring, and patient professor you will EVER have, guaranteed. He truly cares about his students and goes out of his way to make lectures interesting, engaging, and digestible. Absolutely the greatest!
- Kolbie

This professor and class is a breath of fresh air within a busy semester. The content is interesting and the professor is very easygoing. He expresses confidence in his students and encourages students to reach out for anything they might need. The professor is an amazing person and a good grade can be achieved as long as you keep up with lectures!

Although I had already taken a psychology course in high school, Professor Parham kept me engaged during class and had me excited to relearn different concepts. We used an online textbook and the content from our worksheets came directly from the textbook. Overall, Professor Parham is amazing and I highly recommend being in his class if possible.

AMAZING! He is very caring, very understanding and sweet. tells you what you need to know for tests, gives extra credit and lets you submit late assignments till the end of the semester which he only takes half a letter grade for! Class required some effort but as long as you listen in class, skim the textbook before the quizzes you'll be just fine

Professor Parham is awesome. His class is super easy if you keep up with the work and have a good TA (the TAs grade all the papers). The lectures aren't mandatory because he records all of them but I recommended attending simply because the guy is so interesting and he genuinely cares about your success in the course.

I think that Professor Parham was great. I took an online class with him and he was very caring and a nice professor. His lectures were interesting and I was often engaged. He takes late work but of course try to get everything in on time if you can so it does not overwhelm you at the end.

Professor Parham is one of my favorite professors I have had at UMD. He is so caring towards his students understanding the material and excelling in the course. His lectures were very interesting and he was able to get all of the class involved in participating, even when we had classes over zoom.
Had him for a summer psych 100 class, will say this class is very fun and enjoyable. I learned a lot and hope to have him again in the future. There were some short papers and quizzes/exams.

One of the best professors at UMD. Highly recommend you see his lectures. He is incredibly caring and reviews exactly what to expect on your exams. He is easy going and if you need help or have any trouble, please reach out to him and he will work with you. You can tell he cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed! 100% recommend!

Professor Parham is such an amazing, easygoing, and understanding instructor. He goes beyond helping students and is always caring. His class is made so easy and he literally reviews things that will actually be on the test. He is more of a friend than an instructor and does a great job at teaching this class. 110 % recommend him.

Professor Parham is so amazing! By far my favorite professor at UMD. Even though my class was online, he made an effort to get to know us & was always accessible after class. His class is not designed to trick you he wants everyone to succeed and gives you the chance to get an A if you put the effort in. Such a caring man, he always made class fun!

Took online. Received an A. Work was manageable. Did all assignments the best I could and extra credit to get my grade. No textbook. Reviews are helpful! Very humorous and caring. Reach out if there is needed help. Very understanding. Class was very engaging and interesting. He was great. Would take again. Do your best and you wont stress. :)

He is really considerate of his students. If you communicate with him, he will work with you. He teaches the material in such clear ways. Amazing. Your essays will be graded by the TAs and their corrections are sometimes unclear. Other than that, great class!

I took this class to fulfill a GenEd requirement and it was the best decision. Parham is very caring for his students and is one of the rare professors that is always keeping students up to date while being accessible and flexible outside of the classroom. The work is reasonable and easy if you follow the rubric and he is always willing to extend.
If you ever have an option to take his classes, I would highly recommend to take it, as you will learn a lot and actually get a good grade! The best professor I have ever taken!!!!

Professor Parham is one of the BEST professors you will ever have. I absolutely loved his class and his lectures. He makes sure to make everything you learn relatable to your life, breaks down concepts that may be confusing, is super fun & engaging, and is always available to help students and clarify information during lecture, via email, or OH.

Professor Parham is a real gem. He is very personable and understanding. His lectures are always very well done and the workload is manageable. He is very easy to reach, and you can tell he genuinely loves his students and the material. Would definitely recommend.

Professor Parham is literally one of the nicest and most helpful professors ever. Even though it was an online class, he made it so enjoyable and fun. definitely take him if you have the opportunity, he genuinely wants everyone to succeed which is a lot more than I can say for most of my professors

Weekly quizzes on elms based off textbook chapters (2 attempts given). Every now and then, small learning checks or 1-2 page essays (not too bad). He is very kind and will give you an extension on pretty much any assignment. He sincerely cares about his students. Cannot say enough good things. Responds to emails fast & knows his stuff. TAKE HIM!!!!

There's a ton of great reviews here already so I'll save your time. Take him. Such a genuine, funny dude who actually cares about his students. Makes challenging material easy to absorb and remember. Almost always interesting and engaging lectures. He practically goes over the entire exam the class before the exam. Best professor I've had so far.

I can't speak enough about how much I love Dr. Parham. He's so funny and genuine, a really good lecturer, and I genuinely enjoyed logging on Zoom to listen to him talk. He's a very accessible professor and encourages his students to contact him, and is very helpful and understanding when the situation demands it. He's fantastic I highly recommend.

Professor Parham is the best professor that I have had so far at UMD: 5/5 is not enough. He is very flexible and cares about our learning and understanding of the material opposed to just getting a check from the school. The class is lecture-based, but it is super interesting. The work is very manageable and he gives ample time to do it.
Prof. Parham is one of the best professors I've had at umd. The course material is interesting and definitely not overwhelming. This class is truly worth it.
All i am going to say is, TAKE HIS CLASS. you wont regret it
This is the best professor I have had so far at Maryland. He is an easy going teacher that is understanding towards his students. Gives really good lectures and barely gives out homework.

Mr Parham is one of the only teachers ive had that doesnt care about the grade more so then he cares about you leaving with good information. All the work he gives are super easy and you can do the work way ahead of time if you feel like it. Hes truly a one of a kind teacher
the best.

The nicest professor i've ever taken. He's really good at explaining things, and is really patient if you have a lot of questions. He definitely cares a lot about his students and is just a very entertaining lecturer.

He's a good lecturer and very flexible. If you attend his review session and study a little you'll do fine on the midterm and final. There's a few papers you'll need to do which are manageable. The textbook is technically needed for the class and it's definitely helpful but I didn't find myself using it that much besides studying for the final.
amazing professor !!! he will literally help u bring your grade up at the end of the semester in any way possible. he really cares about his students learning and performing well

Professor Parham is one of the best professors in the Psychology department. He truly cares for his students and you really can't fail unless you don't do anything at all. Very easy class 10/10 recommend for anyone who wants to take it with him
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I would 100% take Professor Parham again! He is super nice and understanding. There are a few paper assignments but he is so easy to talk to about them if you have questions. He allows you to redo an assignment if you are unhappy with your grade and if you need an extension, just ask! His class was so fun to attend! Take his classes!!
Professor Parham is one of the most personable professors I've ever had. He cares so much about his students. I wish he taught more classes at UMD

Amazing professor. If I could take more of his classes I 100% would. He's a great lecturer and a very interesting person overall. His assignments are clear and the grading is fair. He is very understanding and makes a real effort to connect with his students. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Literally one of the best professors I have had. So understanding, will let you make up anything and make sure you get the best grade that you can get. You can tell that he truly cares about his students.

Professor Parham is super understanding and overall a great professor to have in college. He simply wants his students to learn: that's why he has test review (where he goes over the whole test) and negotiable deadlines (not really due at 11:59). He won't give extra credit, but he will provide you with the most opportunities possible to get an A.

Very open and easy to talk to him. He cares and believes in you to succeed in his course and he proves it through lots of encouragement. He wants you to learn so the workload is pretty average (1 ch per week). He treats you like an equal and is very social and welcoming! Outstanding professor. He makes it feel very open and safe to ask questions.

Overall great professor. Really cares about students. The class generally follows the textbook. He only tests on what's covered in lecture, but you do need to at least skim the chapter for the chapter quizzes (which are easy). He's responsive and helpful and isn't afraid to get real. Review sessions basically tell you what's on the exam. Great guy

highly recommend i had him for both psyc100 and psyc221. If you do the work, the class is an easy A and there isn't much work. He is very caring and understanding to his students and genuinely wants them to succeed. 10/10

Professor Parham was truly an amazing professor. His discussions were always fun and he found ways to interact with and connect with students over zoom. There are a lot of short papers but as long as you answer the prompt, you should get an A. I definitely want to take one of his classes again at umd.
Prof Parham was an amazing Psyc100 Prof! He really cared about the students and made sure the class was challenging but not too difficult. Also he just an amazing guy and can really relate to anyone!

Professor Parham is such a great professor. He really cares about his students and their success and is willing to always help. There are papers pretty often but they're really short and his grading is not tough at all and he always accepts late work. With Fall 2020 being online, he was very understanding about these crazy times. I recommend him.

best professor ever!!! srsly so nice and really wants ppl to do well. Accepts late work and does extra credit. He really loves what he teaches and cares abt students so much :) its actually rly nice to see. I am really 100% serious when I say that I wish he could teach all my classes! his exam reviews are just like the real thing n straightforward

Even though I had Professor Parham during the Spring 2020 semester, I really enjoyed being in his class. He's very well educated and I learned so much from him that I really didn't think I would. He lays out exactly what he wants on papers, his class is about learning, not testing. A funny guy as well hope I can take him again.
such a fun class with him hes great

Professor Parham was a solid choice. His lectures were sometimes not organized great, but he was a fantastic teacher. Attendance wasnt mandatory on Tuesdays, but I would go because I genuinely had fun in his class. Assignments arent too difficult and hes VERY lenient in all aspects.
Professor Parham is an amazing teacher! He really does care about his students and wants them to succeed. Please take his classes!!!

Professor Parham is by far one of the best teachers I have ever had. He adds a personal touch to his class and engages students which makes learning material easier. His classes are lecture heavy but not boring.

interesting lectures. Kind of a quirky guy but I think that made for a better class. Made concepts applicable and easy to understand. As long as you pay the slightest bit of attention, you should be fine.

Professor Parham is very approachable and is one of the kindest professors I've ever had. You can also tell that he is really interested in the subject matter and is knowledgeable on it. He actually cares about students and wants them to pass. Would definitely take him again!
Great Professor!! His lectures were always interesting and easy to understand. Tests were really easy and barely had work for the class.

Parham cares very much about both keeping his students interested in the material and ensuring that the course is fair. Lectures are recorded and put on Canvas, along with ppt. If more than 50% of the class misses a problem on a test, he drops the question. All papers have a clear-cut rubric, and are graded decently quickly.

Professor Parham is one of my favorite professors at UMD. He really helps students succeed in his class. Exam review is very helpful. Textbook only necessary for online timed quizzes. Attendance isn't mandatory as he records his lectures and puts them as well as the slides online. Highly recommend him!

GREAT TEACHER. He truly cares about his students, if you have any questions at all he would help you. There were more papers than I hoped, but as long as you follow what he suggests, you should be fine. Sometimes lectures were boring but definitely not something to stress over

Professor Parham has been my favorite professor at UMD so far. He really cares about the success of his students, and he just wants to make sure that you learn. Quizzes are not too difficult, and he prepares his students well for the two exams. Attendance is not mandatory, but show up anyway because he is a thorough and hilarious lecturer. 10/10!
amazing professor! he cares a lot and is really lenient and understanding. please take him, you will not regret it. exams and quizzes are simple.
AMAZING professor!!!!!

Professor Parham is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is extremly caring and applies what is going on in society today, to our lessons. This class taught me so much academically and provided me with a lot of knowledge that I can apply to my life.

Professor Parham is such a great professor! I had him for social psychology and he cared about you understanding the information and being able to apply what you learn to the real world. For his papers you can go to office hours and he will tell you what you need to fix. He is fair teacher and grader. Highly recommend.

As long as you attend Prof. Parham's class, you will do absolutely fine. He is super nice and tries hard to be engaging. He genuinely wants his students to learn and be better people. He was always willing to work with accommodations and help outside of class. He doesn't test you on anything he hasn't mentioned in class, so show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I had to miss 6 weeks of class and he worked with me. The only grades youll receive are on a few 500 word essays and a 1500 word essay, and on 2 exams. And on attendance but hes lenient about that. If you go to lectures you should be fine. Read the book as a supplement, but the lectures cover all, and are all online. Definitely take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Prof Parham is a really nice guy and truly wants to help his students learn something. His lectures do contain a lot of information but he will mostly tell you what to expect on an exam. He is a caring professor, will help you to the best of his ability and tries to make the lectures as interesting as possible.

He is a very inspirational teacher that just wants his students to become better people. His lectures may be long sometimes but in general he applies psych to daily life which is something appreciated

Prof. Parham was a really great guy who loves to teach and to get to know his students. He cares a lot about your learning experience, so he would give you every opportunity to learn the best you can (i.e. office hours, after class, review session, quizzes, extra credit essay). As long as you have good work ethic, HE WILL HELP YOU!!!

Prof. Parham is honestly hilarious and personable but this class is just awful. It's like learning one course and taking the exam for another. The tests are hard, but by the end, you will know basically the whole brain and it's functions. He was such a good professor, one of the only ones I've liked at Maryland, and his stories are so funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He's awesome and the nicest guy. He tells us all the time that he's not a biologist, so he doesn't know the answer to every question that may be asked but he knows more than enough for the course material. The exams are death, but he doesn't make them, and he tries his best to communicate what will be on there. He's very easy going and approachable

He's a great guy and a great lecturer all around, but this is a very difficult class as it is and his power points simple are not helpful at all. He'll be on the same slide of just a picture or diagram up for 10 minutes and just lecture orally. If you dose off for 2 seconds, you miss really important things that need to be jotted down.

Micheal is an amazing teacher. Lecture attendance is graded. There is a large online component that includes 3-5 quizzes a week and assessments.  Usually quizzes take >1 hour weekly. There are some miscommunications that occur on assignments (which are unstructured), but he gives food feedback and is very approachable for questions and help.

I loved this class and thought Professor Dunham did a great job moving everything online and keeping the class engaging. I didn't use the textbook at all, so I wouldn't worry about having to rent it, but you do have to practice some on your own outside of class or you may not be able to keep up with the signs. He is a pretty lenient grader though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Class goes faster than I expected; we're supposed to memorize entire alphabet by 2nd class. Lenient grader, but final group project was difficult and unstructured. Requires lots of patience and focus during every single minute of class time. Professor often doesn't understand what we're asking and is poor with emails. Hard to study for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: What a great guy. You'd be crazy not to take his class

Im currently suffering in this class. His lectures are not very structured and they barely go over what we should really know for quizzes and hw, he makes mistakes during his lectures & I dont blame him, but as someone who has trouble grasping the math in this course, I have to do 99% self teaching at this point for concepts I hardly know.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a great guy and will answer any question you ask. I didn't like how the textbook was so awful (like a pdf from mathworks). He recommended we look for "other resources" for the class.  His lectures don't really give any examples of problems and can get boring. He will curve though which is helpful towards your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Fantastic teacher!

Dr. Dunning's class was one of the easiest classes I took this semester. There were three speeches, an introduce-yourself talk, and final project, plus a few open-book online quizzes on Canvas. I found all of the assignments pretty easy, and Dr. Dunning was readily accessible via office hours (and a great sounding board for the speeches.)
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's very energetic and his stories/examples are funny. Each week you have to read a chapter or two and participate in class activities. Warning the class activities require you to speak in front of the class. He spins a wheel with names and it can be very anxiety inducing. You only have three speeches. But if off by like a minute you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: There are much easier comm classes than this one. Comm is supposed to be an easy class and he is the only teacher that gives really hard pop quizzes bringing everyone's grades down. I recommend taking an easier class and not dealing with his BS.

Dr. Dunning was a fun professor! His lectures were engaging and he was a lenient grader for our speeches. We would have to read the textbook and he would quiz us on the readings the next class, but they were all very basic and completely understandable. We would also have class activities once a week which was always fun, interactive, and social.

I had a great time in his class! Despite being online, Professor Dunning was still able to teach the material well and actually keep the class engaged. The only thing to note is that there are short quizzes on every chapter of the textbook, so don't skip a reading.

Dr. Dunning is a really chill professor. He's laid back, a little funny, and seemed to adapt well to online learning. There isn't much work in the class, but you do have to read the textbook, or at least skim it, as there are pop quizzes based on the reading. If you have to take an FSOC class(which you do), I wouldn't tell anyone not to take him.

Dr. Dunning is one cool cat! He makes class super fun and is an easy grader for speeches so as long as you prepare a little bit ahead of time you will get an A. The pop quizzes he gives brought my grade down, but if you study for the midterm and final, you should be good!

Take INAG110 with Dunning. You won't regret it. He grades VERY leniently (lowest grade on our last speech was 122/125). He gives pop quizzes, but they're easy if you read the book. His class is REALLY fun (most of the class is games and activities) and he's a hilarious person. He curves at the end (my 91 got me an A). He's the best for INAG110!

The class claims to be designed for students with no prior experience in programming but the class goes through material at a breakneck pace where you learn most of what you would learn in a high school class in about 2-3 weeks. Not a fan of profs who expect so much work outside of class when most of my free time is already used up on other work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very good guy. Cares a lot about his students and knows the material he teaches very well. the class itself can be pretty time consuming and difficult depending on your programming experience. Id recommend reading the textbook. Its tedious, but made me aware of features of C that were really helpful for projects. Start the projects early!!!!!!!

This is NOT a 2 credit class. Get ready for three projects that have incredibly vague instructions and take >40 hours each. Yes, there is unrelated homework due while you're working on projects, and no, he does not teach. Friend, please take any other course.

Dr. Durand is awesome, highly recommend! She puts together very engaging and easy to follow lectures/slideshows. Lots of time for discussions and student comments, so be ready to talk in class. Also, goes above and beyond by providing constructive and comprehensive feedback on most draft work, which is great. Always available by email as well.
nice enough, young prof so she's big into using big words, but the actual course content isn't too difficult. heavily discussion based.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Honestly have no idea what I learned in this class. She was never good at explaining assignments and often made them a lot more confusing when needed to. Expect a final project (worth 300 points) and a final exam (100 points) all due the last week of class on top of your other classes. You also read a lot and even small readings mean a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Make sure to participate in this class - it counts for part of your grade. She answers emails very quickly so try to make a relationship and show you care about your work by contacting her with questions. Her class is not difficult but she does include some pop-quizzes that can boost (or drop) your grade. She is super sweet and cares about you.

Professor Durand is a really good teacher. My writing has definitely improved in her English 101 class. This class isn't an easy A, but if you put the work in, make use of office hours, and show that you're putting up effort, you'll be just fine.

I highly recommend taking one of Ms. Durand's classes- especially if you are into literature. She is clearly passionate about English and is great at making you feel engaged and your opinions and comments valued. I loved the books she chose and, although it is a lot of reading, really appreciated the discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: She really is a nice lad and you can tell that she is passionate about english. This class is just too much work for a simple gen-ed compared to others. I felt like she decided what range of grades each student was most likely going to get in the beginning of the course and didn't deviate. I could never break a 90 no matter how hard i worked.

This class was meant to be taken for easy gen ed credits. Found out the class was much harder than I thought. No one ever got a perfect grade on a single assignment for the entire semester. Unless you are an English major don't take this course. This class requires the reading of around 5 novels over the semester--very time-consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very good overall. You get the grade you work for as she is a fair grader. She is a smart, funny, and intelligent professor who cares about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: this class isn't that hard it just throws a lot of concepts at you. duncanson is an okay lecturer but i think it becomes very clear which areas she's more knowledgeable about. she's very clearly worried about climate change, which yeah, me too, but it's 9:30 am and I don't need to be sad all day bestie.

Prof. Duncanson was awesome, especially during an all-virtual class. The lectures were very informative and the exams were not terribly difficult, but you have to show up. She held weekly discussion sessions as one of the lectures which were awesome to earn bonus points (Kahoot!) and get clarification.

She cares about her students and teaches very well. Weekly video quizzes which are pretty easy. The midterm was a bit too challenging but if you follow along and study a bit more you should be fine. If you take the labs with it, the labs are more challenging than the actual class which involved multiple choice questions and short essays each week.
Duncanson is engaging and clearly explains the material during lecture. If you're good at memorization this class will be a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The fall 2019 semester was Lauras first time teaching a college course and it clearly showed. Her lectures were always boring and she would go into detail about things that would never show up on the test, and skip over the material that is on the test and tell us to learn it on our own. The class itself is very interesting, but she is not.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is super sweet and very welcome and her lectures are always really interesting. She is really good at explaining concepts.
Dr. Dyer was great! Her emails made my day and make sure to go to class she gives pop quizzes. I really enjoyed this class although the content moves fast so make sure you keep up.

Dyer was the fairest prof I've ever had - her exams were all based on lectures, and her lectures are perfectly clear/easy to follow. She's also super sweet and sends out the best announcements, plus she cares about her students a lot. Don't expect special treatment - you get the grade you earn, but not a difficult class.

Dr. Dyer is an amazing person. She's understanding of what you may be going through, but keep in mind that this class shouldn't be completely ignored and you still need to put effort in showing up. If you go to the lectures and discussions and do the work on time, then you'll do well in the class. Studying is not bad, and the exams are fair.

Dr. Dyer is relatable, and the course load wasn't too bad. She does do random participation points in class sometimes. The exams are in person on paper and not open note, which was different from all the rest of the course work which was done online. Overall not too bad of a class but need to study to do well on the exams

Average prof. Not an easy A but doable with enough studying and effort. Discussion isn't mandatory but definitely recommend going. Exams are fair but were taken in person and on lockdown, so can't rely on notes at all BUT material came from lecture so just study hard and you'll do fine.

She made her lectures extremely useless and read off slides, adding no new information. She sent multiple nasty emails to all of her students when only some students would ask for an extension, pushing back exams, etc... She also changed the way her exams work, as they are no longer open note. Not the best professor.

Good professor but teaches too fast; gave pop quizzes even though people were out sick; sent inspiring emails but sometimes they (prof/TA) wouldn't respond to you; was "somewhat" understanding to life circumstances; homework assignments can be tricky; don't expect your grade to be rounded up even if it's by a few decimals; an okay professor

Such an amazing professor! Very accessible and friendly inside and outside of class. Exams are taken online but are quite difficult (as expected). Other homework assignments were straight-forward. You definitely need to go to discussion sections as I found they were the most helpful and they pay attention to attendance. Overall such a great class!
Listen to the other reviews and take her!! Shes an amazing teacher and she is also very funny. I would 100% take her again.

Professor Dyer is one of the best teachers I've had at UMD. She is an amazing lecturer who truly cares for her students and wants them to succeed. The course is definitely manageable in terms of homework and exams and I would be happy to take another class taught by her.

way too tough grade for the class. also pretty unfair grading system... you are graded based on discussions where if someone repiles, you must reply to all of them. so one student could only get one reply to address, and another could get 3 students to address. group project was pointless especially if you have people who don't pitch in.

I took her at Montgomery College-Germantown. She was as clear in what she taught. But to get a better understanding you had to read the power points. I never used the book, but always had my lab manual. Lectures were kind of boring, but lab was always interesting.
She sux!! shes the worst ever...so rude and sarcastice.Doesnt even teach right and expects u know everything...Would NEVER take her class!!!

Overall, Ebrahimian was one of the most thorough and clear professors that I have had in the UMD sciences. Her exams are all multiple choice, but they are not easy.  She really wants to make every student LEARN the material not just memorize it and I think that out of all my professors at MD she has succeeded the most.

I liked having Eckstein as a professor, overall. His lectures can sometimes be pretty boring, and he doesn't have a powerpoint, so there's no material online. I liked the class and thought he had some pretty interesting anecdotes, so overall I would recommend him, because I did feel like I really learned the material and was ready for the papers.
Cares about students; can be difficult to follow at times, and a bit of stickler on papers.
Eckstein is a wonderful professor. Speak with him one-on-one, he really cares about his students.
Dr. Eckstein is a great professor, he keeps you interested throughout the entire course and ensures comprehension throughout by asking engaging questions.
A preachy, condescending, bitter old man.  He might be brilliant, but the price of admission to that knowledge is far too high.  Stay away.

Dr. Eckstein is a brilliant man! His lectures can sometimes get a little boring, but he's always quite enthusiastic and is very good at relating his lessons to things going on in modern day. The TAs grade kind of hard, and there are 4 papers to write, but only 4-5 pages. Overall, good class.

Eckstein can be a little boring for lectures, but if you can stay awake he does a good job of engraving the information in your mind. Just go to lecture and listen, as he repeats the information in the readings in lecture. It is pretty easy to understand the material and get a good grade.

Extremely boring lecturer. Preachy. So much to memorize! Female TA really sucks, she was completely uninteresting and she seemed more interested in passing her PhD exams then helping our discussion group pass the class. AVOID ECKSTEIN if you're looking for an easy history credit!
He makes class incredibly interesting.  It's so much fun!  Very fair too.

He is a great teacher although i did not like him too much when he kept postponing the midterm and once he couldnt push it back anymore he made it a take home. But i did very well in this class and the TA's are awesome. truly a great class!!
a great proffesor. class isnt very difficult. ta's are very helpful. the dr. is very intelligent. great class choice.

Dr. Eckstein is extremely intelligent and makes lectures interesting. He has been on pbs specials for what he teaches in class, and is hired to speak on many occasions. all you have to do is go to discussion and they go over everything you need to know. reading is a good idea to get an A.

pretty hard class. There is a midterm, a paper and the final. The tas grade very hard on the papers. Eckstein is a good lecturer but the class covers alot of stuff and the midterm and paper aren't that easy. Also the female TA we had made it almost impossible to get anything higher than a C.

Dr. Eckstein is a funny older man. His lectures are interesting. The class is good, but I have to warn you, it is difficult. There is only one paper, midterm, a final, and discussion participation for your grade. The TA's grade difficult too.
Great teacher. Just take her, no questions asked. Very sweet. She enjoys it when you participate a lot, but if you don't, you still do perfectly fine (A).

Best Spanish teacher I've had thus far-- really nice and super helpful. The class is entirely in Spanish, but if you don't understand something, she's happy to go over it. Do the readings and the homework and you'll be fine in her class. She loves students who participate. The exams are hard, but she's not the one who writes them.
She is the best professor I've ever had.
Alejandra is great, very approachable and keeps her classes lighthearted and interesting.

Dr. Orehek is a really strong professor. His lectures were inspiring and full of interesting information that draws you in. His tests cover information from the lectures, ted talks, and the textbook so be sure to read over the chapters. His study guides are a little overwhelming because he legit puts everything on them, and yet tests you on half.
His tests and his lectures did not match up at all. He was easy to understand in lecture but when it came time for the test, they were impossible no matter how much I studied.

it's an extremely interesting class and he does a great job of portraying that. i had hour and a half lectures with him that went by in minutes because they were so interesting. he just takes FOREVER to get grades back and isn't in any rush to get them to you. only 3 tests and 2 one-page papers, an easy class i'd definitely take again.
I had the biggest crush on Ed! He is a great professor, interesting lectures, easy tests, funny, sarcastic, and cute!

Overall nice guy, and an interesting lecturer.  uses good examples and makes it realistic to college students.  He is horrible at returning papers.  Turned a paper in early October and it's almost finals I still don't know where I stand. REALLY annoying, but overall i liked the class

His exams are EXTREMELY fair. He offers a review sheet, it seems like a lot of material, and it is, but it is very helpful. While most younger professors lack experience and ruin students GPAs, he is fair and honest. He offsets the damage done by people like Tamara Walden, who shouldn't be near a classroom.

Edward Orehek is the best teacher on this campus. All others need bow before his presence. Great lecturer, nice guy, lot's of extra credit, "extremely" fair tests, and nice workload. There are professors like him out there to offset the harm done by teachers like Capo.

If you come to class, you will only need to look at the textbook for the key words for the test that he lists in his review sheet. He is really nice and can meet with students for clarification of anything.
No Comments
I learned a lot but not sure how my grade will fare out.

No this class is not easy. And YES, you MUST read the textbook. But it is a manageable class if you attend, read the book and work hard. Fink can come off strong, but he really, really cares about his students and he is passionate about what he teaches.
Um. Rough class. As a teacher he is decent/ good, as a person, not so much. He's really mean to his students. He's just not a nice guy. Makes you feel stupid if you ask a question.
No Comments

I had to sing in a combined choir opportunity with him, and I swear for a course that requires full attendance I couldnt have gotten less out of this opportunity. An unprofessionally loud, arrogantly intense, and pompous leader, I couldve learned more about singing well in a choir by staring at frogs for four hours.

He is good at what he does, but students MUST only listen to specific musical feedback and ignore everything else. Dont ask him for a letter of recommendation, hes notorious for saying yes and not following through. Multiple students have been excluded from summer festivals that require a letter in order for the application to be completed.

If you catch him on a good day, he is great. That being said, he rarely has a good day. Nearly every rehearsal has him putting down a section and insinuating they are no good as musicians. It feels impossible to please him as the work load for this one credit class is insane. Performances also take place during mid terms and finals, hurting GPA.
He isn't afraid to call you out, so make sure you practice!
Love Dr. Maclary. The man is a choral magician.
