But if someone kept asking the *exact same* question over and over Fawzi would say, "We need to move on... Let's talk more after class."  Fawzi was awesome!

Terrible professor! Although, he preaches about the importance of asking questions, he does n't do a good job of answering them and often brushed me off when I would ask a question. Not everyone who takes his class is a Computer Science major, and he does n't care to explain the material. Don't take his class! Very rude!

Very respectable person who knows Java very well. He grades extremely fairly, but strictly. Some other instructors in this department give away grades for free to avoid conflict with students; I believe this is entirely unnecessary. Fawzi teaches you want you have to learn, and if you can't do it; he's doing you a favor by letting you know.

Fawzi was an excellent professor! The lectures were fun and easy to understand.  Graded materials were quite fair. The exams were very short and not that hard if you studied. Outside of class, Fawzi is approachable and easy to talk to. Someone else said that Fawzi didn't help them during office hours, but I find that very hard to believe!

Awesome professor, reasonable and friendly. Focused and directed during lectures, doesn't let himself get taken off track while simultaneously not stifling others. Projects were very clear, fair amount of time was given and they may have been perhaps even a bit too easy. All in all very happy and satisfied, look forward to being in class.

Exceptional teaching style. Does not rely on power points / slides. Gets across the material in an efficient and entertaining way. Never once had to open my textbook or ask a TA for help to get an A in this class. Just show up to every lecture and you will learn the material.

Excellent instructor, really enjoys teaching and does a good job.  Uses good examples and explains very well. Very accessible during office hours if any extra help is needed.  Tests are fair and generally well balanced (a natural 70 average, usually no curve necessary)
131 is really fun! Fawzi is a really good teacher and explains the material well.
Awesome teacher!
Awesome class!
Really good professor! Funny and he gets you into the subject really easily! Take any of his classes, I recommend! He actually got an award of best professor at UMD! =)
Fawzi is the reason I'm still a CS major. Hilarious, engaging, and very clear.  The only problem is the evil TAs.  Stay away from the evil TAs.  Fawzi is stupendous. TAKE THIS CLASS.

Fawzi is awesome.  His class isn't that difficult as long as you go to class and pay attention.  He covers everything you need to know for his exams during class and on a comprehensive list of review questions.  Fawzi explains everything very clearly and has no problem stating it in a different way so it's clear.  Highly recommended!!!!!!
Didn't actually have him as a teacher, but sat in on all his lectures while taking 132 because he was significantly better than the other prof.  Good at explaining things clearly.  A fun guy.

He is absolutley the funnest professor ever. You wont get tired in his class. He throws some jokes between the lecture materials so u dont get bored. His lectures are very elaborate and clear. He gives lots of examples so u get the concept very well. projects are challenging for people who does not have experience in programing.

Fawzi is an amazing professor that explains concepts clearly and always informs you of what you should know for upcoming exams.  Exams and quizzs can be tough.  Live by his study questions - they help out tremendously.  Nice guy, but don't bother him with debugging.  That's what the TAs are for.  Does not curve exams and didn't curve final grade.
Avoid this class unless you have some programming knowledge. Not for novices. His personality is either you really like him or you dont. The ta taught me more than he did. Book was a waste of money.

One of the most owesome teachers ever.  If you already know java, the class should be a breeze, but the projects will be a bit of a challenge.  Don't bother buying a textbook for his class even if you don't know any java.  You can always google for a java tutorial.  Projects might be very hard for java novices--but very interesting.
funny teacher who starts off the class with random conversation

Fawzi is the best instructor I've ever had.  His explainationas are crystal clear - he has a knack for explaining difficult topics, particularly mathematical ones, in a way that the average person can understand.  Highly recommended for ANY course.

Fawzi is a very good instructor and cares about doing a good job.  His lectures are focused and professional, and he does a good job of making sure things don't get too boring.  The exams were fair and reasonable.  Overall one of the best CMSC instructors I've had at UMD.

Good Professor. The thing about him is that he loves lecturing while most other profs will give you slides. This is good for people who are audible, i on the other hand was a visual person and didnt start catching on until i started looking at his notes from past classes. USE HIS NOTES FROM THE PAST!

Fun professor, keeps you engaged during class. Tests and weekly quizzes are rather difficult. Projects are challenging but starting early on them is the best approach- that way you can visit Fawzi or your TA during office hours and resolve whatever problem you're having.

Friendly, knowledgable, and fun, Fawzi teaches a good class.  Tests and quizzes can be difficult. Not alwys clear what you're going to be tested on, but ONLY material covered in lecture is tested.  No "trivia" from obscure portions of the text book!  Projects are demanding, but interesting.  Great instructor!
Really nice guy..a bit goofy but a great prof. If you seek help, he is very helpful. Tests are hard but he prepares you as best he can.

I didn't actually have him...  I had the other 132 professor.  But that guy sucked so I sat in on Fawzi's lectures instead.  As soon as I started attending Fawzi's classes, my grade shot up from a low C to a high B.
Great teacher, friendly, answers questions clearly, makes sure everyone understands the material. An exemplary prof.
Good teacher, good examples
Very helpful and a great teacher.  I would totally recommend him
The tests aren't easy, but the teaching style is excellent.  He does his best to make Comp Sci fun while getting the necessary points across.

Tran uses the flipped classroom design and boasts about how great it is, but it did not work and was a waste of time going to class. Everyone was always confused and lost. Exams had errors, questions were random and hard + everyone had different test questions. Dr. Tran did not care about teaching us, used prerecorded videos from over 3 years ago.

For a biology course this class is one of the easier ones. There is a zoom option for every lecture so in person attendance is not required. Worst part is how assignment heavy it is. If you are in a difficult major, this class will get VERY annoying as many of the assignments are pure busy work. If you put time into it you'll get an A.

Microbiology is a tough course, especially with the lab, but I felt as though Dr. Tran made it as simple as she could. I understood the material she presented, and the exams test the exact material that we covered in class. She does do clicker questions so be ready to attend class for points, but she is very sweet and accessible outside of class.

Dr. Tran is a great professor. I hated the lab, there is just so much group work and busy work. She is a tough grader and I prefer the TA's to grade instead. Her exams are pretty hard and the amount of work really gave me anxiety. If you are struggling, go see Dr. Tran.
Very clear and easy to understand lectures. Clicker participation points. Tests are pretty difficult but so many extra assignments to make up for that.

Tran isn't bad as a lecturer, but BSCI223 was infuriating. So many assignments that it was hard to keep track, at least 3-4 things due each week. Group work is a huge part of grade and stuck with same terrible group all semester. The final exam was way more complicated than it needed to be. I love microbiology, but this class structure was painful

Prof Tran is an awesome lecturer who explains stuff very clearly and reinforces past material in lectures. The lab class is interesting because you actually do a lot of different procedures, but the grading for lab sucks because you're stuck with the same group all semester ... Anyway, Prof Tran is very excited about her material and approachable.

This was Tran's first time teaching micro so the class is very similar to Buchner's. She's less interested in failing everyone like Buchner and more interested in us learning. Boring lectures but they're recorded. I don't recommend this class for 'fun' unless you enjoy incessant amounts of busy work. TONS of group work w/ same partners all semester

Her lectures are a little boring, but the material is straightforward and her exams are very fair. There are so many grading points besides the exams that if you work hard you can do good in the class. She does clickers in class but you can miss up to 7 and get full credit for clickers. Tran is very nice and is interested in what she teaches.
Dr. Tran is a good lecturer and takes time to answer questions during class. Exams are fair. Lab is a lot of work but if you have a good TA it will help.

Professor Tran was a good teacher. First year at UMD. She gives clickers every class but she allows you to miss 7 classes and still get full credit on the points. There are written assignments every week for completion, not accuracy. Exams are fair, average is usually 75. Lab has HW every week and with the same group all semester.
Strong speaker and lecturer. Very enjoyable and interesting class with lenient grading.

He restructured his class so NO multiple choice anymore. All short answer, so don't expect to guess and get a good grade. Only 5 questions on each exam, around 10 on the final. Easy if you've studied the review guides. Do the sample problems and study the homework, and this should be a well earned A!

Material really wasn't that hard, but the exams were short (5 questions each) so if you messed up a question, you lose a large part of your grade (almost no partial credit). Go to class, he doesn't post lectures. But there's a large curve at the end (upwards of 10%) and he's pretty good at explaining the material.

The class was minimal work (2 hw questions a week), but that definitely means don't slack. The tests were also 5 questions and he's a very fair grader. It's not anything harder than some basic calc, and the final were questions on our practice problems sheet with the numbers changed. Really can't complain, but know that you're kinda on your own

Easy material somehow made difficult with strange notations and phrasing on the problem sets. On every exam: e. non of the above ON EVERY DAMNED QUESTION. My man gave the largest curve I've ever seen though. A good 10-12% curve. lecture hall in the Armory SUCKS!
Great teacher. Hard class.

Great professor! What I enjoyed most about his class is how easy he makes these concepts. He just tells you the easiest way to find optimal choice, for example. But for students who are fascinated by economics, he is fun to talk to after class. Also, textbook is not required! Good sense of humor, easy tests...

Solid class. use the homeworks to study for the first two tests. the final was ridiculously hard, so try to do well on the other tests and do the homeworks. Going to class isnt really necessary, but if you are struggling it can help. the ta's were not very helpful. most of the material in this class you've seen in calculus.
Excellent teaching skill
EXCELLENT !!!

Took this the first semester it was taught, Hulten taught the first half and Ozbay the second.  He is so much better! His lectures are very understandable and he makes the hard material so much easier, definately take 300 with him!
No Comments
No Comments

Even if this professor is the only open section for this course, do not sign up!!! Haag's tests make no freaking sense. He's only taught 170 three times and his exam averages are between 50-60%. And the course is exam heavy. He does not give extra credit. He doesn't curve exams. The TA's for the course have even stated these exams are too complex.

reviews.comment: nice guy but had super long lectures that were really hard to comprehend because the way he would explain things was as if you already knew what he was talking about lol and the book was no help either cause it was also extremely hard to grasp the information

I went to every in-person lecture (which averaged ~70 slides) and taught myself all the content. For someone who typically excels in AP level science courses, I ended up with a C after spending hours and weeks preparing for this class. The class average was below a 70 every exam and he did everything to avoid curving. Do not waste your energy.

Dr. Haag is very nice, and responds to emails quickly, sadly this is just a boring and laborious class. Lots of assignments, exams were on the harder side. However he is such a caring guy and would feel personally responsible if the class was not picking up on material. Very accommodating and understanding, study hard and you'll be okay.

Hes kind but not an effective professor by any means. He has a 40-50 slide PowerPoint for every single class and he never got through any of them. The exams were incredibly long and difficult for the 50 minutes we had to complete them and none of the units had any correlation to one another. Dr. Fletcher is by far the best option take him instead
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was a hot mess, still have no idea what the subject of this class was because one week we would learn about bones & the next week would learn about plants. This class truly is thee most frustrating class I have ever taken & i took orgo and got an A. 40 slide PowerPoints every class, & never got through any of them. Take Dr. fletcher instead!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Haag is a very nice professor and cares about the students, however the course itself is rigorous and lecture heavy with no real correlation. He is always willing to help students when you ask, however he does not provide any study guides so its difficult to know what you will be tested on, especially when there is so much content that is covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was a mess. He was constantly going over class time and rushing the main ideas in the last few minutes of class. Exams were very difficult even while studying ahead of time. I heard great things about other professor teaching 207 so wish I would've taken them instead.

Dr. Haag is a great professor but this class is kind of all over the place. There were 4 units and each one was so ridiculously different from the other. He was really willing to help and also gave lots of low-stakes assignments/assignments that were graded for completion. Also, be prepared for a group assignment about once a week (for completion).

I can't really give Dr Haag a bad review bc he does the best he can with this terrible course. The course is unorganized, the material covered is all over the place. It's like they took anything not covered in 161/171 and shoved it in this course. Avoid this course. That being said if you need to take it, Haag is caring and does the best he can.

Really solid professor, he makes sure to put in the effort so that you understand the material. As long as you put in the work you'll do great. He also has a lot of 'fluff' assignments where it's graded for completion, which really takes the stress off doing it and lets you focus on actually learning the material. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is the best honors seminar. Do the readings, write a response, and participate in class. Eric is straightforward and forgiving. There's only two short projects, no tests, no other work. I can't recommend this class highly enough.

He's a funny guy and tried to make his lectures interesting even if the topics weren't always great. His tests weren't too difficult (if you're taking the joint class with Professor Carleton, Haag's tests are notably easier than hers). He's very helpful in office hours however he sometimes goes into excessive detail answering simple questions.

Professor Haag is a really, really, really nice professor. However, it is unfortunate that he is teaching BSCI207, which is one of the worst biology classes ever. He tries to the best of his ability to make the class engaging and palatable. If you really read the slides and make connections you can get by. Terrible class, but great professor.

Great at teaching and has decent power points and examples. Class overall isn't bad, but math in bio initiative is awful, and is a significant chunk of each test, taking the spot of many of the more traditional long answer questions.I understand the ideas, but having to know what z is in a cell membrane flux equation is too much for an intro class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Haag is a great teacher. He is very passionate about what he teaches, and works to make the concepts understandable.

reviews.comment: He is a great guy and a great professor. Reduces the depth of material that you go in, which makes studying easier. Also gives you hints about what is going to be on the exams. Recommend him over any of the other BSCI professors that I have taken

This course was fairly difficult but Dr. Haag explained the material to the best of his ability. However, it sometimes felt like too many topics that did not correlate were being covered, but overall, I would recommend taking this class with Dr. Haag. He was always willing to help his students and answer any questions.
Good and interesting lecturer. The class is pretty hard, but he let us take our top 3 out of 4 exams or just our final for our final grade. Very accessible and a likable nerdy guy.

Go to class. It's three hours on Friday but you will learn more in this class than you'll ever imagine. Go to class (especially the first 8 weeks) and learn all the technical and fundamental aspects he teaches... The TAs grade a little harshly but this class is worth taking 10/10 times simply because of the skills you learn, and not for the grade.

reviews.comment: probably the only professor at umd that has taught me anything valuable

reviews.comment: If you have 0 interest in stocks this class isn't for you. He's very passionate about what he teaches but I was often confused. He locks your grade until the very end so you don't stress about homework and quiz grades, because apparently the final project is the only thing that matters. Participate in the simulation or you're screwed.

Worst Professor I have ever had. Locks grades so you never know what you have until Xmas eve. He doesnt care fir his students. He says he does but then locks all the grades and gives a midterm/final that basically decide ur starting gpa as a freshman in freshman connection. I actually just submitted my transfer application due to this Professor.

Half the class drops the first few weeks and it's for a reason and I should have joined them. If you don't put in 100% effort into the class and question your sanity every week you probably aren't doing good in the class. All grades are locked so you really don't ever know what you have in the class either which is so annoying.

reviews.comment: The amount of reading we have to do in this class is so unnecessary and takes up half your week's worth of time. The final is an extremely long paper that you get only a week for and it was due before finals even started which was messed up. I was a better trader at the beginning of the semester rather than the end which doesn't add up.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class ruined my mental health. The first half of the semester is reading up to 300 pages a week and watching lots of videos in prep for weekly quizzes which are super hard. After that starts an individual trading simulation. I learned a lot but I don't think the stress was worth it and that this class is simply a pyramid scheme.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Wish is an exceptional professor. Ive never seen someone as passionate about a subject as he is. He wants nothing but success for his students and is teaching this course because he wants to share his knowledge and what made him successful. The class can be challenging and frustrating at times but is incredibly worth it. Take this class.

Dr. Wish has had the most impact on my life ever since I took this class. I took it in 2019 when we were still on Campus but ever since I have been able to use everything I learned in class in my life. Dr. Wish truly taught as an ideal professor and has no doubt earned the respect of countless individuals in the past. 100% A MUST Take Class.

Dr. Wish is a great lecturer and definitely cares and is passionate about what he is teaching. The first couple weeks are very heavy in readings and watching videos. The class is a great class to take to learn more about the stock market, but some assignments can be challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the best classes you could take at UMD, super applicable to real life and you learn financial literacy that isn't thought in your normal courses. The class is super front-loaded, expect to read close to 1,000 pages the first month but after the reading is done, the class is great and you get to paper-trade. Office hours are also amazing.
If you take this course, get ready to read a lot in this first few weeks. Definitely worth it. Its a tough class but curve makes it worth it. You learn so much.

reviews.comment: Amazing class, so much great information. The class is very front-loaded but gets so much better if you stick with it. Write a good final and you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lots of quizzes (open note) every single week, so thats a majority of your grade. But if you dont do so well on those, you can easily make up for it in the final paper. Lectures are great and necessary to go to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I knew nothing about the stock market before taking this class, and learned more than in any other that I've taken. It is VERY reading heavy in the beginning, but needed to gain knowledge for a trading simulation in second half. quiz at the start of every class but open notes and one major final portfolio at end makes up most of grade. Take this!

Highly recommend this class to anyone, even if you don't enjoy business. The class is front-loaded with work so after the first 6-8 weeks, you will have a lot less work. He makes you read a lot of books but as long as you get the key concepts your finds. All quizzes and tests are open notes. He goes over everything in the readings after the quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Would suggest this teacher to any student who wants to learn about the stock market. Class is one of a kind. Even if you do not plan on being a business major the material can be applied to anyone who takes his class. Though make sure to do the readings as they are essential for doing well on his weekly quiz. If you pay attention you get an A.

She is a very caring and passionate professor. I would definitely take her course because I remember feeling seen and engaged during her lectures. Her lecture style may be a little heavier than that of average classes; however, her digital check-ins to keep students engaged, such as low-pressure clickers, were very helpful. Lab's were a bit tough.

The professor does not give good feedback on assignments. She'll say "Review" and not explain why the answer is incorrect. She was not understanding at all, you could try your hardest but she does not take your attempts you have to follow her rubric to a T. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: While Dr. King-Marshall is sweet, the structure of this course is subpar. The constant group work became a nightmare when members of the group stopped showing up and didn't participate. The final project and presentation requires participation from all members and grading was completely unfair to the individuals that actually put in effort.
Exams come straight from lecture and participation matters both in lecture and discussion. Solid prof if you consistently attend.

I liked this class a lot. The lectures were pretty straightforward but you are not required to attend since it's recorded. Exams were 100% from lectures with application of vocab. Discussion was mandatory and we had a worksheet due each week. It would be no problem if you have good teammates. Dr. KM always gave feedback on worksheets or projects.

Exams were a little difficult at first but if you really try to learn the material then you'll do well. You definitely need to show up to discussion sections every week. Overall she's really nice and you can tell she cares about students but I wish her grading was more straight-forward as sometimes she takes off points for things not on the rubric
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor is totally disconnected from reality. She forced students to use honorlock during exams. Do not take her, she doesnt care about student.... heck she doesnt even care about public health.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: King's a solid choice. Taken online during covid. You have to attend discussion and participate so take a good class time. There's lectures uploaded asynchronously every week and participation reaction posts due every week so you have to watch the lectures. Tests can be difficult so make sure you know the material. Good class, interesting overall.

If you communicate with her she will help you, but she doesn't fully explain concepts to relate to the exam. Especially if you get something wrong. Exams are rough. Only meets with you during office hours which isn't helpful. Group project!! She yawns every two seconds forming a distraction, as if this would be appropriate in any setting .

Took this class over Summer online. Her exams are very straight forward, easy, no trick questions. The rubrics are very detailed, so take it to step by step and you'll do well. Final presentation and paper can be daunting at first, but the class works its way up to it, so trust me you'll be fine. She is an easy grader on it as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took this class over winter break and It was manageable, but I did get a few of points off for unnecessary things. The work was somewhat confusing without various emails with her back and forth for clarification. The material was easy (mostly common sense or repeat from sphl100) but her lectures were pretty irritating to listen to.

This teacher makes so many grammar mistakes on her slides that it is genuinely shocking. She has a PhD but mixes up "may be" and "maybe." Lecture has in-class attendance checks in the form of 1-2 point activities. My TA is really good and knows her stuff. Discussion is mandatory.

Make sure you come to class because she gives out participation points. Exams seem pretty chill but trips you up if you don't memorize and understand the key terms. Just the usual HLTH class that one would expect.

Lectures tended to be kind of dull and mostly reading off of slides, but she is pretty nice outside of class and helpful with answering questions after class. You have to go to class because of in-class participation activities, and make sure to really follow the rubric for assignments.

Honestly this class sucked. The tests are difficult. Lots of memorization. Hard grader. Projects sucked. First project wasnt explained well and even though I volunteered to present first, got lots of points off because I didnt understand the concept. Not even gonna go easy on me because I signed up for the first day to present? My grade is a B

A really good class. She posts her lecture notes after class so if you miss a class, you can still catch up on what happened. No laptops in class. Reaction Posts are due on Sunday nights. Lab is focused on creating an intervention which leads to a final presentation and paper. Give some effort and you will get a good grade.

FA22. Engaging, interesting, kind, fair, respectful, explains concepts well, has clear expectations. Some weeks are a little read heavy, but relevant. One of the only classes I've been in where the professor did not have to drag people to participate. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very engaging professor. Case study assignments are graded on completion but be prepared to participate on the material in class. I wish there was more feedback on those case assignment studies but other than that the professor was amazing. Took awhile to grade some assignments but was clear with grading throughout the course.
My favorite professor at UMD so far. Always finds ways to make class interesting and connect cases with relevant things students care about. 100% take him for 495

By far my favorite professor that I've taken at umd. Not only is he engaging and interesting to listen to during lectures, he puts hard data and statistics on his slides and provokes the class to draw conclusions for discussion. Go to class, stay engaged and the case analyses will be easy to navigate & you'll know what he's looking for. Take him!!!

Best professor. Seriously only take 495 with him. Super engaging lectures, really interesting guy. About 1-2 case analyses a week but not very difficult and mostly graded for completion. Work hard on the group project as its a big portion of your grade

BY FAR the BEST 495 professor you can take! Rather than just boring lectures, he engages the class very well and turns lectures into conversations. There is also cases and HW assignments, but they're easy. Also, you MUST participate and attend class, as each are graded. Finally, exams are case-based and not that hard. Definitely take him though!

Prof. Starr is very easy-going, not a hard grader. The class is fairly easy: case analyses, one final based on the cases, and a project. Attendance is not mandatory but a good part of your grade is participation so if you don't attend you will not get all points

Really interesting and easy class. If you attend and pay attention, you'll be fine. Lectures are engaging and he has fun stories to tell. Reviews for exams thoroughly went over content, and notes were posted online.
Hes easily one of the funniest professor's I've had and isnt intimidating at all. Talking to him before and after class is painless.
Absolutely amazing professor and an even better person. Love Professor Evans and I highly encourage you take his classes. Very easy A too!

Prof Evans knows a lot about Maryland politics. The exams were very easy as he practically covers half the test during the reviews. Group project is easy but be ready for tough questions. He's laidback and has serious (understandable) disdain for DT, his frequent digs at the guy are hilarious esp when M AGA students get upset.
Recommend this class for an easy A in policy, as long as you study for the tests.
He's lit. Take it.

I enjoyed this class! Professor Evans is kind, witty, and gets right to the point with his material. Attendance is mandatory but he always lets his classes out early. No textbook to purchase, no homework, no quizzes. A midterm, a final, and a project.THAT'S IT. Easy to pass if you just show up and pay attention during exams reviews.Take this class!
great guy and great teacher!!! the best!!!
Treats students like adults. exposed to great deal of info....if you want to learn..go for it...GREAT CLASS
Brilliant teacher..you'll love this guy.....funny and informative
Easy class. Ends at 3pm. Hilarious and easygoing but lacks teaching skills. Teaches the class for free, pro bono. Final exam easy, project relatively easy.
funny guy, so easy, he always ends class at 3pm, no work just final and an easy project. Wish there were more profs like him.
Evans is really cool and his class is ridiculously easy.  Just about everyone in the class gets As without putting in any effort.
the man..

best class i've taken so far. you'll most likely get an A if you put any type of effort into the class at all. he makes it so u actually want to learn and he keeps ur interest. fun class, great guy, and if u want to go into politics, good connect to keep..
Evans is a great teacher, fun, interesting and HOT!!! It was hard to focus seriously in class...
really knows his stuff

if you like getting A's take this guy. i took two of his classes and guess what,..... i got 2 A's. helped my gpa. u know???     the only hard thing about his class was that i could not talk to his hot daughter. she was taking the same class...
Great guy...very fun ..interesting

Erich's BGMT230 class is challenging but engaging. While the exams are tough, the lectures and discussion sections are helpful. Unstuck AI was a lifesaver for test prep. With dedication and the right study tools, you can succeed in this course.

If you have taken a stat class before, this will definitely be much easier for you. However, if you took AP Stat and mostly relied on your calculator, this is different as you do not use calculators at all in class, but you can on exams. Exams were pretty straightforward and curved generously. Discussion sections and homework are helpful.

If you are not good at math already this class is going to be hard.  He is an entertaining teacher and he has a big grade curve at the end of the class so as long as you pay attention and try, you will most likely pass. Just be ready to put the work in.

He's a very polarizing professor and I am not someone who jived well with him. I thought his behavior in lecture was obnoxious and a waste of time. His lectures would include extremely elementary examples, but his homework assignments and exams were very difficult. His practice exams are not helpful and do not apply to his actual exams
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Erich is not the professor you want in order to learn BMGT230. If you can take another professor, please do. Professor Erich is highly strict and the class is fully graded on exams and the exams are the most difficult ever. Professor Erich is not empathetic at all and is famous for failing students for the tiniest mistake they commit.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I did not like this professor at all. He was incredibly strict about his university policy and when I was experiencing an obstacle in my year he was less than accommodating. His grade curve barely had me passing. He tried to make his lectures fun but it just bothered me. He seems like a good guy but in my books wasn't a helpful professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he is such a rule follower. i personally disliked him as a teacher bc he went so fast in lectures and none of the material actually made real life sense- he just taught it. the material is very heavy and you must put in a lot of time to get a good grade in his class. you have to take him bc there are no other professors. worst class this semester

Great professor, amazing lectures, If you cant learn stats from erich then u prolly cant learn stats at all. Exams are not that bad they correlate homework and discussion sesh sheets. study like 2-3 hours a week and you'll do fine
This class is really hard, but the professor tries really hard to make it easier for everyone else. There is a curve at the end and all exams are open note.

Erich is a great professor and his lectures are really fun. He does a really good job of making sure everyone learns the material. However, his exams are open packet (notes) which means they're much more difficult.

Excellent professor who is super passionate about what he teaches. Class is entertaining and he explains things well. Exams are not too bad because they are open note. Don't skip class though because he gets through a lot of material each class.

Erich is a great, entertaining prof. That being said, his class is definitely not easy! Strive to get full points on the homework and section work because the exams are challenging. You will have to put in the work during lectures and outside of class to fully understand the concepts. The open book policy won't help you if you don't study well.

Stats is a boring subject for me. However, Erich made this class vibrant. You will do fine on the exercise sets as long as you attend every lecture. There are 3 exams in that class that are ridiculously hard in comparison to the exercise sets. I am glad the generous curve helps us with the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Apparently nice person but extremely difficult professor. 
PROS: trying to make the class entertaining, posted help-review videos for homework. 
CONS: Not enough practice questions, DIFFICULT Exams (not connected to the coursework), useless homemade course packet (interesting concept but difficult to understand without attending lectures).

Erich is a character and definitely keeps class interesting but is big on no phones. The class definitely isn't easy because exercise sets didn't match the exams at all which were more difficult. But he changes the boundaries of the grades so in the end, you can end up doing good. My 83% became an overall A- for the class due to the boundaries.

i know i got a B+ in this class after the curve, but this was after a lot of stress and tears throughout the semester. Ur gonna suffer unless youre good at math, the exams were ridiculously hard compared to the exercise sets and he REFUSED to upload recordings of the lectures, which all my other profs did bc people would be isolating from covid.

Studer-Ellis is a great teacher and at least 70% of the class will get at least a B-. The lectures aren't mandatory but if you want to get a good grade, I would highly recommend going to them. My only complaint about him is he is super cryptic about how he grades the class. Overall, you will need to work hard to get an A in this class.

Professor Studer-Ellis is a great man and is very funny but does not do a fantastic job at articulating what he teaches in class into the problems that he gives weekly and on the exams. I like him a lot but I would honestly not take him again.

This is the best math teacher I've had in a while. Goes over everything in perfect detail and makes sure you know what you are doing before you turn it in. There is no reason you should not get at least an A-
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Erich is the best professor I've ever had. He really cements key statistical ideas and makes SURE everyone understands everything he's saying; he answers every single question very thoroughly and politely, no matter how stupid the question is. The "course packet" is followed to the wordhe goes over every single part in class, so definitely attend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Erich is a great professor. He really knows the material in his course packet and goes through every page in detail. His review videos that help with the homework are a lifesaver too. As long as you get the notes from either attending class or his posted notes the homework is easy too. Only 3 tests, each one has a retake and highest grade is kept.

He made us feel as if we were doing great in the class and then his exams rolled around and we were apparently not doing well. He told us that the curve will not be as generous just because we are not online even though class averages have been like the past couple semesters when an 85% was curved to an A. Exams are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He provides lots of resources for the weekly homeworks. If you go to lectures, discussion, and put in the work doing well is definitely possible

Entertaining guy, but content can be a little difficult. Online, the final grade consisted of three exams and weekly exercise sets. Decent curve, brought my B- to a B+. He gives you all of the resources you need for success. An A is very attainable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor who somehow manages to make a very difficult class doable. His enthusiastic attitude was very helpful in getting me through the lecture videos and constant stream of new topics. The class is test heavy with 3 major exams, but there's 2 opportunities for each and he keeps the higher score. There's also a generous curve.

He makes a horrible class quite entertaining, even through asynchronous lectures. He's a really funny guy. I would've given him 5 stars if it was a synchronous class, although it sometimes got hard to reach him when I had questions or comments. Great professor overall.

Erich is a great professor bc he is able to make a hard topic easy to understand. If you take the time to watch every lecture, the course will make sense to you. He posts help videos too that get you through the exercise sets. 3 exams and weekly exercise sets, so not a lot goes into your grade. HUGE curve at the end of the semester.
Statistics is a difficult subject and learning everything asynchronously makes it even tougher. Very test heavy and a lot of homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: When I took this class, it was online, asynchronously. He goes into a lot of depth, so the notes were always clear. I will say that if you didn't take stat in high school, you'll need to work a lot harder. Take advantage of the practice exams he releases, but be wary that in-person and online are different. He is strict about excused absences.

As a student, understand how easy it is to find yourself in a hole with this Professor both online and offline. Examinations are your god in this class, with them determining 85% of the course grade. If you fail one, you will suffer to get your grade up to pass this course and this Professor will give you a false sense of security with his attitude
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Erich prepares you well for the class. Buy the course packet or print it yourself, it will make taking notes and understanding the material so much easier. 3 exams including the final, open-note, two attempts each, worth 80% of your grade. 2 weekly problem sets, one with a group. He curves end of sem. based on the class, 84 was an A- this fall.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Studer-Ellis was great for business stat. Your grade is basically made up of three tests, but you get two tries on each test and they're very similar to the notes. He also gives a pretty big curve at the end of the semester. Although we were online and couldn't meet the professor, he seems like a great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is one of the elite professors UMD has to offer. He really loves what he teaches and made distanced learning really do-able. He is always clear with instructions. The class is heavily graded on three tests(we had one retake for each of the three). There is a course packet that is about $25 but is very useful. Make sure to listen to everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor! really has his own personality that you even get to know through online courses. Tests are pretty hard but he curves your overall grade at the end. Three exams in total and problem sets every week
He is an amazing professor! You have to take BMGT230 with Erich! This is the best class I've taken at UMD so far!! You will definitely learn the material with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Studer-Ellis was probably my favorite professor this semester. He put lots of effort in to help us understand the content. He went above and beyond to make additional help videos for the students. His quick wit and caring demeanor made me enjoy his class even more. His music taste was a 9/10.

Erich makes this class easy, even though it should be hard. I took this class without any stat experience and did great. He is super high energy and clearly very passionate about the subject. He makes sure to highlight practical career applications and generally just makes the class worth attending.

Mr. S-E is a very good professor. I do not particularly like statistics, but it was still enjoyable because of the aura he gave off. We had all recorded lectures, but they were very lively. The course grade is heavily weighted on exams, though. All of the lectures follow a course packet. Anyone can do well if they watch the lectures and study.

This guy is a living legend. He teaches an extremely hard subject but does it very well. He teaches every class with a bunch of energy and positivity. He's even implemented little things to ease out the hardest concepts. Gave an amazing speech before classes closed for COVID and was the most accommodating out of all of my teachers.

he's a ball of energy that will wake you up. cares about students, or at least he appears to. 230 is a gateway course, so it is meant to be straightforward. it's ap stats all over again. he teaches methodically through his own simple course book. 3 long exams - though you are allowed a crib sheet.
He has such an energetic personality and he's a really nice guy, always willing to answer questions and help. Definitely go to lecture as much as you can. I would 10/10 take his class again
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Take his class! Definitely one of my fav professors. The content was hard but if you show up to class and go to discussions, you will be fine. Do not skip!! He also allows you to make a note sheet for each exam. He really tries his best to help students and is very caring.

Solid professor. All the notes follow along a course packet which is $25. No textbook. Posts completed notes after class but it's still better to go if you can. Weekly HW but doesn't take long and he offers help sessions. He lets you have a front-and-back cheat-sheet with you for exams. Seems to really care about students. Exams are fair.

Erich is the best. He really cares and wants to do everything he can to help. Lectures arent mandatory but definitely helpful since your class grade is pretty heavily focused on exams. Content is really tough but if you try your hardest you will probably pass.

I LOVEEEEEE ERICH he was one of my favorite professors thus far. He has a great personality and does not fail to keep the class engaged. If I could I would take any other class that he teaches. One tip though is to make sure you pay attention ask questions and DONT USE YOUR PHONE IN CLASS!!!
Best professor I have ever had. Very energetic and knows everything in the course packet. Do the exercise set and activity sheets weekly! THEY MATTERS!
Show up to class and friday discussions, do the homeworks, and with the end of the year curve you will be more than prepared for the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor who is very knowledgable and genuinely cares about the students. Hes very energetic and makes a rather dry subject like stat enjoyable . Tests are worth a large percentage of your final grade, quite difficult, and have low average but the class is curved. Study hard for the tests and do the practice problems and practice exams.

Bstat is not an easy class, but he makes it as easy as possible for students. He is super interactive and energetic, and he makes it easy to follow along. Attendance is not mandatory, but I definately reccomend going since tests are the majority of your grade.

It's a hard class and personally I found stat to be really boring. But he is EASILY my favorite professor, he's so energized and made me actually look forward to his class, even at 930 AM. He's a bit on the weird side, but most people learn to love it, and he truly cares about his students

Erich is a hilarious professor who really cares about statistics. He also explains things very well so it is easy to understand, and if you don't understand you can always go to his office hours or talk to him before and after class and he gets excited to answer your questions. There's a huge curve so don't worry too much if you do bad on the exams

The class is hard, but he'll work with you to clear up confusing topics. Like most 300+ student courses, grading is done on a bell curve, with the mean being roughly around a B-. The first exam had the lowest average (63), so make sure you take that exam seriously. If you do well on it you'll basically have a cushion for the whole semester.
If you don't come to class and take notes in his textbook you will not pass this class. Not much work needed outside of class besides the weekly homeworks which are not *too* difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You only need to buy a course packet which costs about $20. He teaches from the packet, notes are basically filling in information he writes on the board and any extra practice. Don't skip lectures. Amazing professor who teaches incredibly well and makes statistics easy even if you haven't taken it before in high school or for AP credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a great professor and really knows what he is talking about. There is no textbook, but you must purchase a paper packet with everything you need for the course. The material can get tough, so you need to put in the work. No laptops allowed in class, so if you miss you better get the notes from a friend.

His lectures are kept entertaining by him jumping around the class. He teaches the material well and is responsive to students concerns. Tests are difficult, but manageable if you go to class. He created his own textbook and remembers every single detail and number from it (pretty impressive). Gives many resources to help students who request help.

He is THE most caring and responsible prof I have ever seen. He is a humorous person and the way he teaches is amazing. The class is not easy( It's stat so you know) but erich makes what we do much more interesting. Although the average exam scores are pretty low, he gives a lot of curves.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Erich is a very good teacher, his lectures are the best. And he offers extra help for students, willing to answer questions after class. But it is a hard class, you have to go to class in order to understand everything, do the homework, and study a lot for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: As other reviewers said, Erich is probably one of the best professors you'll have at UMD. If he's an option for ANY class, take him. He's super engaging and really wants to help his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He's one of my favorites! The class was hard and a lot of work, but Erich was a good lecturer and he was very approachable.

Great professor, genuinely cares about the students. Created a packet full of only material required for the class, so no text book needed. Lectures are engaging and he is willing to answer any questions you have. He even holds a help session to help students with homework outside of class every week. Tests are fair and match the material taught.

He is actually a great teacher, always filled with energy. The class itself ain't easy; however, he'll do everything so people can do well in tests and homework. If you need to take this class, I recommend him 100%.

This class is by no means easy, but Erich is one of if not the best professor in the Business school and he makes the class much more doable. He is always involved in lecture making the class somewhat interesting. He is also willing to help any student with any question. 10/10 would take again.

Erich is the best professor I've had at UMD! Bstat is already and incredibly hard subject, but Erich makes it bearable. He really cares about his students and wants you to do well. There's one homework assignment a week and three tests and you get a note sheet for the first two and three for the final. If you have to take bstat take him!
Best professor on this campus, no questions asked. Just make sue you go to lectures or you won't understand the material.

This man literally changed my life. His lectures are amazing and he teaches everything so well. He's so accessible outside of class and helps everyone out as much as possible. He really cares and I loved this class so much. The exams can be a little tough, but if you practice, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Erich is an awesome professor. Makes the lectures enjoyable and gives you everything you need to succeed, from the $20 textbook he wrote to old exams/practice problems. Class is hard and you have to work for your grade, but he curves the class at end based on how you did against your peers. Required class for basically everyone who takes it

Bstat is a really hard class that I struggled with (and had to take twice) but as a professor, he is really enthusiastic and engaging so that was nice to see. He's helpful if you go to office hours with any questions. Overall, hard class but he does his best to make it enjoyable
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The professor makes you feel like you are in a class of 20 students, teaching the material clearly and making it a comfortable environment for a student to ask a question. He also makes a $20 book which is all you need. If you make the effort by going to lectures, doing the hw, and going to discussion, youll do well.

Erich is an amazing teacher who is dedicated to seeing his students succeed. That said, this class is very tough and requires you to practice alot outside of class. Erich makes the material interesting though and I would go with him if you have to take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The material is difficult but he's a good teacher. Other than studying before the exam and the homework's due on Friday, it's not too much work.
One of the best professors. Inspirational, caring, knowledgeable professor and just a great person! No book, only his printed notes.

The class itself is very difficult, missing more than one or two lectures will probably hurt your grade a lot. Erich does his best to keep statistics as entertaining as possible and he is very good at answering questions and makes tons of resources available so that you can get a good grade in this class, but you really do have to work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Erich is definitely one of the best teachers at the University of Maryland. He is super enthusiastic and engaging, and he makes a very difficult subject as straightforward and easy as he can. He even gives you the notes for the semester instead of a textbook with fill-in-the-blanks. Don't take BMGT230 without taking Erich!

Erich was a great professor. He really cared about teaching and made an effort to be available to students. He was very knowledgable and often held extra help sessions to review. The material was hard and you did have to study to do well in the class. However, he did provide a course packet that was very useful throughout the semester.
Stats is hard. But Erich is super engaging and really good at explaining things. The class itself is hard but he's a great teacher.
Great teacher, provides help sessions every week. The class is easy; however, your grade is based on your position on the class so not knowing can be stressful
no textbook. everything you need is in the package he wrote for this class. Just study the package and homework you'll do fine.

Probably one of the most enthusiastic/high-spirited/engaging professors in this country (and no, I'm not exagerating.) At 8AM, he keeps you focused and engaged in the material...too bad he's leaving Maryland...he's the best!

He is among the best professors at the University of Maryland, but if you are not a math person, you may want to consider taking another course.  However, if you are up for a challenge, I highly recommend taking this class.
Best teacher ever...attendance isnt mandatory, but you HAVE to go in order to know anything.

He is the best professor I have had at UMD. Not only is he crystal clear in his explanation of the material, he also goes over many examples to ensure you understand it. He is the sweetest, most caring guy I've ever met. He's really cute too and he looks so delicious when he wear his three stooges tie. If only he were gay...oh well, a guy can dream
You have to go to class and discussion. Homework every week. Very passionate about subject. Tests are difficult but fair.
He's a great professor. Material is very extensive and plenty of formulas to know. BUT you get to use note sheets to write whatever you want.

Studer-Ellis is a really great teacher. He knows his stuff and is very organized. All of the material and exams are pretty straight forward. Go to lectures, it'll help a lot!! It was a pretty tough class but if you try hard you can do well. He hates it when you leave early/text during class but that is pretty disrespectful so he has reason.

Studer-Ellis lectures his class with enthusiasm but doesn't like when people leave early. His tests are difficult because you have to move quickly to get them done while at the same time being careful not to make small mistakes. He is helpful and puts in a lot of overtime to help you succeed. My TA-Mendoza was helpful. Don't ever miss class/disc

GO TO CLASS! i never took stat before, and i got an A-. he is fair. he gives extra credit in lecture. do his practice problems, you'll see them again on exams!! very strict about grading, no curves or rounding up. very fair class, no reason to not get A/B if you do your share.

yea yea hes a good teacher and all that, and gives extra credit. but he's plain heartless when it comes to grades...TWO points to an A-(538 when you need 540)A- and he didn't give it to me because he "JUST DOESN'T BUMP"...for that, he just doesn't cut it ...

Very good professor, clear and thorough in lecture. He knows the material extremely well and has a freakishly good memory. He gives excessive extra credit, which unfairly helps students that do not know the material get a higher grade than they deserve. The class should be very easy if you show up to lecture and pay attention.

Studer Ellis is a really good teacher because he makes you work hard and its worth it at the end because you really know it. Do every problem he gives you.  He def has tricks up his sleeves when it comes to exams so be prepared.  The final included SO many repeat questions from previous assignments. Moral of the story: not easy but not impossible.

He is one of the most intense professor's I have ever had. The course is not easy bottom line. Especially for those who have not taken any form of stat prior to his class. Although his class is very challenging, he is an amazing professor, and is always willing to help student learn material both in and out of class. Do ALL of his practice problems

Easy course as long as you attend class, and especially if u toke ap stats in highscool. Minimal studying outside of class and he does offer extra credit, but no curves. Students tend to do their worst on the first test so make sure you understand it

A very quirky man. Tells many corny jokes, but at least keeps you awake. Very loud. Clear and repetitive with his lectures, he really makes sure you understand the material. Gives lots of extra credit (in class extra credit)

really really disturbing personality. you get the impression he's on the edge 60% of the time. the first few ppl that come late he does thsi fake laugh, and then after 6 or 7 ppl come he flips out(i had an 8am, its going to happen) he makes 26 different versions of his exams, super paranoid, not clear. some people love him. personally i didn't
Best professor ever!!
horrible person. Teaches well, is helpful, etc, but is a horrible person.

Definitely a good teacher. Really knows his stuff and is always willing to help a student out as long as its reasonable. His exams are okay towards easy as long as you did some studying and you look over old exams, and  discussion problems. you get a page back and front of hand written notes for every exam and 5 for final. show up, understand, pass

he is an excellent proffessor!!! he wants you to learn and understand the material thus he is very clear in his lectures and will help you at any time......he also tells corny jokes which still makes me laugh.. i very much liked his class..and as long as you go to lectures and discussions, you will get an A...p.s. he gives TONS of extra credit!!!
He is extremely friendly and actually wants you to learn the material.  You need to respect him though or he gets angry but he can be extremely friendly and helpful as long as you try.

Great teacher, knows his stuff, the trick to getting an A is just to do all the practice problems and look over old exams, if you do this you will have an A. To recieve an A on the final all you need is to write down old exam questions because most are on the exam verbatim. This class will make you work but it is not difficult.
AWESOME TEACHER! definitely take him, you'll undoubtedly end up with a B, trust me

Enthusiatic teacher. Need to attend all discussions to get easy 5 pnts and turn in hwk. Exams sort of tricky. Lots of extra credit. Can use 5 note sheet (front and back) for final exam. One note sheet for other exams. Can write anything on them.

Yeah, he is a nice guy and gives you extra help but he is out to trick you on his exams. They are hard with questions that you don't necessarily ever see beforehand. He is anal and will take off credit wherever possible on his exams even if it looks like you got everything right. Irritating and corny and thus even more irritating.****ty class.

He is definitely a great professor. Truly, this course isn't for me, but as long as he sees that you are trying hard, he will make sure you pass. He's extremely passionate in helping students and communicates well. The material is hard for some and easy for others, but overall, I DEFINITELY reccommend his class. One of the best here!

Studer-Ellis has a great paaion for teaching and getting students involved. A great class made even better by his teaching syle. He really supports the students and makes us think to get the answers we need.  Stay on top of the material and DO the practice problems and you should do great in the class.  p.s. He loves it when you ask questions.

I loved Professor Studer-Ellis. I had an 8 am class but he woke me up quickly with his energy. Stats really became an interesting class with him as my teacher. Extra credit is also very generous. My favorite teacher at UMD.

Best teacher so far at College Park. As mentioned in previous reviews it isn't easy, but there is certainly enough opportunity to obtain the needed info if you don't understand it the first time in class. Studer-Ellis is awesome.

Studer-Ellis is one of the best teachers I've had so far here at UMCP. He makes you work for your grade, but he is an excellent teacher and very helpful if you don't understand something. Overall, if you go to class and pay attention, do the assignments and study for tests, you should get an A. He also gives lots of extra credit :)
THIS GUY IS THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! YOU SHOULD DEF TAKE HIM DURING YOUR UMD TENURE

Studer-Ellis taught the best class I've taken at UMD so far. He was really into it and that was portrayed well. You have to go to lecture to fill out his course packet. He's very helpful if you go to his office hours. He offers a lot of extra help sessions. For exams, DO the practice problems. Take the time to study and the exams are easy.

He is the best prof. I've had at UMD, he is so fun and really likes the subject. Tests aren't too hard and you get to bring in notes sheets which definitely help. A tip for the final: he uses LOTS of problems word for word from the previous exams that semester so study and copy them on your notes sheet if you can. Overall, he's an awesome guy.

Best teacher I have had so far at UMD... wants to help everyone pass the class at all costs. Gives tons of extra credit. Go to lecture and take good notes and then go to the discussion to get the easy 5 points for completing a paper the TAs give you the answers to. Don't come late or leave early... he freaks out!
Excellent professor. Good teaching style, euthusiastic, and very helpful when needed. Highly recommended.

He is the man. Works very hard to make sure everyone understands the information, not just so people can pass the tests. His somewhat odd personality makes stats much more interesting. If you go to lecture and pay attention this class should be an A.
Great teacher.  Gives extra credit and many other assignments to help grade.  A little quirky, but entertaining.  Definitely recommend his class.  Wish Studer-Ellis taught more classes.

Great teacher!! Kind of a hippie. He tries to spice up every class with a few lame jokes. Best of all he is VERY accessible during his office hours and will take the time to stop and explain something that the class doesn't understand. Don't bother buying the book, especially now that he has a "course pack" with his notes from the entire semester.
No Comments
excellent teacher though he expects a lot from his students
Statistics is not my favorite subject but Studer-Ellis made it easy to learn.  Make sure you go to class and you'll do fine.

One of those classes where I'd like to badmouth the teacher about getting a B and not an A, but he is really a pretty good teacher and a good guy. He will help you out but will never break any rules to do so. Tests are hard, and attending class is obligatory (I dont say that often). Also requires a good deal of studying... but not too much hw.
No Comments
I did well, but I think since Fall04 he made it harder. He was a good prof. I took AP Stat in HS so that helped make the class easier. But do the work and you'll be fine. Text is pretty useless.
No Comments

He's a good professor but the class itself is really hard and requires alot of work, time and effort outside of class. I recommend taking this class in a winter or summer term by itself when you can focus on it more or maybe during a semester where your classes aren't that hard. He's very exact/on point about grades you get what you earn 79.9 is C
Good guy, but the class itself is no good....if you don't mind doing work, this is the teacher for you.....

Studer-Ellis demands a lot from you. He is a stat teacher so he believes in equality for all of his lecture classes. This means NO curve at all. If you have an 89.9 you get a B, so be prepared to work! TAs are really helpful. Make sure to go to their office hours for help with questions!

This is a pretty tough class. A 'B' is pretty easy to earn but you do have to work for an 'A'. He knows his stuff but cannot quite put into good teaching (goes pretty fast and is a little vague). He's pretty sympathetic towards problems but is pretty rigid about grades.
No Comments
Great teacher, made stat interesting

Great professor! Very caring and really shows she wants to keep students interested. Helped me out with time zone differences and handing things in. Makes you work for it and assigns work you need to learn. Loved her class and learned a lot!

Dont take this class unless you absolutely need it. I thought I would brush up on my spanish but instead she rants about other countries. You learn and practice very little spanish and when she teaches about gramme/pronunciation/etc its only for 5 minutes. Unorganized and tough grader when shes in the mood.
