reviews.comment: Best professor I've had at UMD. He's definitely different so I started out skeptical, but he's funny, he does things to keep class light like music when you walk in and class conversation about tv shows and stuff, and he does a lot to make the class and lectures interesting which seems hard when the topic is HR. Also, switched to open-note exams
Poor grader, wouldn't recommend to my worst enemy

I took this professor this semester on an online course. I feel his work is manageable and if you go over the Prezi slides for his asynchronous class you will be fine. He gives you his number to reach out if you need assistance and seems like a cool dude on the zoom calls.

one of the BEST professors I've ever had (online)!!! The lectures were actually interesting and the workload was so straight and not heavy at all. The midterm and final both are open book, open notes AND you have an option to take a comprehensive exam with the two best scores counted. Seriously don't understand why he has so many bad reviews!

He is beyond bad and I question how he is still a professor at this institution. Does not like to help others. Instead he focuses on ways to embarrass you in front of the entire class and strengthening his ego. If you point out that his statement is inaccurate he will ask for your opinion and dismiss it. Your opinion must match his in his opinion.

Professor Marr spends a lot of class time watching videos and playing music. Although he is trying to be a cool millennial, he comes across as out of touch and ingenuine. His arrogance really shines through when students ask questions about assignments. He is rude to anyone who asks questions, and does not hesitate to remind you of a dumb question.

His class was interesting to say the least. Grading was very subjective, and I sadly did not learn anything in this class. You MUST read the book, as there are chapter quizzes each class. Self-learning for sure. The exams were also poorly worded, which which made them unnecessarily difficult even if you knew the concepts. Overall a thumbs down.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is egregious! He likes to toy with the emotions of his students and also insults them for no reason in front of the whole class. An absolute disgrace of a professor. Never take any class with this man. Also plays awful music at the beginning of every class and wastes 15 to 20 minutes of time taking about it.

Avoid Marr at all costs. He wastes class time talking about his music preferences, which is a serious issue in a class that meets once a week. His grading is unfair, inconsistent and based off of few assignments. He is very unclear about expectations and is rude to students. I did not learn anything in this class because of him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Very rude, very inconsistent, very fake. If you are an independent thinker then this guy is not for you. Feedback lacks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very bad professor. Pick winners and losers early on in the semester. Feedback is non-existent and the feedback you do receive usually in contradicting (we'll give good feedback but a very low grade). If you want to succeed in his class then you have to drink the kool aid. If you're a "follow the herd" person then this Professor is for you.

Gregory Marr is an excellent professor and passionate about what he does. His case studies are intuitive and promote excellent discussion among students. As a grader, he is fair and impartial and rewards students with the grade he or she earned.

His class was interesting and engaging however it was 0 help for any of his exams. They were extremely difficult even with reading every chapter. He doesn't require attendance but there's a quiz nearly every class and participation is worth 10%. Participation is not easy to do well on and is very arbitrary.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Avoid this professor. He is by far the worst professor at Smith. His test are unreasonably hard. Other professors have open book exams, his are closed. His lectures are useless and his grading is nonexistent. It takes 3 weeks to receive grades. Plays music and tv shows in class that have nothing to do with material.
Avoid this professor at all cost ! He absolutely sucks at teaching and is extremely rude
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Marr is very interested in the subjects that he teaches. His classes are semi lecture based but more involved because he has us actively discuss cases. This is a class where there isnt always a definitive answer because you could argue many sides, but he has a "right" answer in mind, if you can hit that your gold.
His exams are really hard. Unless you don't know specifically the whole chapters, you won't pass. I won't talk him again.
The professor himself is extremely nice, but his lectures are very slow, and his slides do not provide enough information. There are weekly quizzes and discussion posts, two exams, and no papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great introductory course & Professor Guarrieri had very engaging lectures. My only complaint was that he would occasionally get behind his schedule and would have to rush through some lectures and have us rely only on the readings for certain topics because he cut them out of the lecture. Otherwise great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Tom is a nice, respectful guy that cares about his students. There are a couple of reading summaries, and essay based midterm, and a final group project. Grading criteria seemed a little arbitrary at times; he has a very specific idea of what he wants. Overall good course. I could have probably gotten an A if I put in a little more effort.

There is a textbook but tbh you don't need to read if you go to lecture. Don't waste your money, go sit in class and take notes, you'll be fine. Ask questions before exams because there's lots of content covered. There are ICONS simulations that are a grade booster if you just participate. He's very passionate about the subject.

Prof. Guarrieri, is a great professor, there's a lot of readings but surprisingly their are no exams or just 2-3 homework assignments so initially it was a cake walk. However be aware not to slack of on the homework assignments because those papers are graded extremely harshly so its imperative that you read the rubrics to a "T".
Very nice and interesting lecturer. Easy to understand and explains complex topics at an appropriate level for undergrad understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Writes on board rather than give a powerpoint. He explains concepts deeply, which seemed to confuse my classmates, but it helped me a lot. I see how he may not be everyones cup of tea but his style matched very well with how I learn. If you learn by understanding rather than memorizing, he's an excellent option. He gives tones of time for exams.

Tests are cruel and unusual, and his lectures are too poor and disorganized to garner a genuine understanding of the materiel. Redeeming qualities (Likable personality, good extra credit opportunities) don't make up for the hurried, very scattered lectures and seemingly unrelated tests. An accurate rating would be somewhere between 1 and 2 stars.

he is not the best professor, however he cares a lot about his students and will make sure they understand it. He is very fair, if you do the homework, go to discussion, go to class, and do the practice exams you will do great! There is also a curve and extra credit! most fair orgo class! TAKE HIM all my friends wish they did and they had stalker.

Although he is a little bit all over the place in lecture, Gutierrez makes this class as straight forward as it can be. Go to discussion and do the packets and practice exams bc they are SUPER helpful. Do the BACON to get a 5% curve. Might not be the best if you need orgo 2 bc he simplifies a lot but makes it easy for orgo 1 purposes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Although Gutierrez is a little all over the place in lectures, his class is about as easy as its gonna get with orgo. He doesn't try and trick you, and does actually care about individual students' success. There is a lot of opportunity to get extra points in this class and for someone who sucks at chem I truly appreciated It.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He may not be the best at explaining things in class, but he is a fair professor. There are no surprises with his class and there is a 5% curve if you do all the bacon. If you go to lecture & discussion, do the clickers, and study for the exams with all the discussion packets you will do just fine I promise! He really wants his students to do well

He is a kind professor, but the worst at lecture. There is no point coming to most of the lectures since you wont learn much anyway. He goes off on tangents and the slides he prepares are not helpful. Obviously organic chemistry is a rigorous course, but the professor should make it a little bit easier to understand. Good luck to anyone taking him

Best orgo 1 professor by far. Great guy, walks you through everything and his tests are extremely fair, unlike what I've heard about other professors. A practice test is provided for every exam that is the same format as the exams. Definitely takes a lot of studying, but its manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Osvaldo is pretty messy during lecture. Understanding and drawing out the chemical structures is a big deal in Organic Chem, it's not clear on the black board when he draws out the structure, his handwriting is hard to read. However, he gives out practice exams which is SO useful for the exam & many bonus questions. CLASS IS NOT CURVED.

DO NOT TAKE FOR ORGO! I'm pre-med and I worked so hard to get a C. My dreams of being a doctor is crushed. This was my first lab class because I tested out of chemistry physics and biology. Didn't know the content was going to be this difficult. Take another lab class to get used to how lab classes and science classes work in college. SELF LEARNing
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took AP chem in high school and scored a 5. Took orgo thinking it wouldn't be too bad. This professor is really funny but makes a lot of mistakes. I didnt enjoy the class. Its all self learn. if it wasnt for youtube videos, i wouldnt have gotten a B.

Gutierrez is super nice and enthusiastic but doesn't explain anything well at all. His test are tricky and include material he never even mentions in class. He also tends to go off on tangents during class. There are no assignments and exams count for 75% of your grade, good luck Charlie.

Professor Gutierrez is a solid choice. He is not the best lecturer and makes quite a lot of mistakes but, he is funny and enthusiastic about chemistry to make up for it. He gives dumb group assignments but, his tests are fair and it is definitely possible to do well especially with the extra credit he gives.

Love this man, he is super approachable, cares a whole lot, and explains things to the maximum. If you ever do not understand something, GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS he will explain it very well and is a super sweet dude. He gives out practice problem sets and practice exams to prepare you for his tests.

He have a confusing and boring teaching style. I have to constantly teach myself most of the class materials because he doesnt have a clear way of explaining. He would give exam reviews but they didn't align with the exams so you have to go through every chapters homework.

Was a decent lecturer and mostly reasonable grader.  Homework instructions were sometimes unclear and he wasn't always the most helpful in answering our questions about confusing instructions.  Still, learned a lot and enjoyed his lectures.

Danul is a very nice guy, but his lectures are just him writing a bunch of notes on paper, which is why lecture was so boring; I feel like I had to teach myself the material. I took his class in Fall 2022 and didn't really enjoy it. On the plus side, he is really good at answering questions and is especially helpful during office hours.

I took him for STAT400. He is a very fair professor. I had Fernandes for about a week last semester, and truss he is much more fair than him. His homeworks where from the textbook. The R projects where similar to the R-Guide he provided. Exams where fair. My advice, just lock down the practice problems that are on the review.

The professor doesn't write the final exam, the head of the math department does. Final exam is so different in terms of difficulty and structure to the midterms is crazy the school doesn't change anything about this. I was comfortable with a B+ in the class for the whole semester and the final exam came out of nowhere and brough me down to a C+.

As long as you pay attention to the lectures, you can do really well in the class. He explains the concepts in understandable ways, and he does his best to make sure we comprehend and understand how to do the work. Try your best to attend lectures and watch the videos, and read the book as often as you can to practice examples and review terms.

Don't know why people don't seem to like him. I thought he explained the material very clearly; make sure you attend/watch lectures and you should easily pass this class. Exams are pretty easy if you go over his review sheets.

Professor Gunatilleka was a fairly good lecturer and communicator. His teaching is nothing groundbreaking, and you'll definitely need to focus during discussion sections in order to keep up, but you can definitely do worse in terms of low-level math profs. Plus, he was willing to push back deadlines if he didn't finish covering material in lecture.

I honestly feel like I would've have done horribly if I didn't take Calculus previously. His teaching style is very confusing and I ended up having to reteach myself most times. The TAs were super helpful though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 5 exams throughout the semester, pretty strict grading. The TAs are helpful so use them often as possible but take another professor for a math course if possible. not worth the agony
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lecturing style was not very clear and he often had me questioning information that I already knew from previous classes with confusing explanations. We also had four midterm exams plus a final, which seemed a bit excessive.

He is honestly very nice and caring. He constantly asks whether we have questions about what he is teaching and tries to make sure we understand the material. His study guides are also helpful towards the exam. Calculus naturally is a tough course, but if you stay on top of the work, you will be fine. He also gives lots of homework assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: MATH140 was definitely very challenging, but I liked the professor. Quizzes every Thursday was kinda annoying, but a good way to boost your grade up a bit. He was very receptive to student concerns and did his best in an online format, which is difficult. This class was definitely the hardest I've taken so far at UMD, so only take it if you need to
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He was getting a lot of hate in the beginning because that was our most difficult unit in the class but as the class progressed the class became really doable and pretty routine and easy. Read the textbook, go to lecture, and youll be absolutely fine.

Everyone talking bad about him didnt put in the work because I had never taken Calc before (never in high school) and I always got a high B on the midterms and an A on the final. The only reason I didnt get an A overall is because I got sick with COVID at a point during the semester. His midterms are so easy and predictable. Hes an okay guy.

Not bad at all. Homeworks are grade boosters, especially the web assigns. Test material is pretty fair. His lectures are pretty helpful sometimes too. Go to lectures,pay attention,and use the textbook to study and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really nice guy. He did really bad at the beginning, but throughout the semester he got better by a lot. I feel like as long as you pay attention to lecture and the practice problems he gives out in lecture then you should be good. I would honestly take him again

The first few weeks of this course, I was prepared to give Danul a 1 rating, but as the semester advanced, he did a much better job at teaching the more complex things. Danul sometimes gives really complex answers to questions that could be answered easily. Overall, Danul's lectures got significantly better as the semester went on.

He is a genuinely nice guy and definitely cares about his students and wants them to do well. The only issue is he is very concept based and skips over the math behind the concepts, so it is very confusing especially if you haven't taken a calculus class before. Luckily, his practice exams are almost identical to exams, do those and you're fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hes really nice and you can tell he doesnt want you to do bad. If you get accused of cheating, thats on the TAs (they grade exams). He never randomly calls on ppl during lecture and never gave a pop quiz (or any quiz). The grades are heavily exam based. If you have a question, hell always try to answer it. Its not as bad as you think.

Honestly he's a pretty nice guy and not out to trick you. Lectures are helpful but he talks very slow so its hard to stay focused. Best thing about this class is that practice exams are similar and sometimes harder than the real thing so you wont get surprised. sometimes youll have to learn on your own but hes very patient and will answer questions
Do a lot of practice problems. He wasn't a tough grader. Allowed test corrections sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Nice professor. Very fair. Material is challenging, It is college! Office hours are helpful. Show up to class, ask questions, put in work, and youll be fine. Whoever complained about being accused of cheating, TAs grade our exams not the professor. He shouldnt get hate for that. DONT CHEAT because we are at home. I would take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The best advice I can give is show up to ALL lectures and office hours. The material for this course is hard, it is college Calc after all. I'm also not good at math but he was really nice about making sure I understood when I reached out for help. He genuinely wants his students to pass the class, but you'll HAVE to put in the work to pass.

This class is a swing and a miss for MATH140. During his lectures, he just talks abstractly and loosely, that you never really understand how the answer is achieved. If you've taken Calc in high school, don't expect the material to be easy. If you haven't, I would highly advise against this class and this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He seems like a very intelligent and nice guy but his lectures are very difficult to understand. On the plus side, his practice exams are actually pretty helpful and reflect what is on the exam. He is willing to answer questions asked in lectures but usually his answers don't clarify much.
The study session taught better than him. That's all I gotta say.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is very bad at explaining things. READ THE TEXTBOOK! and watch khan academy and youtube videos to help explain concepts that he wont be able to explain well.
Absolutely the worst lecture style out of all my professors. This class you basically have to teach yourself because he cannot teach...

He really does seem like a nice and smart guy, but it all goes out the window with lectures. His lecture style is so confusing and he cant answer student questions at all. TAs and GSS leaders are a lifesaver. Overall, look for a different teacher if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A solid choice for MATH140. The practice exams really helped narrow down what to know for the actual exam. Quizzes just ensured that you were keeping up with the material, no difficult computations involved. I never went to office hours or talked to him so I cannot speak on him as a person.

This man talks so slow its like you're waiting for some climactic moment that never comes. I don't even look before I cross the street on the way to his class for hopes a car hits me first and I don't have to go. He also accused one of the smartest people I know of cheating. The audacity of him to tell someone they don't have the ability.

If I could give this professor lower then a 1 I would. His teaching style is very underwhelming. The coursework itself was easy, but this professor was rarely available for help with assignments outside of class. I suggest you take a professor that would care more about their students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Terrible. Accused me of cheating because he said I shouldn't have the "mathematical maturity" to complete the work. Instructions were unclear and accusations were based on nothing but his opinion. Waited until almost a month after the exam to do it as well. Expects too little from his students and is skeptical of any skill. Please, take anyone else

Worst professor ever. Literally do not take him!! He accused 14 of his class of cheating using a calculator with NO PROOF, he said we LACK mathematical maturity and that we were incompetent. He talks really slow and is so boring. Does not answer questions. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! FIND ANOTHER PROFESSOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Nice guy, did Calc 1 with him during Covid. The material itself is challenging and he didn't exactly make it much easier, but could've been worse. TA helped a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Pretty difficult to understand, but the textbook was really good. Nice guy, but I stopped going to lecture after the second week. Still got an A bc the textbook is good, his tests are predictable, and my TA was awesome
Show up to office hours, do the webassigns, and you will get an A. Leave your ego at the door, show up to learn, and take good notes. His practice exams are almost identical to the midterm(s).
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He wasnt the worst professor Ive taken. Usually in class he goes over the theory but not so much on examples. Discussion was much better for learning the material, but he puts some stuff he only goes over in lecture on the exams so be on the lookout for that. Overall not a great professor but he did just get his PhD so maybe hell improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Danul gets a lot of hate from his students because most of them show up thinking," I know math". But they are usually full of it. In no way is this class an easy A but office hours are so beneficial to this class as well as doing the practice problems in the book. You will definitely get an A in this class if you study and ask for help when needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely unenjoyable class, was SOOO lecture heavy lots of reading that is extremely time consuming and difficult, hard grader and the grading system is not very equal. Group project for whole semester. Sections was moved online after first week without being advertised as so on Testudo which was frustrating for a-lot of us.

Definitely a tough grader but she is very knowledgeable and understanding about late assignments when they happen (well, during the pandemic, I cant speak to her policy afterwards). AMST262 has a good deal of reading and writing so just make sure you are actually interested in the class before adding it. I personally really enjoyed the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Guerrero is very knowledgeable and passionate about her work. I learned a lot from the class and the subject matter was interesting. The exams and quizzes are fairly easy as long as you pay attention in lecture and discussion. My only issue was how long the readings were. They're so long and take forever to get through. Not a bad class though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The one thing I hated about this class is that we were assigned around 60 pages of reading every week and then had to take a 5 question quiz on the reading. It was so time consuming, especially for a gen-ed, and weighed heavy on my grade because of how many quizzes we took. Grades take forever to be put in so Its always hard to tell where I stand.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Provides passive aggressive feedback. Did not get grades back for final group project and final paper. I would not recommend this teacher to anybody. The class is interesting yet the professor wishes for you to regurgitate the information exactly how she would describe it and does not allow for students to describe things in their own ways.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She demands the best from her students but can't be bothered to return the favor. Class consists of her projecting paragraphs from the readings on the board until she can hammer out of the class the very specific interpretation of it she wants. TAs are nice, but seem lost and at her mercy. Clearly thinks teaching undergrads is beneath her. Avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Guerrero is knowledgeable about the material and very passionate. We were required to answer a single one page response each week on one of the required readings, had two papers, midterm and final (3 essays on each & in-class exam). This is a doable and super interesting class. Highly recommend this class to ppl interested in raceðnicity
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Guerrero's class in Fall 2013. I loved her as a professor -- she's incredibly intelligent and knowledgeable on the subject matter and her class was very interesting -- I always enjoyed attending and participating. Lots of reading for sure, and she is a tough grader, but her class is worth it and highly recommended!

This class is probably only good for people who are AMST or USLT majors. Otherwise it is waaaay to hard and not worth it. Readings are 20-50 pages each (2 a day). The final is a 20 page paper. Also 4 additional papers. Participation is part of the grade too. And she's strict on writing style, you better be writing like a historian or something.

Professor Guttridge has a ton of industry experience and it shows. Lectures are filled with interesting anecdotes. Learned a lot more than just what the textbook covers in his classes. Exams are a lot like the homeworks so study those heavily for midterm/final. Definitely recommend creating an Excel formula sheet which he allows for the exam.

It's actually funny that someone else said the thing about bad mouthing former coworkers. Wow - he does that SO much. Lectures are virtually pointless - you wont learn even 1 thing in lecture but he has pop quizzes that are one question (why? I have no idea... seems like just to hurt grades). Smart but full of himself. Class sucked to be honest
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Stay away. Almost everything he talks about in lectures is not relevant to the textbook, homework, and exams. However, he gives one question pop quizzes which are worth 3 percent of your grade each so good luck if you get them wrong. Chegg almost required to do well on hw. If you get in a bad group then good luck because he won't help you at all.

Other reviews are accurate. Talks a lot and students don't know what he's saying. Never learned a thing from him. Random 1 question pop quizzes in class. Textbook is mandatory and sucks. Group projects are "figure it out" kind of. He bad mouths former coworkers A LOT. In class there is ZERO practice, it's all on your own. If you can, avoid this one
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Seems like he'd be great at managing your portfolio. Cant teach at all... Has the most boring lectures ever. It's not even close. Pop quizzes that everyone fails. You really have to teach yourself investments. Fyi that is difficult. Reliant on TA but even they sometimes are confused. If another professor available, dont choose him. Passionate tho
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor just straight up sucks. His class is so disorganized, even his explanations and lectures are disorganized and hard to follow. It is hard to trust what he says because he is not reliable (always forgets to record his sessions, NEVER responds to emails, typos all over his lectures, unfair 1 Q quizzes...) Don't take him.

Guttridge is nice guy with practical experience but not a good Professor. His lectures are monotone and he goes on confusing tangents. Most of your grade is based on group projects that are randomly assigned. He says he'll help if you have a bad group, but ignored countless emails. Exams are online but many failed the final with unfair questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ryan is an industry veteran with tons of experience in asset management. If you are serious about equity research, take his class. You will learn a Buffet style investment approach and will build equity DCF models to value companies. Lectures will contain unique insights which you wont learn anywhere else. Tests + HW are online and open book.
This class could have been interesting but the lectures are so boring and the prof is not a good lecturer. Super math/stat heavy class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I went into AREC345 a happy, innocent person who was ready to learn about global poverty. A few classes in, I knew that the class would be anything but. Be ready for massive statistical calculations that make you stay up until 2 AM looking for help on the Groupme. I personally had to drop the class because it was not what I expected.

A really nice guy, and very interesting subject matter, but ruined by lack of structure and clarity in the class. Professor read lectures word for word off the slides, and often failed to clarify confusing topics. No study guides provided for tests, so you're going in blind. Clear lack of communication between the TA and professor.

Do. Not. Take AREC345 with THIS prof. He seems like a really nice guy but he did nothing for the class except lecture confusing info and left everything up to the TA who was condescending when we asked q's and did not know how to properly explain things no matter how hard she tried. Unless you know economics well, don't take this prof for AREC345

Oh my God, please do not take this class. Professor Liberto's lecture slides are so vague, which made the exams next to impossible. Because of this, exam averages were always low, so Professor Liberto always curved the grades. Please save yourself a headache and don't take this class unless you absolutely have to.

Professor Liberto is a really nice lady, but she makes her lecture slides so vague, and she often talks a lot, which in itself is not a huge deal, but she tends to drone on and on, and I often lost focus. Also, her tests are extremely difficult, which stressed me out even more. If another professor is teaching this class, please take it with them.

Prof Liberto is actually amazing. Her lectures are very clear and she makes the material very interesting. Her tests are difficult, but if you show up and take notes in lecture, you can achieve a good grade. Her class was the first philosophy class I have ever taken, and it has made me very interested in the field.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This course is super test-heavy and averages are typically very low on all exams. Lecture material is presented horribly, as you are stuck between listening and hopefully grasping the concept or taking notes on what little you can get down from pen to paper. If her slides were dense in material this class could've been much more manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Straight up the worst class I've taken thus far. Her grading system is headache inducing and based only on exams which are difficult. Not tech savy at all and she constantly had to email the class saying she messed something up. Don't take the class if you can help it :)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm not usually a fan of philosophy but I needed this course for the UH program. Prof Liberto is very knowledgeable about this subject and clearly cares a lot, but it is very easy to get lost in the concepts. Also, TA took forever to grade things so I never really knew where I stood grade-wise, and nothing was done when attention was brought to it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you enjoy the topic, then it might be interesting. I put a lot of work into the class and the readings were dense. However, it really isn't graded that hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: What ever you do, dont take this class! Find another humanities requirement because this class is not worth your time. Its extremely hard, she gives horrible feedback and the TAs are the ones who teach the discussions and they arent any better at explaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: There are not a lot of grades so make sure you are well prepared for tests. Tests are multiple-choice and the questions can be ambigious.

liberto explains the content well & the assigned readings thoroughly so you don't really have to read them. crucial to take notes and understand the content to keep up in the class. Exams are okay, not unreasonably difficult. not a lot of cushion grades though so you have to do well on the exams. just take another easier gen ed honestly
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This semester, the lectures were online and you would have to attend a discussion section on Friday. Expect to put in 30hrs of work each week when taking detailed notes on lectures. If you have good notes you WILL NOT have to read the readings, save yourself the trouble. if you do not enjoy phil this class could be very tiring it is a lot of work!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Liberto takes the word lecture to the next level. She talks for the entire class period and is willing to answer questions; however, there is no encouragement for discussion. She is friendly but tends to overexplain things.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: DO. NOT. TAKE. THIS. CLASS. You will regret taking this class because your GPA will drastically drop! She is very nice but the TAs are the ones who grade all the discussion posts and exams. They will give you a 68% on an assignment and tell you to try harder. Take an easier gen-ed then this, you will regret this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: prof. liberto would have been good but she didnt give many chances to raise grades and she wasnt very accessible, neither were the tas. as an online course it was really hard to grasp the material from her hour long lectures when they were prerecorded and it was hard to contact her for any sort of in person interaction
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She expects you to calculate your grade yourself, which should already tell you how hard she makes things, lectures are interesting but the lectures are heavy, study a lot. If your taking this for a gen Ed, I honestly recommend taking an easier course this one is not worth it. Her rubrics are not helpful at all so dont bother reading them.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Liberto seems like a really sweet lady and she explains the concepts very well. Her recorded lectures were very engaging. There are very few grades (she does curve tests though) so you have to take really thorough notes and understand the material inside and out to do well. If you do that and are a good test taker it's a pretty easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Only work was biweekly discussion posts and Exams. 2 EC options. I think I cried more than 10 times over this class. It was completely asynchronous and no discussion. She's a sweet woman but if you didn't like the subject, good luck. 2 tests, and a quiz, very hard. She drops your quiz if you did better on the midterm. Overall, hated it, liked her

Professor Liberto is a great lecturer! Some of the readings are lengthy but they are worth it and needed for the quizzes, midterm and final. We switched between synchronous and asynchronous lectures throughout the semester. She gives opportunities to raise your grade. she really cares about her students, if you need help dont hesitate to reach out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Tough class to take online. We have zero in person interactions with her or the TA's. You don't really need to read the required papers to do well on the tests however, she does a good job explaining them in the lectures. If you are confused in this class you're screwed, you wont be getting help.

Multiple choice phil exams? nah dude. That was ridiculous, especially since the choices are super similar. Got an average of 60% in all the exams, never done so bad in philosophy smh. Since she uploaded vids (for pandemic) it was sooo much easier to actually grasp/take notes and actually found the class interesting lol

Professor Liberto is an amazing lecturer. Philosophy isn't for everyone and it can be sometimes hard to understand, but the professor explained the content very clearly and it's genuinely an interesting class if you're up for it. Discussion sessions allow people to discuss what was talked about in class. The exams are easy if you actually study,

Overall an easy class - only one paper, one quiz, and two exams. My biggest problem with Prof. Liberto is her exams. Philosophy exams should not be multiple choice, they should be ONLY short answer questions. Her multiple choice options were muddled and more than one answer could have been used for many of the questions - my TA even admitted so.

Professor Liberto is very good at explaining philosophy in a way that makes it simple to understand. You are graded only on your midterm, participation in discussion, your paper, and your final so I reccommend putting in A LOT of effort into those. If you show up to class and listen to her lectures this class is an easy a.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: For a Gen Ed course, I would pick another course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Regret taking this class- too much effort for a gen-ed. She talks through the whole lecture period and is super repetitive in a way that makes it hard to concentrate. TA and disc sections were the only enjoyable things about this course. Graded based on so few things, and she doesn't use elms which makes things unnecessarily stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Liberto is a good lecturer but her exams are tough and there are few grades in the class. I wouldnt take this class again but it wasnt horrible. Its an oddly structured class for a philosophy class. Its not the worst option but if youre on the fence then dont take it.
she makes me want to drop out of college. it makes you regret every life decision youve ever made.

easily the worst class i have ever taken. she talks the whole lecture & doesnt stop. very hard to focus. discussion sections are fine, but not very helpful. her wording is insane especially for the amount of time we get for the test. I have never hated a class this much before or regretted taking a class this much. stressful bc you cant see grade.

Professor Liberto is so sweet and such an amazing lecturer! Attendence is only mandatory at discussion sections, but the lectures are really helpful and you don't need to read the texts if you show up. Exams are not easy, and theres only two exams and an essay that contirbute to your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this for a GenEd. It is generally easy if you show up and pay attention you will do well on the exams without reading. She doesn't use ELMS so you don't know your final grade until the semester ends. Grade consists of a quiz (that can be replaced the midterm), a paper, and the final. Must participate in the discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Liberto is probably the best lecturer Ive ever had in college. She knows the content like the back of her hand, and the topics we covered in the course were pretty engaging and interesting. Definitely essential to attend lecture in this class to do well. Grade is determined only by the midterm and final, but getting an A is very doable.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Nice lady but not a good test creator. Midterm was extremely difficult because she would give us paragraphs to read just to answer one multiple choice question. Her wording is also extremely difficult to comprehend; especially under a time restraint. Overall this class sucked and the lectures were boring too; but if you don't go you'll fail
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: my least favorite class, talks too much and doesn't allow questions. extremely boring, the only class I've ever skipped
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This isn't an "easy A" but it is not difficult to get. It is not necessary to read the required readings before certain lectures but it will help your over understanding of the topics. Missing lectures will make you miss analogy, examples, and side notes critical to the arguments. Love Liberto's voice and way of teaching. Interesting and enjoyable!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The tests were hard and his hand writing was not the best but there are definitely worse math teachers.

The professor is okay, he basically teaches you exactly what is on the textbook and doesn't really explain further. You can't really ask questions in class because he's hard of hearing and he'll say this is basic pre-calc. Homeworks and discussion sheets are worthless. Most of your grade are the mid terms and final, so study or you'll fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Gulick is a quirky prof who definitely knows his stuff when it comes to calculus. He isn't always the greatest at explaining things (tending to focus more on the theoretical/conceptual side), but that really comes with the territory in math. The class was very much weighted to the exams which hurt my grade, but they weren't impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took professor Gulick my freshman year of college in fall 2021, was going well at first but exams that were graded quite heavily and weren't at all representative of lecture. In lecture, he only went over textbook problems and didn't really explain the process of completing them. I took a bunch of notes that I still don't understand today..
Not accommodating.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR FOR MATH140. The 8am time isn't worth it, he doesn't record his lectures, and his handwriting is small and terrible. He's also like a mathematical genius so he just expects students to know how things work (he wrote the textbook too btw). The homeworks take hours to do and are worth barely anything. Take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He got really irritable whenever people asked questions. Not approachable at all and rarely clarified himself. Tests were a nightmare. I self-studied all semester bc his explanations were super vague (he already expects you to know everything). Glad I had him online during pass-fail. Woulda tanked my GPA otherwise. Beware! ("pop quizzes" on Friday)

Gulick is a hilarious professor, he will definitely call you out during lectures. His exams are almost exactly like his practice exams but the numbers are changed. His lectures are not mandatory, but he does give a pop quiz almost every Friday
Great calculus teacher, teaches you what you need to know. Probably better in person as he is very old and not exactly tech-savvy.

He is pretty funny to be honest, but the work is hard so you do have to study and be prepared for class. Lectures are not mandatory, but he does give pop quizzes so you should definitely try to show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: An angel. I thank the math gods daily that I got into his class

He was a nice professor who, for the most part, made it clear as to what we are going to be tested on. The final exam was pretty brutal though. The homework doesn't at all match the tests. The worksheets were sometimes graded pretty harshly, but they were a good representation of what was on the exams. THE QUIZZES ARE POP QUIZZES!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: From what I've heard of other Calc profs, Gullick is probably the best bet. He tries his hardest to help everyone, sometimes he does get frustrated and loses his temper. I personally found this class to be extremely hard and I struggled all the way through. Also don't bother looking at your grade in elms, the grade weighting is incorrect.

Professor Gulick is an amazing lecturer and he knows the content inside out (YES he literally wrote the whole textbook) If you are required to take MATH 140 you should seriously consider taking his class because he is the best lecturer you can have. His test is fairly easy if you read through the previous exam. I am taking MATH 141 with him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super sweet professor, and explains things relatively clearly. However, he grades tests really hard and is picky about correctly showing work; besides that, would definitely recommend for calc 2.

Denny Gulick is a reasonable and fair teacher with a good sense of humor. HOWEVER, he is not flexible when it comes to accommodations. For example, he will not let you take the exam at an ADS location (with fewer distractions), even if it is one of your accommodations. If you have extended time, you will have to show up at 7:35/7:10.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Absolutely love Denny, he's quite funny during lecture and provides many examples to maximize your understanding of the material. However, be prepared for lots of homework on WebAssign even though it doesn't account for much of your grade. The exams account for most points needed to succeed in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hillarious teacher, very friendly, explains the concepts very well. If you look at the Testbank you'll see that all of his exams are MUCH BETTER than any other teacher. Take him for 410!

Great professor, I enjoy every second of lecture. The only thing to be careful of is his grading is sometimes unclear. He is able to liven up even his 8 am class with jokes, puns, and laughs. Also, if you sit in the back and have a question, when he asks for questions, vocalize that you have a question. I strongly recommend taking his class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Gulick is an amazing professor. Although his classes are at 8 am he is always happy and he gives amazing lectures (with tons of puns/jokes). His discussion sections are the worst part of the class ( if your TA grades for accuracy instead of completion). As long as you go to class and the test reviews you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Gulick is a great lecturer. Although his lectures may contain minor calculation errors, he goes over the material thoroughly. The averages of my class exams were 78, 83.3, 76.5, and 60. The final is tough,so if you want to do well really study all parts of the course,and not rely on the questions previously given on finals from Testbank.

Professor Gulick is amazing! I honestly think that people who are complaining that hes a bad prof are just people who dont want to put the effort into studying. Calc 2 is already a hard class, so of course people are gonna struggle. But he breaks down a lot of this material so well, and his tests are very fair. Discussion worksheets are ooff tho
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Respected

reviews.comment: Gulick is a fantastic old professor. Although he teaches a difficult class the workload is reasonable and he is extremely knowledgeable about the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Gulick's lectures mostly focus on definitions (which is difficult to understand (so don't stress out with those), but he scrambles at the end of class to give the really important examples to help with homeworks (which are very difficult), tests and quizzes. It's fair to say you'll do well if you have a good TA. Definitely go to mathsuccess.
If you attend class and take good notes, you will know whats coming for you on the tests. If you work at it, you can really ace every test, but if you slack, you won't.

He is funny during his lectures and teaches really well. The only major problem was that his grading criteria is too strict. Didn't draw the figure for a question (not asked in question)cuts 5 points out of 10. Wrote 5 lines for an answer and made a small calculation mistake at the end, cuts 10 points out of 10. If this was not there, he is awesome

TAKE HIM! HE'S SUCH AN AMAZING TEACHER! I took him for calc 1 this semester b/c of the reviews on here, and honestly it was such a good decision. Yah there are "pop" quizzes, but he goes over what's gonna be on it the lecture he gives it in. Exams are straightforward and a lot like his past exams. Definitely taking him for calc 2 next semester.

I took professor Gulick the last semester and you wouldn't believe but he is the one who actually wrote the calc book. Also, he is a very funny, kind and caring person, all the traits of an awesome professor.

He only teaches classes at 8am which could be a dealbreaker to many but to me they were sort of worth it. Never took calc in high school. Discussion worksheets are extremely hard and irrelevant to the course but thats for every math140 at umd. Tests can be hard, and theres NO partial credit. Hes very bubbly and can kinda treat us like kids lol

Professor Gulick is a gem of the UMD math department. He is so energetic and his love for calculus shows in lecture. He's still kicking it at 82! He's a strict grader: you can lose credit for the whole problem if you're careless. Go to office hours and he'll tell you exactly what he's looking for when grading. Seriously, if you can, take his class!
"Krrr!! Don't fall into the abyss!! That 2 is supposed to be a 3." Funniest professor I've had so far, but the tests are graded with barely any partial credit.
Great professor
Really is not a good professor - does make jokes but his explanations are him writing the answer on the board without explanation. Also extremely hard grader and pretty unreasonable about regrades.

One of the best professors in the math department. Sometimes he makes mistakes, but they do not take away from the teaching experience. Be prepared to study hard for each exam; pay most attention to the material he gives before each one. Worksheets are effing useless, and homeworks are time consuming, which explains why calc2 is weedout.
Hilarious, fair, and funny. His class isn't easy by any stretch of the imagination, but he is a very good teacher.

Oh Denny! Such a quirky old guy, perfect for a math professor! Calc II is hard no matter who you take it with, but Denny makes it interesting. It doesn't hurt that he wrote the textbook either.  His tests are a majority of the grade, and can be tough. If you do practice tests from past semesters you may do well though! Highly recommend this guy!

Denny is the worst math teacher I have ever had.  He is not clear with any explanations and often leaves the class in a state of confusion and desperation as the tests are hard and the curve is extremely minimal.  He can't see past the first row so any questions you have during class will not be answered.  He is to old to teach. DO NOT TAKE HIM

I loved Denny! He's an old guy, but he is adorable! He makes little math jokes in class and is pretty funny. This definitely made the class enjoyable. The class is difficult, but you should be fine as long as you go to class and put in the work. He's very helpful if you go to his office hours. He's definitely one of my favorite teachers.

Dr. Gulick is the best Calculus 1 professor that you can take. He wrote the textbook and makes calculus easy to understand if you ask him questions. He makes class enjoyable because he is so funny! He is really tough though, but as long as you study very hard for his exams and pop quizzes you will do well.

Lectures are fine,Dr. Gulick is energetic and enthusiastic. Tests are ridiculous; they often leave out the seemingly most important material and surprise you. He is very helpful one-on-one, but the material is difficult. Has surprise quizzes, even attendance quizzes when no one shows up. Very fast-paced course.Pray for a good TA
Funny guy but hard class
Amazing teacher but hard tests but totally worth it. I learned so much from him

Denny Gulick is known around campus as the best math professor you can get. A popular and true quote is "He wrote the book!" Literally, he did write the Calculus I textbook that is used. My experience was horrible because I had a COMPLETELY useless TA who sucked balls!

I love love love Gulick. He is so cute and an excellent teacher. He's old and short and makes noises that everybody laughs at. Everyone loves him. To get an A, take notes. pay attention to the things he stars. And ask for help when needed. He goes the extra mile to help his students. Class is hard though so don't ever lose track of your work.

If you attend class and take good notes, youll know whats coming for you on the tests. If you work at it, you can really ace every test, but if you slack, you wont. He often asks rhetorical questions, but then expects an answer, which can be annoying at 8am (when he usually teaches). Great teacher though.

The comments tell the story. Very caring professor who teaches in a way that everyone can understand. Is not afraid of explaining somewhat complex subject matter in different, simpler ways so that everyone will follow.
denny is the man. he makes so many jokes in the morning and is the best teacher for this class. some of his noises are hilarious too. "GRRRR"

Gulick is a great teacher.VERY ENTERTAINING. If you want to take this course with someone who really knos their stuff and will give you a giggle every now and then, Gulick is deffinatly the best choice.
Dr. Gulick is delicious.  He far outstrips any of the other professors teaching this course.  He is clear, entertaining, and grr.  Definitely worth taking an 8:00 am.

He's nothing special, but unlike the other professors he isn't bad.  His tests are fair and he makes every effort to help students learn.  If anyone fails his class, its definitely not Gulick's fault.

Awsome teacher, he wrote the book. He is very funny (he makes noises when writting on the black bored). He is always willing to help students and seems to genuinely care about us understanding the material. Just make sure you can remember the definitions he gives

I had Dr. Gulick for Calc in 1987.  He was the best professor, hands down, that I had during my tenure at UMCP.  I'm thrilled to hear that he's still teaching, still engaged and still appreciated.  Viva Denny!
Nice guy and very helpful, during class and after.  Makes the cutest noises when illustrating concepts  :)

Awesome teacher, he knows his stuff and he knows how to relay it.  He's more than glad to see you come by during his office hour and you'll be suprised how attentive he is.  He's funny and just a great person all around.  The course is not easy, but that's just the subject, but he tries to be as helpful and humerous as possible.

He is so helpful..He is very funny..He always seeks to help students..makes extra review session..He is the one that made the book so he knows what he is talking about! Great teacher I  recommend him for anyone!
He is a good teacher...if you like math.
This mofo wrote the book.  He moves quick and you can never **** the guy that wrote the book.

I took Denny a few years ago. As a teacher is about average in the hardness, but the material is dang hard. I am glad I took it with him because he really seemed to care if I understood the material or not--he is very open to helping students and makes the extra effort. Not a favorite class of mine, but one of my favorite teachers.

He makes certain comments throughout his lectures that sometimes make you laugh or smirk. I think he's not bad as a teacher but the material is slightly hard to understand. One thing, he tends to expect you to understand what he teaches quickly.

I found lectures to be the most important thing. Gulick cowrote the book used in the class, but sadly, if you have never been exposed to calculus I beforehand, the book alone is useless. Bring a print out of web assign your h/w to class and once he's done lecturing, decide whether you need help.
No Comments
He wrote the book on calculus (literally), but it's a confusing book.  He sometimes confuses more than teaches.  He's very odd but kind of loveable and hard not to look.
class is entirely dependent on the TA you have. the labs are very long and the pre labs can also be pretty long at times but they are helpful. overall easy course
He looks into a lot of things even though the TA does most of the work I wouldn't fully put the blame on him but also the TA. Maybe it was the TA that I got but I just wouldn't recommend .

This class was the easiest class of my semester. You spend the entire semester with your TA (have never met Lemke once). Extremely lucky and grateful for my TA (shoutout Amanda) and my groupmates. Only about 1-2 hours worth of work each week. There was no final or midterm..only a practical which they give you the questions before hand.
In fact, the course MATH241 is not that difficult. She is very good at teaching the course Calculus III. If you can attend the classes every time, you will be able to achieve good grades.

One of the most dishonest professors I've taken a course with. The lectures are useless, she does not allow questions during lecture, rushes through material, and leaves TA's in the dark. I can wholy say that the only person that actually taught material in the class was our amazing TA. Avoid at all costs. Seriously.

Hatice was so nice; however, avoid her as a professor at all costs. She is not a organized teacher and lacks communication skills. She often goes over the class limits and teaches topics the day before an exam. She does not post lectures; however, she teaches straight from the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you have another choice of professor, take it. While she isn't the worst professor, it's hard to pass her class. Luckily she gave mine a huge curve, but I did not enjoy the experience.
Other reviews will give us a good idea of her teaching quality but she gives giant curves
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AVOID THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU CAN!! she doesn't know how to teach properly. she makes the test seem like it's easy but once you take it, there's problems that we weren't prepared for. she already has such low expectations for the class and is fine with it. she said her final average last semester was a 65% and claimed it wasn't "that bad".

Nice person, but not a good teacher! Lectures are extremely unorganized. Looking back, my notes just looked like she wrote down whatever came to her mind about the topic she was teaching. There was ZERO structure to said notes. Do not take unless you feel like using Youtube and the textbook constantly to understand topics.

She obviously knows the math herself but when it comes to teaching, be prepared to be completely confused. She often makes mistakes during lectures making it even harder to follow. She does not record lectures. The book and YouTube will be your Bff.

If you are a person who relies on listening to lectures to primarily learn material, this is not the class for you. Get ready to spend an exorbitant amount of time on Youtube, SAShelp, Google, and other out-of-syllabus methods regardless of how well you did on 400 and 401. Her lectures are unintelligible and she never finishes her train of thought.

She is very nice but unfortunately her class is not effective when it comes to actually teaching you the material. The review material for the tests and final were lacking at best and I didn't find her lectures very effective. Her tests are incredibly easy but this makes the final impossible by comparison. The mean was a 47 and the high was a 90.

She is a great lecturer! she makes sure that everyone understands the concepts she is teaching. The homework is difficult, but she makes the quizzes really easy to make up for it. The exams are a tad difficult, but manageable. But, if you have a bad TA, you will really struggle as they are your secondary teacher.

Shes not a bad professor. Although there were weekly quizzes, they werent too difficult because we got two attempts per quiz. (This might not be the case if the class is in person.) Its definitely a class you need to study for. If you put in the effort and practice problems, youll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Please do not take her. She rambles during lecture and regularly goes 5 minutes over the class time limit. She does not provide answer keys to practice tests that she posts nor does she review them in class. Is extremely rigid with the way she teachers. Just learned 2 1/2 new sections the week before the final (the hardest sections). DONT TAKE
I'd advise reading the textbook before lectures. The TAs and professor were all helpful. I enjoyed learning the material.
Material was interesting. All the exams and quizzes are reasonable.

Weekly Quiz (makes me a wire walker), Graded only by Quiz and Exams (only reason I didn't give full credit). She tried to make STAT400 easy as long as you can keep up with the discussion. Not quite a certain standard towards grading us. Taking her course is like "just do your best, and she will take over from here". Don't worry, not too harsh.

If you want a professor who is very skilled at statistics, but lacks even the bare minimum level of communication skills expected out of a normal human, along with poor teaching strategies she is perfect for you. Expect to learn all of the content on your own time with almost no understanding of how the course will be graded in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had her for STAT430, and it wasn't great. Be prepared for topics to appear on the exams that have not been talked about in lecture. If you're looking for an easy class, this is not it.

In my experience, I found that she's not the best at teaching the material. When a large portion of your students have to use YouTube as their primary source of learning, you need to improve your teaching skills. She's also a very tough grader to add insult to injury. Don't take the class with her if you want a good teacher and a reasonable grader/

I thought her lectures were entertaining, and I liked how she showed a lot of examples for how to use the formulas. I did notice that only 1/5 of the class showed up to lectures and almost no one to discussion sections, so keep that in mind as it might be a reason people don't do well in her class/come here to give her a bad rating.

Lectures are not very helpful and often confusing. I have received A's in STAT400, STAT401, and STAT440 but I am struggling in this class because of her lectures. good class
