If you give just a tiny bit of effort you can do great in her class, only because she is so caring and good at her job! Loved her so much I took her twice.

Professor Mazzullo is such a sweetheart! She really cares about her students and is so kind. There is always something to do for this class whether it be a video quiz, lecture, class activity but it reenforced the content.

Professor Mazzullo was awesome as a professor during Fall 2020. She allowed for many chances of extra credit also allowing Test Corrections was super helpful for my grade. TAs were also very nice and the R projects were not too hard at all, she gave all the instructions. Just put a good amount of effort and you'll succeed.

Dr. Mazzullo is an extremely nice and caring professor who teaches the material in a straightforward, clear way. The only downside was that she didn't disable the chat feature in Zoom at the beginning of the semester, which allowed a bunch of annoying and pointless messages to distract everyone from learning the material.
the nicest person ever, but her desire to have everyone do well makes me say, for the first time ever, that a class was too easy.
Really great person. She wants you to succeed so if you put in the work you'll do well.

Prof Mazzullo is such a sweet and kind person, and very good at only calling on the people in the first few rows. If you sit in the back, she will literally never call on you, all you have to do is make sure you participate when she puts a quiz or something for participation points on ELMS. The other STAT teacher is good too so no worries.

Easy A. Just take all exams and quizzes, which are all super easy. There are 20 questions but they are all multiple choice or one-word answers. She says she never liked "trick questions", so she doesn't like to give them to her students in exams and quizzes... and she really doesn't. Finish all exams in max. 40 mins.

If you have the opportunity to take a class with Professor Mazzullo, please do so!!! She is one of the best professors I have ever had the pleasure to be in lecture with. She is easily the MOST INSPIRING. Her tests are fair, her reviews helpful, and she truly wants you to succeed as a student.

Mazzullo is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. She cares a lot about her students didn't want anyone to get below an A. I would say I'm not the best at math but I got an A on every exam and on top of that she lets you use a cheat sheet and do test corrections afterward. She is super nice and with her you are guaranteed to get an A.

Mazzullo is the nicest professor at UMD. She does exam corrections and gives a lot of extra credit. Averages on the exam are like 88 soooo yeh you should take the class. She's not the best lecturer so lots of people skip but, the concepts in the class are just basic statistics. It isn't that hard to learn a couple days before the exam.
Professor Mazzullo was the sweetest professor. It was very clear that she cares about all of her students and wants to see them succeed. I hope to take a class with her again in the future.
very nice professor,

Unlike most professors, she genuinely wants students to get good grades and be successful. The exam questions are very straightforward, and she gives exam study guides and online review sessions. Really kind person. Not a difficult class if you put in moderate effort.
All exams are cumulative. No graded HW. Very caring. Recorded exam reviews. Long exams (midterm 2 was 30 questions, midterm 3 was 20 questions).

She clearly puts a lot of effort into the class and is responsive via email. She hosts optional online review sessions before exams -- something I've never seen any professor at UMD do in three years. Grading is more than fair. The class itself isn't too difficult. Highly recommended.

For this class we were testing a new software called Acrobatiq. Acrobatiq was not my favorite textbook software but it was manageable and not the worst. Susan was a great professor and energetic. Come to class , pay attention, and you will be fine. Not to mention, there were alot of opportunities for extra credit ,so she wants you to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: We used an online textbook that was more busy work than anything. She's a super nice lady, but I'm not sure how much people actually learned in this class. Tests are easy, just be sure to self teach a lot. She gives out a bunch of extra credit in forms of surveys, so be on the lookout for that. Online TopHat questions count for attendance.
This class was easy. I skipped most of the readings needed for the online quizzes, then only needed to study the night before the tests to still get As.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: LOTS of Acrobatiq. Lots of Tophat. Start of class seems super easy but the grading criteria is very weird. GO TO DISCUSSION IF YOU WANT A GOOD GRADE. Susan is super nice but she can get fed up with class's lack of effort. Make sure to do acrobatiqs on time. tests were kind of hard, but she did allow a 8x11 formula sheet

avoid if you're taking for a gen ed, there are easier classes and professors out there. had to do so much work, speeches, and debates that were unnecessarily hard. he was a very hard grader for no reason, gave mid lectures, and graded attendance.

He is a nice guy but the class is pretty boring, not a lot of value add. He is potentially the toughest grader I have ever encountered, unless you do everything perfectly you will not get an A on any assignment, this is supposed to be an easy gened. Easy class, tough professor grading wise.
Feedback was lacking, but a pretty easy course.

Lectures were useless but still have to show up to them since there are graded short presentations every class. He gives unnecessarily harsh grades for a gen ed. You will not get an A on the major presentations if you're anything short of a perfect public speaker, which is ridiculous since the class is a gen ed.

The class is honestly really fun and Swift clearly cares about his students. There is a lot of homework but usually, it's almost never hard and can be done within 30 minutes. Would highly recommend it to fellow classmates who are actually interested in improving their skills in oral communication.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Its an okay class. Lecture attendance is MANDATORY! You get points each lecture just by showing up. You also have weekly in class presentations that you cant prepare beforehand for. Theres 5 major presentations that are filmed and you can redo before submitting. Hes a tough grader and pretty boring. Would not recommend if you want to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Unnecessarily harsh grader for a gen ed class.

He's a chill professor, difficulty is at a low and he's definitely a good professor to deal with. Assignments aren't too time consuming and aren't difficult. You can skip some of the readings, it's really a stress free class I highly recommend it.
None of the assignments are necessarily hard, but they all require a lot of work/different assignments. You can tell he cares about the students and the topic, it can just be a bit boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's probably one of the more uncompromising teachers at the University. Although the class may not be that hard, don't expect him to care about you if a situation arises where you cannot meet deadlines. His presentations and lectures are very useless. Be ready to learn how to speak by reading a textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I am not a COMM major, but I thought he was a decent professor. COMM458D is about deception in public discourse so there is a nice history element. There are 2 group presentations and 2 papers, but the first paper is really a draft of the final. Respond to his feedback and you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Good class. Some of the readings/videos were quite interesting but others were dry. He sometimes gave brief lectures which were stimulating and well put together. He has a bit of a flat affect, but I like that about him. Had to put a good bit of effort into the class, but nothing crazy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is a GenEd requirement that's meant to be an easy A. He seems real chill at the beginning of the semester, and I actually thought I was going to breeze through this class. Heck no! He's such a tough grader and has no respect or consideration for how much effort his students put in, and his assignments are WAY over the top.

This is a GenEd requirement that's meant to be an easy A. He seems real chill at the beginning of the semester, and I actually thought I was going to breeze through this class. Hell no! He's such a tough grader and has no respect or consideration for how much effort his students put in, and his assignments are WAY over the top.

This is supposed to be an easy A, but instead I got a B-. He is an overly harsh grader and gives feedback/criticism for our drafts too late. Class was so boring and he liked to talk too much. I did not like this class at all.
Does not give you feedback until late

Dr. Sweeting is great! His class is fairly difficult, but he goes over the homework in class and is responsive to questions. It would have been nice if he was a bit more transparent about his grading scale at the beginning of the semester, but he curves generously. Also offered a lot of flexibility with COVID in regards to deadlines and exams.
Professor sweeting is the best Economics Professor I ever had a UMD. He was caring, available to answer all questions. He was a kind grader and just a decent brilliant human being.
u must be a genius to get an A

Dr. Sweeting is an absolute expert on Industrial Organization, and all his other classes he teaches are graduate level, and it definitely shows in his teaching. He teaches some rather advanced material but doesn't test on all of it. Homeworks are fairly difficult (teamwork highly recommended) but tests are fare easier. Curves. Don't freak out.
He was great. The lectures were interesting and easy to follow. The homework were easy. The tests were long but they were simple. Easy grader. The TA was very helpful and kind as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Swenson was an OK Professor. His lectures were good and the HW was actually easy! The only thing are his LONGG exams. The exam was open for 12 hrs and it took me 7 hrs to do non-stop. There were extremely long essay questions that were worth more than half of the exam points. No extra credit. And I had a 89% in his class but he wont round up :)
The lectures were interesting and it was fun to learn about ecology. The class is math heavy but its simple. Tests were fair but time consuming. The work in this class was not time consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Use the textbook and take detailed notes you can refer to. This class is not a lot of work for a four credit upper level biology class. I recommend it. What you don't have in assignments though you make up for with the long exams and essay questions. I think it was an easy class though.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were pretty interesting and content was fine. He posts the powerpoints, but you can't rely on them to pass the exams. Discussion was helpful when reviewing topics, but not when reviewing papers - but still go. Exams are very conceptual and questions are often confusingly worded. Grading is sometimes lenient and sometimes very picky/harsh.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class did not require much work, which is an odd for a four credit stem class. This class has a homework and discussion worksheets that are graded, which are fair. However, the exams were very difficult and graded very harshly. They were all short answer responses and took me the entire day to do. The exams did not represent hw or discussion.
One of the worst professors I have ever met. This professor shows no empathy and does not care about anything. I am warning, DO NOT TAKE his class. You will regret.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The lectures were interesting, not too much homework or discussion work. The exams were super hard and exhausting though, and usually took me the entire day to finish. He also graded them pretty harshly. He is a nice guy though, and didn't expect too much from his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is not good at answering emails, don't even bother you will not get one back! He does not care about his students what so ever and just gives vague lectures and expects the class to be able to write paragraphs on exams. avoid at all costs. there are no resources to help, no gss, no review sheets, the TA also give resources
He is an awful professor with no empathy for his kids in a global pandemic. Makes homework and exams so difficult with no guidance during "online lectures". Avoid this professor at all costs.

He doesn't take attendance but going to class is really helpful. He posts the slides but they wont make sense unless you go to class or get notes. He's a good lecturer and pretty easy to pay attention to.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Swenson is a great teacher! His lectures were so interesting and he makes jokes every now and again. There are 4 test and they are all short answer but he is a very lenient grader. He is so knowledgeable about ecology and I enjoyed the class. You have the read a lot of scientific papers for discussion but it is not difficult.

Bethany Swain is a tough professor. Cannot lie to you. She's got high expectations but if you pay attention to the lectures, practice and listen to her feedback and critiques, you will come out of her class so much better for it. She genuinely cares about students and teaching them skills that they'll be able to utilize far into their careers.

Bethany cares more about her students than any professor in the school. Sometimes it reaches a point of being corny, but seriously, she cares. She is super flexible and tries to help every student excel. You have to go to class but she doesn't waste your time. Things could get tedious but I really can't complain.

This professor discriminates students with a documented learning disability and has ridiculed them. This professor with neither help students with learning disabilities in her videography courses nor with any other opportunities. Stay away from her! I was severely left behind by this professor and a very bad experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor is very rude and harsh to students. She berates students for making mistakes when it comes to videography/visual storytelling. She does not care about her students at all as she claims. She does not provide help to students. She leaves students to fend for themselves and isn't accommodating or nice to learning disabled students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Bethany's class is difficult but if you have a chance to take her class, do it. My work was the strongest in her class, it's the closest thing you'll get to real world experience. Your work will drastically improve. She's very blunt but this will only help you. Don't ever think she won't catch a tripod in your shot. She will support you forever.

This professor was not nice to the students. She was very mean and was yelling at students. She left the students behind to have her second child. She does not care about what happens to the students. She is inconsiderate of individual students' needs. I hate Bethany Swain.
Bethany is a great teacher. She does challenge you, but you will walk away from the class knowing so much. If you have the chance to take her class, don't miss out! She knows her stuff!

She was absolutely wonderful. Her lectures were engaging and she did a good job communicating concepts and providing examples to help explain the concepts. Her proofs were pretty easy to follow and she uploads her lecture notes. I only wish there were more practice problems provided.

Dr. Anna has my heart. She's a great lecturer and very clear while teaching concepts. Attend all discussions since worksheets are worth 7%. It is not mandatory to attend lectures but I wouldn't miss them. She posts the notes on ELMS after the class since she uses an iPad. Definitely take her class. She's wonderful!
I love Anna! Such a good professor.
Explains topics in a way that is easy to understand
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had at UMD. She truly cares about her students and if you ever have any issues she is more than willing to work it out with you, even on a whims notice. She is accessible outside of class and gave us her number should we ever need it. She grades fairly and gives straightforward guidelines in regards to assignments.

*MUST TAKE*
Professor B is an easy grader and truly cares about her students. She even gave us her phone number! She allows you to re-do all the assignments for a better grade except the finals. The finals were an individual e-portfolio and a group project proposal. The work is time-consuming, but you should easily be able to get an A.

Probably the most amazing professor Ive had. She is so nice, respectful and gives excellent feedback. She is super helpful and just wants you to leave the class with some knowledge. No textbook needed because she provides all the resources. Asks about how the student is feeling. She is just a warm person and I like her very much.

Professor B is the most kind and caring professor I've ever had. The class isn't perfect, but made the PWP requirement virtually painless. She helped create an atmosphere in the class, which was small, that was intimate and friendly. Gave great feedback on papers, and would always want to check in to make sure you were doing well. Take her class!

Professor B is so incredibly kind and thoughtful. She is also an extremely lenient grader. It is an easy A with her! You have a lot of assignments though, so beware. But they all build off of eachother, so it's quite easy to complete them all. IT'S HEAVY GROUP WORK TOO. But I had a good experience. She is accessible 24/7, literally. She is awesome.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: All assignments are step by step and prepare you for the next assignments. There are first drafts, peer reviews, and final drafts for every assignment. The professor is very easy to talk to and very nice. She will help you if you need anything. The class works together in groups and the environment is very supportive, easily the best class at UMD.

The class is structured to make sure students learn the material and things are not graded blindly. The professor is very kind and accommodating and wants all of her students to succeed. If any student reaches out to her, the professor works with them and grants them more opportunities. The class becomes a family and is one of the best classes.

Her lectures are a mess, she's unclear with directions for assignments (although she penalizes you for small details), and she follows know specific grading rubric. Don't be surprised to see your grade decline rather than increase throughout the course due to her unhelpful feedback and unfair grading.

Professor Bialas was practically a mom in this course (and she literally tells you this the first day). She checked up on us throughout the semester on our assignments and made sure we were doing okay. Although this class had loads of papers, she graded pretty easily and gave good feedback. Lectures were hilarious as well. Definitely recommend.
Prof B. is one of my favorite professors I've ever had. She cares about all of her students so much and makes that clear. Also she's hilarious, and an easy grader.

Dr. Swann is a "chill" professor, but doing well in his class is extremely difficult for no reason. He gives no resources outside of class time, no rubric for any assignments, and uses many out-of-date sources in class. To do well, you must attend every class, do all assignments, hope he likes your work, and rely on your recall skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I had Swann in spring of 24. He is an interesting professor who has a lot to say. He also has related stories and he really pushed us to understand, think critically, and see a bigger picture of the world. His communication outside of class was not the best, but I don't fault him for it b/c of UMD bureaucracy. Overall he is 100% worthwhile.

Hes very personable and down to earth but he just misses the mark. For a simple 200-level course he's made it pretty inaccessible. No rubric, harsh grades, and little to no study materials. Everything you learn is word of mouth so you must attend lectures and take thorough notes. And he won't clarify most things. Gives extensions but is lacking.

Danny is entertaining but is VERY disorganized as a teacher. He is unclear about when assignments are due and about the criteria for the assignments. He will mention an assignment briefly once and then won't mention it again until the day before it is due. He often gives pop quizzes with specific stats that nobody could remember which was annoying.

he's good, and his lectures are interesting and funny, but he is very unorganized, there is no syllabus, and don't even bother trying to send him an email bc he won't respond. not very accomodating, but if ur taking the class just for the material, its a good class

The beginning of the semester was great, he was super chill. It was a really fun lecture to start my day with. Maybe being online got to him, but by the end of the semester he started to be really condescending. Be sure to to listen to all small lecture details to pass pop quizzes, and don't expect much clarification on his paper and video prompts.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: At the beginning of the course I liked Professor Swann because he seemed chill and funny, but by the end, I dreaded going to lecture. He was condescending to the students and wasn't great at answering our questions and concerns. There are also several pop quizzes that are pretty hard if you don't pay super close attention in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Danny is by far one of the best teachers Ive ever had. Even online and in a group of almost 40 he was able to keep the class very personal and informal. The workload isnt bad at all and he answers questions really quickly. Beyond that, Ive actually learned from his class, which cant be said for a lot of other online classes. Take his class!!!!

Professor Swann is super chill, understanding, and funny. But, he is super unorganized when it comes to Canvas, and giving assignments. Lectures are interesting, and he shares lots of personal stories. One flaw is that he does not provide feedback on any assignments, and gives a few pop quizzes. Also, he gave us a project 1 week before our final.

Dr. Swann is great. He makes learning super easy. Make sure you participate in discussions. Only complaint is that only a few things are graded. You won't want to miss class he tells a bunch of funny jokes during class to keep it interesting.
Incredibly cool dude.

Professor Swann was easily my favorite professor freshman year. His material was super interesting and he definitely cares about what hes teaching. I would recommend his class to anyone. He is also hilarious, which is always a plus. Beware, he will call you out if you say something stupid lol. Online class was very bearable with him, loved it!
DANNY THE GOAT NO CAP

Great professor. Class is an easy A if you put some effort. Beware of pop quiz even though most of them are only attendance. He allows you to drop 2 quizzes out of 7 quiz. Class is fun and I learned a log about our society. Definitely recommend.

Dr. Swann is PHENOMENAL and made me want to become a sociology major. If you like a more laidback class I would definitely take his SOA 100 class at Goucher. As long as you're really interested in the material (and trust me you will be) then it's very doable.

He was a good professor, very chill and I enjoyed going to lecture. He was opinionated and I often disagreed with him, but he did present both sides of issues. I was frustrated by his disorganization, and it felt like the end of the semester crept up on him but I did like the class. Pretty easy A if you pay attention in lecture.
Great guy. There are pop quizzes some of them were take home. Also a group project and paper. One midterm and a final. Overall would recommend Swann if you have to take socy 105.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: If I were rating Swann as a person, I would give him 6/5 stars. He is funny, engaging, respectful to students, and super cute. But, as a professor he tends to be disorganized; he does not follow his syllabus at all he uses as little tech as possible. Lectures were still fun and interesting and he grades SUPER easy.

This is my first year at UMD and I just wanna say that Prof. Daniel Swann is sooooooo cool. He is really nice and approachable unlike some of my other professors. He is so hilarious and you will really love this class. The class discussions were so interesting. I'd take this class again even if it was for no credit!
He is a really funny and great teacher! You definitely have to go to class though because he does not post lecture slides online but you will be able to write down all the notes in class.

Really nice, laid back guy. Every class with him was fun and interesting, and it's clear he's passionate and knowledgeable about what he's teaching. However, he's not great at time management and a lot of our projects and quizzes were shoehorned into the last 2 weeks of class, which wasn't fun. Also, pop quizzes are surprisingly hard.

Took his Intro to Sociology class online. There were 2 papers, a midterm, and a final plus weekly discussions. He wasn't interactive at all in the discussion posts; the best way to reach him seemed to be via text/call. He did post occasional videos. The topics covered were interesting, and if you submit everything on time, easy A. :)

His lectures are very interesting and interactive with his students. He focuses more on informing his students on the content and society rather than testing the students and grading. Did take a while to find out what my grade was... but overall, great guy and professor.

Dr. Swann is a cool dude. He is chill and very understanding. He uses humour and relatable notes to teach. He has a lot of powerpoints that he does not share. Be prepared to take pictures of slides and or find someone who can take good notes. He does not like a lot of study guides but is willing to make them if the majority of the class asks.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I learned a lot from his class and Dr. Swann obviously knows his stuff and is really passionate about sociology. He was understanding when I approached him about any concerns I had with the class. His lectures were always fun and enjoyable and he inserts his own anecdotes that make the material all the more interesting. Only problem, he grades late
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Danny treats us like equals. I loved it. Empowers us to say what we want, but also to learn while we are. Made my first semester here. Run to this class and to Swann!
Easy class, lit teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Would take again

reviews.comment: 106 Easy because it was easy to pay attention. Almost always an interesting day in class. He does grade participation.

He's a cool dude and can be laid back, however, when needs to give assessment they are very difficult. This is the perspective of a Goucher student since he has since moved from University of Maryland to Goucher College.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Swann is a young guy so he doesn't care much for giving out too many assignments or assigning chapter readings. His class is heavily reliant on listening him speak on social issues. Quizzes and exams are extremely easy with extra credit opportunities. However, be ready to present group projects and current events. Very easy and interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Favorite class in my 3 years. Lectures are worth it even though his style takes a little getting used to.
Much to read, not very active with class participation and grades late....
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Best lectures I've ever been to. Me and most of my friends that took him think he's the best professor here. Can go a little fast through notes but he really cares about the material that he's teaching.
Expect this class to be lots of fun! Academically and verbally (you'll see).  Lots of material and he doesn't share his lecture slides so be sure to do good notes
Swann is my favorite professor I've had at UMD so far. He's awesome. I would definitely take another class of his.
He's really fun and has a laid back, chill, teaching style. His opinions influence a lot of his teaching, but makes a lot of eye-opening and significant points about society and our generation.
Honestly one of the best classes I've taken at UMD. Such an incredible teacher who wants you to learn and actually cares about his students. Made my year so much better.
Loved the class. I actually looked forward to going, and the project was fun.

Great class.  If you have to take SOCY105 you have to take it with him.  The pop quizzes are easy, the two test are easy and we had two papers that where only 4-5 pages each and that was easy also. The group project was fun and easy( just make sure you choose the right people for your group).  All in all a great class!

Danny Swann's class was very interesting and informative. He teaches by showing a lot of short youtube videos on the topic we are talking about. The two papers we had to write were very easy and so was the group video project. I would recommend taking this professor if you are taking Social Problems.

Great class, easy A. His tests and quizzes are a breeze. You do get a group project, but it was actually fun and all groups got an A on it. He shows lots of videos to go with his lecture. He teaches material based off what he thinks we would be interested in. I recommend Swann's class

Easy A!! Take this class, but ONLY with Swann. He is a young guy and explains everything in everyday language. He does give pop quizzes but if you go to class, they're easy. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK. Never did we actually need the book. His tests are easy along with his papers and projects. Great class and cool teacher.

I felt like he was good at lecturing and made the content clear and concise.  He is a bit monotone which may make him seem unintentionally rude.  Homeworks are very hard, but they prepare you well for the exams. The content is VERY hard but that's not his fault.  Overall good experience, he gave us donuts and pizza at the end of the semester too :)

I had this online, maybe not the best experience. The homeworks aren't bad but can suck a lot of time. Lectures were good sometimes, but confusing and really fast to the end. Content required effort and the exams were horrible. Work on your time management, you will run out in an exam. Overall not an awful course but not great.
not too bad. Favorite part was when he talked bout his kids
Hes boring, but handsome. That being said, he should probably shave. The concepts arent too difficult, but it makes me fall asleep.

Taylor York was a great Professor overall she was very caring and took pride in making sure the class understands the lecture materials. She also doesn't grade harsh and is very considerate. If your looking for a good elective to take I suggest you take this one with Taylor York you won't regret it.
PROFESSOR YORK IS THE BEST Y'ALL. I LOVE THEM

Professor York is genuinely an amazing professor, both inside and outside of class. Theres a lot of reading, however they review the readings in detail in class. They are very understanding of students needs, and will shift things around after grabbing a consensus of how the class is feeling. Assignments are pretty straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I cannot say enough good things about Taylor. Lots of reading, but discussions really help to solidify the key ideas you should take away from each module. They are very understanding of the fact that students have work for other classes and they really seemed to care about our mental health. It was refreshing to have Taylor as professor.

I loved this class! Taylor made an effort to make our discussions engaging despite being online and you could tell they really care about the material. Very understanding and willing to give you extensions. A bit reading heavy but nothing that long or difficult. Not many assignments and they weren't hard at all. Can't recommend enough!

Taylor is an excellent professor. Very caring and understanding and would often offer extensions on assignments without us even asking. You can tell they really care about the material and despite the class being online, Taylor made an effort to make discussions engaging and meaningful. The assignments were not difficult at all. Highly recommend!
I would definitely take this class again. All the discussions are very interesting and you don't have so much homework.
Prof. York is AMAZING!!! One of the best classes ever! Highly recommend, especially with them!

Take Taylors class! The class is very discussion based and was super interesting to talk about. You do have a good amount of reading to do, but nothing that is too much to handle. We have maybe one assignment every week that was super easy. Do all the readings, participate, and do the assignments and youll get an A.

Dr. Tchetcherina is extremely nice and you can tell she cares about teaching us the material rather than being a harsh grader. Heavy accent, but she tries her best and you get used to it. 50% of the class grade is a group project, but she lets you resubmit if you get a bad grade. Would highly recommend her!

English is not her first mother language but she tries so hard to make sure students understand the materials. If you misunderstand and make mistakes in the reports/projects, just meet her. She gives you a second chance. Very nice. Well-respected professor at UMD math dept.
STAT400 is pretty easy if you take her

OK, she's not a great professor, but it's not because she's a tough grader, gives hard exams, or is mean. She is very nice, but her lectures are tough to understand and somewhat disorganized. Everything is on the PPT though, and the exams often have problems exactly from practice tests but with a few numbers changed. It's an easy A so whatever.

She is a nice person, but she is a very bad lecturer. Main reason people went to lecture was because there was graded attendance. Her English is poor, making it very difficult to understand what she is saying. She also explains things very poorly, many times just writing formulas on the board without much explanation as to why or when theyre useful

She isn't a clear lecturer, and reads off slides without explaining anything clearly. The textbook is online and she doesn't assign text problems that will help with the web assign or exam. The web assign questions are rather dissimilar to what is on the exam and the whole course feels like a whole lot of struggle to end up not learning anything

It pains me to write this, because she's such a nice woman, but Miss Tchetcherina may be the worst teacher I've ever had :( She's very smart, but her lectures are borderline useless, and she cannot effectively answer your questions.  Her saving grace is that her practice tests are direct mirrors of the actual tests, making them very easy.

Horrendous public speaker. This is clearly evident when you attempt to listen to her lectures. Spent more effort trying to understand what she was saying rather then the actual material being taught; exactly why I gave up on her lectures and just read the textbook. Her lectures slides are horrible as well and she just reads off of the slides.

amazing prof! his lectures make the material easy and fun. a large portion of his exams are conceptual true or false questions so make sure you actually understand the material! by far one of my favorite math classes I've taken. if you miss any lectures, he has youtube videos you can watch to catch up.

God awful professor. I made the mistake of taking him because of the reviews here. A poorly structured class combined with a terrible professor is an awful combo. He puts minimal effort into his boring lectures and the instructions are unclear and confusing. Also, my guy has a fake email on the syllabus because he will not respond to your emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Linear Algebra is definitely a step into new waters for anyone, and Terrance taught it well and provided us with helpful lecture slides to learn from. Quite the caring guy and I'd say the only annoying thing about this class was the fact that he made the MatLab projects group ones :/ (I don't like group projects :P).
A funny guy with a straightforward way of teaching. He makes things clear and takes time to explain concepts so that everyone can understand them.

Terence is hilarious, fun, happy, and every class is one that I look forward to. He does, however, give VERY difficult exams. If you're not comfortable with your grade being determined almost entirely by quizzes and exams, he isn't the professor for you. Only take him if you're very comfortable with math, and don't mind having to work a ton!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best professors you could have for math. He teaches very well and does his best to make sure that everyone understands the material. The exams are extremely fair to what you are learning. Rewatch videos anytime because YouTube :)

Professor Long is a great lecturer. The exams and homework were fair, as were the matlab projects. The final exam was significantly harder than anything else but since class was online, we were given 2 days to complete it. If you have questions, he will answer them and explain the concept in depth

Dr. Long is a laid back, but captivating professor who teaches the material in a straightforward, clear way. The assignments and exams weren't tricky or confusing at all, and he made sure to be as accommodating as possible during the pandemic.

Great professor. I try to take him for every math I possibly can. His mat labs are easy and done in groups. Calc III is a decently hard course but is very do-able when Terence is your professor!No homework which is great. Weekly quizzes in discussion. Very understanding about grades and answers emails promptly. He also is super entertaining :)
Dr. Long is a funny, easy and very intelligent guy. He is not organized, but yet, take him.

Dr. Long was a great professor for MATH461 (which is very similar to MATH240). He was articulate, provided a ton of examples in class and was great at describing things that may have been confusing in class. I only said it was lecture heavy as I took the course over the summer, so it was in an expedited format.
Had a great experience in MATH240 this semester. Terence gives good lectures and wants his students to succeed. Highly recommend

Terence is a phenomenal lecturer. His midterms and quizzes are fair, and he gives a generous end-of-semester curve. However, the final blindsided everybody (the average was a D) and was substantially harder than any other exam. Apart from the final, everything about Terence and his class is great.

The best Professor you can get for higher math! Prof. Long is a very gifted math teacher and a caring human being. He explains the material clearly and offers support during his office hours if you need it. His tests and quizzes are well matched to the material that he lectures on. He genuinely wants his students to succeed; no curveballs here.

Dr. Long is a great professor. For how difficult MATH141 is for a lot of students, Long makes the class bearable. The lectures were very useful because he presents the information in a very systematic way, and his sense of humor makes it much more enjoyable. Exams are straight forward and he doesn't give minus grades.

Terence's class was great. Attendance and homework were optional, and the MATLAB projects were pure grade fluff. As long as you show up to most lectures and do well on the quizzes, you should do well on the exams and in the class overall.

Professor long was great. He was extremely clear about the format and content of exams and quizzes. He was considerate and very understanding of circumstances. Coming to class was definitely necessary because there was new material daily, but I rarely did work outside of class. Also, he doesn't use the +/- system, which is amazing. Loved him!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best professor ever. Very nice, funny and smart. His class is very doable and he's accessible outside class. Exams were fair

This is the first time I've felt that a professor truly enjoyed teaching the students and enjoyed what they were teaching. His nerdy humor is always perfectly timed as calculus 2 can become a bit dry at times. Plus, his passion for math, in general, makes me that much more interested.

This guy is great! He's really good at simplifying the material. He really just wants you to pass too. He doesn't do minus grades but he does plus grades. We had online homework that he gave us 100% for at the end of the semester if we had 75% of the points. He prepares you for his exams, but the final exam is a gamble since he doesn't make it.

Lectures were okay, he does the simple problems from the textbook. The exam problems were not too difficult but not easy either. Overall, as long as you do practice problems, you'll do fine. He also curves a little and doesn't give minus grades (which is nice).

Professor Long was one of the best math professors I've had. He taught really well and explained all material with interest. He's a really chill guy who likes teaching as much as he likes Mountain Dew. Not a hard grader but expects you to understand the material. Going to lectures really help understanding all the subjects so go to them.

Terence Long is by far my favorite professor at UMD. His notes were really helpful and even uses some examples for the exam. His exams were fair and straightforward. I was never a math person, but I've definitely learned the most from him. I wish all my professors were as passionate about their course as he is about calculus.

Terence Long is probably the best professor you could have for this class. He is so laid back and friendly and also makes the class super easy to understand and do well in. He is very fair on all his exams and quizzes and always tells you exactly what you need to know. He is the angel you need in your life to have a stress-free semester :)

Great guy. He's funny, and genuinely wants everyone to do well. If you go to class, he will do example problems that you'll find are very similar to those on his exams. You get some great stories during class, and he teaches in a way that is easy to understand (for me, at least). Go to every class, and take notes. I never did the homework tho

Long is nice and pretty laid back. He wears t-shirts that have his favorite bands and video games on it everyday. He explains topics well and doesnt do (-) grading. For discussion he doesnt do worksheets and has about 10 quizzes randomly throughout the semester and he doesnt drop any.

He's a really cool guy who really wants his students to understand the material and is willing to put the time in for his students. He does not give pop quizzes and is very straightforward with tests and quizzes. He gives a lot of practice problems. Cool, laidback person in general. He does review sessions the class before a test, which is helpful.

T. Long really wants you to do well which makes calc much more manageable. He is always available for questions and helps you out a lot when it comes to grading. 10/10 would takes Long for another class.

Prof. Long takes generally disliked subject matter and makes it fun and interesting with his very nerdy spin. He is nice and sympathetic, and wants to help. He also has a very generous no minus grades policy on top of a slight curve. Discussions occasionally have quizzes but also help explain the material, which covers a wide range of calc subjects
Teli is pretty solid, at least for 250. He gave in person quizzes and exams vs Cliff's online ones though, so that's something to keep in mind.

Teli was good and caring lecturer, and was fair with exam questions in my opinion. I think he would sometimes go a bit fast, but when you needed a question answered he was very patient and responded respectfully. I would  not mind taking Teli again.

He's a good lecturer. He is very clear about what is going to be on quizzes and exams. He takes his time during lecture and answers questions well. He frequently takes pauses during lecture to make sure everyone is understanding the material being presented. Very solid choice. I would take again.

Teli gives good lectures (especially online where chat makes it easier to ask questions), but his exams are so brutal and completely different from the homework. And the practice exams. Yeah, the practice exams in this class are worthless. This is a class that needs some major changes, but in its current state, I suppose Teli is a good option.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Teli is not a bad professor and by no means a bad guy.... However, this course is taught and structured(pun not intended) absolutely terribly. It honestly seems as though the class sets students up for failure, especially how tough everything is graded. This is unfortunate for CS majors since it is required. Exams were brutal, just hope to pass.

reviews.comment: He is very patient with his students and wants to make sure students understand the topic before moving on. Always happy to go back and reexplain things if needed. There are weekly HWs and 2 exams that were pretty fair

So nice a Prof!
There's nothing wrong with him. He helps and exams are at times lengthy but if you know the material well you'll do good. Great professor!

reviews.comment: He is a great professor; he really cares about the student's understanding of the material.

However, the classes are completely useless, lectures are either common-sense knowledge or YouTube videos you could've watched alone, and instructions for assignments are abhorrently unclear.

Yes this class can be stressful, but the class provides a solid foundation in entrepreneurship and a competitive environment where groups develop their own businesses, enhancing teamwork and decision making skills. This professor does not acknowledge the TA's relationships with the students. worst professor ever
She gives a lot of work to students but it pays off in the end.

so annoying pls never take her

EXTREMELY UNPROFESSIONAL! Due dates and other info didn't match Canvas. She gave very short notice for major assignments. She just gambled half our grades because most of us weren't prepared. Don't take her class.

The grading in this class makes zero sense. The worst class I have ever taken

A big portion of your grade is based on a group project

Lots of papers due for homework but assignments are generally easy. She's a pretty interesting lecturer and lots of guest speakers throughout the semester. Only drawback is her belief that everything can be improved, so you likely won't earn full credit on paper-style assignments.

Lots and lots of homework, but they're all easy essays about yourself/social entrepreneurship. Bunch of group projects, and 2 main presentations. Thamire is an ok guy, but his class is hard. The homework is time-consuming. Anytime my friends or I would email him with questions he would respond with answers that were unhelpful. Worst experience ever. I won't take this professor again

Awful, just plain inconsiderate. He expects way too much time from you. In addition, EXTREMELY difficult quizzes/test.

This is from a Fall 2018 student, so my experience was a messy mix. Do not skip out on Discussions or the homework will be a painful chore for you. GREAT
By far the best professor I have ever had. Nice guy, very helpful, and really knows his stuff. Exams are fair, even holds review sessions before each.

By far the nicest professor I have had so far. He takes his time in lecture to make sure everyone understands; gives fair exams and homework; and is never condescending. The class is a lot of work, but Thamire helps keep it interesting.

Great Teacher.  He's really overworked in the department so it'll take him a while to get grades back to you.  Aside from that he is willing to give you the time you need to complete your projects and he's willing to help you every step of the way.

He expects a lot from you.  He'll always extend deadlines and if you need more time that's fine because it will take him a while to get any grades back to you.  Good teacher; really cares about his students and that they're learning.  Very, very helpful and understanding person.  Do well on the reports/presentations and you will be fine.
Learnt a lot from him.
He wants you to learn. Take him!
Great professor. Will teach you what is needed for your engineering career and not just exam problems.
Best professor in courses I have taken here so far
Great Professor

He has an accent, but it's not bad at all. His lectures are boring, but its the material... not his fault. He really wants his students to do well, and he is very willing to help anyone out. He's very lenient in grading, and gave us extra credit for attendence. He's very respectful of other students and is a great professor. I highly recommend him.
Great Professor.
She is extremely passionate about landscape architecture, and the class is very easy as long as you come to lectures. Very caring and exceptional professor

I took this class for my gen ed requirement and although not all of the lectures were the most interesting, she tried her best to make them more exciting. reviews.comment: Professor Tjaden is funny and cool. Pretty easy B+ to A- if you go to lectures. There are 4 pop quizzes during lecture and a semester long project. Textbook is only necessary for a few pages.

(I took 282, not 405). The class lacked structure. He grades based on his "judgment," not the rubric & deducts points w/o reasoning. He doesn't take attendance but heavily considers it when grading assignments. The class covers design thinking & the business model canvas--both can be easily searched & learned online within a matter of minutes.

Dr. Tilley really cares about making classes interactive and entertaining. He made the material easier to grasp with great in class examples. Make sure to attend lectures and participate and you'll be fine! One of the best teachers at umd imo.
Very rude. Makes you feel stupid if you don't understand something.

This is class is about what? This class is a total mash..... You have no idea what he is trying to teach. Unstructured, unprepared, spontaneous. This is one of those classes  that you don't learn much, but you will get an A.
Tilley is laid back, and welcomes discussion. Tests are over lecture material. Some online assignments. Understanding concepts can be a little hard. Go to lecture and ask questions.
No Comments

We struggled not to learn the content but to show him we did A very kind very old man but hes a very confused (rarely understood our Qs) & stubborn prof Hes horrible with tech doesnt post any resources just have to be @ lecture or read txtbk Exams make up 90% of ur grade & he failed 40% of us Dont rec unless 222 wasnt bad for u & u dont mind txtbks

HE FAILED OVER 50% OF THE CLASS!! He is a nice man, but does not believe the way he grades or teaches is a problem. The only thing I can say is take this course if you want to experience the worst. 
DON'T TAKE THIS COURSE!

reviews.comment: Teaches well and directly, keeping it simple and short. Likes to ask questions to people during classes, be awake. Gave one homework per week and was very punctual. Even though the class is a hard one he managed to keep it consistent and ease a bit, within what was possible.
Good teacher. I liked the class and would recommend it to others. (Keep it clean) makes engineering fun and fun!
He is a very nice person. Great at explaining stuff. His grading is very fair. Exam reviews help a lot in preparations for exams.
Very good lecturer. Explains concepts very well. Emphasises heavily to ask questions.

Probably the best EE professor I've had.  He actually cares about the students and is willing to help anyone who wants to put the effort in to succeed.  His exams are not jokes, but they are fair and reasonable, and accurately test your knowledge of the material.  If you give an honest effort you have a very good chance to get an A.
Dr**** is one of  the best professors in this university. He teaches very well and is very helpful. He is highly reccomended for 322, 244. He cares a lot about his students. Ideal professor.

Dr.**** is an excellent teacher.  The signals and systems is a theoretical class, so Dr.**** focuses on the concepts.  I learned alot from his style of teaching.  Not only does he know the stuff, but he is interested in making sure you learn it too.  Hes dosent make you learn everything from the book (like bad prof.'s do).  Go to Review Sesions!

Professor**** is by far my favorite professor in the EE department.  His classes are challenging, but there is no other professor that is so devoted to his/her students' success.  Professor**** does everything in his power to ensure his students understand the material.  His grading is very fair, and his teaching style is excellent.
Dr**** is an excellent professor, he is highly recommended for 322 and 244.

tries to make thing harder than they need to be

Professor Canty's teaching style is very casual, and he is clearly very interested in the topics he teaches. His lectures are easy to understand, and the workload in the class is relatively light. His office hours are always open for anyone with questions, or if you just wanna stop by and say hello. 10/10, wonderful professor, would recommend.

So basically Tim is one of the best professors in all of UMD. The class isn't an easy A but it could be if you go to the lectures and pay attention, which is hard not to do because he's so funny. group projects were fun and our TA was super chill too.

I love canty so much and am sad that the semester ended because I cant have him again. He cares for his students and listens to their feedback. Take him youll enjoy the entirety of it he is a GOAT and deserves a Nobel peace prize

His lectures are great, I honestly have never learned so much from an intro level class. If you pay attention to the lectures, you'll truly understand the weather around you. Best professor at UMD!!! His lectures are hilarious and really tries to keep his lectures entertaining even though it can be difficult to make wind direction fun. Hes a fair grader and understands that not everyone in the class wants to be there. Hes amazing and you will learn so much from him. He also records all the lectures

Tim is an excellent, if quirky, lecturer who keeps class interesting with nerdy jokes. If you show up to class and study, you're all but guaranteed an A. He posts old midterms and quizzes online, making studying a matter of effort rather than difficulty. A brilliant man, Tim Canty is by far my favorite professor so far at the University of Maryland

LOVE Tim, the best teacher I have had thus far at UMD. His lectures are so fun and interesting with tons of cool demonstrations, and he puts recordings of his lectures online so you can skip sometimes and still keep up (although his lectures really are fun). I recommend this class to all of my friends and he's the only one who teaches it :)

This class was so easy. It's only graded by a presentation and paper, plus he's an easy grader.
the lectures were also generally interesting even though I didn't do any readings. Attendance is not mandatory but don't skip them all.

reviews.comment: Step 1: Show up every class Step 2: Listen attentively, ask questions Step 3: Get an A There is one presentation and a final essay. No homework, no reading quizzes, no pressure. You just sit down, learn about Karl Marx. Honestly one of my favorite classes I took this semester, and I learned a lot about something I didn't realize I enjoyed.
She teaches and explains things really fast. As long as you do all the quizzes (she drops two), the assignments, do good on all the exams, you will pass!

Simply unaproachable and rude to students that are not gifted. No consideration for the other things going on in students life and expects students to understand her nonsensical lectures at 8am and not ask questions. Exams are so specific its insane and structure of exams is just cruel.

Prof. O'Brien is quite possibly the rudest professor I have ever come across in my college career. She would answer questions before exams by telling students to look it in the dictionary. Great professor, I was worried because of the other reviews but she really cares about this class and her students. She gives snacks on exam days and lets you get 10 extra points for doing exam reviews. Endo is a challenging class no matter who you take it with. But comparing my experiences with my peers, Dr. O'Brien really leads a fair section that, while being work heavy, is still doable. Lectures were a bit scattered but the topics we were to be tested on were clearly outlined and resources were plentiful! A solid instructor for sure.

reviews.comment: Her lectures were very clear and easy to understand and exams are very fair when virtual. But, she makes you ask questions on discussion boards, but closes them pretty early. Not a good lecturer in my opinion. Jumps around and is kind of disorganized which makes learning material 10x harder than it needs to be. Also very nit-picky on grading.
Did not respond to my emails in a good way

Dr. O'Brien is very very intelligent, she's super passionate but is in way over her head. She thinks she's teaching in med school and isn't the best at explaining things. She isn't understanding of online schooling or empathizes with students... If you have an alternative take them if not, oh well.

I took genetics during winter term and it was definitely intense but doable. The exams were fair and Dr. Obrien and the TAs were pretty generous with grading. You will have to dedicate a lot of time to this class but Dr. Obrien made it more enjoyable and really cares about her students.

Prof. O'Brien is unavailable and makes you want to not ask her any questions. She's not very nice and has no problem thinking she's teaching a medical school course. Her exams are tricky in ways that are just mean and she's not empathetic nor understanding of the difficulties of online classes during a global pandemic. Don't take her.

I took BSCI202 online, so the structure might be different. But I think this professor is AMAZING. She put all of the lectures up in mid- July, so honestly, there was plenty of time to work ahead. She has lots of assignments, so your grade isn't solely based on lectures but rather so many different assignments.

Strict on deadlines and not understanding or willing to help. Dont know why there are so many positive reviews. Seems to think she is above helping her students, and will not reply to emails if asking for help on clarification of course material.

Dr. O'Brien is really sweet. Tons of assignments worth like 5 points which are kind of annoying, but she also drops a lot of them so you don't need to complete every single one. I took this as an online summer course so the exams weren't that bad, since they were all open book, open notes.

Professor O'Brien is really caring and energetic. I took Lombardi for AP1 but found O'Brien's class to be a little better. PROS: - TONS of extra credit, just be awake during her early lectures - Records all lectures online - Very fair exams, just take organized notes - Kinda fair curve CONS: - Office hours are kinda dry - Very early lecture

She posts her lecture slides and records her lectures which is helpful, and all of the material from the quizzes and exams are from the lecture slides. However, she does not answer questions or provide clarification on topics or concepts, she just refers you back to her lecture slides which are not very explanatory and is just a list of points.

Dr. O'Brien is GREAT! She posts really detailed videos of her lecture slides and lots of online resources (b/c there is no text book). She really cares if you do well & will do whatever she can to help. Highly recommend! One of the best teachers I've had! (warning: there are a few surprise lecture assignments throughout the semester)

Engaging lectures and tons of extra credit for just participating. The textbook for this class is basically her notes, so you know exactly what to study. She's not always the best at explaining but she records extra Panoptos for us. She genuinely wants us to do well and motivates us all semester to work hard. She's good at seeing the bigger picture

In lecture, Dr. O'Brien is pretty passionate but talks really fast and goes on rants, but she has Panopto recordings of every lecture with everything you need for the exams. Exams tend to focus on specific details so a lot of memorization is needed. She offers a good amount of extra credit which can help.

I posted my review down below but I wanted to add, she record all her lectures on panapto. Something Lombardi doesn't do. I know that because I took Lombardi for A&p1 and had to record them on my phone. She also gives everyone snacks on exam days

Work hard, study efficiently and you will do fine. I never went to office hours or GSS but some say it helps. Just really go over the material, watch videos, do the learning outcomes she provides . Lab is slightly hard then ap1. She shares a lot of facts about things unrelated to lecture and advocates for minorities. She is an okay professor.

She definitely has a political agenda she is trying to brainwash her students with, in an anatomy course. She goes on and on about her opinions on moral issues or random side topics that aren't tested and brazes over important material. I would not take her course again.

Dr. O'Brien is a solid professor. She's a bit quirky and can come off cold sometimes, but she really does want her students to get an A. You could bring cheat sheets to every test, which were on a computer and multiple choice.

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Brien is a gem. She posts her lectures online but she gives random lecture assignments in class for easy points. Her grading is not over the top. Everything on test is based on her lecture slides. Just study and you'll be fine. Only downfall is her slides are 80+ per topic.

Dr. O'Brien is very organized and so are her lectures. Her exams aren't extremely difficult, and she offers extra credit. The only part that was kind of annoying was that she requires every student to post on discussion boards regularly. In order to receive points, you have to participate on the boards regularly.

Dr. O'Brien is terrible, her lectures are necessary if you want to stand a chance in the class since she only posts incomplete slides online. In class she'll spend 20 minutes talking about some weird disorder and how different cultures have different opinions on things (NOT TESTED) but then go through 10 slides in like a minute.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved Dr.O'Brien!! A&P2 is tough because there's so much information to cram into your memory, but I think Dr. O'Brien does a beautiful job at it. Her lectures are memorable as she uses real life examples, but also very clear and to the point. You will have to study days in advance for her tests, but she is super kind and I highly recommend her
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Tests are tough--Would take again

reviews.comment: Lectures are not mandatory, but she does do in-class assignments sometimes. Exams are honestly fair since she provides several resources (old exams, panapto recordings of each body system ) to help prepare, but studying for them still makes you wanna pull your hair out because questions are somewhat detailed. Lab points boost your grade a lot

A&P 2 with OBrien is a HARD class. I studied hours on end for this class and still didn't always receive the grade I would have liked. However, I learned a ton from this class and OBrien's energy was refreshing. Study the practice tests online, take good notes, and actually study (study groups help a lot) and you'll do well in her class.

A lot of people hate on her but she's actually really nice and energetic, especially for an 8 am. A&P is a course with a lot of material in general, but if you put in the hours outside of class and go to GSS it's definitely possible to get As and Bs on the exams as they are very fair. Go to office hours, sit in the front, talk to her, she'll help.

By far the worst professor I have ever encountered at UMD. Avoid at all costs. Exam averages were in the 60s for each exam and she does not curve. The highest grade in my section on the final was an 86. There are other professors for bsci202 who are not condescending and rude. Does not care about student success.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Brien is a great lecturer, and made this class so fun that I am switching my major from Gen Bio to Cell Bio and Genetics. She's quirky and kinda crazy but in a lovable way. Her exams are hard but fair, and there's lots of other assignments to help you bring up your grade. In order to do well, just care and pay attention!

My best advice would be to attend GSS sessions. There is a bunch of stuff on her slides that she does not ever test on, and a lot of diagrams that you may think are unimportant that end up being most imperative. Go to GSS regularly and you'll be fine in this class. She does not give nearly as much e.c. as she should considering the difficulty

If you value your GPA and sanity, you will take any other professor for genetics. I have never experienced anyone who has ever been vile enough to give out tests like the one's she gives out. I've struggled more on her tests than I ever have on an Organic Chemistry test, and she gives minimal compensation for how long and difficult her exams are.

Please do yourself a favor and try to take anatomy with a different professor. I mean it when I say if you're not the type to study 5 hours a day for a class, like 80% of us, then you'll probably get a bad grade or have to repeat the class. It's an 8 o clock class and it's an hour and a half lecture of boring material. Zero effort to help students.

She ruins the subject by expecting you to know minor details on slides she may have skipped over during lecture. Uses the fact that she taught in a medical school to make the class miserable for students who need this class as nothing more than a pre-req, should be an entertaining and enjoyable topic but she manages to make it unbearable!

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. O'Brien's class she's really an entertaining &engaging lecturer. Her class is HARD I took it in the summer. You will study like your life depends on it. Dr. O'Brien seems really impressed with herself and so she is really rude in one-on one conversation.She will invite you to her office to talk and make you feel like an idiot for trying. Eh... Easy class for me.. Only if attend class for assignments i probably get an A but I don't so I have B. I just cram before exam but if you are not a fast learner be prepare to study all the time.

This class is sooooo hard. but you will learn a lot. she talks so fast and sorta feels intimidating. i wish her test werent so hard cus i could of done good. the lab saved my life. be prepared to be studying all the time or put a lot of your time towards this class!

Worst teacher ever..yea, sure she may have more than enough passion to teach it but the material on her exam is impossible to even get a C..sigh i hope UMD get a new teacher for this class.

She is a horrible professor! I am not sure why she is allowed to teach! Beware of this professor she is not nice, doesn't care about students, and doesn't care about your grades...unfortunately there is no other professor for this course :(

She's definitely the best professor to have at 8 am! Her energy and enthusiasm in the topic keeps you interested. She's very approachable  and the textbook is not needed because her lecture notes are really thorough

I'm taking her again this semester for BSCI202

This class is very difficult and requires a lot of time on your part out of class, but Dr. O'Brien is an amazing teacher that knows the material incredibly well and is very passionate in her teaching. I strongly urge you NOT to take this class. Professor Todd does not know how to use ELMS and is extremely disorganized. This course is not worth the headache. Professor Todd said MANY problematic things under the guise of trying to be relatable. I cringed because I could not believe the things he said. He's the most down to earth and kindhearted professor I've had, I'm a senior! He has true understanding for people in his heart, and that's what makes him so amazing. Professor Todd was very helpful and approachable during and outside of class. Make sure you follow along with the rubrics for your assignments.

Professor is the most disorganized ive had at UMD, especially in online environment. ELMs page is highly confusing, with no assignments tab due dates and assignments are difficult to keep track of. AWFUL. His disorganization will cost you your grade. He loves to place blame on other reasons. SOOO UNCLEAR. Can't read anything he writes. He's a nice guy but literally screws your grade. DO NOT TAKE.

Super fun class/lab, seriously recommend. If you complete all the assignments/readings you are guaranteed an A. Professor is also hilarious and has a lot of experience in this field. Take this class!

DEFINITELY RECOMMEND. 10/10

great teacher...really fun and interesting class...would recommend for any major.

Best teacher ever! I idolize him!

so excited that dr t is teaching undergrad classes again! had her for 201 and she was the best hd prof ive had. plus her online class style is fire. just signed up for both online classes she has in the fall

Dr. turpin is one of the kindest professors I've had yet, it's because of him I was able to get my summer internship. He's a wonderful teacher :)

I liked the class, and the group project was interesting.

Great class! This was a requirement for me but I'm happy I took it.
Prof. Turpin is very kind, caring, and flexible, and he made the class enjoyable. Take him!

Good course, good professor.

This was a smooth course. The prof gives homework every week, but theyre short so its not too bad. Lectures were easy to follow. The extra credit and project make this an easy A.
Professor Rodman was very understand about keeping me up to date with class when I was going through covid. He teaches well and extra credit helps very much.

Clear teaching materials and very flexible. Great teacher all around. Would take again.

Kevin was a great student facilitator for this course. Learning about research kits, other laboratory procedures, and troubleshooting were very interesting and fills in the gaps that are left from standard lab courses. Highly recommended to take this course!
Kevin slaps. He's clearly knowledgeable and passionate about the subject while also creating a class environment which doesn't crush you down.

Kevin was an amazing instructor for this course. He was extremely approachable and accessible to ask questions or for further explanations of things. Kevin is honestly the best. He is so caring and listens to students' needs to better improve their learning. He provides so many extra credit options throughout the semester as well. I wished I took his class earlier because all of the troubleshooting would have been helpful in my lab courses.
What a great person, super understanding of students. Easy to approach and communicate with makes it not so scary to ask questions!

Kevin was super nice and definitely put in the effort to make the class as stress-free as possible while still making the course super informative.
